AudioManager:
-- 公共层·AudioManager：UI 音效 + 游戏动作音共用同一开关链
-- 总音量（0~100，作用于 BGM 与全部 SFX）/ 音效开关（两类 SFX 统一）/ 震动反馈（haptic）
-- 所有播放必须走这里，禁止任何绕开开关的硬编码播放。
-- headless（-tool_mode 无音频设备）时 audio 子系统未就绪 → 全部音频操作静默跳过。
local Save = require("SaveStore")
local Sound = {}

local DIR = "Sounds/"

---@type Scene?
local scene_ = nil
---@type Node?
local sfxNode_ = nil
---@type SoundSource?
local musicSource_ = nil
---@type Sound?
local bgmSound_ = nil
local sfxPool_ = {}
local sfxLast_ = {}
local sounds_ = {}
local settings_ = nil

local KNOWN = {
    "ui_click", "cat_low", "cat_mid", "cat_high", "ui_reject", "ui_transition",
    "sfx_jump", "sfx_land", "sfx_drop", "sfx_grab", "sfx_undo", "sfx_restart",
    "sfx_scissors", "sfx_felt", "sfx_home", "sfx_meow", "sfx_warning", "sfx_step", "bgm_loop",
}

-- 音频子系统就绪检测（headless 下 IsInitialized=false，避免触碰未初始化的 mixer）
local function audioReady()
    if audio == nil then return false end
    local ok, initialized = pcall(function() return audio:IsInitialized() end)
    return ok and initialized == true
end

function Sound.Init(context)
    settings_ = Save.Load().settings
    if not audioReady() then return end
    scene_ = Scene(nil)
    sfxNode_ = scene_:CreateChild("SfxRoot")
    musicSource_ = sfxNode_:CreateComponent("SoundSource")
    musicSource_.soundType = SOUND_MUSIC
    for _, name in ipairs(KNOWN) do
        local ok, snd = pcall(function() return cache:GetResource("Sound", DIR .. name .. ".wav") end)
        sounds_[name] = ok and snd or nil
    end
    bgmSound_ = sounds_.bgm_loop
    if bgmSound_ then bgmSound_.looped=true end
    Sound.ApplyVolumes()
end

---@param settings table|nil 不传则读存档
function Sound.SetSettings(settings)
    settings_ = settings or Save.Load().settings
    Sound.ApplyVolumes()
end

-- 试听单项设置时合并当前音频配置，避免覆盖其他开关。
function Sound.PreviewSettings(patch)
    local merged = {}
    for key, value in pairs(Sound.GetSettings()) do merged[key] = value end
    for key, value in pairs(patch or {}) do merged[key] = value end
    settings_ = merged
    Sound.ApplyVolumes()
end

function Sound.GetSettings()
    return settings_ or Save.defaultSettings
end

-- 总音量作用在 master gain；「音效关」只静音 SFX 类型通道（游戏动作音 + UI 交互音两类都在内）
function Sound.ApplyVolumes()
    if not audioReady() then return end
    local s = Sound.GetSettings()
    local master = math.max(0, math.min(100, s.sound or 80)) / 100
    audio:SetMasterGain(SOUND_EFFECT, master * (s.effects or 80) / 100)
    audio:SetMasterGain(SOUND_MUSIC, master * (s.music or 80) / 100)
    if not s.sfx then
        if not audio:IsSoundTypePaused(SOUND_EFFECT) then audio:PauseSoundType(SOUND_EFFECT) end
    elseif audio:IsSoundTypePaused(SOUND_EFFECT) then
        audio:ResumeSoundType(SOUND_EFFECT)
    end
    if master <= 0 then
        if not audio:IsSoundTypePaused(SOUND_MUSIC) then audio:PauseSoundType(SOUND_MUSIC) end
    elseif audio:IsSoundTypePaused(SOUND_MUSIC) then
        audio:ResumeSoundType(SOUND_MUSIC)
    end
end

local function play(name, gain, pitch)
    if not audioReady() or sfxNode_ == nil then return end
    local s = Sound.GetSettings()
    if not s.sfx then return end -- 音效关：两类 SFX 全静
    if (s.sound or 0) <= 0 then return end
    local snd = sounds_[name]
    if not snd then return end
    local now = time:GetElapsedTime()
    -- 同一声音 60ms 内不连发（边沿语义，长按不刷屏）
    if sfxLast_[name] and now - sfxLast_[name] < 0.06 then return end
    sfxLast_[name] = now
    for i = 1, #sfxPool_ do
        local src = sfxPool_[i]
        if not src.playing then
            src:Play(snd, snd:GetFrequency() * (pitch or 1), gain or 1.0)
            return
        end
    end
    if #sfxPool_ >= 16 then return end
    local node = sfxNode_:CreateChild("sfx" .. (#sfxPool_ + 1))
    local fresh = node:CreateComponent("SoundSource")
    fresh.soundType = SOUND_EFFECT
    sfxPool_[#sfxPool_ + 1] = fresh
    fresh:Play(snd, snd:GetFrequency() * (pitch or 1), gain or 1.0)
end

-- ===== UI 音效规范 =====
-- 通用点击「嗒」：菜单按钮 / 关卡卡片 / 切猫卡片 / 设置控件（边沿，长按不连发）
function Sound.Click() play("ui_click", 0.8) end

-- 切换猫「叮」：三猫不同音高（汤低/煤中/奶高），闭眼也分得清
function Sound.CatSwitch(index)
    local names = { "cat_low", "cat_mid", "cat_high" }
    play(names[index] or "cat_mid", 0.9)
end

-- 拒绝「噔」：未解锁关卡 / 顶球钻缝失败 / 其他被拒绝操作
function Sound.Reject() play("ui_reject", 0.9) end

-- 场景过渡音：进选择页 / 回主菜单 / 加载完成
function Sound.Transition() play("ui_transition", 0.7) end

-- ===== 游戏动作音 =====
Sound.Sfx = play
function Sound.Jump() play("sfx_jump", 0.7) end
function Sound.Land() play("sfx_land", 0.6) end
function Sound.Drop() play("sfx_drop", 0.8) end
function Sound.Grab() play("sfx_grab", 0.8) end
function Sound.Undo() play("sfx_undo", 0.9) end
function Sound.Restart() play("sfx_restart", 0.8) end
function Sound.Scissors() play("sfx_scissors", 0.9) end
function Sound.Felt() play("sfx_felt", 0.9) end
function Sound.Home() play("sfx_home", 1.0) end
function Sound.Meow() play("sfx_meow", 1.0) end
function Sound.Warning() play("sfx_warning", 0.8) end

-- ===== 移动端硬件震动（受「震动反馈」开关控制；不支持的设备静默跳过） =====
function Sound.Vibrate(level)
    local s = Sound.GetSettings()
    if not s.haptic then return end
    if sdk == nil then return end
    -- Haptics are documented by the engine; the bundled SDK declaration omits them.
    local device=sdk --[[@as table<string, any>]]
    if level == "heavy" then
        if device.VibrateLong then pcall(function() device:VibrateLong() end) end
    else
        if device.VibrateShort then pcall(function() device:VibrateShort(level or "light") end) end
    end
end

-- ===== BGM（受总音量控制；「音效」开关只管 SFX 两类） =====
function Sound.PlayBGM()
    if not audioReady() or bgmSound_ == nil or musicSource_ == nil then return end
    local s = Sound.GetSettings()
    if (s.sound or 0) <= 0 then return end
    if musicSource_.playing then return end
    musicSource_:Play(bgmSound_, bgmSound_:GetFrequency(), 0.35)
end

function Sound.StopBGM()
    if musicSource_ then musicSource_:Stop() end
end

return Sound
BounceSofa:
-- 可复用弹跳沙发：只有落到坐垫或主动在坐垫上跳跃才加弹力。
local Sofa = {}
Sofa.__index = Sofa

function Sofa.New(options)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Sofa)
    self:Init(options or {})
    return self
end

function Sofa:Init(options)
    self.x = options.x or 12.8
    self.w = options.w or 1.2
    self.y = options.y or 0.25
    self.bonus = options.bonus or 2
    self.compression = 0
    self.bounces = 0
end

--       猫脚底下降穿过坐垫上沿 → 普通跳高 + 2 格
--       [--------- 坐垫 --------] y=0.25
--       |                      | 地板 y=0
-- 走路不自动弹；顶球不改弹力；毡球自身不具有弹性，但不妨碍猫使用沙发。
function Sofa:Contains(x)
    return x >= self.x and x <= self.x + self.w
end

function Sofa:LaunchSpeed(jumpHeight, gravity, dt)
    self.compression = 1
    self.bounces = self.bounces + 1
    -- 半隐式积分损失半步高度，用半步补偿保持标称跳高，而非偷偷增加规则数值。
    return math.sqrt(2 * gravity * (jumpHeight + self.bonus)) + gravity * dt / 2
end

function Sofa:Update(dt)
    self.compression = math.max(0, self.compression - dt * 4)
end

function Sofa:Snapshot()
    return { compression = self.compression, bounces = self.bounces }
end

function Sofa:Restore(snapshot)
    self.compression, self.bounces = snapshot.compression, snapshot.bounces
end

return Sofa
ButtonHold:
-- 保持式按钮：沿用第2关的 pressed/remaining/releaseDelay 定义。
-- 猫或无主球持续压住时生效，离开后等待2秒；多个按钮可以串联为AND门。
local ButtonHold = {}

function ButtonHold.Weight(game, button)
    local weight = 0
    for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        local cx = cat.x + (cat.w or 0.95) / 2
        if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.y - (button.y or 0)) < 0.08
            and cx >= button.x and cx <= button.x + button.w then
            weight = weight + cat.weight
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        local cx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.holeRoute and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
            and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - (button.y or 0)) < 0.001 and math.abs(ball.vy or 0) < 0.001
            and cx >= button.x and cx <= button.x + button.w then
            weight = weight + ball.weight
        end
    end
    return weight
end

function ButtonHold.Tick(button, weight, dt)
    local oldPressed = button.pressed or false
    local oldActive = button.activated or false
    local pressed = weight >= (button.need or 1)
    button.pressed = pressed
    if pressed then button.remaining = button.releaseDelay or 2
    else button.remaining = math.max(0, (button.remaining or 0) - dt) end
    button.activated = pressed or button.remaining > 0.0001
    return oldPressed ~= pressed or oldActive ~= button.activated
end

function ButtonHold.AllActive(buttons)
    if #buttons == 0 then return false end
    for _, button in ipairs(buttons) do if not button.activated then return false end end
    return true
end

return ButtonHold

local function Shade(c, f, a)
    return { math.floor(c[1] * f + 0.5), math.floor(c[2] * f + 0.5), math.floor(c[3] * f + 0.5), a or c[4] or 255 }
end

local function Fill(ctx, color)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(color[1], color[2], color[3], color[4] or 255))
    nvgFill(ctx)
end

local function Stroke(ctx, color, width)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(color[1], color[2], color[3], color[4] or 255))
    nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, width or 1.5)
    nvgStroke(ctx)
end

local function Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, radius, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, radius or 0)
    Fill(ctx, color)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline, 1.5) end
end

local function Ellipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    nvgEllipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry)
    Fill(ctx, color)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline, 1.4) end
end

local function Circle(ctx, x, y, r, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    nvgCircle(ctx, x, y, r)
    Fill(ctx, color)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline, 1.4) end
end

local function Poly(ctx, points, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    nvgMoveTo(ctx, points[1], points[2])
    for i = 3, #points, 2 do nvgLineTo(ctx, points[i], points[i + 1]) end
    nvgClosePath(ctx)
    Fill(ctx, color)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline, 1.4) end
end

local function Text(ctx, x, y, value, size, color, preserveInk)
    -- 旧版场景标签不再承担玩法说明；过滤非 ASCII 文本也保证 English 模式无中文漏出。
    if type(value) == "string" then
        for i = 1, #value do if value:byte(i) > 127 then return end end
    end
    if sceneDark and not preserveInk and color[1]+color[2]+color[3]<380 then color={238,219,178,color[4] or 255} end
    nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans")
    nvgFontSize(ctx, math.max(11,size or 11) * (Save.GetSetting("textScale") or 1))
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER + NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(color[1], color[2], color[3], color[4] or 255))
    nvgText(ctx, x, y, value, nil)
end

local function Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)

local function Arrow(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)

    Poly(ctx, { x2, y2, x2 - math.cos(a - 0.55) * 8, y2 - math.sin(a - 0.55) * 8,
        x2 - math.cos(a + 0.55) * 8, y2 - math.sin(a + 0.55) * 8 }, color)
end

local function DrawPlant(ctx,x,ground,s)
    Ellipse(ctx,x,ground+1,s*.27,s*.055,{86,65,44,25})
    for i=1,5 do
        local side=i%2==0 and -1 or 1
        local tipX=x+side*s*(.26+(i%3)*.11)
        local tipY=ground-s*(.68+i*.09)
        local rootY=ground-s*.29
        nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgMoveTo(ctx,x,rootY)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx,x-side*s*.04,tipY+s*.16,tipX-side*s*.15,tipY-s*.06,tipX,tipY)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx,tipX+side*s*.08,tipY+s*.17,x+side*s*.16,rootY-s*.04,x,rootY)
        nvgClosePath(ctx);Fill(ctx,{117+i*3,151+i*2,105+i*2,205})
        nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgMoveTo(ctx,x,rootY)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx,x+side*s*.07,rootY-s*.16,tipX-side*s*.06,tipY+s*.12,tipX,tipY)

    Poly(ctx,{x-s*.23,ground-s*.32,x+s*.23,ground-s*.32,x+s*.17,ground,x-s*.17,ground},

local function DrawRoom(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
    local room = ROOM[game.level] or ROOM[1]
    if game.level==10 and HighContrast(game) then

        room={wall={177,162,148,255},floor={185,145,106,255},trim={224,187,131,255},accent=room.accent}
    end
    if game.level == 3 then
        BathroomArt.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
        return room
    end
    if game.level == 6 then
        KitchenArt.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
        return room
    end
    if game.level == 1 or game.level == 2 or game.level == 5 then
        LivingArt.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
        return room
    end
    if game.level == 7 or game.level == 8 or game.level == 9 then
        UtilityArt.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
        return room
    end
    local contrast = (game.level == 10 or game.level == 11) and HighContrast(game) or false
    if AtmosphereArt.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy, contrast) then return room end
    local x, y, w = layout.x, layout.y, layout.w
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    nvgRect(ctx, x, y, w, ground - y)
    nvgFillPaint(ctx, nvgLinearGradient(ctx, x, y, x, ground, nvgRGBA(room.wall[1], room.wall[2], room.wall[3], 255),
        nvgRGBA(math.floor(room.wall[1] * 0.94), math.floor(room.wall[2] * 0.94), math.floor(room.wall[3] * 0.94), 255)))
    nvgFill(ctx)
    for i = 0, 8 do Line(ctx, x + i * w / 8, y, x + i * w / 8, ground, Shade(room.floor, 1.08, game.level >= 10 and 25 or 28), 1) end
    DrawRoomProps(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy, room)
    Craft.RoomAccents(ctx,game.level,unit,wx,gy)
    DrawFloor(ctx, layout, ground, room)
    return room
end

local function IsMachineActive(game, id)
    local indexed=game.machineById and game.machineById[id]
    if indexed then return indexed.active==true end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do
        if machine.id == id then return machine.active == true end
    end
    return false
end

local function DrawPlatform(ctx, platform, unit, wx, gy, room, game)
    if game.level == 3 then
        BathroomArt.Platform(ctx, platform, game, unit, wx, gy)
        return
    end
    if LivingArt.Platform(ctx, platform, game, unit, wx, gy) then return end
    if UtilityArt.Platform(ctx, platform, game, unit, wx, gy) then return end
    local x = wx(platform.x)
    local w = platform.w * unit
    local h = math.max(platform.h * unit, 7)
    local y0 = Details.PlatformY(game,platform,platform.x+platform.w*.5) or 0
    local topY = gy(y0 + (platform.h or 0.14))
    if platform.requiresActive and not platform.riseHeight and not IsMachineActive(game,platform.requiresActive) then
        Line(ctx,x,topY,x+w,topY,{126,114,94,95},2)
        for i=1,4 do Circle(ctx,x+i*w/5,topY,2.2,{126,114,94,90}) end
        return
    end
    if platform.riseHeight and platform.requiresActive then
        local active = IsMachineActive(game, platform.requiresActive)
        local ghostY = gy((platform.riseHeight or y0) + (platform.h or 0.14))
        Rect(ctx, x, ghostY, w, h, 3, Shade(room.accent, 1.05, active and 190 or 80), Shade(room.accent, 0.65, active and 210 or 95))
        topY = active and ghostY or topY
    end
    if platform.ramp then
        local yA = gy((platform.y or 0) + (platform.h or 0.12))
        local yB = gy((platform.y1 or platform.y or 0) + (platform.h or 0.12))
        Poly(ctx, { x, yA, x + w, yB, x + w, yB + h, x, yA + h }, { 180, 134, 88, 245 }, { 112, 82, 56, 230 })
    else
        local face = platform.id=="sailDeck" and {191,185,139,245} or platform.soft and {184,151,103,245} or {141,98,62,250}
        Rect(ctx, x, topY + 3, w, h + 4, 4, face, {96,68,47,235})
        Rect(ctx, x, topY, w, math.max(6,h*.55), 4,
            platform.soft and {222,196,145,255} or {190,145,94,255}, {112,82,56,245})
        Line(ctx,x+4,topY+2,x+w-4,topY+2,{244,213,157,130},1.2)
        for k = 1, math.max(1, math.floor(platform.w)) do
            local seam=x+k*w/(math.floor(platform.w)+1)
            Line(ctx,seam,topY+3,seam,topY+h+5,{91,63,43,115},1)
        end
        if platform.id=="sailDeck" then
            Poly(ctx,{x,topY,x+w*.5,topY-.7*unit,x+w,topY},{226,216,172,220},{114,139,123,230})
        end
        if y0>.25 then
            Poly(ctx,{x+7,topY+h+4,x+18,topY+h+4,x+7,topY+h+16},{123,84,55,210})
            Poly(ctx,{x+w-7,topY+h+4,x+w-18,topY+h+4,x+w-7,topY+h+16},{123,84,55,210})
        end
    end
    if game.level==1 and not platform.ramp then
        Craft.Wood(ctx,x,topY,w,h+3,{181,133,86,255})

    if platform.requiresActive then
        Dots(ctx, x + w / 2 - 7, topY - 10, 2, room.accent)
    else
        Circle(ctx,x+8,topY+4,1.8,{92,66,46,170})
        Circle(ctx,x+w-8,topY+4,1.8,{92,66,46,170})
    end
end

    local kind = zone.kind=="finale_vacuum" and "vacuum" or zone.kind=="finale_water_basin" and "water" or zone.kind
    local fill = kind == "water" and { 104, 176, 204, 165 }
        or kind == "wind" and { 170, 212, 218, 110 } or kind == "windTrack" and { 166, 205, 210, 130 }
        or kind == "carpet" and { 155, 128, 154, 155 } or kind == "vacuum" and { 114, 124, 136, 170 }

-- A plate and the door it powers share one visible circuit.  The muted cable
-- explains the relationship at rest; moving green beads confirm power flow.
local function DrawPlateDoorLinks(ctx, game, unit, wx, gy, left, right)
    local machines = game.campaign.machines or {}
    local byId = game.machineById or {}
    local selected=game.sheep[game.active]
    local reduced=Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion")==true
    for _, door in ipairs(machines) do
        if door.kind == "door" and door.requires then
            for inputIndex, requirement in ipairs(door.requires) do
                local plate = byId[requirement]
                if not plate then
                    for _, candidate in ipairs(machines) do
                        if candidate.id == requirement then plate = candidate break end
                    end
                end
                local weighted=plate and (plate.kind == "plate" or plate.kind == "laserPlate")
                local nearby=plate and (math.abs(selected.x-plate.x)<3 or math.abs(selected.x-door.x)<3)
                if plate and (weighted or nearby) then
                    local powered = plate.pressed or plate.active
                    local color = weighted and (powered and {126,184,98,235} or {157,132,92,175})
                        or (powered and {91,177,190,235} or {99,126,133,175})
                    local startX = wx((plate.x or 0) + (plate.w or .9) * .5)
                    local startY = gy((plate.y or 0) + .08)
                    local endX = wx((door.x or 0) + (door.w or .55) * .5)+(inputIndex-1)*3
                    local endY = gy((door.y or 0) + .72)
                    local railY = gy(math.min((plate.y or 0) + .24, .32)+(inputIndex-1)*.075)
                    -- A dark seam keeps the circuit legible on pale and dark rooms.
                    Line(ctx,startX,railY,endX,railY,{50,60,52,125},powered and 5 or 3.5)
                    Line(ctx, startX, startY, startX, railY, color, powered and 3 or 2)
                    Line(ctx, startX, railY, endX, railY, color, powered and 3 or 2)
                    Line(ctx, endX, railY, endX, endY, color, powered and 3 or 2)
                    if nearby and endX>right-12 and startX<right-44 then
                        Arrow(ctx,right-44,railY,right-14,railY,color,2.5)
                    elseif nearby and endX<left+12 and startX>left+44 then
                        Arrow(ctx,left+44,railY,left+14,railY,color,2.5)
                    end
                    Circle(ctx, startX, startY, powered and 4.2 or 3.4, color, { 89, 75, 57, 150 })
                    Circle(ctx, endX, endY, powered and 4.2 or 3.4, color, { 89, 75, 57, 150 })
                    if nearby and not weighted then
                        local badge=powered and "+" or "-"
                        WeightBadge(ctx,startX,gy((plate.y or 0)+.8),badge,powered)
                    end
                    if powered then
                        local direction = endX >= startX and 1 or -1
                        local distance = math.abs(endX - startX)
                        for i = 0, 3 do
                            local phase = ((reduced and 0 or (game.clock or 0)) * 1.35 + i * .25) % 1
                            local beadX = startX + direction * distance * phase
                            Circle(ctx, beadX, railY, 3.2, { 218, 241, 178, 235 })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local alternate=door.alternativeLatch and byId[door.alternativeLatch]
            if alternate then
                local color=alternate.active and {91,177,190,235} or {99,126,133,175}
                local sx,ex=wx(alternate.x),wx(door.x)
                local rail=gy(.55)
                Line(ctx,sx,gy(.18),sx,rail,color,2)
                Line(ctx,sx,rail,ex,rail,color,2)
                Arrow(ctx,ex,rail,ex,gy(.72),color,2)
                if alternate.active then WeightBadge(ctx,ex,gy(1.15),"+",true) end
            end
            if door.open and door.latch and byId[door.latch] and byId[door.latch].active then
                WeightBadge(ctx,wx(door.x+(door.w or .55)*.5),gy((door.y or 0)+1.15),"+",true)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Mechanical controls use a cool-blue cable so they cannot be confused with
-- the green plate/door power circuit.  The arrow points at the moving result.
local function DrawControlLinks(ctx, game, unit, wx, gy)
    local machines = game.campaign.machines or {}
    local byId = game.machineById or {}
    for _,m in ipairs(machines) do
        if m.kind=="exp_chute" then
            local target=m.target and byId[m.target]
            local tx,ty=target and target.x or m.targetX,target and (target.y or 0) or m.targetY
            local cat=game.sheep[game.active]
            if tx and (math.abs(cat.x-m.x)<3 or math.abs(cat.x-tx)<3) then
                local color=m.active and {91,177,190,225} or {99,126,133,130}
                local y=gy((m.y or 0)+.35)
                Line(ctx,wx(m.x),y,wx(tx),y,color,2)
                Arrow(ctx,wx(tx),y,wx(tx),gy((ty or 0)+.12),color,2)
            end
        end
    end
    local relay=byId.materialRelay
    if relay then
        local open=byId.aExitLatch and byId.aExitLatch.active
        local color=open and {91,177,190,210} or {99,126,133,120}
        local endX=wx(16.9)
        for _,id in ipairs({"plateA","plateB"}) do
            local source=byId[id]
            if source then
                local sx=wx(source.x+(source.w or 1)*.5)
                local rail=gy(.10)
                Line(ctx,sx,rail,endX,rail,color,2)
            end
        end
        Arrow(ctx,wx(relay.x),gy(.10),endX,gy(.10),color,2.5)
    end
    for _, platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms or {}) do
        if platform.requiresActive then
            local control = byId[platform.requiresActive]
            if not control then
                for _, candidate in ipairs(machines) do
                    if candidate.id == platform.requiresActive then control = candidate break end
                end
            end
            local kind = control and control.kind
            local visualControl = kind == "switch" or kind == "windControl" or kind == "pulley"
                or kind == "bridge" or kind == "seesaw" or kind == "prop"
                or kind=="exp_red_target" or kind=="exp_sail"
            if visualControl then
                local active = control.active == true
                local color = active and { 91, 177, 190, 225 } or { 99, 126, 133, 125 }
                local startX = wx((control.x or 0) + (control.w or 0) * .5)
                local startY = gy((control.y or 0) + .18)
                local endX = wx((platform.x or 0) + (platform.w or 1) * .5)
                local endY = gy((platform.y or 0) + (platform.lift or 0) + (platform.h or .16) * .5)
                local railY = gy(math.min((control.y or 0) + .38, .52))
                Line(ctx, startX, startY, startX, railY, color, active and 3 or 2)
                Line(ctx, startX, railY, endX, railY, color, active and 3 or 2)
                Arrow(ctx, endX, railY, endX, endY, color, active and 3 or 2)
                Circle(ctx, startX, startY, active and 4.2 or 3.4, color, { 66, 82, 86, 150 })
                if active then
                    local direction = endX >= startX and 1 or -1
                    local distance = math.abs(endX - startX)
                    for i = 0, 2 do
                        local phase = ((Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion") and 0 or (game.clock or 0)) * 1.15 + i / 3) % 1
                        Circle(ctx, startX + direction * distance * phase, railY, 3.1, { 184, 234, 237, 235 })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function DrawCutStation(ctx, machine, game, mx, my, unit)
    local reacting = (machine.reactionTimer or 0) > 0
    local elapsed = 2 - (machine.reactionTimer or 0)
    local closing = reacting and elapsed < .65 and math.sin(elapsed / .65 * math.pi) or 0
    local wood = { 224, 189, 140, 255 }
    Ellipse(ctx, mx, my + .025 * unit, .65 * unit, .07 * unit, { 81, 62, 43, 45 })
    Rect(ctx, mx - .50 * unit, my - .42 * unit, .13 * unit, .42 * unit, 3,
        { 152, 104, 65, 255 }, { 104, 77, 51, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, mx + .37 * unit, my - .42 * unit, .13 * unit, .42 * unit, 3,
        { 152, 104, 65, 255 }, { 104, 77, 51, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, mx - .62 * unit, my - .48 * unit, 1.24 * unit, .14 * unit, 5,
        wood, { 133, 95, 61, 255 })
    Line(ctx, mx - .53 * unit, my - .43 * unit, mx + .53 * unit, my - .43 * unit,
        { 249, 222, 180, 255 }, 2)
    -- 剪刀立在独立的浅色背板前，保持原交互位置与碰撞不变。
    Rect(ctx, mx - .28 * unit, my - .43 * unit, .56 * unit, .36 * unit, 6,
        { 246, 229, 195, 255 }, { 160, 120, 78, 230 })
    DrawScissors(ctx, mx, my - .30 * unit, .60 * unit, closing)

    -- 功能牌是道具的一部分；白底避免毛球和箭头混进后方木桌。
    local signY = my - 1.01 * unit
    Rect(ctx, mx - .68 * unit, signY, 1.36 * unit, .38 * unit, 7,
        { 255, 247, 224, 255 }, { 163, 133, 93, 235 })
    local cy = signY + .19 * unit
    local yarn = { 210, 142, 80, 255 }
    YarnArt.YarnBall(ctx, mx - .43 * unit, cy, .135 * unit, yarn, 1, "full")
    Arrow(ctx, mx - .23 * unit, cy, mx + .04 * unit, cy, { 91, 131, 76, 255 }, 2)
    -- 两个半圆分离，平直切面相对；不再用缩小的整球代替半球。
    for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
        local cx = mx + (.36 + side * .085) * unit
        nvgBeginPath(ctx)
        nvgArc(ctx, cx, cy, .135 * unit, side == -1 and math.pi * .5 or -math.pi * .5,
            side == -1 and math.pi * 1.5 or math.pi * .5, NVG_CW)
        nvgClosePath(ctx)
        Fill(ctx, yarn)
        Stroke(ctx, { 139, 92, 52, 255 }, 1.4)
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local offset = i * .035 * unit
            Line(ctx, cx + side * .02 * unit, cy - offset, cx + side * .09 * unit, cy - offset,
                { 164, 106, 56, 235 }, 1.2)
        end
        Line(ctx, cx, cy - .12 * unit, cx, cy + .12 * unit, { 251, 213, 154, 255 }, 2)
    end
    if reacting then
        for i = 0, 3 do
            local a = math.pi * .25 + i * math.pi * .5
            Line(ctx, mx + math.cos(a) * .42 * unit, my - .26 * unit + math.sin(a) * .28 * unit,
                mx + math.cos(a) * .50 * unit, my - .26 * unit + math.sin(a) * .36 * unit,
                { 206, 158, 72, 220 }, 2)
        end
    end
end

        if not doorOpen then

-- Readability is applied above the existing per-room art. No scenery or fake
-- platform is promoted to gameplay; every cap follows the real support surface.
local function DrawSupportEdge(ctx, game, platform, unit, wx, gy, left, right)
    if platform.collapsed then return end
    if platform.requiresActive and not platform.riseHeight and not IsMachineActive(game,platform.requiresActive) then return end
    if platform.id=="ropeDeck" and IsMachineActive(game,"wideBridge") then return end
    local x0,x1=wx(platform.x),wx(platform.x+platform.w)
    if x1<left or x0>right then return end
    local h=platform.h or .14
    local y0=gy((Details.PlatformY(game,platform,platform.x) or 0)+h)
    local y1=gy((Details.PlatformY(game,platform,platform.x+platform.w) or 0)+h)
    local inset=math.min(3,(x1-x0)*.08)
    local edge=sceneDark and {236,215,165,240} or {250,235,196,245}
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgLineCap(ctx,NVG_ROUND)
    Line(ctx,x0+inset,y0,x1-inset,y1,{85,82,61,195},math.max(2.5,math.min(3.8,unit*.042)))
    -- The bright line is just inside, not above, the collision top.
    Line(ctx,x0+inset,y0+1,x1-inset,y1+1,edge,math.max(1.4,math.min(2.3,unit*.026)))
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

local mechanismStates=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function DrawOperatingParts(ctx, game, unit, wx, gy, left, right)
    local state=mechanismStates[game]
    if not state or state.attempt~=game.campaign.attemptId then
        state={attempt=game.campaign.attemptId,machines={}};mechanismStates[game]=state
    end
    local clock=game.clock or 0
    for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do
        local part=Visual.ControlPart(game,m)
        local signature=tostring(m.active)..tostring(m.mode)..tostring(m.running)..tostring(m.open)..tostring(m.used)
            ..tostring(part and part.state)
        local known=state.machines[m.id]
        if not known then known={signature=signature,changed=-10};state.machines[m.id]=known
        elseif known.signature~=signature then known.signature,known.changed=signature,clock end
        local elapsed=clock-known.changed
        if part then
            local px,py=wx(part.x),gy(part.y)
            if px>=left-16 and px<=right+16 then
                local radius=math.max(3.8,part.radius*unit)
                local color=part.state and {193,218,147,255} or {232,205,137,255}
                Circle(ctx,px,py,radius,color,{92,85,62,245})
                Line(ctx,px-radius*.30,py-radius*.30,px+radius*.18,py-radius*.40,{255,245,214,240},1.25)
                if elapsed>=0 and elapsed<.55 then
                    local fade=math.floor((1-elapsed/.55)*190)
                    for i=0,2 do
                        local angle=-math.pi*.75+i*math.pi*.5
                        Line(ctx,px+math.cos(angle)*(radius+3),py+math.sin(angle)*(radius+3),
                            px+math.cos(angle)*(radius+7),py+math.sin(angle)*(radius+7),{133,163,99,fade},1.8)
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif elapsed>=0 and elapsed<.55 then
            local shape=Visual.ActionShape(game,m)
            local px,py=wx(shape.x),gy(shape.y)
            if px>=left-20 and px<=right+20 then
                nvgBeginPath(ctx)
                if shape.radius then nvgCircle(ctx,px,py,shape.radius*unit+3)
                else nvgRoundedRect(ctx,px-shape.w*unit*.5-2,py-shape.h*unit*.5-2,shape.w*unit+4,shape.h*unit+4,6) end
                Stroke(ctx,{144,178,110,math.floor((1-elapsed/.55)*165)},2)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function DrawCandidateOutline(ctx, shape, unit, wx, gy, color, clock)
    local px,py=wx(shape.x),gy(shape.y)
    local gap=3+math.sin(clock*4)*.5
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    if shape.radius then nvgCircle(ctx,px,py,math.max(8,shape.radius*unit)+gap)
    else nvgRoundedRect(ctx,px-shape.w*unit*.5-gap,py-shape.h*unit*.5-gap,
        shape.w*unit+gap*2,shape.h*unit+gap*2,math.min(9,unit*.12)) end
    -- Dark seam under the pale edge survives both cream cabinets and dark rooms.
    Stroke(ctx,{78,80,59,205},4.8)
    Stroke(ctx,{255,248,222,245},3.1)
    Stroke(ctx,color,1.65)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

function Art.Scene(ctx, game, layout, metrics)
    local def, c = game.def, game.campaign
    sceneDark=game.level==10 and not HighContrast(game)
    local x, y, w, h = layout.x, layout.y, layout.w, layout.h
    local unit, left, ground = metrics.unit, metrics.left, metrics.ground
    local function wx(worldX) return left + worldX * unit end
    local function gy(worldY) return ground - worldY * unit end

    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, x, y, w, h)
    local room = DrawRoom(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
    if def.gap then
        local gap=def.gap
        Rect(ctx,wx(gap.x0),ground,(gap.x1-gap.x0)*unit,math.abs(gap.depth)*unit,0,{77,63,54,255},{117,89,63,230})
        Line(ctx,wx(gap.x0),gy(gap.tunnelY),wx(gap.x1),gy(gap.tunnelY),{194,158,117,210},4)
        local tunnelMid=wx((gap.x0+gap.x1)*.5)
        Arrow(ctx,tunnelMid-.45*unit,gy(gap.tunnelY)-12,tunnelMid+.45*unit,gy(gap.tunnelY)-12,{235,211,164,190},1.8)
    end

    for _,cover in ipairs(def.coverZones or {}) do
        if not cover.requires or IsMachineActive(game,cover.requires) then
        Rect(ctx,wx(cover.x0),ground-unit*.8,(cover.x1-cover.x0)*unit,unit*.8,5,{54,51,48,85},{131,123,107,170})
        local coverMid=wx((cover.x0+cover.x1)*.5)
        Ellipse(ctx,coverMid,ground-unit*.48,.22*unit,.10*unit,{215,198,163,55},{215,198,163,125})
        end
    end
    for _, zone in ipairs(c.zones or {}) do DrawZone(ctx, zone, unit, wx, ground, game) end
    for _, platform in ipairs(c.platforms or {}) do DrawPlatform(ctx, platform, unit, wx, gy, room, game) end
    DrawPlateDoorLinks(ctx, game, unit, wx, gy,x,x+w)
    DrawControlLinks(ctx, game, unit, wx, gy)
    for _, wall in ipairs(c.walls or {}) do
        local handled = LivingArt.Wall and LivingArt.Wall(ctx, wall, game, unit, wx, gy)
        if not handled and UtilityArt.Wall then handled = UtilityArt.Wall(ctx, wall, game, unit, wx, gy) end
        if not handled and game.level == 6 then handled = KitchenArt.Wall(ctx, wall, game, unit, wx, gy) end
        if not handled then DrawWall(ctx, wall, unit, wx, gy, game) end
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(c.machines or {}) do DrawMachine(ctx, machine, game, unit, wx, gy, ground, room) end
    for _, platform in ipairs(c.platforms or {}) do DrawSupportEdge(ctx,game,platform,unit,wx,gy,x,x+w) end
    DrawOperatingParts(ctx,game,unit,wx,gy,x,x+w)


    if c.secret and not c.secretCollected then DrawSecret(ctx, c.secret, wx, gy, unit) end

    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost and not ball.inWasher
            and ball.state~="consumed" and ball.state~="stored"
            and ball.state~="inWasher" and ball.state~="dustbin" then
            local radius = ball.w * unit * 0.5
            YarnArt.YarnBall(ctx, wx(ball.x + ball.w / 2), gy(ball.y or 0) - radius,
                radius, YARN_COLORS[ball.owner] or { 208, 160, 92, 255 }, 1,
                ball.felt and "felt" or ball.kind)
            if ball.charged then
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    Line(ctx, wx(ball.x) + i * radius * 0.45, gy(ball.y or 0) - radius - i * 3,
                        wx(ball.x) + i * radius * 0.65 + 5, gy(ball.y or 0) - radius - i * 7, { 230, 206, 92, 230 }, 1.6)
                end
            end
            if ball.source == "decoy" then Text(ctx, wx(ball.x + ball.w / 2), gy(ball.y or 0) - radius * 2.2, "假", 8, { 126, 82, 46, 230 }) end
        end
    end

    DrawHome(ctx, game, wx, gy, unit)
    local order = { 1, 2, 3 }
    table.sort(order, function(a, b)
        local ay,by=game.sheep[a].y,game.sheep[b].y
        if ay~=by then return ay>by end
        if a==game.active then return false end
        if b==game.active then return true end
        return a<b
    end)
    for _, index in ipairs(order) do
        local cat = game.sheep[index]
        local carried = Room.CarriedBall(game, index)
        local bodyScale=index==1 and 1.0 or index==2 and .88 or .72
        local width = CAT_W * unit*bodyScale*(1+(cat.weightBonus or 0)*.07)
        local centerX = wx(cat.x + CAT_W / 2)
        local feetY = gy(cat.y)
        if cat.arrived and cat.homeSlot then
            local homeX,homeY=Room.HomeCenter(game,cat.homeSlot)
            centerX,feetY=wx(homeX),gy(homeY)
        end
        Cats.Draw(ctx, centerX-width*.5, feetY, width, cat.facing or 1,
            cat.color, cat.gait, game.active == index and not cat.arrived,
            game.clock, cat.squash, carried, index, cat.napping or cat.arrived,
            {dizzy=game.level==7 and not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and cat.x+CAT_W>7.4 and cat.x<10.2 and cat.y>.25 and cat.y<2.3})
        if game.level == 4 then BalconyArt.CarriedFish(ctx, game, cat, index, unit, wx, gy) end
        if game.level == 6 then KitchenArt.CarriedFish(ctx, game, cat, index, unit, wx, gy) end
        local badgeY = feetY - (cat.bodyH + (carried and carried.w * 0.85 or 0)) * unit - 11
        if cat.arrived then
            Text(ctx, centerX, badgeY, "Zz", 8, { 112, 104, 82, 220 })
        end
    end


    if not Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion") then
        for _,effect in ipairs(game.effects or {}) do
            local fade=math.max(0,math.min(1,effect.life/effect.maxLife))
            local ex,ey=wx(effect.x),gy(effect.y)
            if effect.kind=="home" then
                local size=unit*.035*(.5+fade)
                Line(ctx,ex-size,ey,ex+size,ey,{245,213,138,math.floor(190*fade)},1.3)
                Line(ctx,ex,ey-size,ex,ey+size,{245,213,138,math.floor(190*fade)},1.3)
            else
                Ellipse(ctx,ex,ey,unit*.045*(1.5-fade),unit*.025,{215,193,157,math.floor(105*fade)})
            end
        end
    end

    if game.level==5 and c.ropeTipX then
        Line(ctx,wx(11.6),gy(-.35),wx(c.ropeTipX),gy(-.35),{161,116,74,230},3)
    end

    -- S uses exactly one production candidate. An amber barred seam denotes a
    -- reachable but uncarryable ball, rather than promising a pickup that fails.
    ---@type table<string,any>?
    local grab=Room.GrabCandidate(game,game.active)
    if grab and grab.mode=="grab" then
        local ball=game.balls[grab.ball]
        if ball and not ball.carriedBy then
            local cx,cy=wx(ball.x+ball.w*.5),gy(ball.y or 0)-ball.w*unit*.5
            local radius=ball.w*unit*.63+3
            local blocked=grab.blocked==true
            nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgCircle(ctx,cx,cy,radius)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx,blocked and nvgRGBA(194,102,78,230) or nvgRGBA(255,244,178,220));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,2.4);nvgStroke(ctx)
            if blocked then
                local bx,by=cx+radius*.75,cy-radius*.75
                Line(ctx,bx-3,by-3,bx+3,by+3,{194,102,78,255},1.8)
                Line(ctx,bx-3,by+3,bx+3,by-3,{194,102,78,255},1.8)

            end
        end
    elseif grab and grab.mode=="grabFish" then
        local fish=game.machineById and game.machineById[grab.machine]
        if fish then
            DrawCandidateOutline(ctx,{x=fish.x,y=(fish.y or 0)+.25,w=.76,h=.5},unit,wx,gy,{219,177,84,250},game.clock or 0)
        end
    end
    -- E hugs the operable handle/face, not a generic large disk at the floor.
    -- Background etchings stay quiet, and no extra answer text/HUD is introduced.
    local _,hasAction,machineId=Room.GetContextAction(game)
    if hasAction and machineId then
        local target=game.machineById and game.machineById[machineId]
        if target then DrawCandidateOutline(ctx,Visual.ActionShape(game,target),unit,wx,gy,{149,190,117,250},game.clock or 0) end

    end
    if game.level==9 and not c.laserOff then
        local targetX,targetY=wx(c.laserTarget or 15.4),gy(.6)
        Circle(ctx,targetX,targetY,7,{255,244,221,110},{165,54,49,230})
        Circle(ctx,targetX,targetY,3,{234,64,60,255})
        for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1}) do
            Line(ctx,targetX+sign*9,targetY,targetX+sign*12,targetY,{165,54,49,230},1.4)
            Line(ctx,targetX,targetY+sign*9,targetX,targetY+sign*12,{165,54,49,230},1.4)
        end
    end
    if c.padX then Ellipse(ctx,wx(c.padX),gy(c.padY or 0)-3,unit*.6,unit*.08,{146,191,142,180},{87,126,86,220}) end
    if game.level==10 and not HighContrast(game) then
        local highLight,lowLight=IsMachineActive(game,"lightHigh"),IsMachineActive(game,"lightLow")
        local first=math.max(0,math.floor((x-left)/unit/.7))
        local last=math.min(math.ceil(def.roomWidth/.7),math.ceil((x+w-left)/unit/.7))
        for i=first,last do
            local worldX=i*.7
            local visibility=.22
            if worldX<13.1 or worldX<18.2 and highLight or lowLight and worldX>=18.2 then visibility=.95 end
            for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do visibility=math.max(visibility,math.max(0,1-math.abs(cat.x-worldX)/3.3)) end
            Rect(ctx,wx(worldX),y,.72*unit,ground-y-4,0,{20,19,24,math.floor((1-visibility)*120)})
        end
    end
    -- Warnings remain readable above the night shading, including inactive cats.
    local warningCat=c.finale and c.finale.owner and c.finale.owner.warningCat
    for index,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        if (cat.coverExposure or warningCat==index) and not cat.arrived then
            local carried=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
            local warningY=gy(cat.y)-(cat.bodyH+(carried and carried.w*.85 or 0))*unit-29
            Text(ctx,wx(cat.x+CAT_W/2),warningY,cat.coverExposure and "!" or "?",14,{246,207,120,255})
        end
    end
    -- Keep the selection marker above every cat when teammates overlap.
    local activeCat=game.sheep[game.active]
    if not activeCat.arrived then
        local carried=Room.CarriedBall(game,game.active)
        local centerX=wx(activeCat.x+CAT_W/2)
        local badgeY=gy(activeCat.y)-(activeCat.bodyH+(carried and carried.w*.85 or 0))*unit-11
        Poly(ctx,{centerX-7,badgeY-5,centerX+7,badgeY-5,centerX,badgeY+5},
            {250,236,173,255},{101,84,52,255})
    end
    -- Physically faithful previews; component HUD owns all explanatory text.
    local preview=Room.DropPreview(game,game.active)
    if preview then
        local px,py=wx(preview.x),gy(preview.y)
        nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgRoundedRect(ctx,px,py-preview.w*unit,preview.w*unit,preview.w*unit,4)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx,nvgRGBA(111,164,96,190));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,2);nvgStroke(ctx)
        Arrow(ctx,wx(game.sheep[game.active].x+.475),gy(game.sheep[game.active].y+.9),px+preview.w*unit*.5,py-preview.w*unit*.5,{111,164,96,100},1)
    end
    local selected=game.sheep[game.active]
    for _,machine in ipairs(c.machines) do
        local near=math.abs((machine.x or 0)-selected.x)<2.5
        if machine.need and (near or Save.GetSetting("labels")) then
            local cx=wx(machine.x+(machine.w or 0)*.5)
            local cy=gy((machine.y or 0)+.48)
            local amount=machine.kind=="seesaw" and math.floor((machine.weight or 0)*10)/10
                or Room.GetPlateWeight(game,machine)
            local value=tostring(amount).." / "..machine.need
            local scale=Save.GetSetting("textScale") or 1
            local halfBadge=math.max(44,#value*7+12)*scale*.5
            for index,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                if math.abs(cx-wx(cat.x+CAT_W/2))<CAT_W*unit*.65+halfBadge then
                    local carried=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
                    local top=gy(cat.y+cat.bodyH+(carried and carried.w*.85 or 0))
                    if cy+10*scale>top and cy-10*scale<gy(cat.y)+5 then
                        cy=math.min(cy,top-24-10*scale)
                    end
                end
            end
            WeightBadge(ctx,cx,cy,value,machine.active)
        end
        if machine.kind=="ropeBridge" and (near or Save.GetSetting("labels")) then
            WeightBadge(ctx,wx(machine.x+(machine.w or 0)*.5),gy((machine.y or 0)+.6),"<= 2",(machine.weight or 0)<=2)
        end
        if machine.kind=="dog" then
            local phase=c.dog.phase
            local symbols={idle="z",alert="!",inspect="?",play="~",["return"]="<",contained="+"}
            Text(ctx,wx(machine.x),gy((machine.y or 0)+1.3),symbols[phase] or "?",19,{219,151,64,255})
        end
        if machine.kind=="washer" and machine.running then
            local a=Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion") and 0 or game.clock*2
            local cx,cy=wx(machine.x),gy((machine.y or 0)+.75)
            Circle(ctx,cx+math.cos(a)*unit*.5,cy+math.sin(a)*unit*.5,3,{113,160,179,255})
        end
    end
    -- Wind streaks and collection shimmer provide motion without concealing hazards.
    if not Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion") then
        for _,zone in ipairs(c.zones) do
            if (zone.kind=="wind" or zone.kind=="windTrack") and (not zone.requires or IsMachineActive(game,zone.requires)) then
                local sign=game.campaign.windDirection or 1
                for i=1,4 do
                    local progress=(game.clock*.22*sign+i*.23)%1
                    local x=zone.x0+progress*(zone.x1-zone.x0)
                    if zone.kind=="wind" then
                        local height=((game.clock*.4+i*.23)%1)*1.05+.2
                        local px=wx(zone.x0+(zone.x1-zone.x0)*i/5)
                        Arrow(ctx,px,gy(height),px,gy(height+.2),{115,174,164,110},1.2)
                    else
                        Arrow(ctx,wx(x),gy(.4+i*.2),wx(x+.35*sign),gy(.4+i*.2),{115,174,164,110},1.3)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if c.secret and not c.secretCollected then
            local glow=.65+.35*math.sin(game.clock*3)
            Circle(ctx,wx(c.secret.x),gy(c.secret.y+.12),3+glow*2,{232,191,86,math.floor(glow*150)})
        end
    end
    for index,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        if cat.support and cat.support>0 then
            local cx,cy=wx(cat.x+.475),gy(cat.y)
            Line(ctx,cx-unit*.22,cy+2,cx+unit*.22,cy+2,{129,176,113,220},3)
        end
        local ball=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
        if ball and ball.source=="rescue" then Text(ctx,wx(cat.x+.475),gy(cat.y+cat.bodyH+ball.w+.2),"+",14,{133,147,186,255}) end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

function Art.Wind(ctx, zone, game, unit, wx, ground)

            if machine.id == zone.requires then enabled = machine.active == true; break end
        end
        if not enabled then color = { 128, 157, 160, 65 } end

    if zone.kind == "wind" then
        -- 上升风道用地面出风格栅和竖向气流，不再误画成水平风。

        for row = 1, 2 do
            for i = 1, count do

                    cx + dir * .43 * unit, y + .06 * unit }, color)

        end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

    nvgSave(ctx)

end

function Art.Zone(ctx, zone, game, unit, wx, ground)
    local kind = zone.kind
    if kind ~= "water" and kind ~= "carpet" and kind ~= "slip" then return false end
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(zone.x0), ground); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    local w = zone.x1 - zone.x0
    if kind == "water" then
        -- 蓝色水面严格对应触水区，白色盆沿低于桥面，出料口对应生产 outlet。
        Rect(ctx, -.08, -.26, w + .16, .46, .12, PORCELAIN, INK)
        Gradient(ctx, .04, -.20, w - .08, .24, .085, { 139, 198, 207, 235 }, { 100, 161, 183, 240 })
        Line(ctx, .16, -.18, w - .16, -.18, { 241, 255, 239, 210 }, .020)
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local cx = w * (.12 + i * .22)
            local r = .09 + ((game.clock or 0) * .055 + i * .06) % .11
            nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, cx, -.07, r, .026)
            Stroke(ctx, { 233, 250, 238, 135 }, .015)
        end
        Rect(ctx, -.065, .03, w + .13, .14, .05, { 194, 216, 206, 255 }, INK)
        local outlet = (zone.outlet or zone.x1) - zone.x0
        Poly(ctx, { w - .15, .035, outlet + .16, .07, outlet + .16, .17, w - .15, .15 },
            { 214, 226, 208, 255 }, INK)
        Arrow(ctx, w - .02, .10, outlet + .09, .13, { 118, 153, 144, 220 })
        -- 水滴与四点重量是盆体图示，不生成毛线球或额外可收集实体。
        Drop(ctx, w * .45, .09, .047, { 120, 163, 177, 255 })
        for i = 1, 4 do Oval(ctx, w * .53 + i * .075, .095, .018, .018, INK) end
    elseif kind == "carpet" then
        Rect(ctx, -.045, -.19, w + .09, .19, .065, { 137, 125, 149, 255 }, { 106, 110, 121, 235 })
        Rect(ctx, .06, -.17, w - .12, .115, .045, PURPLE, { 216, 209, 201, 180 })
        for i = 1, math.floor(w / .12) do
            local xx = i * .12
            Line(ctx, xx, -.04, xx + .035, -.125, { 215, 203, 216, 170 }, .017)
        end
        for _, side in ipairs({ 0, w }) do
            for i = 1, 4 do Line(ctx, side, -.16 + i * .033, side + (side == 0 and -.08 or .08),
                -.14 + i * .033, { 180, 161, 183, 220 }, .016) end
        end
        Poly(ctx, { w * .5 + .055, -.17, w * .5 - .035, -.095, w * .5 + .015, -.095,
            w * .5 - .055, -.025, w * .5 + .095, -.115, w * .5 + .035, -.115 },
            { 246, 221, 150, 255 })
    else
        -- 湿滑区不是深水；薄反光与方向纹路显示可回收的短滑行。
        Oval(ctx, w * .51, -.055, w * .53, .070, { 133, 189, 196, 105 }, { 112, 164, 173, 150 })
        for i = 1, 3 do
            Line(ctx, w * (.08 + i * .18), -.09, w * (.21 + i * .18), -.09,
                { 235, 252, 237, 200 }, .021)
        end
        Drop(ctx, .12, -.09, .05, { 104, 158, 174, 175 })
        Arrow(ctx, w - .40, -.04, w - .12, -.04, { 103, 150, 156, 160 })
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    return true
end

function Art.Platform(ctx, p, game, unit, wx, gy)
    local source = p.requiresActive and game:GetMachine(p.requiresActive)
    local active = not p.requiresActive or source and source.active == true
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(p.x), gy(0)); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    local top = -((p.y or 0) + (p.h or .12))
    local h, w = p.h or .12, p.w
    if p.id == "waterBridge" and not active then
        Rect(ctx, -.06, -w, .13, w, .04, { 158, 188, 166, 255 }, INK)
        for i = 1, 8 do Line(ctx, -.035, -i * w / 9, .045, -i * w / 9, { 222, 233, 201, 200 }, .018) end
        Oval(ctx, 0, -.06, .085, .085, METAL, INK)
    elseif p.requiresActive and not active then
        local endY = -((p.y1 or p.y or 0) + h)
        Line(ctx, 0, top, w, endY, { 113, 146, 142, 95 }, .018)
        for i = 1, 4 do Oval(ctx, i * w / 5, top + (endY - top) * i / 5, .025, .025,
            { 113, 146, 142, 100 }) end
        -- 待放下的短坡收在铰链处，虚线只提示未来通路，不能冒充实体地面。
        Rect(ctx, w - .055, endY - .62, .11, .62, .03, { 177, 199, 176, 230 }, INK)
        Oval(ctx, w, endY, .065, .065, METAL, INK)
    elseif p.ramp then
        local endY = -((p.y1 or p.y or 0) + h)
        Poly(ctx, { 0, top, w, endY, w, endY + h, 0, top + h }, { 188, 206, 181, 255 }, INK)
        Line(ctx, .025, top + .025, w - .025, endY + .025, PORCELAIN, .025)
        for i = 1, math.floor(w / .23) do
            local xx = i * .23
            local yy = top + (endY - top) * xx / w
            Line(ctx, xx, yy + .045, xx + .085, yy + .055, { 132, 158, 138, 190 }, .024)
        end
        Oval(ctx, w - .09, endY + h * .5, .045, .045, METAL, INK)
    else
        local bridge = p.id == "waterBridge"
        Rect(ctx, 0, top + .045, w, h, .04, bridge and { 164, 188, 157, 255 } or { 160, 188, 173, 255 }, INK)
        Rect(ctx, 0, top, w, math.max(.055, h * .55), .04,
            bridge and { 211, 224, 186, 255 } or PORCELAIN, INK)
        Line(ctx, .08, top + .019, w - .08, top + .019, { 251, 255, 234, 210 }, .015)
        for i = 1, math.floor(w / (bridge and .38 or .65)) do
            local xx = i * (bridge and .38 or .65)
            Line(ctx, xx, top + .02, xx, top + h, { 127, 160, 142, 130 }, .014)
        end
        for _, xx in ipairs({ .09, w - .09 }) do Oval(ctx, xx, top + .04, .022, .022, INK) end
        if bridge then
            Oval(ctx, .06, top + .09, .06, .06, METAL, INK)
            Lamp(ctx, w - .16, top + .105, true)
        elseif (p.y or 0) > .25 then
            for _, xx in ipairs({ .13, w - .13 }) do
                Poly(ctx, { xx, top + h, xx + .16, top + h, xx, top + h + .17 }, { 136, 168, 156, 210 })
            end
        end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

local function Door(ctx, machine, game)
    local w, h = machine.w or .55, machine.h or 3.6
    local open = machine.open or machine.active
    Rect(ctx, -.07, -h - .10, w + .14, .15, .035, METAL, INK)
    Rect(ctx, 0, -h, w, open and .13 or h, .035,
        open and { 186, 216, 166, 255 } or { 171, 197, 183, 255 }, INK)
    if not open then
        for i = 1, math.floor(h / .32) do
            Line(ctx, .045, -h + i * .32, w - .045, -h + i * .32, { 133, 166, 153, 150 }, .018)
        end
        Rect(ctx, w * .18, -.72, w * .64, .08, .025, PORCELAIN, INK)
    end
    local requirements = machine.requires or {}
    local count = #requirements
    Rect(ctx, w * .5 - .10 - count * .065, -h - .43, .20 + count * .13, .23, .055, PORCELAIN, INK)
    for i, id in ipairs(requirements) do
        local source = game:GetMachine(id)
        Lamp(ctx, w * .5 + (i - (count + 1) * .5) * .13, -h - .315,
            open or source and (source.active or source.pressed))
    end
end

function Art.Machine(ctx, machine, game, unit, wx, gy)
    local id = machine.id
    if id ~= "weightDoor" and id ~= "exitDoor" and id ~= "heavyPlate" and id ~= "insideLatch"
        and id ~= "bridgeSwitch" and id ~= "rampSwitch" and id ~= "releaseMetal" and id ~= "metalCatch" then return false end
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(machine.x or 0), gy(machine.y or 0)); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    nvgLineCap(ctx, NVG_ROUND)
    local active = machine.active == true
    if machine.kind == "door" then Door(ctx, machine, game)
    elseif id == "heavyPlate" then
        local w = machine.w or 1.6
        local lit = machine.pressed or active
        local travel = lit and -.025 or -.105
        Rect(ctx, -.06, -.025, w + .12, .115, .045, { 103, 139, 140, 255 }, INK)
        Rect(ctx, 0, travel, w, .11, .045, lit and { 166, 202, 138, 255 } or { 151, 180, 179, 255 }, INK)
        Oval(ctx, w * .5, travel + .035, w * .37, .045, { 97, 130, 130, 80 }, { 118, 153, 148, 190 })
        for i = 1, machine.need or 4 do Oval(ctx, w * .5 + (i - 2.5) * .12,
            travel - .16, .039, .039, lit and GREEN or { 92, 126, 131, 255 }, PORCELAIN) end
        if not lit then Arrow(ctx, .17, -.37, .17, -.16, INK); Arrow(ctx, w - .17, -.37, w - .17, -.16, INK) end
    elseif id == "insideLatch" then
        Rect(ctx, -.32, -.09, .64, .10, .03, METAL, INK)
        Poly(ctx, active and { -.30, -.10, -.04, -.37, .23, -.10 }
            or { -.04, -.10, .22, -.37, .48, -.10 }, { 205, 182, 130, 255 }, { 129, 134, 108, 255 })
        Lamp(ctx, -.23, -.49, active)
        Key(ctx, .21, -.52, unit)
        local door = game:GetMachine("weightDoor")
        if door then
            local dx = door.x + (door.w or .45) - machine.x
            Line(ctx, -.26, -.10, dx, -.10, active and GREEN or { 132, 157, 145, 125 }, .032)
            if active then Rect(ctx, dx - .065, -.19, .13, .20, .025, { 179, 202, 145, 255 }, INK) end
        end
    elseif id == "bridgeSwitch" or id == "rampSwitch" then
        Rect(ctx, -.25, -.32, .50, .29, .055, MINT, INK)
        Rect(ctx, -.19, -.24, .38, .15, .028, PORCELAIN, INK)
        Line(ctx, 0, -.31, active and .15 or -.15, -.58, INK, .038)
        Oval(ctx, active and .15 or -.15, -.58, .065, .065, { 220, 195, 139, 255 }, INK)
        Lamp(ctx, .29, -.36, active)
        Rect(ctx, -.31, -.98, .62, .23, .05, PORCELAIN, INK)
        if id == "bridgeSwitch" then
            Line(ctx, -.19, -.85, .19, -.85, METAL, .04)
            for i = 0, 2 do Line(ctx, -.13 + i * .13, -.92, -.13 + i * .13, -.84, INK, .018) end
        else Line(ctx, -.19, -.82, .19, -.93, METAL, .04) end
        Key(ctx, -.34, -.52, unit)
    elseif id == "releaseMetal" then
        Rect(ctx, -.18, -.20, .36, .18, .045, MINT, INK)
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgArc(ctx, 0, -.16, .07, -.70, 4.65, NVG_CW); Stroke(ctx, INK, .023)
        Poly(ctx, { -.003, -.23, -.084, -.23, -.05, -.17 }, INK)
        Key(ctx, 0, -.40, unit)
    else
        -- 只绘制接球槽本体，槽内是否有球仍由公共实体渲染决定。
        Rect(ctx, -.31, -.15, .62, .16, .06, MINT, INK)
        Oval(ctx, 0, -.14, .255, .055, { 131, 165, 161, 220 }, INK)
        Line(ctx, -.26, -.09, -.26, -.22, PORCELAIN, .033)
        Line(ctx, .26, -.09, .26, -.22, PORCELAIN, .033)
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    return true
end

return Art
CampaignDemo:
-- 第一关独立操作演示：沿用正式固定步长、碰撞、抱放与剪球规则，不接触玩家存档。
local UI = require("urhox-libs/UI")
local Room = require("CampaignRoom")
local Cats = require("WoolCats")
local YarnArt = require("WoolArt")
local I18n = require("I18n")
local UIF = require("UIFactory")
local Demo = {}
Demo.__index = Demo

local STEP = 1 / 120
local STEPS = {
    { key = "W", duration = 1.6, action = "jump" },
    { key = "A", duration = 1.0, target = 2.4 },
    { key = "S", duration = 2.0, action = "carry" },
    { key = "D", duration = 1.0, target = 4.3 },
    { key = "E", duration = 2.0, action = "interact" },
}

function Demo.New()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Demo)
    self:init()
    return self
end

function Demo:init()
    self.running = false
    self.step = 1
    self.stepTime = 0
    self.accumulator = 0
    self.secondCarry = false
    self.game = setmetatable({ clock = 0, demoMode = true }, { __index = Room })
end

function Demo:Begin()
    Room.Init(self.game, 2)
    local game = self.game
    -- 训练区只有平地和真实剪刀台，没有通关、收藏或危险触发器。
    game.def = { profile = "campaign-room", roomWidth = 10, homeX = 100, spawnX = 4.3,
        platforms = {}, walls = {}, zones = {}, machines = {}, hintTasks = {}, homeY = 0 }
    game.level = 1
    game.campaign.platforms, game.campaign.walls, game.campaign.zones = {}, {}, {}
    game.campaign.secret = nil
    game.campaign.machines = {
        { id = "demoCut", kind = "cutStation", x = 4.8, y = 0, label = "剪刀台", active = false, used = false },
    }
    game.machineById = { demoCut = game.campaign.machines[1] }
    game.active = 1
    for index, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        cat.x, cat.y = index == 1 and 4.3 or 7.5 + index, 0
        cat.vx, cat.vy, cat.support, cat.grounded = 0, 0, -6, true
        cat.arrived, cat.napping = false, false
        cat.carry = index == 1
    end
    for index, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        ball.carriedBy = index == 1 and 1 or nil
        ball.state = index == 1 and "carried" or "stored"
        ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx, ball.vy = index == 1 and 4.3 or 9.2, 0, 0, 0
    end
    self.running, self.step, self.stepTime, self.accumulator, self.secondCarry = true, 1, 0, 0, false
    self:EnterStep()
    if self.page then self.page:Show() end
    print("[操作演示] 开始独立训练区；正式关卡暂停，使用真实动作规则")
end

function Demo:EnterStep()
    local step = STEPS[self.step]
    if not step then self:Finish(); return end
    self.stepTime, self.secondCarry = 0, false
    if step.action == "jump" then
        self.game:Jump()
    elseif step.action == "carry" then
        assert(self.game:ToggleCarry(1), "演示放球失败")
    elseif step.action == "interact" then
        assert(self.game:Interact(), "演示剪球失败")
    end
    for key, widget in pairs(self.keys or {}) do
        widget:SetStyle({ backgroundColor = key == step.key and UIF.P.greenDark or UIF.P.sage })
        local label = widget:FindById("demoKey" .. key) --[[@as Label?]]
        if label then label:SetFontColor(key == step.key and UIF.P.cream or UIF.P.greenDark) end
    end
end

function Demo:Update(dt)
    if not self.running then return end
    self.accumulator = self.accumulator + math.min(dt, .1)
    while self.accumulator >= STEP and self.running do
        self.accumulator = self.accumulator - STEP
        local step = STEPS[self.step]
        self.stepTime = self.stepTime + STEP
        local moveX = 0
        if step.target then
            local delta = step.target - self.game.sheep[1].x
            if math.abs(delta) > .035 then moveX = delta > 0 and 1 or -1 end
        end
        self.game:Update(STEP, moveX)
        if step.action == "carry" and self.stepTime >= 1.0 and not self.secondCarry then
            self.secondCarry = true
            assert(self.game:ToggleCarry(1), "演示重新拾球失败")
        end
        if self.stepTime >= step.duration then
            self.step = self.step + 1
            self:EnterStep()
        end
    end
end

function Demo:Finish(silent)
    if not self.running then return end
    self.running = false
    if self.page then self.page:Hide() end
    print("[操作演示] 结束；训练状态已隔离，正式关卡保持原状态")
    if not silent and self.onFinish then self.onFinish() end
end

local Arena = UI.Widget:Extend("CampaignDemoArena")
function Arena:Render(ctx)
    local demo = self.props.demo
    if not demo or not demo.running then return end
    local game = demo.game
    local l = self:GetAbsoluteLayout()
    local unit = math.min(l.w / 6.8, l.h / 2.7)
    local left, ground = l.x + l.w * .5 - 3.5 * unit, l.y + l.h - 18
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h, 14)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(245, 234, 212, 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRect(ctx, l.x, ground, l.w, 18)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(200, 164, 116, 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
    local machine = game.campaign.machines[1]
    local mx = left + machine.x * unit
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, mx - 20, ground - 17, 40, 11, 4)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(179, 132, 81, 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
    for direction = -1, 1, 2 do
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgCircle(ctx, mx + direction * 7, ground - 26, 5)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(88, 93, 80, 255)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, mx + direction * 4, ground - 23)
        nvgLineTo(ctx, mx - direction * (machine.used and 4 or 10), ground - 37)
        nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and ball.state == "world" then
            local r = ball.w * unit * .5
            YarnArt.YarnBall(ctx, left + (ball.x + ball.w * .5) * unit, ground - ball.y * unit - r,
                r, { 214, 96, 76, 255 }, 1, ball.kind)
        end
    end
    local cat = game.sheep[1]
    Cats.Draw(ctx, left + cat.x * unit, ground - cat.y * unit, .95 * unit,
        cat.facing, cat.color, cat.gait, true, game.clock, cat.squash, game:CarriedBall(1), 1, false)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

function Demo:CreateUI(onFinish)
    self.onFinish = onFinish
    self.keys = {}
    local keys = {}
    for _, step in ipairs(STEPS) do
        local widget = UI.Panel { width = 42, height = 40, borderRadius = 9,
            backgroundColor = UIF.P.sage, borderWidth = 1, borderColor = UIF.P.line,
            alignItems = "center", justifyContent = "center",
            children = { UIF.Label(step.key, 16, UIF.P.greenDark, { id = "demoKey" .. step.key }) } }
        self.keys[step.key] = widget
        keys[#keys + 1] = widget
    end
    self.page = UI.Panel {
        id = "demoPage", visible = false, position = "absolute", left = 0, right = 0, top = 0, bottom = 0,
        zIndex = 55, pointerEvents = "auto", backgroundColor = { 64, 57, 43, 138 },
        alignItems = "center", justifyContent = "center",
        children = { UI.Panel { width = 470, maxWidth = "94%", padding = 18, gap = 12,
            borderRadius = 20, backgroundColor = UIF.P.cream, borderWidth = 1, borderColor = UIF.P.line,
            children = {
                UIF.Title(I18n.T("replayDemo"), 19, { fontColor = UIF.P.greenDark }),
                Arena { width = "100%", height = 174, demo = self },
                UI.Row { justifyContent = "flex-end", gap = 7, children = keys },
                UIF.Button(I18n.T("skipDemo"), function() self:Finish() end,
                    { id = "skipDemoButton", height = 40, backgroundColor = UIF.P.sage }),
            },
        } },
    }
    return self.page
end

return Demo
CampaignDetails:
-- 细化组件：可逆运输、小陷阱、绳端、托架与可解释的注意力状态。
local D={}
local W=.95
local function find(g,id) for _,m in ipairs(g.campaign.machines) do if m.id==id then return m end end end
local function active(g,id) local m=find(g,id); return m and m.active==true end
local function available(b) return not b.lost and b.state=="world" and not b.carriedBy end
local function warn(g,key) g.campaign.notice=key; g.campaign.noticeTimer=2.5 end

-- 承重/碰撞示意（世界单位米，Y向上）：
--       [猫+携球]        飞球/高柜猫：没有接触链，不传重量
--          | 脚底接触（误差<=0.045，横向有实质重叠）
--       [猫 或 普通球]   已睡猫：立即退出支撑链
--          |            踩边/离开/恢复旧support：重新核实接触，循环链拒绝
--   ===== 板/绳桥 =====  跷跷板力臂取根接触点，而非上层猫的投影
local function worldBall(b)
    return b and available(b) and not b.inTransit and not b.inWasher and not b.feltStored
end
function D.SupportBall(g,id)
    for _,b in ipairs(g.balls) do if b.id==id and worldBall(b) then return b end end
    return nil
end
function D.CatSupportTop(g,lowerIndex,upperIndex)
    local lower,upper=g.sheep[lowerIndex],g.sheep[upperIndex]
    if not lower or not upper or lower.arrived then return nil end
    local uw,lw=upper.bodyW or W,lower.bodyW or W
    local ux,lx=upper.x+(W-uw)*.5,lower.x+(W-lw)*.5
    local top=nil
    if ux+uw>lx+.06 and ux<lx+lw-.06 then top=lower.y+lower.bodyH end
    local b=g:CarriedBall(lowerIndex)
    if b and ux+uw>lower.x+W*.5-b.w*.5+.06 and ux<lower.x+W*.5+b.w*.5-.06 then
        top=math.max(top or -math.huge,lower.y+lower.bodyH+b.w*.85)
    end
    return top
end
function D.BallSupportTop(g,b,cat)
    if not worldBall(b) then return nil end
    local w=cat.bodyW or W
    local x=cat.x+(W-w)*.5
    if x+w>b.x+.04 and x<b.x+b.w-.04 then return (b.y or 0)+b.w end
    return nil
end
local function resting(entity)
    return math.abs(entity.vy or 0)<=.05
end
local function rootContact(g,entity,width,cat,m)
    if not resting(entity) then return nil end
    local x=entity.x+width*.5
    local inside=entity.x+width>m.x+.01 and entity.x<m.x+(m.w or 1)-.01
    if not inside then return nil end
    local y=entity.y or 0
    -- 移动板、绳桥只在自己的实体台面计重；高柜重合X不能隔空施压。
    local linkedSurface=false
    for _,p in ipairs(g.campaign.platforms) do
        if (p.movingMachine==m.id or p.requiresActive==m.id) and D.PlatformEnabled(g,p,cat)
            and entity.x+width>p.x+.01 and entity.x<p.x+p.w-.01 then
            linkedSurface=true

function D.Update(g,dt)

    if c.noticeTimer==0 then c.notice=nil end
    local near,far=find(g,"ropeNear"),find(g,"ropeFar")

        bridge.weight=weight; bridge.overload=math.max(0,(bridge.overload or 0)+(weight>2 and dt or -dt*3))

        if bridge.overload>.8 then breakRope(g,bridge) end
    end

        local t=c.secretTransit; t.timer=math.max(0,t.timer-dt)

    end

            local period=m.cycleSeconds or 8
            local t=((m.carrierClock or 0)%period)*8/period
            m.lift=t<1 and 0 or t<3 and (t-1)*1.19 or t<4 and 2.38 or t<6 and (6-t)*1.19 or 0
            m.docked=m.lift<.02 and "lower" or m.lift>2.36 and "upper" or "moving"
        elseif m.kind=="receiver" and m.id~="secretDelivery" then
            for _,b in ipairs(g.balls) do if available(b) and (not m.acceptKind or b.kind==m.acceptKind)
                and (b.amount or 0)>=(m.requiredAmount or 0)
                and math.abs((b.y or 0)-(m.y or 0))<.2 and b.x+b.w*.5>=m.x and b.x+b.w*.5<=m.x+(m.w or 1) then
                b.vx=0; m.active=true
            end end

            for _,b in ipairs(g.balls) do if available(b) and b.x+b.w>m.x and b.x<m.x+(m.w or .3) and math.abs(b.y-(m.y or 0))<.3 then b.x,b.vx=m.x-b.w-.02,-1 end end

            if candidate and m.scaredTimer==0 then
                if (m.theftTimer or 0)==0 then warn(g,"ratWarning") end

                if m.theftTimer>3 then candidate.lost,candidate.state=true,"lost"; m.theftTimer=0; warn(g,"ratLost") end
            else m.theftTimer=0 end
        elseif m.kind=="noisyToy" then
            for _,cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.x-m.x)<.45 and not m.triggered then
                m.triggered=true
                if c.dog.phase~="contained" then c.dog.phase,c.dog.timer,c.dog.targetX="inspect",2,m.x; warn(g,"toyNoise") end
            end end
        elseif m.kind=="bottleRack" then
            m.rattleWindow=math.max(0,(m.rattleWindow or 0)-dt)
            if m.rattleWindow==0 then m.rattle=0 end
        end
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(c.platforms) do
        if p.soft then
            local loaded=false
            for _,cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do
                if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and cat.x+W>p.x and cat.x<p.x+p.w
                    and math.abs(cat.y-p.y-p.h+(p.sag or 0))<.1 then loaded=true end
            end
            p.sag=math.max(0,math.min(.28,(p.sag or 0)+(loaded and dt*.24 or -dt*.36)))
            if p.sag>=.28 then p.collapsed=true elseif p.sag==0 then p.collapsed=false end
            if loaded then warn(g,"softCardboard") end
        end
    end
    for _,zone in ipairs(c.zones) do
        if zone.kind=="windTrack" and active(g,zone.requires) then
            zone.phase=(g.clock or 0)%4; zone.warning=zone.phase>2.5 and zone.phase<3.2
            zone.gust=zone.phase>=3.2 and zone.phase<3.8

                else b.vx=(c.windDirection or 1)>0 and (zone.gust and 3.2 or 2.4) or -.9; if b.x>=zone.target then b.x,b.vx=zone.target,0 end end
            end end
        elseif zone.kind=="slip" then

        elseif zone.kind=="mint" then
            zone.flat=false
            for _,b in ipairs(g.balls) do if available(b) and b.kind=="full" and b.x+b.w>zone.x0 and b.x<zone.x1 then zone.flat=true end end
        end
    end
    c.laserFollowing=g.level==9 and not c.laserOff and not c.laserManual and c.laserTarget~=nil
end
function D.Direction(g,index,direction,dt)
    local cat=g.sheep[index]

function D.Conveyor(g,cat)
