            exp_red_target={"让红点停在这里，再让空手奶盖走来踩住；也可手动控制奶盖", "Aim the red dot here, then bring empty Naigai onto it; manual control also works"},
            exp_recover={"只归拢同层、无遮挡的附近散球；不重置机关或补回损失", "Gather nearby unobstructed loose yarn on this floor; machines and losses stay unchanged"},
        }
        local t=texts[machine.kind]
        return (Mechanics.CanInteract(game,machine) and Input.Name("interact").." · " or "")..M.L(t[1],t[2])
    end
    if machine.kind=="mirror" then
        local target=(machine.targets or {})[machine.mode or 1]
        local nextTarget=(machine.targets or {})[(machine.mode or 1)%#(machine.targets or {1})+1]
        return M.L("红点落点 ", "Red dot ")..tostring(target or "—")..M.L(" · 下次转到 ", " · Next ")..tostring(nextTarget or "—")
    end
    if machine.kind=="checkpoint" then
        local snapshot=game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot
        if snapshot and game.campaign.checkpointId==machine.id then
            local count=0
            for _,m in ipairs(snapshot.campaign.machines or {}) do if m.active then count=count+1 end end
            return M.L("已记录 ", "Saved ")..count..M.L(" 项机关与全部原材料；暂停面板可恢复", " mechanisms and all original yarn; restore from Pause")
        end
        return M.L("站稳后记录机关、队友和材料位置", "Stand here to record mechanisms, teammates and yarn positions")
    end
    if machine.kind=="finale_basket" then
        local count=machine.stored or 0
        if machine.dragging then return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 停下拖篮；线球会随篮保留", " Stop dragging; stored yarn stays in the basket") end
        if machine.active then return M.L("工作线球已收齐，拖篮是可选操作", "All working yarn stored; dragging is optional") end
        return M.L("已收 ", "Stored ")..count.." / 3"..M.L(" · 抱球递交，也能空手收起篮旁散球", " · Deliver carried yarn, or collect loose yarn beside the basket empty-handed")
    end
    if machine.id=="returnDish" then return M.L("递交鱼干，同时切好支线；再到鼠洞请它运线", "Hand over fish to select the secret route, then start delivery at the mouse hole") end
    if game.level==10 and (machine.kind=="finale_timed_gate" or machine.kind=="finale_timed_switch") then
        local brace=game:GetMachine("aExitLatch")
        if brace and brace.active then return M.L("短廊已固定敞开，可以放心取回半球", "Hall secured open; recover both halves without rushing") end
    end
    if machine.kind=="rat" and game.level==6 then
        if machine.fed then return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 请老鼠运线 · 本关不用再喂食", " Ask the mouse to deliver yarn · Meal covers this room") end
        if (machine.theftTimer or 0)>0 then
            return string.format("%.1fs",math.max(0,3-machine.theftTimer))..M.L(" 后线球会被拖走 · ", " until yarn is taken · ")..Input.Name("meow")..M.L(" 赶开老鼠", " Scare the mouse away")
        end
        return M.L("先把鱼干送到食盘，再请它帮忙；别把球留在洞口", "Feed the mouse first; keep unattended yarn away from the hole")
    end
    if machine.kind=="dish" and machine.repeatRoute and game:GetMachine("rat").fed then
        return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 切到支线 · 无需再次喂食", " Select secret route · No extra meal")
    end
    if machine.kind=="fish" then
        local missing=M.Missing(game,machine)
        if #missing>0 then return M.L("送达主线后可取鱼干", "Fish available after the main delivery") end
        if game.campaign.fishInHand then return M.L("鱼干已拿好，送到食盘吧", "Fish in hand; take it to the dish") end
        if not game.campaign.fishAvailable then return M.L("暂时没有鱼干", "No fish available right now") end
        return Input.Name("action")..M.L(" 拿鱼干", " Take fish")
    end
    if machine.kind=="door" and machine.open then
        local brace=machine.latch and game:GetMachine(machine.latch)
        local alternate=machine.alternativeLatch and game:GetMachine(machine.alternativeLatch)
        if alternate and alternate.active then return M.L("帆布已固定，坡道与窝门保持开放", "Sail secured; ramp and home door stay open") end
        return brace and brace.active and M.L("门已撑住，大家都能通过", "Braced open; everyone can pass")
            or M.L("门开着，可以通过", "Open; you can pass")
    end
    if machine.id=="exitLatch" then
        if game.level==3 and machine.active then return M.L("门已撑好，可以解除磁吸取回线球", "Door braced; release the magnet to recover your yarn") end
        return machine.active and M.L("已经撑好，队友可以离开压板", "Braced; teammates can leave the plate")
            or Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 撑住窝门", " Brace the nest door")
    end
    if machine.kind=="seesaw" then
        local torque=math.floor((machine.weight or 0)*10)/10
        return M.L("左侧作用 ", "Left torque ")..tostring(torque).." / "..tostring(machine.need or 2)
            ..M.L(" · 离支点越远作用越大；右侧会抵消。", " · Distance from the pivot increases leverage; the right side counteracts it.")
    end
    if machine.need then
        local light=""
        local links={}
        for _,other in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
            for _,id in ipairs(other.requires or {}) do
                if id==machine.id then links[#links+1]=M.Name(other);break end
            end
        end
        local missing=math.max(0,machine.need-Room.GetPlateWeight(game,machine))
        local relation=(#links>0 and " → "..table.concat(links," / ") or "")
            ..(missing>0 and M.L(" · 还差 ", " · Needs ")..string.format("%.1g",missing)..M.L(" 重量", " more weight") or "")
        if machine.kind=="laserPlate" then
            local center=machine.x+(machine.w or 0)*.5
            local target=game.campaign.laserTarget or center
            local lit=not game.campaign.laserOff and math.abs(target-center)<=.8
            light=lit and M.L(" · 已被激光照亮", " · Laser aligned")
                or M.L(" · 还需激光照射", " · Needs laser alignment")
        end
        return M.L("重量 ", "Weight ")..tostring(Room.GetPlateWeight(game,machine)).." / "..machine.need
            ..(machine.maxDiameter and M.L(" · 仅小半球", " · Small halves only") or "")
            ..light..(machine.active and M.L(" · 已压住", " · Held down") or M.L(" · 还没压到底", " · Not fully pressed"))..relation
    end
    if machine.kind=="cutStation" then
        if Mechanics.CanInteract(game,machine) then
            return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 剪开整球 → 两个半球 · 毛线数量不变", " Cut full yarn → two halves · No yarn lost")
        end
        return M.L("需要一颗未毡化的整球；抱来或放到剪刀台边", "Needs one unfelted full ball; carry it here or place it beside the table")
    end
    if machine.kind=="weaveStation" then
        local count=Mechanics.WeaveCount(game,machine)
        if count==2 then return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 两个半球 → 绳 · 毛线数量不变", " Two halves → rope · No yarn lost") end
        return M.L("台边半球 ", "Halves at loom ")..count.."/2"..M.L(" · 还需 ", " · Needs ")..(2-count)..M.L(" 个，放到同侧可接触的位置", " more, within reach on the same side")
    end
    if machine.kind=="prop" and not machine.active then
        local ball=game:CarriedBall(game.active)
        local weight=game.sheep[game.active].weight+(ball and ball.weight or 0)
        local need=machine.pushMin or 1
        if weight<need then return M.L("推动需要重量 ", "Pushing needs weight ")..need..M.L(" · 当前 ", " · Current ")..weight..M.L("，试试抱球或换更重的猫", "; carry yarn or try a heavier cat") end
    end
    if machine.kind=="washerControl" and not game.campaign.carrierEnabled then
        return M.L("先打开高台上的托架开关，之后可用拉绳暂停或继续", "Enable the carrier at the upper switch first; then use this cord to pause or resume")
    end
    if machine.kind=="unhook" then
        local bridge=game:GetMachine("ropeBridge")
        if not bridge or not bridge.active then return M.L("绳桥尚未固定，没有可回收的绳", "No secured rope bridge to recover yet") end
        for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and cat.x+.95>bridge.x and cat.x<bridge.x+(bridge.w or 1) then
                return M.L("桥上还有队友，全部离开桥面后才能收绳", "A teammate is on the bridge; clear the deck before recovering rope")
            end
        end
        return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 回收原来的绳 · 毛线数量不变", " Recover the original rope · No yarn lost")
    end
    if machine.kind=="releaseMetal" then
        return Mechanics.CanInteract(game,machine) and Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 解除吸附，取回原球", " Release the magnet to recover the original yarn")
            or M.L("金属开关上没有吸附的线球", "No yarn is attached to the magnet")
    end
    if machine.kind=="ropeBridge" then return M.L("承重≤2 · 绳可回收重织", "Load ≤2 · Recover and reweave rope") end
    if machine.kind=="windControl" or machine.id=="routeSwitch" then
        local state
        if machine.id=="routeSwitch" then
            state=machine.mode==2 and M.L("秘密线路", "Secret route") or M.L("主线路", "Main route")
        else
            state=machine.mode==2 and M.L("向右 →", "Right →") or M.L("← 向左", "← Left")
        end
        return state..M.L(" · 从两侧走过去推动，无需按键", " · Walk into either side; no button needed")
    end
    if machine.kind=="washer" then
        if machine.processing then return M.L("正在洗线 · ", "Washing yarn · ")..string.format("%.1fs",math.max(0,1.5-(machine.timer or 0)))..M.L(" · 托架可单独暂停", " · Carrier can be paused separately") end
        if machine.loaded and not machine.running then return M.L("线团已放好 · 再按 ", "Yarn loaded · Press ")..Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 开机", " to start") end
        local phase=((machine.carrierClock or 0)%(machine.cycleSeconds or 8))*8/(machine.cycleSeconds or 8)
        local motion=not machine.running and M.L("已暂停", "Paused")
            or phase<1 and M.L("地面等候", "Board at ground")
            or phase<3 and M.L("正在上升", "Rising")
            or phase<4 and M.L("上层停靠", "Upper stop")
            or phase<6 and M.L("正在下降", "Descending") or M.L("地面等候", "Board at ground")
        return motion..M.L(" · 外圈运猫，内筒处理线团", " · Outer ring carries cats; inner drum processes yarn")
    end
    if machine.kind=="finale_material_relay" then
        if not game:GetMachine("aExitLatch").active then return M.L("先完成A区协作，固定宽路", "Secure the cooperative route in A first") end
        if Mechanics.CanInteract(game,machine) then return Input.Name("interact")..M.L(" 将槽内半球一起送到织线机 · 保留原材料", " Send tray halves to the loom · Original yarn retained") end
        return M.L("槽内没有待送半球；手持或已送出的材料不受影响", "No loose halves in the trays; carried or delivered yarn stays put")
    end
    if machine.kind=="dog" then
        local dog=game.campaign.dog
        return M.Phase(dog.phase)..((dog.phase=="alert" or dog.phase=="play") and string.format(" · %.1fs",dog.timer or 0) or "")
    end
    if machine.kind=="finale_owner" then return M.Phase(game.campaign.ownerPhase or "patrol") end
    local missing=M.Missing(game,machine)
    if #missing>0 then return M.L("还需要：", "Needs: ")..table.concat(missing," · ") end
    if machine.active then return M.L("已完成", "Complete") end
    return M.L("靠近后按 ", "Approach and press ")..Input.Name("interact")..M.L("；绿色轮廓表示当前可操作", "; a green outline means ready")
end
function M.Objective(game)
    if game.won then return M.L("三只猫都已回家", "All three cats are home") end
    -- Keep the destination visible; detailed solutions belong to requested hints.
    if not game.def.hidden then
        local text=M.L("一起回窝 · ", "Get everyone home · ")..game:ArrivedCount().." / 3"
        if Room.IsRecalling(game) then
            text=text..M.L(" · 正在排队回窝，移动或切猫可接手", " · Heading home; move or select a cat to take control")
        elseif Room.CanRecall(game) then
            text=text..M.L(" · ", " · ")..Input.Name("meow")..M.L(" 喵一声，招呼安全通道上的队友回窝", " Meow to call teammates in the safe corridor home")
        elseif Room.IsGathering(game) then
            text=text..M.L(" · 队友正在集合，可切猫接手", " · Teammates gathering; select one to take control")
        elseif Room.CanGather(game) then
            text=text.." · "..Input.Name("meow")..M.L(" 招呼身后的队友过来", " Call nearby teammates over")
        end
        return text
    end
    if game.campaign.allEvidence and Room.CanRecall(game) then
        if Room.IsRecalling(game) then return M.L("正在排队回窝装睡，移动或切猫可接手", "Heading home to sleep; move or select a cat to take control") end
        return Input.Name("meow")..M.L(" 招呼队友回窝装睡", " Call teammates home to pretend to sleep")
    end
    if game.campaign.allEvidence then return M.L("整理完成 · 一起回窝 ", "All tidy · Head home ")..game:ArrivedCount().."/3" end
    local side=game:GetMachine("shadowLatch")
    if side and side.active then
        local basket=game:GetMachine("basket")
        local tools=0
        for _,id in ipairs({"toolScissors","toolSpool"}) do local m=game:GetMachine(id);if m and m.active then tools=tools+1 end end
        local cover=game.campaign.evidence.machineCovered
        local lid=tools==2 and not game.campaign.evidence.toolsInBox and M.L("（待关盒）", " (close lid)") or ""
        return M.L("分工整理 · 线球 ", "Tidy together · Yarn ")..tostring(basket and basket.stored or 0).."/3"
            ..M.L(" · 工具 ", " · Tools ")..tools.."/2"..lid
            ..(cover and M.L(" · 机器已盖好", " · Machine covered") or M.L(" · 机器待盖", " · Cover the machine"))
    end
    for taskIndex,task in ipairs(game.def.hintTasks or {}) do
        local done=task.skipIf and game:GetMachine(task.skipIf) and game:GetMachine(task.skipIf).active
        if not done then
            done=true
            for _,id in ipairs(task.requires or {}) do if not game:GetMachine(id) or not game:GetMachine(id).active then done=false end end
        end
        if not done then
            local parts={}
            for _,id in ipairs(task.requires or {}) do
                local m=game:GetMachine(id)
                if m and not m.active then parts[#parts+1]=M.Name(m) end
            end
            return M.L("整理好房间，再一起装睡 · ", "Tidy the room, then pretend to sleep · ")..table.concat(parts," · ")
        end
    end
    return M.L("把三只猫送回窝 · ", "Bring all cats home · ")..game:ArrivedCount().." / 3"
end
function M.Nearby(game)
    local cat=game.sheep[game.active]
    local nearest, distance=nil,1.8
    for _,machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        local d=math.abs(cat.x+.475-((machine.x or 0)+(machine.w or 0)*.5))
        if d<distance and math.abs(cat.y-(machine.y or 0))<.8 then
            nearest,distance=machine,d
        end
    end
    return nearest
end

function M.CatStatus(game,index)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived then return M.L("已回窝", "Home") end
    if cat.recallHome then return M.L("正在回窝", "Heading home") end
    for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        if m.need and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.y-(m.y or 0))<.06
            and cat.x+.95>m.x and cat.x<m.x+(m.w or 1) then return M.L("正在守板 · ", "Holding plate · ")..M.Name(m) end
    end
    local b=game:CarriedBall(index)
    return M.L("自身重 ", "Body weight ")..cat.weight..(b and M.L(" + 抱球 ", " + Cargo ")..b.weight or M.L(" · 空手，可接应", " · Empty, ready to help"))
end
function M.RouteSummary(game)
    local rows={}
    local labels={sailAnchor={"借风开路","Wind route"},drawerCord={"抽屉挂绳","Drawer rope route"},
        mouseQueue={"排队运输","Queued deliveries"},laundryRelay={"一次出料接力","Laundry relay"},
        redCabinet={"红点开柜","Laser cabinet"},materialRelay={"半球接力","Half-ball relay"},
        fullRelay={"整球接力","Full-ball relay"},bathStep={"踏板开路","Movable step route"},repairLoom={"床边补绳机","Bedside repair loom"},bookChute={"书槽送球","Book chute"}}
    for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do local label=labels[m.id]
        if label and m.active then rows[#rows+1]=M.L(label[1],label[2]) end
    end
    return #rows>0 and M.L("这次合作：", "Teamwork: ")..table.concat(rows," · ") or ""
end

function M.DefaultContext(game)
    local ball=game:CarriedBall(game.active)
    if game.level==1 and ball then
        return Input.Name("action")..M.L(" 放下 · ", " Place · ")..Input.Name("interact")
            ..M.L(" 轻抛 · 面朝想送球的方向", " Pass · Face where you want the yarn to go")
    end
    return M.Ball(ball)
end
function M.Failure(game,action)
    local cat=game.sheep[game.active]
    if action=="carry" then
        ---@type CampaignGrabCandidate?
        local grab=Room.GrabCandidate(game,game.active)
        if cat.carry then return M.L("前方没有安全放球位置；换一侧或回溯。", "No safe drop position; face the other way or rewind.") end
        if grab and grab.blocked then return M.L("上方空间不足，抱球会碰到障碍或同伴。", "Not enough headroom to carry; a ceiling or teammate blocks it.") end
        return M.L("附近没有可拾取物；靠近球或鱼干再试。", "No reachable item; move closer to yarn or fish.")
    end
    local closest, distance = nil, 1.8
    for _,machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        local d=math.abs(cat.x+.475-(machine.x or 0))
        if d<distance and math.abs(cat.y-(machine.y or 0))<.8 then closest,distance=machine,d end
    end
    if closest then return M.Name(closest).."："..M.Description(game,closest) end
    return M.L("靠近机关；", "Approach a mechanism; ")..Input.Name("action")
        ..M.L(" 拾取，", " picks up, ")..Input.Name("interact")
        ..M.L(" 加工或递交。", " processes or hands over.")
end

CampaignFinaleMechanics:
-- Finale-only mechanics. Root should call:
-- Init(game) at the end of Room.Init,
-- Interact(game, machine) before shared Mechanics.Interact,
-- Update(game, dt) at the end of shared update.
local M = {}

local CAT_W = 0.95

local function copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local out = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do out[key] = copy(item) end
    return out
end

local function starts_with(value, prefix)
    return type(value) == "string" and value:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix
end

local function find(game, id)
    local indexed = game.machineById and game.machineById[id]
    if indexed then return indexed end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do
        if machine.id == id then return machine end
    end
    return nil
end

local function active(game, id)
    local machine = find(game, id)
    return machine and machine.active == true
end

local function carried(game, index)
    if game.CarriedBall then return game:CarriedBall(index) end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
        if ball.carriedBy == index and not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" then return ball end
    end
    return nil
end

local function usable(ball)
    return ball and not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" and ball.state ~= "stored"
        and ball.state ~= "installed" and ball.state~="dustbin" and not ball.inTransit and not ball.inWasher
end

local function release_carried(game, ball, machine)
    if ball.carriedBy then
        local cat = game.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
        if cat then cat.carry = false end
        ball.carriedBy = nil
    end
    ball.state = "world"
    ball.x = (machine.x or ball.x) + 0.35
    ball.y = machine.y or 0
    ball.vx, ball.vy = 0, 0
end

local function nearby_ball(game, machine, predicate)
    local cx = (machine.x or 0) + (machine.w or 1) * 0.5
    local best, bestDistance
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
        if usable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and (not predicate or predicate(ball)) then
            local distance = math.abs((ball.x or 0) + (ball.w or 0.4) * 0.5 - cx)
            if distance < 1.35 and game:CanReachBall(machine,ball,1.35) and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) then
                best, bestDistance = ball, distance
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function requirements_met(game, machine)
    for _, id in ipairs(machine.requires or {}) do
        if not active(game, id) then return false end
    end
    if machine.requiresAny then
        for _, id in ipairs(machine.requiresAny) do
            if active(game, id) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function ability_met(game, machine)
    return game.sheep[game.active] ~= nil
end

local function working_ball(ball)
    return usable(ball) and ball.source ~= "decoy" and (ball.amount or 0) > 0
end
local function pulley_ball(ball)
    return working_ball(ball) and ball.kind == "full" and not ball.felt
end
local function bait_ball(ball)
    return usable(ball) and (ball.source == "decoy" or ball.kind == "full")
end
local function delivery_ball(game,machine,predicate)
    local ball=carried(game,game.active)
    if ball then return predicate(ball) and ball or nil end
    return nearby_ball(game,machine,predicate)
end
local function basket_evidence(game,basket)
    local units,count=0,0
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.state=="stored" and ball.storedAt==basket.id and not ball.lost
            and ball.source~="decoy" and (ball.amount or 0)>0 then
            units,count=units+ball.amount,count+1
        end
    end
    basket.stored,basket.storedUnits,basket.active=count,units,units>=18
    game.campaign.evidence.yarnInBasket=basket.active
end

-- Only loose halves actually resting in A's original trays can enter the
-- return chute. Carried, installed and already travelling yarn stays put.
local function relay_halves(game)
    local out={}
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if usable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and ball.state=="world" and ball.kind=="half" then
            for _,id in ipairs({"plateA","plateB"}) do
                local plate=find(game,id)
                local center=ball.x+(ball.w or .28)*.5
                if plate and center>=plate.x-.1 and center<=plate.x+(plate.w or 1)+.1
                    and math.abs((ball.y or 0)-(plate.y or 0))<.2 then
                    out[#out+1]=ball;break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- Shared by the green outline, context prompt, and execution path.
function M.CanInteract(game,machine)
    if not requirements_met(game,machine) or not ability_met(game,machine) then return false end
    local kind=machine.kind
    if kind=="finale_timed_gate" or kind=="finale_basin" or kind=="finale_owner" or kind=="finale_thief" then return false end
    if kind=="finale_material_relay" then return #relay_halves(game)>0 end
    if kind=="finale_pulley" then return delivery_ball(game,machine,pulley_ball)~=nil end
    if kind=="finale_dog_gate" then return not machine.active and delivery_ball(game,machine,bait_ball)~=nil end
    if kind=="finale_basket" then
        local ball=carried(game,game.active)
        if ball then return working_ball(ball) end
        return nearby_ball(game,machine,working_ball)~=nil or game.active==1
    end
    if kind=="finale_toolbox" then return not machine.active and active(game,"toolScissors") and active(game,"toolSpool") end
    if kind=="finale_bait_return" then
        if not active(game,"finalDivider") then return false end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do if ball.installedAt=="dogGate" then return true end end
        return false
    end

    if kind=="finale_clutter_book" then return not machine.tipped end
    if kind=="finale_dustbin" then
        if not machine.used then return true end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do if ball.state=="dustbin" then return true end end
        return false
    end
    if kind=="finale_timed_switch" or kind=="finale_decoy_station" or kind=="finale_noise_floor" then return true end
    return not machine.used
end

local function ensure_decoy(game, machine)
    for index, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.source == "decoy" then
            if ball.carriedBy then
                local cat = game.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
                if cat then cat.carry = false end
            end
            table.remove(game.balls, index)
            return true
        end
    end
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active]
    game.balls[#game.balls + 1] = {
        id = game.nextBallId or (#game.balls + 1),
        owner = 0,
        kind = "decoy",
        source = "decoy",
        amount = 0,
        weight = 1,
        w = 0.32,
        state = "world",
        x = (cat and cat.x or machine.x or 1) + 1.0,
        y = cat and cat.y or 0,
        vx = 0,
        vy = 0,
    }
    game.nextBallId = (game.nextBallId or #game.balls) + 1
    return true
end

function M.Init(game)
    if not game or not game.def or not game.def.finale then return end
    local c = game.campaign
    c.finale = c.finale or {}
    c.finale.timers = {}
    c.finale.owner = {
        x = game.level == 11 and 18.0 or 0,
        dir = 1,
        alertTimer = 0,
        distracted = 0,
        warningCat = nil,
    }
    c.finale.vacuum = { paperTimer = 0, warning = false }
    c.finale.completed = {}
    if game.level == 10 or game.level == 11 then
        c.inventoryTools = c.inventoryTools or {}
        c.inventoryTools["假球"] = true
    end
    if game.level == 11 then
        c.evidence = c.evidence or {}
        c.evidence.yarnInBasket = false
        c.evidence.toolsInBox = false
        c.evidence.machineCovered = false
        c.allEvidence = false
    end
end

function M.Interact(game, machine)
    if not machine or not starts_with(machine.kind, "finale_") then return false, false end
    if not M.CanInteract(game,machine) then return true,false end
    local c = game.campaign
    c.finale = c.finale or { timers = {} }
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active]

    if machine.kind == "finale_plan" then
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_material_relay" then
        local halves=relay_halves(game)
        for index,ball in ipairs(halves) do
            ball.inTransit,ball.state,ball.transitTimer=true,"inTransit",1.4
            ball.transitDuration,ball.transitStartX,ball.transitStartY=1.4,ball.x,ball.y
            ball.transitTarget,ball.transitY=16.3+(index-1)*.55,0
        end
        machine.active=true
        return true,#halves>0
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_timed_switch" then
        local target = find(game, machine.target)
        c.finale.timers[machine.target] = machine.duration or 5
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        if target then target.active = true end
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_timed_gate" then
        return true, false
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_lamp" then
        if machine.id == "lightLow" then local towel=find(game,"towelShade");towel.active,towel.used=true,true end
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_towel" then
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_latch" then
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        if machine.id == "vacuumOff" then c.finale.vacuumOff = true end
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_pulley" then
        local ball = delivery_ball(game,machine,pulley_ball)
        if not ball then return true, false end
        release_carried(game, ball, machine)
        ball.inTransit, ball.state, ball.transitTimer = true, "inTransit", 1.1
        ball.transitDuration,ball.transitStartX,ball.transitStartY=1.1,ball.x,ball.y
        ball.transitTarget, ball.transitY = machine.targetX or machine.x + 2, 0
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_basin" then
        return true, false
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_dustbin" then
        local any = false
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
            if ball.state == "dustbin" then
                ball.state, ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx, ball.vy = "world", (machine.x or 0) + 0.5, machine.y or 0, 0, 0
                ball.vacuumTimer = 0
                any = true
            end
        end
        machine.active,machine.used = true,true
        machine.hasCargo=false
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_bait_return" then
        if not active(game,"finalDivider") then return true,false end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.installedAt=="dogGate" then
                ball.installedAt,ball.state,ball.x,ball.y=nil,"world",machine.x+.2,0
                return true,true
            end
        end
        return true,false
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_dog_gate" then
        local ball = delivery_ball(game,machine,bait_ball)

        if not ball then return true, false end
        release_carried(game, ball, machine)
        ball.state, ball.installedAt = "installed", machine.id
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_decoy_station" then
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, ensure_decoy(game, machine)
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_noise_floor" then
        c.finale.owner.distracted = 2.5
        c.finale.owner.phase="inspect"
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_clutter_book" then
        if machine.tipped then return true,false end
        machine.tipped,machine.repaired,machine.used=true,false,true
        return true,true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_basket_brake" then
        machine.active = true
        c.finale.basketSlowHint = true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_basket" then
        local ball = delivery_ball(game,machine,working_ball)

        if not ball then
            if game.active~=1 then return true,false end
            machine.dragging=not machine.dragging
            return true,true
        end
        release_carried(game, ball, machine)
        ball.state, ball.storedAt = "stored", machine.id
        basket_evidence(game,machine)
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_tool_piece" then
        machine.active,machine.used,machine.x=true,true,(find(game,machine.target) or machine).x
        return true,true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_toolbox" then
        if not active(game,"toolScissors") or not active(game,"toolSpool") then return true,false end
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        c.evidence.toolsInBox = true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_machine_cover" then
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        c.evidence.machineCovered = true
        return true, true
    elseif machine.kind == "finale_owner" then
        return true, false
    end

    return true, false
end

local function cat_in_cover(game, cat)
    for _, zone in ipairs(game.def.coverZones or {}) do
        if (not zone.requires or active(game,zone.requires)) and cat.x-.12>=zone.x0 and cat.x+CAT_W+.08<=zone.x1 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function nearest_safe_x(game, cat)
    local best, distance = game.def.spawnX or 1.4, math.huge
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do
        if machine.id=="safeSpot" or machine.kind=="checkpoint" and machine.used then
            local d = math.abs(cat.x - (machine.x or 0))
            if d < distance then best, distance = (machine.x or best)-CAT_W*.5, d end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function update_level10(game, dt)
    local c = game.campaign
    local finale = c.finale
    for id, time in pairs(copy(finale.timers or {})) do
        local nextTime = math.max(0, time - dt)
        finale.timers[id] = nextTime
        local machine = find(game, id)
        if machine then machine.active = nextTime > 0 end
    end
    local aDoor=find(game,"aDoor")
    if active(game,"plateA") and active(game,"plateB") and active(game,"aHighLatch") and active(game,"aCrawlLatch") then
        local latch=find(game,"aExitLatch"); latch.active=true
        aDoor.latch="aExitLatch"
    end
    local gate=find(game,"timedGate")
    -- Solving all four cooperative tasks permanently secures the short hall;
    -- recovering the halves must not demand repeated timed-switch trips.
    if active(game,"aExitLatch") then gate.active=true end
    gate.open=gate.active
    if not gate.active then
        for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and cat.x+CAT_W>gate.x and cat.x<gate.x+.45 then
                cat.x=cat.x<gate.x and gate.x-CAT_W-.08 or gate.x+.52
                cat.vx=0
            end
        end
    end
    c.stage=active(game,"bInnerBrace") and "C" or active(game,"aExitLatch") and "B" or "A"
    if active(game,"dogGate") then
        for _,wall in ipairs(c.walls) do if wall.id=="dogSlowGap" then wall.requiresActive="dogGate" end end
    end

    local basin = find(game, "waterBasin")
    if basin then
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
            if usable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and not ball.felt
                and math.abs((ball.x or 0) - (basin.x or 0)) < 1.1
                and math.abs((ball.y or 0)-(basin.y or 0)) < .2 then
                ball.felt, ball.weight, ball.w = true, 4, 0.29
                ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx, ball.vy = (basin.x or 0) + 0.9, 0, 0, 0
                basin.active = true
            end
        end
    end

    local vacuumOff = active(game, "vacuumOff") or finale.vacuumOff == true
    local thief=find(game,"finaleThief")
    if (c.meowPulse or 0)>0 then thief.theftTimer,thief.scaredTimer=0,2 end
    thief.scaredTimer=math.max(0,(thief.scaredTimer or 0)-dt)
    local candidate
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if usable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and math.abs(ball.x-thief.x)<1.2 and ball.source~="decoy" then candidate=ball;break end
    end
    if candidate and thief.scaredTimer==0 then
        thief.theftTimer=(thief.theftTimer or 0)+dt
        if thief.theftTimer>=3 then candidate.lost,candidate.state=true,"lost";thief.theftTimer=0 end
    else thief.theftTimer=0 end
    local dustbin = find(game, "dustbinOpen")
    if not vacuumOff then
        local phase=(game.clock or 0)%4
        finale.vacuum.warning=phase<1
        finale.vacuum.sucking=phase>=1 and phase<3
        for _, zone in ipairs(game.def.zones or {}) do
            if zone.kind == "finale_vacuum" then
                for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
                    if usable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and ball.state == "world" and ball.y<.4 and finale.vacuum.sucking
                        and ball.x + (ball.w or 0.4) > zone.x0 and ball.x < zone.x1 then
                        ball.vacuumTimer = (ball.vacuumTimer or 0) + dt
                        if ball.vacuumTimer >= 1.0 then
                            ball.state, ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx, ball.vy = "dustbin", zone.dustbinX or 31.8, 0, 0, 0
                            if dustbin then dustbin.hasCargo = true end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    c.meowPulse=math.max(0,(c.meowPulse or 0)-dt)
end

local function update_hidden(game, dt)
    local c = game.campaign
    local owner = c.finale.owner
    local ownerMachine = find(game, "owner")
    if owner.warningCat then
        local cat=game.sheep[owner.warningCat]
        if cat and (cat_in_cover(game,cat) or math.abs(cat.x-owner.x)>2) then owner.alertTimer,owner.warningCat=0,nil end
    end
    for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        cat.coverExposure=false
        for _,zone in ipairs(game.def.coverZones or {}) do
            if cat.x+CAT_W>zone.x0 and cat.x<zone.x1 and not cat_in_cover(game,cat) then cat.coverExposure=true end
        end
    end
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.source=="decoy" and ball.state=="world" and math.abs(ball.x-owner.x)<5 and not ball.ownerPicked and owner.distracted<=0 then
            ball.ownerPicked=true; owner.distracted=6; owner.phase="pickup"; owner.actionX=ball.x; owner.toyId=ball.id
        end
    end
    local book=find(game,"fallenBook")
    if book and book.tipped and owner.distracted<=0 and math.abs(book.x-owner.x)<2.4 then
        owner.distracted,owner.phase,owner.actionX,owner.repairId=3.2,"repair",book.x,book.id
    end
    local basket=find(game,"basket")
    basket_evidence(game,basket)
    if basket.dragging and game.active==1 then
        local cat=game.sheep[1]
        basket.speed=math.abs(cat.vx)
        basket.x=cat.x+.5
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do if ball.storedAt==basket.id then ball.x=basket.x+.2 end end
        basket.noiseWarning=basket.x>11.3 and basket.x<12.4 and basket.speed>2.1
        if basket.noiseWarning then owner.alertTimer=math.max(owner.alertTimer,.8); owner.phase="inspect" end
    end
    local floor=find(game,"noiseFloor")
    for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.x+CAT_W*.5-floor.x)<.3 and not cat.floorSeen then
            cat.floorSeen=true; owner.distracted=2.5; owner.phase="inspect"
        end
    end
    if owner.distracted and owner.distracted > 0 then
        owner.distracted = math.max(0, owner.distracted - dt)
        if owner.actionX then
            owner.dir=owner.actionX<owner.x and -1 or 1
            owner.x=owner.x+math.max(-dt*.9,math.min(dt*.9,owner.actionX-owner.x))
            if ownerMachine then ownerMachine.x=owner.x end
        end
        if owner.phase=="repair" and owner.distracted<.8 and book then book.tipped,book.repaired=false,true end
        if owner.phase=="pickup" and owner.distracted<3 then
            for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do if ball.id==owner.toyId then ball.state="stored" end end
        end
        if owner.distracted==0 then owner.actionX,owner.repairId,owner.toyId=nil,nil,nil end
        if ownerMachine then ownerMachine.active = false end
    else
        if owner.warningCat then
            local exposed=game.sheep[owner.warningCat]
            if exposed then owner.dir=exposed.x<owner.x and -1 or 1 end
        end
        owner.x = owner.x + owner.dir * dt * 0.7
        if owner.x > 25.0 then owner.dir = -1 elseif owner.x < 12.0 then owner.dir = 1 end
        if ownerMachine then ownerMachine.x = owner.x end
        if owner.alertTimer and owner.alertTimer > 0 then
            owner.alertTimer = math.max(0, owner.alertTimer - dt)
            if owner.alertTimer == 0 and owner.warningCat then
                local cat = game.sheep[owner.warningCat]
                if cat and not cat.arrived and not cat_in_cover(game, cat) and math.abs(cat.x-owner.x)<1.8 then
                    cat.x, cat.y, cat.vx, cat.vy = nearest_safe_x(game, cat), 0, 0, 0
                end
                owner.warningCat = nil
            end
        else
            for index, cat in ipairs(game.sheep or {}) do
                if not cat.arrived and math.abs(cat.x - owner.x) < 1.2 and not cat_in_cover(game, cat) then
                    owner.warningCat = index
                    owner.alertTimer = game.def.ownerWarningSeconds or 1.0
                    if ownerMachine then ownerMachine.active = true end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    c.ownerPhase=owner.distracted>0 and (owner.phase or "pickup") or owner.alertTimer>0 and "alert" or "patrol"

    c.allEvidence = c.evidence and c.evidence.yarnInBasket and c.evidence.toolsInBox and c.evidence.machineCovered
end

function M.Update(game, dt)
    if not game or not game.def or not game.def.finale or not game.campaign or not game.campaign.finale then return end
    if game.level == 10 then update_level10(game, dt) end
    if game.level == 11 then update_hidden(game, dt) end
end

return M

CampaignHintState:
-- Hint depth belongs to the current puzzle, not the entire room.
local M = {}
local function active(game, id)
    local machine = game:GetMachine(id)
    return machine and machine.active == true
end
function M.Task(game)
    if game.won then return "won" end
    if game.campaign.lossUnits > 0 and not game.campaign.hasWool then return "rescue" end
    for index, task in ipairs(game.def.hintTasks or {}) do
        local done = task.skipIf and active(game, task.skipIf)
        if not done then
            done = true
            for _, id in ipairs(task.requires or {}) do
                if not active(game, id) then done = false; break end
            end
        end
        if not done then return "task:" .. index, index end
    end
    return "home"
end
function M.Sync(game)
    local key = M.Task(game)
    local c = game.campaign
    if c.hintTask ~= key then
        c.hintTask, c.hintStage = key, 1
    end
    return c.hintStage or 1
end
function M.Set(game, stage)
    M.Sync(game)
    game.campaign.hintStage = math.max(1, math.min(3, stage or 1))
end
function M.Advance(game)
    local key = M.Task(game)
    local changed = game.campaign.hintTask ~= key
    local stage = M.Sync(game)
    -- An open panel can advance only within the puzzle it was showing.
    if not changed then M.Set(game, stage >= 3 and 1 or stage + 1) end
    return M.Sync(game)
end
return M

    for row = 0, math.ceil(bottom / .38) do
        local yy = row * .38
        Line(ctx, x0, yy, x1, yy, { 139, 107, 80, 90 }, .015)

            Line(ctx, xx + .41, yy + .27, xx + 1.25, yy + .26, { 140, 106, 79, 40 }, .009)

    Line(ctx, x0, -.092, x1, -.092, { 251, 231, 199, 200 }, .017)
    Line(ctx, x0, .015, x1, .015, { 128, 101, 78, 170 }, .020)

    local cx = level == 1 and 3.28 or level == 2 and 5.75 or 5.65
    Oval(ctx, cx, .37, level == 1 and 2.28 or 2.11, .23, palette.fabric, { 150, 145, 128, 110 })
    Oval(ctx, cx, .37, level == 1 and 2.10 or 1.94, .17, { 233, 224, 204, 130 })
    for i = 1, 10 do Line(ctx, cx - 1.65 + i * .30, .25, cx - 1.58 + i * .30, .47,
        { 148, 146, 130, 60 }, .010) end
    Oval(ctx, 31.50, .40, 1.66, .21, palette.fabric)

---@param ctx NVGContextWrapper
---@param game table
---@param layout table
---@param ground number
---@param unit number
---@param wx fun(x:number):number
---@param gy fun(y:number):number
---@return boolean
function Art.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
    if not Supported(game) or unit <= 0 then return false end
    local palette = PALETTES[game.level]
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(0), ground); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    nvgLineCap(ctx, NVG_ROUND)
    local x0 = (layout.x - wx(0)) / unit
    local x1 = x0 + layout.w / unit
    local top = (layout.y - ground) / unit
    Gradient(ctx, x0, top, x1 - x0, math.max(.1, -top), 0, palette.top, palette.wall)
    -- 纸纹和墙裙固定在米制世界坐标，近景平移/全景缩放时不沿屏幕漂移。
    for i = math.floor(x0 / .84), math.ceil(x1 / .84) do
        local xx = i * .84
        Line(ctx, xx, top, xx, -.13, { 186, 165, 136, 25 }, .012)
        for j = 1, 4 do Oval(ctx, xx + .22 + (j % 2) * .21, -j * .89 + (i % 3) * .085,
            .016, .023, { 194, 176, 148, 23 }) end
    end
    Rect(ctx, x0, -1.95, x1 - x0, 1.85, 0, { 219, 207, 182, game.level == 5 and 35 or 60 })
    Line(ctx, x0, -1.94, x1, -1.94, { 173, 159, 135, 60 }, .017)
    local function visible(a, b) return x1 > a - .5 and x0 < b + .5 end
    if game.level == 1 then Living(ctx, game, visible)
    elseif game.level == 2 then Study(ctx, game, visible)
    else Bedroom(ctx, game, visible) end
    -- 家具与灯光先画在背景，猫、唯一散线和真实机关仍在公共前景层。
    if game.level == 1 then Poly(ctx, { 12.55, -.35, 15.72, -.35, 18.92, -.05, 14.00, -.05 },
        { 255, 240, 188, 22 }) end
    local bottom = math.max(.1, (layout.y + layout.h - ground) / unit)
    Floor(ctx, x0, x1, bottom, palette, game.level)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    return true
end

---@param ctx NVGContextWrapper
---@param p table
---@param game table
---@param unit number
---@param wx fun(x:number):number
---@param gy fun(y:number):number
---@return boolean
function Art.Platform(ctx, p, game, unit, wx, gy)
    if not Supported(game) or unit <= 0 then return false end
    local known = game.level == 1 and (p.id == "cabinet" or p.id == "secretShelf")
        or game.level == 2 and (p.id == "seesawRight" or p.id == "bookShelf" or p.id == "upperPlate" or p.id == "foldedRamp")
        or game.level == 5 and (p.id == "nearHookShelf" or p.id == "ropeDeck" or p.id == "wideBridgeDeck" or p.id == "underExit")
    if not known then return false end
    local source = p.requiresActive and game:GetMachine(p.requiresActive)
    local active = not p.requiresActive or source and source.active == true
    local base = Details.PlatformY(game, p, p.x) or 0
    local h = p.h or .14
    local w = p.w
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(p.x), gy(base + h)); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    nvgLineCap(ctx, NVG_ROUND)
    if p.id == "ropeDeck" then
        local wide = game:GetMachine("wideBridge")
        if active and not (wide and wide.active) then
            -- 顶线保持在真实碰撞面；下垂读生产 sag，仅画在承重线下方作预警。
            Line(ctx, 0, 0, w, 0, { 161, 133, 98, 255 }, .034)
            local sag = source and source.sag or 0
            Curve(ctx, 0, .038, w * .31, .038 + sag, w * .69, .038 + sag, w, .038,
                { 206, 179, 137, 255 }, .023)
            for i = 1, math.floor(w / .28) do
                local xx = i * .28
                Line(ctx, xx, .009, xx + .032, .047 + sag * math.sin(xx / w * math.pi),
                    { 129, 111, 82, 170 }, .011)
            end
        end
    elseif p.id == "wideBridgeDeck" and not active then FoldedBridge(ctx, p)
    elseif p.id == "foldedRamp" and not active then
        local endBase = Details.PlatformY(game, p, p.x + w) or base
        local dy = base - endBase
        Rect(ctx, w - .075, dy - .73, .15, .74, .035, { 190, 175, 144, 255 }, INK)
        for i = 1, 5 do Line(ctx, w - .054, dy - i * .12, w + .054, dy - i * .12, PAPER, .016) end
        Oval(ctx, w, dy + h * .5, .055, .055, METAL, INK)
    elseif not active then
        nvgRestore(ctx); return false
    elseif p.ramp then
        local endBase = Details.PlatformY(game, p, p.x + w) or base
        local dy = base - endBase
        Poly(ctx, { 0, 0, w, dy, w, dy + h, 0, h },
            p.id == "underExit" and { 206, 184, 159, 255 } or WOOD, INK)
        Line(ctx, .02, .019, w - .02, dy + .019, CREAM, .017)
        for i = 1, math.floor(w / .30) do
            local xx = i * .30
            Line(ctx, xx, dy * xx / w + .035, xx + .055, dy * (xx + .055) / w + h - .025,
                { 142, 122, 98, 140 }, .018)
        end
        Oval(ctx, w - .05, dy + h * .5, .023, .023, METAL, INK)
    elseif p.id == "wideBridgeDeck" then
        Deck(ctx, w, h)
        for i = 1, math.floor(w / .34) do Line(ctx, i * .34, .017, i * .34, h - .018,
            { 147, 118, 91, 180 }, .015) end
        for _, xx in ipairs({ .075, w - .075 }) do Oval(ctx, xx, h * .55, .034, .034, METAL, INK) end
    else
        Deck(ctx, w, h, p.id == "nearHookShelf" and { 196, 177, 194, 255 } or nil)
        if p.id == "seesawRight" then
            -- 托架平台与真实 lift 同步，既不画固定顶面，也不在旧高度留下副本。
            Rect(ctx, w * .47, h, .12, .23, .025, METAL, INK)
            Poly(ctx, { w * .23, h + .23, w * .77, h + .23, w * .52, h + .035 },
                { 177, 164, 135, 220 }, INK)
            LampDot(ctx, w - .18, h * .56, (base or 0) > 1.12)
        end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    return true
end

local function Door(ctx, m, game)
    local w, h = m.w or .55, m.h or 3.6
    local open = m.open or m.active
    Rect(ctx, -.06, -h - .08, w + .12, .13, .03, { 194, 176, 146, 255 }, INK)
    Rect(ctx, 0, -h, w, open and .13 or h, .035,
        open and { 180, 203, 151, 255 } or { 214, 187, 151, 255 }, INK)
    if not open then
        Rect(ctx, w * .14, -h + .18, w * .72, h * .47, .028, { 226, 203, 169, 255 },
            { 185, 157, 123, 160 })
        Rect(ctx, w * .14, -h * .35, w * .72, h * .28, .027, { 224, 200, 165, 255 },
            { 185, 157, 123, 160 })
        Oval(ctx, w * .72, -h * .48, .040, .040, METAL, INK)
        Grain(ctx, .05, -h + .10, w - .10, h - .20)
    end
    local requirements = m.requires or {}
    local span = math.max(.48, #requirements * .15 + .17)
    Rect(ctx, w * .5 - span * .5, -h - .43, span, .25, .055, CREAM, INK)
    for i, id in ipairs(requirements) do
        local source = game:GetMachine(id)
        LampDot(ctx, w * .5 + (i - (#requirements + 1) * .5) * .15, -h - .305,
            open or source and (source.active or source.pressed))
    end
end

local function Plate(ctx, m)
    local w = m.w or 1.4
    local lit = m.pressed or m.active
    local top = lit and -.025 or -.105
    Rect(ctx, -.055, -.02, w + .11, .12, .04, { 146, 148, 123, 255 }, INK)
    Rect(ctx, 0, top, w, .10, .035, lit and { 177, 203, 147, 255 } or { 209, 190, 152, 255 }, INK)
    if m.ballWell then Oval(ctx, w * .5, top + .021, w * .35, .045,
        { 139, 123, 95, 95 }, { 156, 139, 108, 180 }) end
    if m.maxDiameter then
        -- 半球罩的入口使用真实直径限制；不放任何示意毛线球充当已有材料。
        local mouth = m.maxDiameter
        local left, right = (w - mouth) * .5, (w + mouth) * .5
        Poly(ctx, { 0, -.01, 0, -.28, left - .045, -.40, left, -.32, left, -.01 },
            { 183, 192, 174, 255 }, INK)
        Poly(ctx, { right, -.01, right, -.32, right + .045, -.40, w, -.28, w, -.01 },
            { 183, 192, 174, 255 }, INK)
        Line(ctx, left, -.32, right, -.32, CREAM, .017)
        LampDot(ctx, .13, -.21, lit)
    end
    local count = m.need or 1
    for i = 1, count do LampDot(ctx, w * .5 + (i - (count + 1) * .5) * .13,
        m.maxDiameter and -.56 or -.29, lit) end

local function Tray(ctx, m, game)

local function Hook(ctx, m)
