---@param ctx NVGContextWrapper
---@param m table
---@param game table
---@param unit number
---@param wx fun(x:number):number
---@param gy fun(y:number):number
---@return boolean
function Art.Machine(ctx, m, game, unit, wx, gy)
    if not Supported(game) or unit <= 0 then return false end
    -- 剪刀台既有精修、织线机、网兜、解挂及备用线仍交给公共层，避免丢掉预览和反馈。
    local id = m.id
    local known = m.kind == "door" or m.kind == "plate"
        or game.level == 1 and (id == "climbSwitch" or id == "crawlSwitch" or id == "exitCatch")
        or game.level == 2 and (id == "balance" or id == "rampLatch" or id == "bookBumper" or id == "cutReset")
        or game.level == 5 and (id == "ropeNear" or id == "ropeFar" or id == "ropeBridge"
            or id == "farSwitch" or id == "wideBridge" or id == "drawer" or id == "ropeRepairTray")
    if not known then return false end
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(m.x or 0), gy(m.y or 0)); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    nvgLineCap(ctx, NVG_ROUND)
    if m.kind == "door" then Door(ctx, m, game)
    elseif m.kind == "plate" then Plate(ctx, m)
    elseif m.kind == "switch" then Switch(ctx, m)
    elseif m.kind == "receiver" or m.kind == "resetTray" then Tray(ctx, m, game)
    elseif id == "bookBumper" then
        Rect(ctx, -.04, -.39, (m.w or .25) + .08, .37, .055, { 176, 193, 181, 255 }, INK)
        Rect(ctx, .015, -.36, .075, .29, .035, { 225, 224, 193, 255 }, INK)
        Curve(ctx, .12, -.09, .02, -.15, .22, -.24, .12, -.31, METAL, .019)
        Arrow(ctx, -.07, -.50, -.29, -.50, { 145, 168, 130, 255 })
    elseif id == "balance" then
        -- 不画额外可踩的斜梁。真实右端托架已在 Platform 中跟随 lift 绘制。
        local w = m.w or 3.3
        Poly(ctx, { w * .37, -.02, w * .67, -.02, w * .52, -.37 },
            { 184, 161, 122, 255 }, INK)
        Oval(ctx, w * .52, -.23, .074, .074, METAL, INK)
        Curve(ctx, .14, -.07, w * .26, -.12, w * .44, -.19, w * .52, -.23,
            { 174, 159, 125, 200 }, .026)
        Rect(ctx, .055, -.06, .78, .075, .030, { 200, 184, 151, 255 }, INK)
        local need = m.need or 2
        for i = 1, need do Oval(ctx, .445 + (i - (need + 1) * .5) * .13, -.21,
            .025, .025, m.active and GREEN or MUTED) end
        LampDot(ctx, w * .52, -.49, m.active == true)
    elseif id == "ropeNear" or id == "ropeFar" then Hook(ctx, m)
    elseif id == "ropeBridge" then
        -- 绳体只画一次，由 ropeDeck 读取真实顶面；此处为固定承重牌和状态灯。
        Rect(ctx, -.62, -.55, .49, .28, .055, CREAM, INK)
        for i = 1, 2 do LampDot(ctx, -.56 + i * .12, -.405,
            m.active and (m.weight or 0) <= 2) end
        if (m.overload or 0) > 0 then
            Line(ctx, -.34, -.74, -.34, -.66, { 189, 129, 99, 255 }, .024)
            Oval(ctx, -.34, -.60, .015, .015, { 189, 129, 99, 255 })
        end
    elseif id == "wideBridge" then
        Rect(ctx, -.27, -.12, .54, .13, .035, { 183, 179, 145, 255 }, INK)
        Poly(ctx, m.active and { -.19, -.11, .02, -.39, .22, -.11 }
            or { -.19, -.11, -.19, -.47, .08, -.47, .18, -.11 }, WOOD, INK)
        Oval(ctx, -.05, -.21, .040, .040, METAL, INK)
        LampDot(ctx, .29, -.42, m.active == true)
    elseif id == "drawer" then
        nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, m.active and -.31 or 0, 0)
        Rect(ctx, -.36, -.32, .72, .29, .045, { 218, 188, 157, 255 }, INK)
        Rect(ctx, -.29, -.26, .58, .16, .027, { 228, 205, 173, 255 }, { 189, 157, 127, 190 })
        Line(ctx, -.075, -.17, .075, -.17, METAL, .025)
        Grain(ctx, -.29, -.28, .58, .22); nvgRestore(ctx)
        if not m.active then Arrow(ctx, .25, -.51, -.15, -.51, { 154, 172, 135, 255 }) end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    return true
end

---@param ctx NVGContextWrapper
---@param wall table
---@param game table
---@param unit number
---@param wx fun(x:number):number
---@param gy fun(y:number):number
---@return boolean
function Art.Wall(ctx, wall, game, unit, wx, gy)
    local known = game.level == 1 and wall.id == "catGap" or game.level == 2 and wall.id == "bookend"
    if not known or unit <= 0 then return false end
    local source = wall.requiresActive and game:GetMachine(wall.requiresActive)
    local open = source and source.active == true
    local w = wall.w or .55
    local h = wall.h or 3.2
    local bottom = wall.y or .66
    -- h 是真实碰撞高度，必须从 y+h 开始；不能沿用旧公共层把 h 当世界顶坐标。
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(wall.x), gy(bottom + h)); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit)
    nvgLineCap(ctx, NVG_ROUND)
    Rect(ctx, -.025, -.07, w + .05, .13, .035, { 198, 179, 147, 255 }, INK)
    if not open then
        if wall.id == "bookend" then
            Rect(ctx, 0, 0, w, h, .045, { 176, 189, 174, 255 }, INK)
            Rect(ctx, .07, .12, w - .14, h - .24, .030, { 194, 204, 187, 255 })
            for i = 1, 4 do Line(ctx, .07, h * i / 5, w - .07, h * i / 5, PAPER, .025) end
            CatEtching(ctx, w * .5, h - .26, .53)
        else
            Rect(ctx, 0, 0, w, h, .035, { 220, 196, 160, 255 }, INK)
            Rect(ctx, .07, .12, w - .14, h - .24, .022, { 229, 210, 176, 255 },
                { 185, 162, 130, 155 })
            Grain(ctx, .05, .15, w - .10, h - .30)
            CatEtching(ctx, w * .5, h - .28, .62)
        end
        Line(ctx, 0, h, w, h, CREAM, .027)
    else
        Rect(ctx, 0, .02, w, .13, .032, { 188, 205, 165, 255 }, INK)
    end
    LampDot(ctx, w * .5, -.23, open)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    return true
end

return Art
CampaignLocalization:
-- CampaignLocalization：沿用 main 的文本刷新与下一帧重建；不初始化 UI、不持有页面快照。
-- ctx.getUI() 动态返回 gameLayer/overlayTitleLabel/overlaySubLabel/headerLevelLabel/countLabel/
-- legacyLabel/woolButton/interactButton/pauseButton/endingBackButton/overviewButton/menuPage/
-- selectPage/settingsPage/pausePage；ctx.getState() 返回 game/mode/paused/overview/displayedEnding。
-- 其他依赖：T/Guide/Progress/Legacy/LevelTitle/SubText/LevelHeader/refreshEnding。
-- destroyGameUI 由主负责销毁 gameLayer、endingPage，并清 gameLayer/victory/pausePage/endingPage。
-- buildGame/buildSelect/buildSettings 由主负责赋值、挂载；后两者还须销毁并替换各自旧页。
-- Refresh 只能刷新文本和置待重建标记；Apply 在下一帧调用，绝不能从语言切换回调同步调用。

---@class CampaignLocalization
---@field pendingRebuild boolean
---@field pendingGameRebuild boolean
local Localization = {}
Localization.__index = Localization

---@param ctx table<string, any>
---@return CampaignLocalization
function Localization.New(ctx)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Localization)
    self:init(ctx)
    return self
end

---@param ctx table<string, any>
function Localization:init(ctx)
    self.ctx = ctx
    self.pendingRebuild = false
    self.pendingGameRebuild = false
end

function Localization:Refresh()
    local ctx = self.ctx
    local T = ctx.T
    ctx.Guide.RefreshLanguage()
    local ui, state = ctx.getUI(), ctx.getState()
    local game = state.game
    if ui.gameLayer and state.mode == "game" then
        ui.overlayTitleLabel:SetText(ctx.LevelTitle(game.def, game.level))
        ui.overlaySubLabel:SetText(game.campaignV2 and ctx.SubText(game.level, game.def.sub) or (game.def.sub or ""))
        ui.headerLevelLabel:SetText(ctx.LevelHeader(game.def, game.level))
        ui.countLabel:SetText(T("inNest", game:ArrivedCount()))
        if game.campaignV2 then
            local data = ctx.Progress.GetCampaignData()
            ui.legacyLabel:SetText(T("totalYarn", data.totalStrands, data.totalUnits))
        else
            ui.legacyLabel:SetText(T("legacy", math.floor(ctx.Legacy.Get() + .5)))
        end
        ui.woolButton:SetText(game.sheep[game.active].carry and T("dropWool") or T("holdWool"))
        if ui.interactButton then ui.interactButton:SetText(T("interact")) end
        ui.pauseButton:SetText(state.paused and T("resume") or T("paused"))
    end
    ctx.refreshEnding(state.displayedEnding)
    ui = ctx.getUI()
    if ui.endingBackButton then ui.endingBackButton:SetText(T("toSelect")) end
    if ui.overviewButton then ui.overviewButton:SetText(T(state.overview and "followView" or "overview")) end
    -- 当前事件栈可能来自覆盖层按钮；此处绝不 Destroy，统一留到下一帧 Apply。
    self.pendingRebuild = true
    self.pendingGameRebuild = true
    if ui.menuPage then
        local t = ui.menuPage:FindById("menuTitle") --[[@as Label?]]
        if t then t:SetText(T("title")) end
        local s = ui.menuPage:FindById("startButton") --[[@as Button?]]
        if s then s:SetText(T("start")) end
        local b = ui.menuPage:FindById("menuSettingsButton") --[[@as Button?]]
        if b then b:SetText(T("settings")) end
        local rt = ui.menuPage:FindById("rulesTitle") --[[@as Label?]]
        if rt then rt:SetText(T("rulesTitle")) end
        local rl = ui.menuPage:FindById("rulesLoad") --[[@as Label?]]
        if rl then rl:SetText("① " .. T("rulesLoad")) end
        local rs = ui.menuPage:FindById("rulesShape") --[[@as Label?]]
        if rs then rs:SetText("② " .. T("rulesShape")) end
        local rc = ui.menuPage:FindById("rulesScore") --[[@as Label?]]
        if rc then rc:SetText("③ " .. T("rulesScore")) end
    end
end

function Localization:Apply()
    if not self.pendingRebuild then return end
    self.pendingRebuild = false
    local ctx = self.ctx
    if ctx.rebuildMenu then ctx.rebuildMenu() end
    if self.pendingGameRebuild then
        self.pendingGameRebuild = false
        local ui = ctx.getUI()
        local wasVisible = ui.gameLayer and ui.gameLayer:IsVisible() or false
        ctx.destroyGameUI()
        ctx.buildGame()
        ui = ctx.getUI() -- 重建后必须取新引用，不能继续访问已销毁页面。
        ui.gameLayer:SetVisible(wasVisible)
        if ui.pausePage then ui.pausePage:SetVisible(ctx.getState().paused and wasVisible) end
    end
    local ui = ctx.getUI()
    if ui.selectPage then
        local wasVisible = ui.selectPage:IsVisible()
        ctx.buildSelect() -- 主回调销毁、替换旧页，避免重复 Destroy 或主局部留悬空引用。
        ctx.getUI().selectPage:SetVisible(wasVisible)
    end
    ui = ctx.getUI()
    if ui.settingsPage then
        local wasVisible = ui.settingsPage:IsVisible()
        ctx.buildSettings()
        ctx.getUI().settingsPage:SetVisible(wasVisible)
    end
end

return Localization
CampaignMechanics:
-- Campaign V2 通用机关状态机。关卡配置使用稳定 ID；变形、运输和安装都复用原资源实体。
local Mechanics = {}
local Details = require("CampaignDetails")
local Expansion = require("CampaignExpansion")
local Finale = require("CampaignFinaleMechanics")
local GRAVITY = 19
local CAT_W = 0.95
local BallAvailable

local function stationBall(game,machine,ball,range)
    return BallAvailable(ball) and game:CanReachBall(machine,ball,range)
end

local function Ledger(ball)
    return ball.ledger or { [ball.source or "standard"] = ball.amount or 0 }
end

function Mechanics.ScoredUnits(ball)
    local ledger = Ledger(ball)
    return (ledger.standard or 0) + (ledger.collectible or 0)
end

function Mechanics.CanInteract(game, machine)
    local expanded,allowed=Expansion.CanInteract(game,machine)
    if expanded then return allowed end
    if game.active==1 then
        for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
            if m.kind=="finale_basket" and m.dragging then return machine==m end
        end
    end
    if type(machine.kind)=="string" and machine.kind:sub(1,7)=="finale_" then
        return Finale.CanInteract(game,machine)
    end
    if machine.used and (machine.kind=="finale_tool_piece" or machine.kind=="finale_towel") then return false end
    -- Two-position levers are physical controls.  Walking into either side sets
    -- their direction; E must never toggle them behind the player's back.
    if machine.kind == "windControl" or machine.id == "windControl" or machine.id == "routeSwitch"
        or machine.kind == "fish" then
        return false
    end
    if machine.kind == "plate" or machine.kind == "door" or machine.kind == "seesaw"
        or machine.kind=="finale_timed_gate" or machine.kind=="finale_owner" or machine.kind=="finale_basin" or machine.kind=="finale_thief"
        or machine.kind == "laserPlate" or machine.kind == "metal" or machine.kind == "owner"
        or machine.kind == "dog" or machine.kind == "receiver" or machine.kind == "bumper"
        or machine.kind == "bottleRack" then return false end
    if machine.requires then
        for _,id in ipairs(machine.requires) do
            local ready=false
            for _,candidate in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
                if candidate.id==id then ready=candidate.active==true;break end
            end
            if not ready then return false end
        end
    end
    local oneShot = machine.kind=="button" or machine.kind=="bridge" or machine.kind=="divider"
        or machine.kind=="prop" or machine.kind=="tool"
        or machine.kind=="switch" and machine.id~="unload" and machine.id~="catTree"
    if oneShot and machine.active then return false end
    if machine.kind=="prop" then
        local ball=game:CarriedBall(game.active)
        return game.sheep[game.active].weight+(ball and ball.weight or 0)>=(machine.pushMin or 1)
    elseif machine.kind=="ropeBridge" then
        if machine.manualEnds or machine.active then return false end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.kind=="rope" and BallAvailable(ball) and math.abs(ball.x-machine.x)<1.6 then return true end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind=="washerControl" then
        return game.campaign.carrierEnabled==true
    elseif machine.kind=="releaseMetal" or machine.kind=="dustbin" then
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if machine.kind=="releaseMetal" and ball.installedAt=="metalSwitch"
                or machine.kind=="dustbin" and ball.state=="dustbin" then return true end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind=="backup" then
        return game:CanGrantRescue()
    elseif machine.kind=="dish" and machine.repeatRoute then
        -- Inspect the stable machine list here; Find is scoped below.
        for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do if m.id=="rat" and m.fed then return true end end
        return game.campaign.fishInHand==true
    elseif machine.kind=="eatFish" or machine.kind=="dish" then
        return game.campaign.fishInHand==true
    elseif machine.kind=="rest" then
        return (game.sheep[game.active].weightBonus or 0)>0
    elseif machine.kind=="cutStation" then
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.kind=="full" and not ball.felt and BallAvailable(ball)
                and (ball.carriedBy==game.active or not ball.carriedBy and stationBall(game,machine,ball,1.2)) then return true end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind=="weaveStation" then
        return Mechanics.WeaveCount(game,machine)>=2
    elseif machine.kind=="ropeNear" then
        if machine.active then return false end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.kind=="rope" and not ball.lost and ball.state~="consumed"
                and (ball.carriedBy==game.active or not ball.carriedBy and math.abs(ball.x-(machine.x or 0))<2) then return true end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind=="ropeFar" then
        local near,bridge=nil,nil
        for _,candidate in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
            if candidate.id=="ropeNear" then near=candidate elseif candidate.id=="ropeBridge" then bridge=candidate end
        end
        return near and near.active==true and machine.active~=true and bridge and bridge.active~=true
            and (game.campaign.ropeTipX or -math.huge)>=(machine.x or 0)-.2
    elseif machine.kind=="unhook" then
        local bridge=nil
        for _,candidate in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do if candidate.id=="ropeBridge" then bridge=candidate;break end end
        if not bridge or not bridge.active then return false end
        for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and cat.x+CAT_W>bridge.x and cat.x<bridge.x+(bridge.w or 1) then return false end
        end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do if ball.installedAt==bridge.id then return true end end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind=="routeReset" then
        for _,b in ipairs(game.balls) do if b.inTransit then return true end end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind=="pulley" then
        local plate=nil
        for _,candidate in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do if candidate.id=="laserPlate" then plate=candidate;break end end
        if plate and not plate.active then return false end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if not ball.carriedBy and ball.state=="world" and stationBall(game,machine,ball,1.2) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- 机关不按猫的身份拒绝操作；到达能力由关卡空间、身体尺寸与携带状态自然决定。
    return true
end

local function Find(game, id)
    local indexed = game.machineById and game.machineById[id]
    if indexed then return indexed end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        if machine.id == id then return machine end
    end
    return nil
end

BallAvailable = function(ball)
    return not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" and ball.state ~= "stored"
        and ball.state ~= "installed" and ball.state ~= "dustbin" and not ball.inWasher and not ball.inTransit
end

function Mechanics.WeaveCount(game,machine)
    local count=0
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.kind=="half" and stationBall(game,machine,ball,2)
            and math.abs(ball.x-(machine.x or 0))<1.6 then count=count+1 end
    end
    return math.min(2,count)
end

local function PlateWeight(game, machine)
    return Details.MachineWeight(game, machine)
end

function Mechanics.GetPlateWeight(game,machine) return PlateWeight(game,machine) end

local function DoorRequirementsMet(game, machine)
    for _, id in ipairs(machine.requires or {}) do
        local required = Find(game, id)
        if not required or required.active ~= true then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function SplitBall(game, machine)
    local index = game.active
    local ball = game:CarriedBall(index)
    if ball and (ball.kind~="full" or ball.felt) then ball=nil end
    if not ball then
        for _,candidate in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if candidate.kind=="full" and not candidate.felt and BallAvailable(candidate) and not candidate.carriedBy
                and stationBall(game,machine,candidate,1.2) then ball=candidate; break end
        end
    end
    if not ball or ball.kind ~= "full" or ball.felt then return false end
    local before = game:YarnAmount()
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if ball.carriedBy==index then cat.carry=false end
    ball.carriedBy=nil
    local halfLedger = {}
    for source, units in pairs(Ledger(ball)) do halfLedger[source] = units / 2 end
    ball.ledger = halfLedger
    ball.kind, ball.amount, ball.weight, ball.w = "half", 3, 1, 0.28
    ball.state, ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx = "world", machine.x - 0.38, machine.y or 0, 0
    local other = {}
    for key, value in pairs(ball) do other[key] = value end
    other.ledger = {}
    for source, units in pairs(halfLedger) do other.ledger[source] = units end
    other.id, other.x = game.nextBallId, machine.x + 0.55
    game.nextBallId = game.nextBallId + 1
    game.balls[#game.balls + 1] = other
    machine.used, machine.active = true, true
    machine.reactionTimer=2
    assert(game:YarnAmount() == before, "剪球操作不得增减毛线单位")
    print("[剪刀台] 整球6单位变成两个半球，各3单位")
    return true
end

local function WeaveRope(game, machine)
    local halves = {}
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.kind == "half" and BallAvailable(ball)
            and math.abs(ball.x - machine.x) < 1.6 and stationBall(game,machine,ball,2) then
            halves[#halves + 1] = ball
            if #halves == 2 then break end
        end
    end
    if #halves < 2 then return false end
    local before = game:YarnAmount()
    local rope, consumed = halves[1], halves[2]
    local merged = {}
    for _, half in ipairs(halves) do
        for source, units in pairs(Ledger(half)) do merged[source] = (merged[source] or 0) + units end
        if half.carriedBy then game.sheep[half.carriedBy].carry = false; half.carriedBy = nil end
    end
    rope.ledger, consumed.ledger = merged, {}
    rope.kind, rope.weight, rope.w = "rope", 2, 0.56
    rope.amount, rope.parts, rope.x, rope.y, rope.state = rope.amount + consumed.amount,
        { rope.id, consumed.id }, machine.x + 0.6, 0, "world"
    consumed.amount, consumed.weight, consumed.lost, consumed.state = 0, 0, false, "consumed"
    machine.used, machine.active = true, true
    assert(game:YarnAmount() == before, "织绳操作不得增减毛线单位")
    print("[织线机] 两个半球合成同一根6单位绳，材料来源随实体保留")
    return true
end

local function EatFish(game, machine)
    local c = game.campaign
    if not c.fishInHand then return false end
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active]
    c.fishInHand = false
    cat.weightBonus = 1
    cat.weight = cat.baseWeight + 1
    cat.jumpHeight = math.max(0.5, cat.baseJumpHeight - 0.5)
    cat.jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * cat.jumpHeight)
    machine.active = true
    print("[鱼干] " .. cat.name .. " 体重+1；可到休息篮恢复")
    return true
end

Mechanics.EatFish=EatFish

local function StoreBallInBasket(game, machine)
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active]
    local ball = game:CarriedBall(game.active)
    if not ball or ball.source == "rescue" then return false end
    local before = game:YarnAmount()
    cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.state = false, nil, "stored"
    ball.storedAt, ball.x, ball.y = machine.id, machine.x, 0
    machine.stored = (machine.stored or 0) + 1
    machine.active = machine.stored >= 3
    game.campaign.evidence.yarnInBasket = machine.active
    assert(game:YarnAmount() == before, "隐藏关归篮不能改变毛线账目")
    print(string.format("[隐藏证据] 毛线入篮 %d/3", machine.stored))
    return true
end

local function UpdateDog(game, machine, dt)
    local c = game.campaign
    if c.dog.phase == "contained" then
        machine.active = true
        return
    end
    if c.dog.phase == "play" then
        c.dog.timer = math.max(0, c.dog.timer - dt)
        if c.dog.timer == 0 then c.dog.phase = "idle" end
    elseif c.dog.phase == "idle" then
        local safe = Find(game, "safeSpot")
        for index, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            local hidden = safe and math.abs(cat.x - safe.x) < 1
            if not cat.arrived and not hidden and math.abs(cat.x - machine.x) < 1.1 then
                c.dog.phase, c.dog.timer, c.dog.lastCat = "alert", 1, index
                print("[旺财] 竖耳预警：退到家具后或投出假球")
                break
            end
        end
    elseif c.dog.phase == "alert" then
        c.dog.timer = math.max(0, c.dog.timer - dt)
        if c.dog.timer == 0 then
            local victim = game.sheep[c.dog.lastCat or 1]
            if victim and not victim.arrived then victim.x = math.max(1.4, victim.x - 1.2) end
            c.dog.phase = "idle"
        end
    end
    machine.active = c.dog.phase == "play"
end

local function UpdateOwner(game, dt, machine)
    local c = game.campaign
    c.ownerX = c.ownerX + c.ownerDir * dt * 0.75
    if c.ownerX > 23 then c.ownerDir = -1 elseif c.ownerX < 12 then c.ownerDir = 1 end
    local safe = Find(game, "safeSpot")
    if c.ownerAlertCooldown and c.ownerAlertCooldown > 0 then
        c.ownerAlertCooldown = math.max(0, c.ownerAlertCooldown - dt)
    else
        for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and math.abs(cat.x - c.ownerX) < 0.7
                and (not safe or math.abs(cat.x - safe.x) > 1) then
                cat.x = math.max(1.4, cat.x - 1)
                c.ownerAlert, c.ownerAlertCooldown = true, 2
                break
            end
        end
    end
    machine.active = c.ownerAlert == true
end

function Mechanics.Interact(game, machine)
    if not machine then return false end
    local c, cat = game.campaign, game.sheep[game.active]
    local expanded,result=Expansion.Interact(game,machine)
    if expanded then return result end
    local finalHandled,finalResult=Finale.Interact(game,machine)
    if finalHandled then return finalResult end
    local handled,result=Details.Interact(game,machine)
    if handled then return result end
    if machine.requires and not DoorRequirementsMet(game,machine) then return false end
    if machine.kind == "backup" then
        return game:GrantRescue()
    elseif machine.kind == "checkpoint" then
        if game.Checkpoint then game:Checkpoint(machine) end
        machine.used, machine.active = true, true
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "button" or machine.kind == "switch" or machine.kind == "mirror" then
        if machine.id == "mirror" then
            machine.mode = (machine.mode or 1) % 2 + 1
        end
        if machine.id == "mirror" then c.laserTarget = (machine.targets or {20.7,17.6})[machine.mode] end
        if machine.id == "catTree" then
            c.carrierEnabled = true
            local washer=Find(game,"washer")
            if washer then washer.running,c.washerRunning=true,true end
        end
        if machine.id == "unload" then c.unloadSet = not c.unloadSet end
        if machine.id == "vacuumSwitch" then c.vacuumOff = true end
        machine.active, machine.used = true, true
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "cutStation" then
        return SplitBall(game, machine)
    elseif machine.kind == "weaveStation" then
        return WeaveRope(game, machine)
    elseif machine.kind == "ropeBridge" then
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.kind == "rope" and BallAvailable(ball) and math.abs(ball.x - machine.x) < 1.6 then
                if ball.carriedBy then game.sheep[ball.carriedBy].carry = false; ball.carriedBy = nil end
                ball.state, ball.installedAt = "installed", machine.id
                machine.active, machine.used = true, true
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind == "bridge" or machine.kind == "divider" then
        machine.active, machine.open, machine.used = true, true, true
        c.bridgesOpen = true
        if machine.kind == "divider" then c.dog.phase = "contained" end
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "fish" then
        if c.fishAvailable and not c.fishInHand then
            c.fishAvailable, c.fishInHand, machine.active = false, true, true
            return true
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind == "eatFish" then
        return EatFish(game, machine)
    elseif machine.kind == "rest" then
        cat.weightBonus, cat.weight, cat.jumpHeight = 0, cat.baseWeight, cat.baseJumpHeight
        cat.jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * cat.jumpHeight)
        c.fishAvailable, machine.active = true, true
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "dish" then
        local hired=machine.repeatRoute and Find(game,"rat") and Find(game,"rat").fed
        if not c.fishInHand and not hired then return false end
        c.fishInHand = false
        local rat = Find(game, "rat")
        if rat then rat.fed, rat.active = true, true end
        if machine.deliveryMode then
            local route=Find(game,"routeSwitch")
            if route then route.mode,route.active=machine.deliveryMode,true end
        end
        machine.active = true
        print("[老鼠交易] 鱼干进入食盘，鼠洞开放运输")
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "decoy" then
        return game:UseTool("假球")
    elseif machine.kind == "tool" then
        c.inventoryTools[machine.tool],machine.active=true,true
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "bell" then
        if c.dog.phase~="contained" then
            local repeats=machine.rings or 0
            local duration=(Find(game,"dog") or {}).playSeconds or 6
            machine.rings=repeats+1
            c.dog.phase,c.dog.timer,c.dog.targetX="play",math.max(3.5,duration/(1+repeats*.25)),machine.x+3
        end
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "laser" then
        c.laserOff=not c.laserOff
        machine.active=not c.laserOff
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "dustbin" then
        local any=false
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.state=="dustbin" then
                ball.state,ball.x,ball.y,ball.vx,ball.vy="world",machine.x+0.6,0,0,0
                ball.vacuumTimer=0
                any=true
            end
        end
        return any
    elseif machine.kind == "releaseMetal" then
        local any=false
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.installedAt=="metalSwitch" then
                ball.state,ball.installedAt,ball.x,ball.magnetCooldown="world",nil,machine.x-.2,2
                any=true
            end
        end
        return any
    elseif machine.kind == "unhook" then
        local bridge=Find(game,"ropeBridge")
        if not bridge then return false end
        for _,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not other.arrived and other.x+CAT_W>bridge.x and other.x<bridge.x+(bridge.w or 1) then return false end
        end
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.installedAt==bridge.id then
                ball.state,ball.installedAt,ball.x,ball.y="world",nil,machine.x+0.5,0
                bridge.active=false
                local near,far=Find(game,"ropeNear"),Find(game,"ropeFar")
                if near then near.active=false end
                if far then far.active=false end
                game.campaign.ropeTipX=nil
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind == "rat" then
        if not machine.fed then return false end
        local route = Find(game, "routeSwitch")
        if route and route.mode == 2 then
            if c.secret and not c.secretCollected then
                c.secretCollected, c.secret, c.fishAvailable = true, nil, true
                machine.active = true
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if BallAvailable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and math.abs(ball.x - machine.x) < 1 then
                local plate = Find(game, "deliveryPlate")
                ball.inTransit, ball.state, ball.transitTimer = true, "inTransit", 1.4
                ball.transitTarget = plate and plate.x + 0.2 or machine.x + 7
                machine.active = false
                c.fishAvailable = true
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind == "washer" then
        local carried = game:CarriedBall(game.active)
        if carried and not carried.felt then
            cat.carry, carried.carriedBy, carried.inWasher, carried.state = false, nil, true, "inWasher"
            machine.loaded = true
            machine.processing = true
            machine.timer=0
            return true
        end
        machine.running = not machine.running
        c.washerRunning = machine.running
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "pulley" then
        local laserPlate = Find(game, "laserPlate")
        if laserPlate and not laserPlate.active then return false end
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if not ball.carriedBy and stationBall(game,machine,ball,1.2) then
                local plate = Find(game, "upperPlate")
                ball.inTransit, ball.state, ball.transitTimer = true, "inTransit", 1
                ball.transitTarget = plate and plate.x + 0.4 or machine.x + 7
                ball.transitY=plate and (plate.y or 0) or 0
                machine.active,machine.used=true,true
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    elseif machine.kind == "basket" then
        local ball = game:CarriedBall(game.active)
        if not ball or ball.source == "rescue" then return false end
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.state = false, nil, "stored"
        machine.stored = (machine.stored or 0) + 1
        machine.active, c.evidence.yarnInBasket = machine.stored >= 3, machine.stored >= 3
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "toolBox" then
        c.evidence.toolsInBox, machine.active = true, true
        return true
    elseif machine.kind == "cover" then
        c.evidence.machineCovered, machine.active = true, true
        return true
    end
    return false
end

UpdateDog = function(game, machine, dt)
    local c = game.campaign
    if c.dog.phase == "contained" then machine.active = true; return end
    if c.dog.phase == "play" then
        c.dog.timer = math.max(0, c.dog.timer - dt)
        if c.dog.timer == 0 then c.dog.phase = "idle" end
    elseif c.dog.phase == "idle" then
        local safe = Find(game, "safeSpot")
        for index, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and not (safe and math.abs(cat.x - safe.x) < 1)
                and math.abs(cat.x - machine.x) < 1.1 then
                c.dog.phase, c.dog.timer, c.dog.lastCat = "alert", 1, index
                print("[旺财] 竖耳预警：退到家具后或投出假球")
                break
            end
        end
    elseif c.dog.phase == "alert" then
        c.dog.timer = math.max(0, c.dog.timer - dt)
        if c.dog.timer == 0 then
            local victim = game.sheep[c.dog.lastCat or 1]
            if victim and not victim.arrived then victim.x = math.max(1.4, victim.x - 1.2) end
            c.dog.phase = "idle"
        end
    end
    machine.active = c.dog.phase == "play"
end

UpdateOwner = function(game, dt, machine)
    local c = game.campaign
    if (c.ownerDistracted or 0)>0 then
        c.ownerDistracted=math.max(0,c.ownerDistracted-dt)
        machine.active=false
        return
    end
    c.ownerX = c.ownerX + c.ownerDir * dt * 0.75
    if c.ownerX > 23 then c.ownerDir = -1 elseif c.ownerX < 12 then c.ownerDir = 1 end
    local safe = Find(game, "safeSpot")
    if c.ownerAlertCooldown and c.ownerAlertCooldown > 0 then
        c.ownerAlertCooldown = math.max(0, c.ownerAlertCooldown - dt)
    else
        for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and math.abs(cat.x - c.ownerX) < 0.7
                and (not safe or math.abs(cat.x - safe.x) > 1) then
                cat.x = math.max(1.4, cat.x - 1)
                c.ownerAlert, c.ownerAlertCooldown = true, 2
                break
            end
        end
    end
    machine.active = c.ownerAlert == true
end

function Mechanics.Update(game, dt)
    local c = game.campaign
    c.meowCooldown = math.max(0, c.meowCooldown - dt)
    for _, zone in ipairs(c.zones) do
        if zone.kind == "water" then
            for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost and ball.state == "world"
                    and ball.x + ball.w > zone.x0 and ball.x < zone.x1 and (ball.y or 0)<.2 and not ball.felt then
                    ball.felt, ball.weight, ball.w = true, 4, 0.29
                end
            end
            if zone.outlet then
                for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                    if ball.felt and ball.state=="world" and not ball.carriedBy and ball.x>zone.x0 and ball.x<zone.outlet then ball.vx=1.1 end
                end
            end
        elseif zone.kind == "carpet" then
            for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                if ball.felt and BallAvailable(ball) and not ball.carriedBy and ball.state=="world"
                    and math.abs((ball.y or 0)-(zone.y or 0))<.15
                    and ball.x + ball.w > zone.x0 and ball.x < zone.x1 then ball.charged = true end
            end
        elseif zone.kind == "vacuum" and not c.vacuumOff then
            for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost and ball.state == "world"
                    and ball.x + ball.w > zone.x0 and ball.x < zone.x1 then
                    ball.vacuumTimer = (ball.vacuumTimer or 0) + dt
                    if ball.vacuumTimer >= 2 then ball.state,ball.x="dustbin",zone.x1+0.5 end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(c.machines) do
        machine.reactionTimer=math.max(0,(machine.reactionTimer or 0)-dt)
        if machine.kind == "dog" then Details.UpdateDog(game, machine, dt)
        elseif machine.kind == "owner" then UpdateOwner(game, dt, machine)
        elseif machine.kind == "washer" and (machine.running or machine.processing) and machine.loaded then
            machine.timer = machine.timer + dt
            if machine.timer >= 1.5 then
                local plate = Find(game, "heavyPlate")
                for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                    if ball.inWasher then
                        ball.inWasher, ball.state, ball.felt, ball.weight, ball.w = false, "world", true, 4, 0.29
                        ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx = c.unloadSet and plate and plate.x + 0.45 or machine.x + 1.4, c.unloadSet and plate and (plate.y or 0) or 0, 0
                    end
                end
                machine.loaded,machine.timer,machine.active,machine.processing=false,0,true,false
                if not machine.carrier then machine.running,c.washerRunning=false,false end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        ball.magnetCooldown=math.max(0,(ball.magnetCooldown or 0)-dt)
        if ball.inTransit then
            ball.transitTimer = math.max(0, ball.transitTimer - dt)
            if ball.transitDuration then
                local t=1-ball.transitTimer/ball.transitDuration
                ball.x=(ball.transitStartX or ball.x)+((ball.transitTarget or ball.x)-(ball.transitStartX or ball.x))*t
                ball.y=(ball.transitStartY or 0)+((ball.transitY or 0)-(ball.transitStartY or 0))*t
            end
            if ball.transitTimer == 0 then
                ball.inTransit, ball.state, ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx = false, "world", ball.transitTarget or ball.x, ball.transitY or 0, 0
            end
        end
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(c.machines) do
        if machine.kind=="windControl" or machine.id=="routeSwitch" then
            for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                if not cat.arrived and math.abs(cat.x+CAT_W*.5-(machine.x or 0))<.55
                    and math.abs(cat.y-(machine.y or 0))<.7 and math.abs(cat.dx or 0)>.001 then
                    -- 拨杆只响应本步真实接触位移；恢复快照中的旧vx不再误拨。
                    machine.mode=(cat.dx or 0)>0 and 2 or 1
                    machine.active=true
                    if machine.id=="windControl" then c.windDirection=machine.mode==2 and 1 or -1 end
                    if machine.id=="routeSwitch" then c.routeMode=machine.mode end
                end
            end
        end
        if machine.kind == "plate" then
            local wasPressed = machine.pressed == true
            machine.weight = PlateWeight(game, machine)
            machine.pressed = machine.weight >= (machine.need or 1)
            if machine.pressed or wasPressed then machine.remaining = machine.releaseDelay or 2
            else machine.remaining = math.max(0, (machine.remaining or 0) - dt) end
            machine.active = machine.pressed or machine.remaining > 0
        elseif machine.kind == "seesaw" then
            local torque=0
            local center=machine.x+(machine.w or 3)*0.5
            for _,entry in ipairs(Details.MachineLoads(game,machine)) do
                torque=torque+(center-entry.x)*entry.weight

            end
            machine.weight,machine.active=torque,torque>=(machine.need or 2)
            local target=math.max(0,math.min(1.15,1.15*torque/(machine.need or 2)))
            local current=machine.lift or 0
            local liftDelta=machine.blockedByCat and 0 or math.max(-dt,math.min(dt,target-current))
            machine.lift=math.max(0,math.min(1.15,current+liftDelta))
        elseif machine.kind == "laserPlate" then
            local target = c.laserTarget or machine.x + (machine.w or 0) * 0.5
            machine.weight = PlateWeight(game, machine)
            machine.active = not c.laserOff and math.abs(target - (machine.x + (machine.w or 0) * 0.5)) <= 0.8
                and machine.weight >= (machine.need or 1)
        elseif machine.kind == "metal" then
            machine.active = false
            for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                if ball.charged and not ball.lost and ball.state~="consumed" and ball.magnetCooldown==0
                    and (ball.state=="world" or ball.state=="installed" and ball.installedAt==machine.id)
                    and math.abs((ball.y or 0)-(machine.y or 0))<.2
                    and not ball.carriedBy and math.abs(ball.x + ball.w * 0.5 - machine.x) < 0.9 then
                    machine.active=true
                    ball.state,ball.installedAt,ball.vx="installed",machine.id,0
                    break
                end
            end
        elseif machine.kind == "door" then
            local latch=machine.latch and Find(game,machine.latch)
            local alternative=machine.alternativeLatch and Find(game,machine.alternativeLatch)
            local wantsOpen = latch and latch.active or alternative and alternative.active or DoorRequirementsMet(game, machine)
            if not wantsOpen and machine.open then
                for index,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                    local carried=game:CarriedBall(index)
                    local visibleHeight=cat.bodyH+(carried and carried.w*.85 or 0)
                    if not cat.arrived and cat.x+CAT_W>machine.x and cat.x<machine.x+(machine.w or .55)
                        and cat.y<(machine.y or 0)+(machine.h or 3.6) and cat.y+visibleHeight>(machine.y or 0) then
                        wantsOpen=true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not wantsOpen then
                    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                        if not ball.carriedBy and ball.state=="world" and not ball.lost
                            and ball.x+ball.w>machine.x and ball.x<machine.x+(machine.w or .55)
                            and (ball.y or 0)<(machine.y or 0)+(machine.h or 3.6)
                            and (ball.y or 0)+ball.w>(machine.y or 0) then
                            wantsOpen=true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            machine.open = wantsOpen
            machine.active = machine.open
        elseif machine.kind == "bridge" then
            machine.open = machine.active == true
        elseif machine.kind == "rat" then
            machine.active = machine.fed == true
        elseif machine.kind == "divider" and machine.active then
            c.dog.phase = "contained"
        end
    end
    c.lossUnits = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.lost then c.lossUnits = c.lossUnits + Mechanics.ScoredUnits(ball) end
    end
    local upper=Find(game,"upperPlate")
    local stairs=Find(game,"stairs")
    if stairs and upper and upper.pressed then stairs.active,stairs.open=true,true end
    Details.Update(game,dt)
    Finale.Update(game,dt)
    Expansion.Update(game,dt)
end

return Mechanics
CampaignMenus:
-- CampaignMenus：从 main.lua 的 BuildSelect / BuildSettings / CreateMenu 抽出的页面工厂。
-- 只构建并返回 Panel；不初始化 UI、不挂载 root、不销毁主文件持有的旧页。
-- ctx 每次构建时传入，依赖均为现有公共层，不读取 main 的私有局部变量。
-- startGame：打开/刷新选关页（不是直接加载第 1 关）；openSettings：打开设置页。
-- setSetting：主文件负责持久化、失败提示、Sound.SetSettings 及开启音效/震动的反馈。
-- 返回 false 时恢复控件原值；true / nil 表示接受。不要在此回调内同步销毁当前页。
-- scoreBestUnits 的翻译格式应为 "%+.1f缕"（英文对应 strands），参数为半单位 / 2。

---@class CampaignMenusContext
---@field UI table<string, any> 现有 urhox-libs/UI；Panel / Row / Column / ScrollView / SafeAreaView / Slider / Toggle
---@field UIF table<string, any> 现有 UIFactory；Panel / Button / Label / Title
---@field P table<string, string> UIF.P 原配色
---@field T fun(key: string, ...: any): string 现有 I18n.T
---@field Game table<string, any> WoolGame；HIDDEN_LEVEL / GetDefinition(level, game)
---@field game table<string, any> 当前真实游戏实例（使用 campaignV2）
---@field Progress table<string, any> CampaignProgress；IsUnlocked / GetBestStars / GetBestUnits / GetEndingGallery
---@field Save table<string, any> SaveStore；Load().settings，仅用于读取设置
---@field Sound table<string, any> AudioManager；Reject（其他 UI 音效由 UIF 和主回调负责）
---@field compactWidth boolean UI 视口是否较窄
---@field compactLayout boolean UI 视口是否较矮或较窄
---@field CatPortrait fun(props: table): Widget main 创建的现有 CatPortrait 构造器
---@field loadLevel fun(level: number): boolean?
---@field setMode fun(mode: string)
---@field showEnding fun()
---@field openSettings fun()
---@field startGame fun()
---@field setSetting fun(key: string, value: any): boolean?
---@field root Widget?
---@field ExperienceUI table
---@field refreshText function

local Menus = {}
local UI=require("urhox-libs/UI")
local L=require("CampaignExperience").L
local Sound = require("AudioManager")

---@param ctx CampaignMenusContext
---@return Panel
function Menus.Select(ctx)
    local UI, UIF, P, T = ctx.UI, ctx.UIF, ctx.P, ctx.T
    local compactWidth = ctx.compactWidth == true
    local compactLayout = ctx.compactLayout == true
    local columns = compactWidth and 3 or 4
    local rowCount = math.ceil(11 / columns)
    local cardWidth = compactWidth and 148 or 168
    local Game, game, Progress, Sound = ctx.Game, ctx.game, ctx.Progress, ctx.Sound
    local CatPortrait = ctx.CatPortrait
    local rows = {}
    for row = 1, rowCount do
        local cells = {}
        for col = 1, columns do
            local level = (row - 1) * columns + col
            if level <= 11 and (level ~= Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL or Progress.IsUnlocked(Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL)) then
                local def = Game.GetDefinition(level, game)
                local unlocked = Progress.IsUnlocked(level)
                local stars = Progress.GetBestStars(level) --[[@as integer]]
                local bestUnits = Progress.GetBestUnits(level)
                local dayText = level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL and T("hiddenTag") or (def.day and T("day", def.day) or T("levelFmt", level, ""))
                local roomText = game.campaignV2 and (level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL and T("levelName11")
                    or (T("room" .. tostring(level)) .. "\n" .. T("levelName" .. tostring(level)))) or (def.room or def.name)
                local starText = string.rep("★", stars) .. string.rep("☆", 3 - stars)
                local scoreText = bestUnits ~= nil and T("scoreBestUnits", bestUnits / 2) or T("scoreNotCleared")
                local completed = stars > 0
                if level==Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL then
                    completed=Progress.GetCampaignData().hiddenBadge==true
                    starText=completed and L("✦ 隐藏徽章","✦ Hidden badge") or L("◇ 待发现","◇ Undiscovered")
                    scoreText=completed and L("三项证据已齐全","All evidence collected") or L("整理现场，一起归窝","Tidy up and bring everyone home")
                end
                cells[#cells + 1] = UIF.Panel({
                    width = cardWidth, maxWidth = compactWidth and "31%" or "23%",
                    minHeight = compactWidth and 132 or 144, height="auto", padding = compactWidth and 7 or 10, gap = 3,
                    alignItems = "center", justifyContent = "space-between",
                    id = "levelCard" .. level, locked = not unlocked,
                    bg = not unlocked and "#E7E1D4" or (completed and "#F2F6E8" or P.cream),
                    border = not unlocked and "#D0C8B9" or (completed and "#B8C99C" or P.line),
                    borderBottomColor = completed and P.green or "#C5B99F",
                    opacity = 1,
                    onClick = function()
                        -- 保留动态检查：卡片构建之后解锁状态仍可能变化。
                        if not Progress.IsUnlocked(level) then
                            Sound.Reject()
                            return
                        end
                        ctx.setMode("game")
                        ctx.loadLevel(level)
                    end,
                    children = {
                        UI.Column { width = "100%", gap = 3, alignItems = "center", pointerEvents = "none", children = {
                            UIF.Label(unlocked and (completed and "✓" or ("Lv " .. level)) or T("locked"), 11,
                                completed and P.greenDark or P.muted, { id = "lockIcon" .. level, fontWeight = "bold", lineHeight = 1.2 }),
                            UIF.Label(dayText, 14, unlocked and P.ink or P.muted, {
                                width = "100%", textAlign = "center", fontWeight = "bold", lineHeight = 1.25, id = "dayLabel" .. level,
                            }),
                            UIF.Label(roomText, 10, unlocked and P.greenDark or P.muted, {
                                width = "100%", height = 36, textAlign = "center", verticalAlign = "middle",
                                whiteSpace = "normal", maxLines = 2, lineHeight = 1.2, id = "roomLabel" .. level,
                            }),
                        } },
                        UI.Panel {
                            width = "100%", minHeight = 42, height="auto", flexShrink = 0, gap = 2, paddingVertical = 4,
                            justifyContent = "center", alignItems = "center", pointerEvents = "none",
                            id = "levelRating" .. level, borderRadius = 8,
                            backgroundColor = completed and "#E8EFDA" or "#F4EDDC",
                            children = {
                                UIF.Label(L("重玩目标：散线与无损","Replay: loose yarn & no loss"),8,P.muted,{
                                    id="replayGoal"..level,visible=level~=Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL and unlocked and stars<3,width="100%",whiteSpace="normal",textAlign="center"}),
                                UIF.Label(starText, 12, completed and "#C18B32" or "#B8B29F", {
                                    id = "starLabel" .. level, width = "100%", textAlign = "center", lineHeight = 1.15,
                                }),
                                UIF.Label(scoreText, 8, P.muted, {
                                    id = "scoreLabel" .. level, width = "100%", textAlign = "center", lineHeight = 1.2,
                                }),
                            },
                        },
                    },
                })
            end
        end
        rows[row] = UI.Row { width = "100%", gap = 10, justifyContent = "center", children = cells }
    end
    return UI.Panel {
        id = "selectPage", position = "absolute", left = 0, top = 0, right = 0, bottom = 0, zIndex = 70,
        backgroundColor = P.paper, pointerEvents = "auto", visible = false,
        justifyContent = "center", alignItems = "center",
        children = {
            UI.Panel { id = "levelSelectBoard", width = compactWidth and 590 or 754, maxWidth = "94%",
                height = compactLayout and "96%" or "90%", maxHeight = compactLayout and 680 or 620,
                padding = compactLayout and 10 or 18, gap = compactLayout and 8 or 12, alignItems = "center",
                backgroundColor = P.cream, borderRadius = 22,
                borderWidth = 1, borderColor = P.line,
                shadowBlur = 26, shadowColor = { 72, 58, 38, 38 },
                children = {
                    UI.Row { height = 46, flexShrink = 0, gap = 12, alignItems = "center", children = {
                        CatPortrait { width = 54, height = 46, flexShrink = 1, catIndex = 1, idleClock = true },
                        UIF.Title(T("selectLevel"), 24, { fontColor = P.greenDark, letterSpacing = 2, flexShrink = 1 }),
                        CatPortrait { width = 54, height = 46, flexShrink = 1, catIndex = 3, idleClock = true },

-- 按按钮的实际祖先查页，并在隐藏前取消该页内的活动指针。
---@param UI table<string, any>
---@param page Widget
local function cancelPagePointers(UI, page)
    local active = UI.Input and UI.Input.GetActivePointers and UI.Input.GetActivePointers()
    if type(active) ~= "table" then return end
    local function contains(root, widget)
        while widget do
            if widget == root then return true end
            widget = widget.parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function hasDrag(widget)
        if widget.state and (widget.state.dragging or widget.state.isDragging) then return true end
        for _, child in ipairs(widget.children or {}) do
            if hasDrag(child) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local dragging = hasDrag(page)
    local pointers = {}
    for pointerId, pointer in pairs(active) do
        local pressed = UI.GetPressedWidgetForPointer and UI.GetPressedWidgetForPointer(pointerId)
        if contains(page, pressed) or dragging then
            pointers[#pointers + 1] = {
                id = pointerId, type = pointer.pointerType or (pointerId == 0 and "mouse" or "touch"),
                x = pointer.x or 0, y = pointer.y or 0, pressedInPage = contains(page, pressed),
            }
        end
    end
    if #pointers == 0 then return end

    for _, pointer in ipairs(pointers) do
        local event = UI.PointerEvent.new(UI.PointerEvent.Types.PointerCancel, {
            pointerId = pointer.id, pointerType = pointer.type, x = pointer.x, y = pointer.y,
            pressure = 0, button = -1, buttons = UI.PointerEvent.Buttons.None,
            isPrimary = pointer.id == 0 or pointer.id == 1,
        })
        if pointer.pressedInPage or not UI.GetPressedWidgetForPointer(pointer.id) then
            UI.HandlePointerCancel(event)
        end
        if UI.Gesture and UI.Gesture.HandlePointerCancel then
            UI.Gesture.HandlePointerCancel(event)
        end
        if UI.Input.UnregisterPointer then UI.Input.UnregisterPointer(pointer.id) end
    end

    -- ScrollView pan can cancel the pressed child before its page is rebuilt.
    local function cancelRemainingDrags(widget, pointer)
        if widget.state and widget.state.dragging and widget.OnPointerCancel then
            widget:OnPointerCancel(UI.PointerEvent.new(UI.PointerEvent.Types.PointerCancel, {
                pointerId = pointer.id, pointerType = pointer.type, x = pointer.x, y = pointer.y,
                pressure = 0, button = -1, buttons = UI.PointerEvent.Buttons.None,
                isPrimary = pointer.id == 0 or pointer.id == 1,
            }))
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(widget.children or {}) do cancelRemainingDrags(child, pointer) end
    end
    for _, pointer in ipairs(pointers) do cancelRemainingDrags(page, pointer) end
    if UI.InputAdapter and UI.InputAdapter.Reset then UI.InputAdapter.Reset() end
end

function Menus.CloseSettings(widget)
    local page = widget
    while page and page.props.id ~= "settingsPage" do page = page.parent end
    if not page then return end
    cancelPagePointers(UI, page)
    Sound.SetSettings()
    if page.Hide then page:Hide() else page:SetVisible(false) end
end

function Menus.Settings(ctx)
    local UI, UIF, P, T = ctx.UI, ctx.UIF, ctx.P, ctx.T
    local compactWidth = ctx.compactWidth == true
    local compactLayout = ctx.compactLayout == true
    local s = ctx.Save.Load().settings
    local volumeValue = math.floor(tonumber(s.sound) or 80)
    local previewVolume = volumeValue
    local volumeLabel = UIF.Label(tostring(volumeValue), 11, P.greenDark, {
        minWidth = compactWidth and 28 or 34, textAlign = "right", flexShrink = 0,
    })
    local function rollbackVolumePreview(self)
        self.props.value = volumeValue
        volumeLabel:SetText(tostring(volumeValue))
        previewVolume = volumeValue
        Sound.SetSettings()
    end
    local volumeSlider = UI.Slider {
        value = volumeValue, min = 0, max = 100, step = 1, width = compactWidth and 116 or 170,
        trackHeight = 6, thumbSize = 20, id = "volumeSlider", flexShrink = 0,
        onChange = function(self, v)
            previewVolume = math.floor(v)
            Sound.PreviewSettings({ sound = previewVolume })
            volumeLabel:SetText(tostring(previewVolume))
        end,
        onPointerCancel = function(event, self)
            if self.state.dragging then
                self:SetState({ dragging = false })
                rollbackVolumePreview(self)
            end
        end,
        onChangeEnd = function(self, v)
            local value = math.floor(v)
            if value == volumeValue then
                Sound.SetSettings()
                return
            end
            if ctx.setSetting("sound", value) == false then
                Sound.SetSettings()
                self.props.value = volumeValue
                volumeLabel:SetText(tostring(volumeValue))
                previewVolume = volumeValue
                return
            end
            volumeValue, previewVolume = value, value
        end,
    }
    local function toggle(key, initial, id)
        local accepted = initial
        return UI.Toggle {
            value = initial, id = id,
            onChange = function(self, v)
                if ctx.setSetting(key, v) == false then
                    self.props.value = accepted
                    return

                accepted = v

    end
    local sfxToggle = toggle("sfx", s.sfx ~= false, "sfxToggle")
    local hapticToggle = toggle("haptic", s.haptic ~= false, "hapticToggle")

                        width = "100%", whiteSpace = "normal", maxLines = 2, flexShrink = 1,
                    }),
                } },
                control,
            },
        }
    end
    local page = UI.Panel {
        id = "settingsPage", position = "absolute", left = 0, top = 0, right = 0, bottom = 0, zIndex = 95,
        backgroundColor = { 60, 55, 40, 150 }, pointerEvents = "auto",
        justifyContent = "center", alignItems = "center",
        children = {
            UI.Panel {
                width = compactWidth and 390 or 430, maxWidth = "92%", height = "92%", maxHeight = 560,
                padding = compactLayout and 12 or 24, gap = compactLayout and 7 or 9,
                backgroundColor = P.cream, borderRadius = 24, borderWidth = 1, borderColor = P.line,
                shadowBlur = 30, shadowColor = { 49, 61, 39, 62 },
                children = {
                    UI.Row { height = 38, flexShrink = 0, gap = 8, alignItems = "center", justifyContent = "center", children = {
                        UI.Panel { width = 28, height = 5, borderRadius = 3, backgroundColor = P.wool },
                        UIF.Title(T("settings"), 21, { fontColor = P.greenDark, letterSpacing = 2 }),
                        UI.Panel { width = 28, height = 5, borderRadius = 3, backgroundColor = P.green },
                    } },
                    UI.ScrollView {
                        id = "settingsScroll", width = "100%", flexGrow = 1, flexBasis = 0,
                        scrollY = true, scrollX = false, bounces = false, showScrollbar = not compactWidth,
                        children = {
                            UI.Panel { width = "100%", minHeight = 62, padding = 10, flexShrink = 0,
                                flexDirection = "row", alignItems = "center", gap = 10,
                                backgroundColor = P.sage, borderRadius = 12,
                                borderWidth = 1, borderColor = "#CAD6B7", children = {
                                    UI.Column { flexGrow = 1, flexShrink = 1, minWidth = 0, gap = 2, children = {
                                        UIF.Label(T("settingsSound"), 14, P.ink, { fontWeight = "bold", width = "100%" }),
                                        UIF.Label(T("settingsSoundNote"), 9, P.muted, {
                                            width = "100%", whiteSpace = "normal", maxLines = 2, flexShrink = 1,

                            row("settingsContrast", "settingsContrastNote", contrastToggle),
                            UIF.Button(T("settingsLang").." · "..(require("I18n").Get()=="en" and "English" or "中文"),function()
                                local lang=require("I18n").Get()=="en" and "zh" or "en"
                                ctx.setSetting("lang",lang);require("I18n").Set(lang);UIF.RefreshLanguage()

-- 《毛线守恒》免费版 v2 成绩/解锁存档。旧 legacy 字段留给兼容回归，不参与 Campaign。
local Save = require("SaveStore")
local Progress = {}

local INITIAL_UNITS = 18
local MAX_UNITS = 78
local HIDDEN_LEVEL = 11
-- 发布/正式运行只允许按存档进度解锁；临时验收可用 isolated test fixture 解锁。
Progress.DEBUG_UNLOCK_ALL = false

local function levelKey(level) return tostring(level) end

local function copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local out = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do out[key] = copy(item) end
    return out
end

local function migrate(data)
    local campaign = data.campaignV2
    if campaign.migratedFromLegacy then return false end
    campaign.unlockedLevel = math.max(campaign.unlockedLevel or 1, math.min(10, data.unlockedLevel or 1))
    campaign.hiddenUnlocked = campaign.hiddenUnlocked == true or data.hiddenUnlocked == true
    for _, name in ipairs(data.tools or {}) do campaign.toolUnlocks[name] = true end
    campaign.migratedFromLegacy = true
    campaign.migrationNotice = true
    return true
end

local function migrationNotice()
    print("[Campaign存档迁移] 保留已解锁进度/工具；新版毛线成绩按版本2规则重新计算")
end

local function read()
    local data = Save.Load()
    if data.campaignV2.migratedFromLegacy then return data.campaignV2 end
    local candidate = copy(data)
    migrate(candidate)
    if Save.Save(candidate) == true then
        migrationNotice()
        return candidate.campaignV2
    end
    print("[Campaign存档迁移] 保存失败，保留旧档；下次读取可重试")
    return data.campaignV2
end

-- Load 不缓存，也可能被测试替换成返回共享表；事务只改副本。
-- 同一次操作把迁移和业务变化一起提交，失败不会消耗 attempt 或污染旧档。
local function beginChange()
    local persisted = Save.Load()
    local candidate = copy(persisted)
    local migrated = migrate(candidate)
    return candidate, persisted.campaignV2, migrated
end

---@return table campaign
---@return boolean saved
---@return string reason
local function commit(candidate, persisted, migrated)
    if Save.Save(candidate) ~= true then
        print("[Campaign存档] 保存失败，保留旧档；本次操作可重试")
        return persisted, false, "save_failed"
    end
    if migrated then migrationNotice() end
    return candidate.campaignV2, true, "saved"
end

function Progress.Load()
    return read()
end

---@return string|nil attemptId 只有持久化成功才分配 ID；失败重试同一调用
---@return boolean saved
---@return string reason
function Progress.NewAttemptId()
    local candidate, persisted, migrated = beginChange()
    local campaign = candidate.campaignV2
    campaign.nextAttemptId = (campaign.nextAttemptId or 0) + 1
    local _, saved, reason = commit(candidate, persisted, migrated)
    if not saved then return nil, false, reason end
    return tostring(campaign.nextAttemptId), true, reason
end

function Progress.GetCheckpoint(level)
    local campaign = read()
    return copy(campaign.checkpoints[levelKey(level)])
end

---@return boolean saved
---@return string reason
function Progress.SetCheckpoint(level, snapshot)
    local candidate, persisted, migrated = beginChange()
    candidate.campaignV2.checkpoints[levelKey(level)] = copy(snapshot)
    local _, saved, reason = commit(candidate, persisted, migrated)
    return saved, reason
end

function Progress.IsUnlocked(level)
    if Progress.DEBUG_UNLOCK_ALL then return type(level)=="number" and level>=1 and level<=HIDDEN_LEVEL and level%1==0 end
    local campaign = read()
    if level == 1 then return true end
    if level == HIDDEN_LEVEL then return campaign.hiddenUnlocked == true end
    return level >= 2 and level <= 10 and campaign.unlockedLevel >= level
end

local function totalUnits(campaign)
    local total = INITIAL_UNITS
    for level = 1, 10 do
        local key = levelKey(level)
        if campaign.completedLevels[key] == true then
            total = total + (campaign.levelBestUnits[key] or 0)
        end
    end
    return total
end

function Progress.GetCampaignData()
    local campaign = read()
    local total = totalUnits(campaign)
    return {
        unlockedLevel = Progress.DEBUG_UNLOCK_ALL and 10 or campaign.unlockedLevel,
        hiddenUnlocked = Progress.DEBUG_UNLOCK_ALL or campaign.hiddenUnlocked,
        totalUnits = total,
        totalStrands = math.max(0, total) / 2,
        bestStars = campaign.bestStars,
        levelBestUnits = campaign.levelBestUnits,
        completedLevels = campaign.completedLevels,
        hiddenBadge = campaign.hiddenBadge,
        toolUnlocks = campaign.toolUnlocks,
    }
end

function Progress.GetBestStars(level)
    local campaign = read()
    return (campaign.bestStars or {})[levelKey(level)] or 0
end

function Progress.GetBestUnits(level)
    local campaign = read()
    local key = levelKey(level)
    if campaign.completedLevels[key] ~= true then return nil end
    return campaign.levelBestUnits[key]
end

function Progress.GetTotalUnits()
    return totalUnits(read())
end

function Progress.GetDisplayedUnits()
    return math.max(0, Progress.GetTotalUnits())
end

function Progress.GetTotalStrands()
    return Progress.GetDisplayedUnits() / 2
end

local function endingKeyForUnits(units)
    local strands = math.max(0, units) / 2
    if strands >= 33 then return "endingThick" end
    if strands >= 24 then return "endingMid" end
    if strands >= 12 then return "endingThin" end
    return "endingBare"
end

function Progress.GetEndingKey()
    return endingKeyForUnits(Progress.GetTotalUnits())
end

function Progress.GetEndingGallery()
    local campaign = read()
    local gallery = campaign.endingGallery
    local unlocked = copy(gallery.unlocked or {})
    -- Old saves can replay their latest ending without replaying level 10.
    if campaign.completedLevels["10"] then unlocked[Progress.GetEndingKey()] = true end
    return { unlocked = unlocked, hiddenEnding = campaign.hiddenBadge == true,
        endingKey = Progress.GetEndingKey(), available = campaign.completedLevels["10"] == true }
end

function Progress.HasTool(name)
    return read().toolUnlocks[name] == true
end

-- 同一 attempt 可在 U 回溯后补收散线/减少损失，结算只提高最好成绩。
-- clearRecords 记录该尝试的最好结果；兼容旧档里的 true 标记。
-- 不累加收益，不生成新 attempt；失败返回旧 campaign，原参数可直接重试。
---@return table campaign 持久化后的状态；失败/重复时为已有状态
---@return boolean committed 本次是否成功提交变化（重复不是保存失败）
---@return string reason saved|improved|duplicate|save_failed|invalid_level|invalid_score|attempt_conflict
function Progress.CommitClear(level, netUnits, stars, attemptId)
    local candidate, persisted, migrated = beginChange()
    local campaign = candidate.campaignV2
    if type(level) ~= "number" or level % 1 ~= 0 or level < 1 or level > HIDDEN_LEVEL then
        return persisted, false, "invalid_level"
    end
    if type(netUnits) ~= "number" or netUnits ~= netUnits or math.abs(netUnits) == math.huge then
        return persisted, false, "invalid_score"
    end
    attemptId = tostring(attemptId or "")
    local record = campaign.clearRecords[attemptId]
    if type(record) == "table" and record.level ~= level then
        return persisted, false, "attempt_conflict"
    end
    stars = stars or 1
    if type(stars) ~= "number" or stars ~= stars or math.abs(stars) == math.huge then
        return persisted, false, "invalid_score"
    end
    local key = levelKey(level)
    local recordNet = type(record) == "table" and record.netUnits or nil
    local recordStars = type(record) == "table" and record.stars or nil
    local improves = false
    if level == HIDDEN_LEVEL then
        improves = campaign.hiddenBadge ~= true or campaign.endingGallery.hiddenEnding ~= true
    else
        local oldBest = campaign.levelBestUnits[key]
        improves = campaign.completedLevels[key] ~= true or oldBest == nil or netUnits > oldBest
            or stars > (campaign.bestStars[key] or 0)
    end
    local improvesRecord = level ~= HIDDEN_LEVEL and type(record) == "table" and
        (netUnits > (recordNet or netUnits) or stars > (recordStars or stars))
    if record and not improves and not improvesRecord then
        return persisted, false, "duplicate"
    end

    if level == HIDDEN_LEVEL then
        campaign.hiddenUnlocked = true
        campaign.hiddenBadge = true
        campaign.endingGallery.hiddenEnding = true
    else
        local passed = campaign.completedLevels[key] == true
        local oldBest = campaign.levelBestUnits[key]
        if not passed or oldBest == nil or netUnits > oldBest then
            campaign.levelBestUnits[key] = netUnits
        end
        campaign.completedLevels[key] = true
        campaign.bestStars[key] = math.max(campaign.bestStars[key] or 0, stars)
        campaign.unlockedLevel = math.max(campaign.unlockedLevel, math.min(10, level + 1))
        if level == 10 then campaign.hiddenUnlocked = true end
        -- Improving an earlier level updates the ending immediately after the finale.
        if campaign.completedLevels["10"] then
            local gallery = campaign.endingGallery
            gallery.endingKey = endingKeyForUnits(totalUnits(campaign))
            gallery.unlocked = gallery.unlocked or {}
            gallery.unlocked[gallery.endingKey] = true
        end
        if level == 5 then campaign.toolUnlocks["网兜"] = true end
        if level == 7 then campaign.toolUnlocks["护垫"] = true end
        if level == 8 then campaign.toolUnlocks["假球"] = true end
    end

    if attemptId ~= "" then
        campaign.clearRecords[attemptId] = {
            level = level,
            netUnits = math.max(recordNet or netUnits, netUnits),
            stars = math.max(recordStars or stars, stars),
        }
    end
    campaign.totalUnits = totalUnits(campaign)
    local result, saved, reason = commit(candidate, persisted, migrated)
    if saved and record then reason = "improved" end
    return result, saved, reason

end

function Progress.UnlockTool(name)
    local candidate, persisted, migrated = beginChange()
    if candidate.campaignV2.toolUnlocks[name] then return false, "duplicate" end
    candidate.campaignV2.toolUnlocks[name] = true
    local _, saved, reason = commit(candidate, persisted, migrated)
    return saved, reason
end

Progress.INITIAL_UNITS = INITIAL_UNITS
Progress.MAX_UNITS = MAX_UNITS

return Progress

CampaignRoom:
-- 《毛线守恒》免费版 v2 共用关卡运行时：固定步长、三猫、毛线账本和机关状态。
local Levels = require("CampaignLevels")
local Progress = require("CampaignProgress")
local Mechanics = require("CampaignMechanics")
local Details = require("CampaignDetails")
local Finale = require("CampaignFinaleMechanics")
local I18n = require("I18n")
local Input = require("InputState")
local Hints = require("CampaignHints")
local HintState = require("CampaignHintState")
local FX = require("FX")
local Room = {}

local GRAVITY = 19
local STEP = 1 / 120
local CAT_W = 0.95
local EPS = 0.0001
local MAX_UNDO = 180
local sessionAttempt = 0
local sessionPrefix = tostring({})
local COLORS = {
    { 226, 158, 92, 255 }, { 65, 68, 70, 255 }, { 238, 228, 208, 255 },
}
local NAMES = { "汤圆", "煤球", "奶盖" }

local function Copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local out = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do out[key] = Copy(item) end
    return out
end

local function IndexMachines(game)
    local byId = {}
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do byId[machine.id] = machine end
    game.machineById = byId
end

local function Find(game, id)
    local indexed = game.machineById and game.machineById[id]
    if indexed then return indexed end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        if machine.id == id then return machine end
    end
    return nil
end

local function Active(game, id)
    local machine = Find(game, id)
    return machine ~= nil and machine.active == true
end

local function BallAmount(ball)
    if ball.lost or ball.state == "consumed" then return 0 end
    return Mechanics.ScoredUnits(ball)
end

local function CatHeight(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    local ball = game:CarriedBall(index)
    return cat.bodyH + (ball and ball.w * 0.85 or 0)
end

local function IsBallUsable(ball)
    return not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" and ball.state ~= "stored"
        and ball.state ~= "installed" and ball.state ~= "inWasher" and ball.state ~= "dustbin" and not ball.inTransit
end

local function RecalculateHasWool(game)
    game.campaign.hasWool = false
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.source ~= "decoy" and not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" and ball.state ~= "stored" then
            game.campaign.hasWool = true
            return
        end
    end
end

local RestoreSnapshot
local GrantRescueImpl
local RectOverlap,CatBodyWidth,CatBodyRect,CatVolumes,PlatformSolid,BlockingRects
local SegmentHitsRect,ClearPath,VolumeOverlap,SupportTop
local BallCanOccupy

function Room.GetDefinition(level)
    return Levels.Get(level)
end

function Room.GetLevelCount()
    return Levels.COUNT
end

function Room.GetSelectableCount()
    return Levels.HIDDEN
end

function Room.GetLevelTitle(level)
    local def = Levels.Get(level)
    if not def then return "" end
    if def.hidden then return "隐藏 · " .. def.room end
    return string.format("第%d天 · %s", def.day, def.room)
end

function Room.HomeSlots(gameOrDef)
    local def=gameOrDef.def or gameOrDef
    local available=(def.roomWidth or 34)-def.homeX
    local spacing=available<3.5 and math.max(.5,(available-.90)*.5) or 1.15
    local first=def.homeX+(available<3.5 and .45 or .82)
    local slots={}
    for i=1,3 do slots[i]={x=first+(i-1)*spacing,y=def.homeY or 0,w=math.min(.86,spacing-.02)} end
    return slots
end
function Room.HomeCenter(gameOrDef,slot)
    local target=Room.HomeSlots(gameOrDef)[slot]
    if target then return target.x,target.y end
    return nil,nil
end

function Room.Init(game, level)
    local def = Levels.Get(level)
    assert(def, "未注册的Campaign关卡 " .. tostring(level))
    game.campaignV2 = true
    def.profile = "campaign-room"
    game.level = level
    game.def = def
    game.clock = 0
    game.elapsed = 0
    game.accumulator = 0
    game.undoTimer = 0
    game.undoStack = {}
    game.effects = {}
    game.active = 1
    game.won = false

    game.campaign = {
        machines = {}, hasWool = true,
        platforms = Copy(def.platforms or {}), walls = Copy(def.walls or {}),
        zones = Copy(def.zones or {}), secret = Copy(def.secret), secretCollected = false,
        lossUnits = 0, rescueGranted = false, borrowed = false, fishInHand = false,
        fishAvailable = level == 4, meowCooldown = 0, dog = { phase = "idle", timer = 0 },
        washerRunning = false, washerTimer = 0, ownerX = 16, ownerDir = 1,
