        inventoryTools = {}, tutorialStep = level==1 and 1 or 4, checkpointId = nil, checkpointSnapshot = nil,
        attemptId = "demo",
    }
    if not game.demoMode then
        local attemptId,ok=Progress.NewAttemptId()
        if not attemptId or ok==false then
            sessionAttempt=sessionAttempt+1
            attemptId="session-"..sessionPrefix.."-"..sessionAttempt
            game.campaign.saveFailed,game.campaign.saveReason=true,"attempt"
        end
        game.campaign.attemptId=attemptId
    end
    for name, _ in pairs({ ["网兜"] = true, ["护垫"] = true, ["假球"] = true }) do
        if not game.demoMode and Progress.HasTool(name) then game.campaign.inventoryTools[name] = true end
    end
    if def.hidden then
        game.campaign.fishAvailable = false
        game.campaign.inventoryTools["假球"] = true
    end
    if level==10 then
        game.campaign.inventoryTools["网兜"],game.campaign.inventoryTools["护垫"],game.campaign.inventoryTools["假球"]=true,true,true
    end

    for _, definition in ipairs(def.machines or {}) do
        local machine = Copy(definition)
        machine.active = false
        machine.open = false
        machine.pressed = false
        machine.remaining = 0
        machine.used = false
        machine.mode = definition.mode or 1
        machine.timer = 0
        if machine.kind == "backup" then machine.available = true end
        if machine.kind == "decoy" then machine.available = true end
        if machine.kind == "washer" then machine.running = false end
        if machine.kind=="receiver" then machine.ballWell=true end
        if machine.kind == "switch" and machine.id == "windControl" then machine.mode = 1 end
        if machine.kind == "mirror" then machine.mode = 1 end
        game.campaign.machines[#game.campaign.machines + 1] = machine
    end
    IndexMachines(game)

    game.sheep = {}
    game.balls = {}
    for index = 1, 3 do
        local jumpHeight = index == 2 and 2 or 1
        local cat = {
            x = def.spawnX + (index - 1) * 1.05, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0,
            name = NAMES[index], color = Copy(COLORS[index]), weight = 4 - index,
            baseWeight = 4 - index, weightBonus = 0, jumpHeight = jumpHeight,
            baseJumpHeight = jumpHeight, speed = 4.3, jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * jumpHeight),
            grounded = true, support = -6, coyote = 0.1, facing = 1, gait = 0, squash = 0,
            arrived = false, carry = true,
            bodyH = index == 1 and 1.0 or index == 2 and 0.88 or 0.64,
            bodyW = index == 1 and 0.95 or index == 2 and 0.84 or 0.68,
            napping = false, dx = 0, dy = 0, rearmHome = false, blockedSeconds = 0,
        }
        game.sheep[index] = cat
        game.balls[index] = {
            id = index, owner = index, kind = "full", felt = false, charged = false,
            w = 0.42, weight = 3, amount = 6, source = "standard", state = "carried",
            carriedBy = index, x = cat.x, y = cat.bodyH, vx = 0, vy = 0,
        }
    end
    game.nextBallId = 4
    require("CampaignExpansion").Init(game)
    Details.Init(game)
    Finale.Init(game)
    if level==6 then game.campaign.fishAvailable=true end
    if not game.demoMode and (level==10 or level==Levels.HIDDEN) then
        local persisted=Progress.GetCheckpoint(level)
        if type(persisted)=="table" and persisted.sheep and persisted.campaign then
            game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot=Copy(persisted)
            game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot.campaign.attemptId=game.campaign.attemptId
            game.campaign.checkpointId=persisted.campaign.checkpointId
        end
    end
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    print(string.format("[Campaign] 初始化关卡%d：%s；三猫3/2/1，毛线18单位", level, def.name))
end

function Room.LoadLevel(game, level)
    Room.Init(game, level)
end

function Room.GetMachine(game, id)
    return Find(game, id)
end

function Room.Size(game, index)
    return CAT_W, CatHeight(game, index)
end

function Room.CarriedBall(game, index)
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == index and not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" then return ball end
    end
    return nil
end

function Room.LooseBallCount(game)
    local count = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and IsBallUsable(ball) then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

function Room.YarnAmount(game)
    local total = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do total = total + BallAmount(ball) end
    return total
end

function Room.YarnStats(game)
    local full, half, felt = 0, 0, 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if BallAmount(ball) > 0 then
            if ball.felt then felt = felt + 1
            elseif ball.kind == "half" then half = half + 1
            else full = full + 1 end
        end
    end
    return full, half, felt
end

function Room.VisibleYarnWeight(game)
    local total = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" then total = total + (ball.weight or 0) end
    end
    return total
end

function Room.ArrivedCount(game)
    local count = 0
    for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do if cat.arrived then count = count + 1 end end
    return count
end

function Room.Stars(game)
    if game.level == Levels.HIDDEN or not game.won then return 0 end
    local stars = 1
    if game.level <= Levels.COUNT and game.campaign.secretCollected then stars = stars + 1 end
    if game.campaign.lossUnits == 0 then stars = stars + 1 end
    return stars
end

local function MachineByX(game, kind, x)
    local best, bestDistance = nil, 1.15
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        if (not kind or machine.kind == kind) then
            local distance = math.abs((machine.x or 0) + (machine.w or 0) * 0.5 - x)
            if distance < bestDistance then best, bestDistance = machine, distance end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function Snapshot(game)
    local campaign = Copy(game.campaign)
    campaign.checkpointSnapshot = nil
    return {
        sheep = Copy(game.sheep), balls = Copy(game.balls), campaign = campaign,
        active = game.active, elapsed = game.elapsed, clock = game.clock, started = game.started,
        won = game.won, switches = game.switches, nextBallId = game.nextBallId,
    }
end

function Room.PushUndo(game)
    local snapshot = Snapshot(game)
    -- Latches and installed ropes change without moving cats or changing total yarn.
    game.undoStack[#game.undoStack + 1] = snapshot
    if #game.undoStack > MAX_UNDO then table.remove(game.undoStack, 1) end
end

function Room.YarnAmountFrom(balls)
    local total = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(balls or {}) do total = total + BallAmount(ball) end
    return total
end

RestoreSnapshot = function(game, snapshot)
    if not snapshot then return false end
    game.sheep, game.balls, game.campaign = Copy(snapshot.sheep), Copy(snapshot.balls), Copy(snapshot.campaign)
    game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot = nil
    game.active, game.elapsed, game.clock = snapshot.active, snapshot.elapsed, snapshot.clock
    game.started, game.won, game.switches = snapshot.started, snapshot.won, snapshot.switches
    game.nextBallId = snapshot.nextBallId
    game.accumulator, game.undoTimer, game.jumpBuffer = 0, 0, 0
    game.effects = {}
    IndexMachines(game)
    Details.RestoreContacts(game)
    return true
end

function Room.GetPlateWeight(game, machine) return Mechanics.GetPlateWeight(game,machine) end

function Room.CanUndo(game)
    return #game.undoStack >= 2
end

function Room.Undo(game)
    if not Room.CanUndo(game) then return false end
    local wasWon, attemptId = game.won, game.campaign.attemptId
    table.remove(game.undoStack)
    local snapshot = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    local checkpoint = game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot
    RestoreSnapshot(game, snapshot)
    game.campaign.attemptId = wasWon and Progress.NewAttemptId() or attemptId
    for _, saved in ipairs(game.undoStack) do saved.campaign.attemptId = game.campaign.attemptId end
    if checkpoint then checkpoint.campaign.attemptId = game.campaign.attemptId end
    game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot = checkpoint
    game.undoStack[#game.undoStack] = Snapshot(game)
    print("[Campaign回溯] 恢复角色、毛线来源、机关与本关状态")
    return true
end

function Room.GrantRescue(game)
    return GrantRescueImpl(game)
end

function Room.Reset(game)
    local level = game.level
    local checkpoint = game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot
    if (level == 10 or level == Levels.HIDDEN) and checkpoint then
        local attemptId = game.campaign.attemptId
        game.undoStack = {}
        RestoreSnapshot(game, checkpoint)
        game.campaign.attemptId = attemptId
        game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot = checkpoint
        Room.PushUndo(game)
        print("[Campaign检查点] 已还原完整关卡快照")
        return
    end
    Room.Init(game, level)
end

function Room.Checkpoint(game, machine)
    machine.used = true
    machine.active = true
    game.campaign.checkpointId = machine.id
    local snapshot = Snapshot(game)
    game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot = snapshot
    local ok,reason=Room.RetryCheckpoint(game)

    Room.PushUndo(game)
    print(ok and "[Campaign检查点] 已保存完整检查点："..(machine.label or machine.id)
        or "[Campaign检查点] 仅保留本轮内存，永久写入失败，可重试")
    return ok,reason
end
function Room.RetryCheckpoint(game)
    local c=game.campaign
    if not c.checkpointSnapshot then return false,"no_checkpoint" end
    if game.demoMode then return true end
    local ok,reason=Progress.SetCheckpoint(game.level,c.checkpointSnapshot)
    if not ok then c.saveFailed,c.saveReason=true,"checkpoint"
    elseif c.saveReason=="checkpoint" or c.saveReason=="checkpoint_clear" then c.saveFailed,c.saveReason=false,nil end
    return ok,reason
end

local function PlateWeight(game, plate)
    return Details.MachineWeight(game, plate)
end

local function CurrentLossUnits(game)
    local lost = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.lost then
            lost = lost + Mechanics.ScoredUnits(ball)
        end
    end
    return lost
end

GrantRescueImpl = function(game)
    local c = game.campaign
    if not Room.CanGrantRescue(game) then return false end
    c.rescueGranted, c.borrowed = true, true
    game.balls[#game.balls + 1] = {
        id = game.nextBallId, owner = 1, kind = "full", felt = false, charged = false,
        w = 0.42, weight = 3, amount = 6, source = "rescue", state = "world",
        carriedBy = nil, x = game.sheep[game.active].x + CAT_W + 0.1, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0,
    }
    game.nextBallId = game.nextBallId + 1
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    print("[借用备用线] 无计分救援材料已放到脚边；本次损失仍保留")
    return true
end

function Room.CanGrantRescue(game)
    local availableRescue=0
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.lost and ball.state~="consumed" then
            availableRescue=availableRescue+(ball.ledger and ball.ledger.rescue or ball.source=="rescue" and ball.amount or 0)
        end
    end
    return availableRescue < CurrentLossUnits(game)
end

function Room.UseTool(game, name)
    local c,cat=game.campaign,game.sheep[game.active]
    if not c.inventoryTools[name] or game.won then return false end
    if name=="假球" then
        for index,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.source=="decoy" then
                if ball.carriedBy then game.sheep[ball.carriedBy].carry=false end
                table.remove(game.balls,index)
                -- PushUndo记录操作后的状态；Undo先弹当前层，再恢复前一层。
                Room.PushUndo(game)
                return true
            end
        end
        game.balls[#game.balls+1]={id=game.nextBallId,owner=0,kind="decoy",source="decoy",
            amount=0,weight=1,w=0.32,state="world",x=cat.x+1.2,y=cat.y,vx=0,vy=0}
        game.nextBallId=game.nextBallId+1
        if c.dog.phase~="contained" then c.dog.phase,c.dog.timer="play",(Find(game,"dog") or {}).playSeconds or 6 end
        c.ownerDistracted=6
    elseif name=="护垫" then
        if game.def.gap and cat.x>game.def.gap.x0 and cat.x<game.def.gap.x1 then return false end
        c.padX,c.padY=cat.x+0.5,cat.y
    elseif name=="网兜" then
        for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if not ball.carriedBy and IsBallUsable(ball) and (ball.x-cat.x)^2+((ball.y or 0)-cat.y)^2<9 then
                local targetX=cat.x+CAT_W+.06
                if ClearPath(game,game.active,ball.x+ball.w*.5,(ball.y or 0)+ball.w*.5,nil)
                    and BallCanOccupy(game,ball,targetX,cat.y,game.active) then
                    ball.x,ball.y,ball.vx,ball.vy=targetX,cat.y,0,0; Room.PushUndo(game); return true
                end
            end
        end
        local secret=c.secret
        if secret and not c.secretCollected and Details.SecretReady(game)
            and (secret.x-cat.x)^2+(secret.y-cat.y)^2<9 then
            if ClearPath(game,game.active,secret.x,secret.y,nil) then
                c.secretCollected,c.secret=true,nil; Room.PushUndo(game); return true
            end
        end
        return false
    else return false end
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    return true
end

function Room.ToggleLaser(game)
    if game.level~=9 then return false end
    game.campaign.laserOff=not game.campaign.laserOff
    return true
end

local function MachineTarget(machine)
    local x=(machine.x or 0)+(machine.kind=="ropeBridge" and 0 or (machine.w or 0)*.5)
    local y=(machine.y or 0)+math.min(.35,(machine.h or .7)*.35)
    return x,y
end

local function InteractCandidate(game,index)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won then return nil end
    local nearest,distance=nil,1.35
    for _,machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        local tx,ty=MachineTarget(machine)
        local d=math.abs(cat.x+CAT_W*.5-tx)
        if d<distance and math.abs(cat.y-(machine.y or 0))<.65
            and Mechanics.CanInteract(game,machine) and ClearPath(game,index,tx,ty,machine) then
            nearest,distance=machine,d
        end
    end
    return nearest
end

function Room.Interact(game)
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active]
    if game.won or cat.arrived then return false end
    local nearest=InteractCandidate(game,game.active)
    if nearest and nearest.kind == "backup" and not game.campaign.rescueGranted and game.campaign.lossUnits > 0 then
        Mechanics.Interact(game, nearest)
        Room.PushUndo(game)
        return true, nearest.label
    end
    if not nearest then
        if game.level==1 then return Room.RollBall(game,game.active) end
        return false
    end
    local wasFishInHand = game.campaign.fishInHand
    local ok = Mechanics.Interact(game, nearest)
    if ok then
        game.campaign.tutorialStep=4
        if nearest.kind == "fish" and game.campaign.fishInHand and not wasFishInHand then
            return "stored", nearest.label
        end
        Room.PushUndo(game)
        return true, nearest.label
    end
    return false
end

function Room.Select(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won or game.active == index then return end
    for _, other in ipairs(game.sheep) do other.aiJump = false end
    cat.recallHome=nil
    cat.gatherX=nil
    game.active, game.jumpBuffer, game.switches = index, 0, game.switches + 1
    Room.PushUndo(game)
end

function Room.Next(game)
    for offset = 1, 3 do
        local index = (game.active + offset - 1) % 3 + 1
        if not game.sheep[index].arrived then return Room.Select(game, index) end
    end
end

function Room.Jump(game)
    if not game.won then
        game.sheep[game.active].recallHome=nil
        game.sheep[game.active].gatherX=nil
        game.jumpBuffer, game.started = 0.18, true
        if game.campaign.tutorialStep==2 then game.campaign.tutorialStep=3 end
    end
end

local function CanCarryBall(game,index,ball)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local volume={x=cat.x+CAT_W*.5-ball.w*.5,y=cat.y+cat.bodyH-.015,w=ball.w,h=ball.w*.85+.015}
    for _,box in ipairs(BlockingRects(game,false)) do
        if RectOverlap(volume,box,.015) then return false end
        -- A low ray under a crawl gap is not enough: the item must also fit
        -- through the path into the carried volume, without crossing a wall.
        if SegmentHitsRect(ball.x+ball.w*.5,(ball.y or 0)+ball.w*.5,
            cat.x+CAT_W*.5,cat.y+cat.bodyH+ball.w*.4,box) then return false end
        local swept={x=box.x-ball.w*.5,y=box.y-ball.w*.65,w=box.w+ball.w,h=box.h+ball.w*1.3}
        if SegmentHitsRect(ball.x+ball.w*.5,(ball.y or 0)+ball.w*.5,
            cat.x+CAT_W*.5,cat.y+cat.bodyH+ball.w*.4,swept) then return false end
    end
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms or {}) do
        if platform.solidCeiling and PlatformSolid(game,platform,cat) then
            local box={x=platform.x,y=Details.PlatformY(game,platform,platform.x+(platform.w or 0)*.5),
                w=platform.w or 0,h=platform.h or .12}
            if RectOverlap(volume,box,.015) then return false end
        end
    end
    if not game.testMode then
        for otherIndex,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if otherIndex~=index and not other.arrived then
                for _,otherVolume in ipairs(CatVolumes(game,otherIndex)) do
                    if RectOverlap(volume,otherVolume,.015) then return false end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

BallCanOccupy = function(game,ball,x,y,carrierIndex)
    local volume={x=x,y=y,w=ball.w,h=ball.w}
    for _,box in ipairs(BlockingRects(game,false)) do
        if RectOverlap(volume,box,.015) then return false end
    end
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms or {}) do
        if platform.solidCeiling and PlatformSolid(game,platform,nil) then
            local box={x=platform.x,y=Details.PlatformY(game,platform,platform.x+(platform.w or 0)*.5),
                w=platform.w or 0,h=platform.h or .12}
            if RectOverlap(volume,box,.015) then return false end
        end
    end
    if not game.testMode then
        for otherIndex,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if otherIndex~=carrierIndex and not other.arrived then
                for _,catVolume in ipairs(CatVolumes(game,otherIndex)) do
                    if RectOverlap(volume,catVolume,.015) then return false end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,other in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if other~=ball and not other.carriedBy and IsBallUsable(other) and other.state=="world"
            and RectOverlap(volume,{x=other.x,y=other.y or 0,w=other.w,h=other.w},.015) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function DropPosition(game,index,ball)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local preferred=cat.facing>=0 and cat.x+CAT_W+.06 or cat.x-ball.w-.06
    local candidates={preferred}
    for step=1,12 do
        local offset=step*.12
        candidates[#candidates+1]=preferred+(cat.facing>=0 and offset or -offset)
        candidates[#candidates+1]=preferred+(cat.facing>=0 and -offset or offset)
    end
    for _,x in ipairs(candidates) do
        x=math.max(.3,math.min(game.def.roomWidth-ball.w-.3,x))
        if BallCanOccupy(game,ball,x,cat.y,index) then return x,cat.y end
    end
    return nil,nil
end

function Room.DropPreview(game,index)
    local ball=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
    if not ball then return nil end
    local x,y=DropPosition(game,index,ball)
    if not x then return nil end
    return {x=x,y=y,w=ball.w,weight=ball.weight,kind=ball.kind}
end

-- Optional short pass in the first room. S remains a precise, stationary drop;
-- E away from a machine lets players aim a ball into the plate's shallow tray.
function Room.RollBall(game,index)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local ball=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
    if game.level~=1 or not cat or cat.arrived or game.won or not ball or not cat.grounded then return false end
    local x,y=DropPosition(game,index,ball)
    if not x then return false end
    local direction=cat.facing>=0 and 1 or -1
    -- Never use a fallback drop behind the cat for a forward pass.
    if (x+ball.w*.5-cat.x-CAT_W*.5)*direction<0 then return false end
    if not ClearPath(game,index,x+ball.w*.5,y+.12+ball.w*.5,nil) then return false end
    if not BallCanOccupy(game,ball,x,y+.12,index) then return false end
    cat.carry,ball.carriedBy,ball.state=false,nil,"world"
    ball.x,ball.y,ball.vx,ball.vy=x,y+.12,direction*4.8,1.6
    if game.AddEffect then game:AddEffect(x,y,"dust") end
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    return true,I18n.Get()=="en" and "Yarn pass" or "轻抛线球"
end

local function NearbyFish(game,index)
    if not game.campaign.fishAvailable or game.campaign.fishInHand then return nil end
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local best,distance=nil,1.05
    for _,fish in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        if fish.kind=="fish" then
            local ready=true
            for _,id in ipairs(fish.requires or {}) do if not Active(game,id) then ready=false end end
            local d=math.abs(cat.x+CAT_W*.5-(fish.x or 0))
            if ready and d<distance and math.abs(cat.y-(fish.y or 0))<.75
                and ClearPath(game,index,fish.x or 0,(fish.y or 0)+.2,fish) then best,distance=fish,d end
        end
    end
    return best
end

function Room.ToggleCarry(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won then return false end
    local current = Room.CarriedBall(game, index)
    if current then
        local dropX,dropY=DropPosition(game,index,current)
        if not dropX then return false end
        cat.carry, current.carriedBy, current.state = false, nil, "world"
        current.x,current.y,current.vx,current.vy=dropX,dropY,0,0
        if game.campaign.tutorialStep==3 then game.campaign.tutorialStep=4 end
        print("[放球] " .. cat.name .. " 放下" .. current.kind .. "，毛线 " .. Room.YarnAmount(game) .. "单位")
        Room.PushUndo(game)
        return true
    end
    local fish = NearbyFish(game,index)
    if fish then
        local ok = Mechanics.Interact(game, fish)
        if ok then
            if game.campaign.tutorialStep==3 then game.campaign.tutorialStep=4 end
            Room.PushUndo(game); return true
        end
    end
    local cx, best, nearest = cat.x + CAT_W / 2, nil, 0.92
    for indexInList, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and IsBallUsable(ball) and not ball.inTransit and not ball.inWasher
            and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.75
            and ClearPath(game,index,ball.x+ball.w*.5,(ball.y or 0)+ball.w*.5,nil) then
            local distance = math.abs(ball.x + ball.w / 2 - cx)
            if distance < nearest then best, nearest = indexInList, distance end
        end
    end
    if not best then return false end
    local ball = game.balls[best]
    if not CanCarryBall(game,index,ball) then return false end
    cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.state, ball.vx = true, index, "carried", 0
    if game.campaign.tutorialStep==3 then game.campaign.tutorialStep=4 end
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    print("[抱球] " .. cat.name .. " 抱起" .. ball.kind)
    return true
end

---@class CampaignGrabCandidate
---@field mode string
---@field ball integer?
---@field machine string?
---@field blocked boolean?
---@return CampaignGrabCandidate?
function Room.GrabCandidate(game,index)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won then return nil end
    local carried=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
    if carried then return {mode="drop",ball=carried.id,blocked=false} end
    local fish=NearbyFish(game,index)
    if fish then
        return {mode="grabFish",machine=fish.id,blocked=false}
    end
    local nearest,best=.92,nil
    for i,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and IsBallUsable(ball) and not ball.inTransit and not ball.inWasher
            and math.abs((ball.y or 0)-cat.y)<.75
            and ClearPath(game,index,ball.x+ball.w*.5,(ball.y or 0)+ball.w*.5,nil) then
            local d=math.abs(ball.x+ball.w*.5-cat.x-CAT_W*.5)
            if d<nearest then best,nearest=i,d end
        end
    end
    if not best then return nil end
    return {mode="grab",ball=best,blocked=not CanCarryBall(game,index,game.balls[best])}
end

local function RecallRouteOpen(game)
    if not game.def.recallStartX or game.won then return false end
    if game.def.hidden then return game.campaign.allEvidence==true end
    local door=Find(game,"exitDoor")
    return door~=nil and door.open==true
end

local function RecallSafe(game,cat)
    return cat and not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and cat.x>=game.def.recallStartX
        and math.abs(cat.y-(game.def.homeY or 0))<.08
end

function Room.CanRecall(game)
    return RecallRouteOpen(game) and RecallSafe(game,game.sheep[game.active]) or false
end

function Room.IsRecalling(game)
    for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do if not cat.arrived and cat.recallHome then return true end end
    return false
end

function Room.Meow(game)
    local c = game.campaign
    if Room.IsRecalling(game) or Room.IsGathering(game) then
        for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do cat.recallHome=nil;cat.gatherX=nil end
        Room.PushUndo(game)
        return true
    end
    if Room.CanRecall(game) then
        for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            cat.gatherX=nil
            -- The whole eligible queue walks, including the caller. Automatic
            -- selection after home arrival must not interrupt the next cat.
            cat.recallHome=RecallSafe(game,cat)
        end
        Room.PushUndo(game)
        return true
    end
    if Room.CanGather(game) then
        Room.Gather(game);Room.PushUndo(game);return true
    end
    if game.won or (game.level~=6 and game.level~=10) or c.meowCooldown > 0 then return false end
    c.meowCooldown = 2
    if game.level == 6 then
        local cat=game.sheep[game.active]
        local rat=Find(game,"rat")
        if rat and math.abs(cat.x-rat.x)<2.3 then rat.theftTimer=0; rat.scaredTimer=2 end
        local rack=Find(game,"bottles")
        if rack and math.abs(cat.x-rack.x)<2 then
            rack.rattle=(rack.rattle or 0)+1
            rack.rattleWindow=5
            c.notice,c.noticeTimer="bottlesRattle",2
            if rack.rattle>=2 then cat.stunTimer=.6; rack.rattle=0 end
        end
    else
        c.meowPulse=2
    end
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    return true
end

local function WallBlocks(game, cat, index, nextX)
    local h = CatHeight(game, index)
    if game.level==5 and not game.def.gap and not Active(game,"wideBridge") then
        local bridge=Find(game,"ropeBridge")
        local ball=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
        if bridge and nextX+CAT_W>bridge.x and nextX<bridge.x+bridge.w
            and (not bridge.active or cat.weight+(ball and ball.weight or 0)>2) then
            game.campaign.bridgeWarning=true
            return true
        end
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        -- Elevated wall controls have a visible pedestal.  Keep cats beside the
        -- pedestal instead of letting their body pass through it; ground levers
        -- stay non-solid so narrow puzzle routes are unchanged.
        if machine.id == "climbSwitch" then
            local halfWidth = .25
            if nextX < (machine.x or 0) + halfWidth
                and nextX + CAT_W > (machine.x or 0) - halfWidth
                and cat.y < (machine.y or 0) + .62
                and cat.y + h > (machine.y or 0) then return true end
        end
        if machine.maxDiameter and nextX<machine.x+(machine.w or 1)
            and nextX+CAT_W>machine.x and cat.y<(machine.y or 0)+0.6
            and cat.y+cat.bodyH>(machine.y or 0) then return true end
        if machine.kind == "plate" and machine.pressed and (machine.remaining or 0) <= 0
            and nextX < machine.x + (machine.w or 1.1) and nextX + CAT_W > machine.x
            and cat.y < (machine.y or 0) + 0.14 and cat.y + h > (machine.y or 0) then return true end
    end
    for _, wall in ipairs(game.campaign.walls) do
        if nextX < wall.x + (wall.w or 0.55) and nextX + CAT_W > wall.x
            and cat.y < (wall.y or 0) + (wall.h or 3.2) and cat.y + h > (wall.y or 0) then
            if wall.requiresActive and Active(game, wall.requiresActive) then
                -- 互动开锁后，同一缺口允许所有猫通过。
            elseif wall.ability == "crawl" then
                if index ~= 3 or cat.carry or cat.y + h > (wall.y or 0) + 0.02 then return true end
            elseif cat.y + h > (wall.y or 0) then return true end
        end
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        if machine.kind=="finale_timed_gate" and not machine.open and nextX<machine.x+.45 and nextX+CAT_W>machine.x then return true end
        if machine.kind == "door" and not machine.open
            and nextX < machine.x + machine.w and nextX + CAT_W > machine.x
            and cat.y < (machine.y or 0)+machine.h and cat.y + h > (machine.y or 0) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function SurfaceAt(game, x, cat)
    local height = Details.Ground(game,x,cat)
    for _, platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        if Details.PlatformEnabled(game,platform,cat) and x + CAT_W > platform.x and x < platform.x + platform.w then
            local y = Details.PlatformY(game,platform,x+CAT_W*.5)
            if y + platform.h <= cat.y + 0.04 then
                height = math.max(height, y + platform.h)
            end
        end
    end
    return height
end

RectOverlap=function(a,b,pad)
    pad=pad or EPS
    return a.x+a.w>b.x+pad and a.x<b.x+b.w-pad
        and a.y+a.h>b.y+pad and a.y<b.y+b.h-pad
end

CatBodyWidth=function(game,index)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    return cat.bodyW or CAT_W
end

CatBodyRect=function(game,index,x,y)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local width=CatBodyWidth(game,index)
    return {x=(x or cat.x)+(CAT_W-width)*.5,y=y or cat.y,w=width,h=cat.bodyH}
end

CatVolumes=function(game,index,x,y)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local baseX,baseY=x or cat.x,y or cat.y
    local volumes={CatBodyRect(game,index,baseX,baseY)}
    local ball=Room and Room.CarriedBall and Room.CarriedBall(game,index) or nil
    if ball then
        volumes[#volumes+1]={
            x=baseX+CAT_W*.5-ball.w*.5,
            y=baseY+cat.bodyH-.015,
            w=ball.w,
            h=ball.w*.85+.015,
        }
    end
    return volumes
end

PlatformSolid=function(game,platform,cat)
    if platform.collapsed then return false end
    if cat then return Details.PlatformEnabled(game,platform,cat) end
    return not platform.requiresActive or platform.riseHeight~=nil or Active(game,platform.requiresActive)
end

BlockingRects=function(game,includePlatforms)
    local boxes={}
    for _,wall in ipairs(game.campaign.walls or {}) do
        if not wall.requiresActive or not Active(game,wall.requiresActive) then
            boxes[#boxes+1]={x=wall.x,y=wall.y or 0,w=wall.w or .55,h=wall.h or 3.2,source=wall}
        end
    end
    for _,machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do
        if machine.kind=="door" and not machine.open then
            boxes[#boxes+1]={x=machine.x,y=machine.y or 0,w=machine.w or .55,h=machine.h or 3.6,source=machine}
        elseif machine.kind=="finale_timed_gate" and not machine.open then
            boxes[#boxes+1]={x=machine.x,y=machine.y or 0,w=machine.w or .45,h=machine.h or 3.8,source=machine}
        end
    end
    if includePlatforms then
        for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms or {}) do
            if PlatformSolid(game,platform,nil) then
                boxes[#boxes+1]={x=platform.x,y=Details.PlatformY(game,platform,platform.x+(platform.w or 0)*.5),
                    w=platform.w or 0,h=platform.h or .12,source=platform}
            end
        end
    end
    return boxes
end

SegmentHitsRect=function(x1,y1,x2,y2,box)
    local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
    local t0,t1=0,1
    local function clip(p,q)
        if math.abs(p)<EPS then return q>=0 end
        local r=q/p
        if p<0 then
            if r>t1 then return false end
            if r>t0 then t0=r end
        else
            if r<t0 then return false end
            if r<t1 then t1=r end
        end
        return true
    end
    return clip(-dx,x1-box.x) and clip(dx,box.x+box.w-x1)
        and clip(-dy,y1-box.y) and clip(dy,box.y+box.h-y1)
        and t1>.03 and t0<.97
end

ClearPath=function(game,index,targetX,targetY,ignore)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local startX=cat.x+CAT_W*.5
    local startY=cat.y+math.min(cat.bodyH*.6,.55)
    -- Floors and shelves are one-way platforms.  They support feet and balls from
    -- above, but never behave like a vertical wall between a cat and a nearby item.
    for _,box in ipairs(BlockingRects(game,false)) do
        if box.source~=ignore and SegmentHitsRect(startX,startY,targetX,targetY,box) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

-- Processing stations use the same obstruction geometry as player interaction.
function Room.CanReachBall(game, machine, ball, range)
    if math.abs(ball.x+(ball.w or .4)*.5-(machine.x+(machine.w or 1)*.5)) >= (range or 1.35)
        or math.abs((ball.y or 0)-(machine.y or 0)) >= .65 then return false end
    for _, box in ipairs(BlockingRects(game,false)) do
        if box.source~=machine and SegmentHitsRect(machine.x+(machine.w or 1)*.5,(machine.y or 0)+.3,
            ball.x+(ball.w or .4)*.5,(ball.y or 0)+(ball.w or .4)*.5,box) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

VolumeOverlap=function(game,aIndex,ax,ay,bIndex,bx,by)
    local bestX,bestY=nil,nil
    for _,a in ipairs(CatVolumes(game,aIndex,ax,ay)) do
        for _,b in ipairs(CatVolumes(game,bIndex,bx,by)) do
            if RectOverlap(a,b,.01) then
                local ox=math.min(a.x+a.w,b.x+b.w)-math.max(a.x,b.x)
                local oy=math.min(a.y+a.h,b.y+b.h)-math.max(a.y,b.y)
                if not bestX or ox<bestX then bestX,bestY=ox,oy end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestX,bestY
end

SupportTop=function(game,lowerIndex,upperIndex)
    return Details.CatSupportTop(game,lowerIndex,upperIndex)
end

-- 上跳顶头仅检测有水平重叠的实体墙下沿与平台底面，墙完全打开时不再阻挡。
-- 窄缝示意：墙下沿 y=.66 ───── 头顶上升到墙底即停
--                         [猫身高 .64]
--                   ───── 地面 y=0
local function CeilingAt(game,x,index,ignoredPlatform,includeOneWay)
    local cat=game.sheep[index]
    local visibleHeight=CatHeight(game,index)
    local ceiling=math.huge
    for _,wall in ipairs(game.campaign.walls) do
        if not (wall.requiresActive and Active(game,wall.requiresActive))
            and x+CAT_W>wall.x+.01 and x<wall.x+(wall.w or .55)-.01 then
            local underside=wall.y or 0
            if underside>=cat.y+visibleHeight-.03 then ceiling=math.min(ceiling,underside) end
        end
    end
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        if platform~=ignoredPlatform and Details.PlatformEnabled(game,platform,cat)
            and (includeOneWay or platform.solidCeiling)
            and x+CAT_W>platform.x+.18 and x<platform.x+platform.w-.18 then
            local bottom=Details.PlatformY(game,platform,x+CAT_W*.5)
            if bottom>=cat.y+visibleHeight-.03 then ceiling=math.min(ceiling,bottom) end
        end
    end
    return ceiling
end

-- Teammates take a small step aside on plain, safe floor. Build the entire
-- displacement plan first so a blocked third cat cannot partially push a queue.
-- A cat supporting a puzzle (plate, seesaw, rider) never moves on its own.
local function MakeRoom(game,index,otherIndex,delta)
    local mover=game.sheep[index]
    if index~=game.active or not mover.grounded or math.abs(delta)<EPS
        or WallBlocks(game,mover,index,mover.x+delta) then return false end
    local plan={}
    local function propose(id)
        if plan[id] then return true end
        local cat=game.sheep[id]
        if id==index or cat.arrived or not cat.grounded or cat.recallHome
            or math.abs(cat.y-mover.y)>.04 or (cat.support or 0)>0 or cat.supportBall then return false end
        for _,rider in ipairs(game.sheep) do if rider.support==id and not rider.arrived then return false end end
        local nextX=cat.x+delta
        if nextX<.3 or nextX>game.def.roomWidth-CAT_W-.3 or WallBlocks(game,cat,id,nextX)
            or math.abs(SurfaceAt(game,nextX,cat)-cat.y)>.04 then return false end
        local lo,hi=math.min(cat.x,nextX),math.max(cat.x,nextX)+CAT_W
        local gap=game.def.gap
        if gap and hi>gap.x0-.15 and lo<gap.x1+.15 then return false end
        for _,zone in ipairs(game.campaign.zones) do
            if hi>(zone.x0 or math.huge)-.15 and lo<(zone.x1 or -math.huge)+.15 then return false end
        end
        for _,p in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
            if (p.movingMachine or p.ramp or p.soft) and hi>p.x and lo<p.x+p.w then return false end
        end
        for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
            if (m.kind=="rat" or m.kind=="finale_thief") and hi>m.x-2.3 and lo<m.x+2.3 then return false end
            if (m.kind=="plate" or m.kind=="laserPlate" or m.kind=="seesaw"
                or m.kind=="dog" or m.kind=="finale_owner" or m.kind=="finale_noise_floor")
                and hi>m.x-.25 and lo<m.x+(m.w or 2)+.25 then return false end
        end
        plan[id]=nextX
        for j,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if j~=id and j~=index and not other.arrived
                and VolumeOverlap(game,id,nextX,cat.y,j,plan[j] or other.x,other.y) then
                if not propose(j) then return false end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    if not propose(otherIndex) then return false end
    for id,x in pairs(plan) do
        local cat=game.sheep[id]
        cat.dx=(cat.dx or 0)+x-cat.x;cat.x=x;cat.facing=delta>0 and 1 or -1
        cat.gait=cat.gait+math.abs(delta)*4
    end
    return true
end

local function GatherPlan(game)
    if game.won or game.level==6 or game.level>=10 then return {} end
    local leader=game.sheep[game.active]
    if not leader.grounded or leader.arrived or (leader.support or 0)>0 or leader.supportBall then return {} end
    local order={}
    for i,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        if i~=game.active and not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and (cat.support or 0)<=0
            and not cat.supportBall and math.abs(cat.y-leader.y)<.03
            and cat.x<leader.x-.3 and leader.x-cat.x<8 then order[#order+1]=i end
    end
    table.sort(order,function(a,b) return game.sheep[a].x>game.sheep[b].x end)
    local plan={}
    for slot,id in ipairs(order) do
        local cat=game.sheep[id]
        local target=leader.x-slot*1.15
        local lo,hi=cat.x,target+.95
        local safe=target>cat.x+.15
        for otherId,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if otherId~=id and otherId~=game.active and not other.arrived and not plan[otherId]
                and other.x>cat.x and other.x<target+.95 then safe=false end
        end
        for _,rider in ipairs(game.sheep) do if rider.support==id and not rider.arrived then safe=false end end
        if game.def.gap and hi>game.def.gap.x0-.2 and lo<game.def.gap.x1+.2 then safe=false end
        for _,wall in ipairs(game.campaign.walls) do
            if hi>wall.x and lo<wall.x+(wall.w or .55)
                and not (wall.requiresActive and Active(game,wall.requiresActive)) then safe=false end
        end
        for _,z in ipairs(game.campaign.zones) do if hi>(z.x0 or math.huge)-.2 and lo<(z.x1 or -math.huge)+.2 then safe=false end end
        for _,p in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do if hi>p.x-.2 and lo<p.x+p.w+.2 then safe=false end end
        for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
            if m.need or m.kind=="dog" or m.kind=="rat" then
                if hi>m.x-.3 and lo<m.x+(m.w or 2)+.3 then safe=false end
            end
        end
        for x=lo,target,.15 do
            if WallBlocks(game,cat,id,x) or math.abs(SurfaceAt(game,x,cat)-cat.y)>.03 then safe=false;break end
        end
        if safe then plan[id]=target end
    end
    return plan
end

function Room.IsGathering(game)
    for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do if cat.gatherX then return true end end
    return false
end
function Room.CanGather(game) return next(GatherPlan(game))~=nil end
function Room.Gather(game)
    for id,target in pairs(GatherPlan(game)) do game.sheep[id].gatherX=target end
end

local function MoveCat(game, index, direction, dt)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived then cat.dx, cat.dy = 0, 0; return end
    local oldX, oldY = cat.x, cat.y
    if cat.support and cat.support > 0 then
        local base=game.sheep[cat.support]
        local top=base and SupportTop(game,cat.support,index)
        if base and not base.arrived and top and math.abs(cat.y+(base.dy or 0)-top)<=.045 then
            local supportX=cat.x+(base.dx or 0)
            local supportY=cat.y+(base.dy or 0)
            local blockedX=WallBlocks(game,cat,index,supportX)
            local ceiling=CeilingAt(game,supportX,index,nil)
            local blockedY=(base.dy or 0)>0 and supportY+CatHeight(game,index)>ceiling-.02
            if not blockedX and not blockedY then
                cat.x,cat.y=supportX,supportY
            else
                cat.support,cat.grounded=0,false
            end
        else
            cat.support,cat.grounded=0,false
        end
    end
    if cat.supportBall then
        local top=Details.BallSupportTop(game,Details.SupportBall(game,cat.supportBall),cat)
        if not top or math.abs(cat.y-top)>.045 then cat.supportBall,cat.grounded=nil,false end
    end
    direction=Details.Direction(game,index,direction,dt)
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        if platform.movingMachine then
            local machine=Find(game,platform.movingMachine) or {}
            local lift=machine.lift or 0
            local oldLift=platform.lastLift or 0
            if cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.y-oldLift-platform.h)<0.05
                and cat.x+CAT_W>platform.x and cat.x<platform.x+platform.w then
                local delta=lift-oldLift
                local ceiling=CeilingAt(game,cat.x,index,platform,true)
                if delta>0 and cat.y+delta+CatHeight(game,index)>ceiling-.02 then
                    machine.lift=oldLift
                    machine.blockedByCat=true
                else
                    cat.y=cat.y+delta; oldY=cat.y
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local wasGrounded = cat.grounded
    cat.coyote = wasGrounded and 0.14 or math.max(0, cat.coyote - dt)
    if (index == game.active and game.jumpBuffer > 0 or cat.aiJump) and cat.coyote > 0 then
        cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support, cat.coyote = cat.jump, false, 0, 0
        cat.supportBall=nil
        if index==game.active then game.jumpBuffer=0 end
        cat.aiJump,cat.squash=false,.12
        if game.AddEffect then game:AddEffect(cat.x + CAT_W / 2, cat.y, "dust") end
    end
    if direction ~= 0 then cat.facing, cat.gait = direction, cat.gait + dt * cat.speed * 4 end
    local nextX = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - CAT_W - 0.3, cat.x + (direction * cat.speed+Details.Conveyor(game,cat)) * dt))
    local catBlocked=false
    cat.blockedByTeammate=nil
    if not game.testMode then
        for otherIndex,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            local linkedStack=otherIndex==cat.support or other.support==index
            local overlapX=otherIndex~=index and not linkedStack and not other.arrived
                and VolumeOverlap(game,index,nextX,cat.y,otherIndex,other.x,other.y) or nil
            if overlapX then
                local moved=direction~=0 and MakeRoom(game,index,otherIndex,nextX-cat.x)
                if not moved then catBlocked=true;cat.blockedByTeammate=otherIndex;break end
            end
        end
    end
    if not catBlocked and not WallBlocks(game, cat, index, nextX) then cat.x = nextX end
    cat.blockedSeconds=catBlocked and direction~=0 and (cat.blockedSeconds or 0)+dt or 0
    cat.vx = direction * cat.speed
    cat.vy = cat.vy - GRAVITY * dt
    for _,zone in ipairs(game.campaign.zones) do
        local carried=Room.CarriedBall(game,index)
        if zone.kind=="wind" and cat.x+CAT_W>zone.x0 and cat.x<zone.x1
            and cat.weight+(carried and carried.weight or 0)<=1 and not cat.arrived and cat.y<1.4 then
            cat.vy=2.4
        end
    end
    local nextY = cat.y + cat.vy * dt
    if cat.vy>0 then
        local ceiling=CeilingAt(game,cat.x,index,nil)
        local visibleHeight=CatHeight(game,index)
        if oldY+visibleHeight<=ceiling+.03 and nextY+visibleHeight>ceiling then
            nextY,cat.vy=ceiling-visibleHeight,0
        end
    end
    local surface = SurfaceAt(game, cat.x, cat)
    if cat.grounded then
        for _,p in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
            if not p.ramp and Details.PlatformEnabled(game,p,cat) and cat.x+CAT_W>p.x and cat.x<p.x+p.w then
                local top=Details.PlatformY(game,p,cat.x+CAT_W*.5)+p.h
                if top>=oldY and top-oldY<=.18 then nextY,oldY,cat.vy=top,top,0; surface=math.max(surface,top) end
            end
            if p.ramp and Details.PlatformEnabled(game,p,cat) and cat.x+CAT_W*.5>=p.x and cat.x+CAT_W*.5<=p.x+p.w then
                local top=Details.PlatformY(game,p,cat.x+CAT_W*.5)+p.h
                if math.abs(top-oldY)<.18 then nextY,oldY,cat.vy=top,top,0; surface=math.max(surface,top) end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Falling sweeps find platform tops even when the previous foot was far above.
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        local py=Details.PlatformY(game,platform,cat.x+CAT_W*.5)
        local top=py+platform.h
        if Details.PlatformEnabled(game,platform,cat) and cat.x+CAT_W>platform.x and cat.x<platform.x+platform.w and oldY>=top-0.04 and nextY<=top then
            surface=math.max(surface,top)
        end
    end
    local landingSupport,landingBall=0,nil
    -- 脚底扫过普通球顶才落脚；球下落/抛起、仅横向擦边不成为底座。
    for _,ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        local top=Details.BallSupportTop(game,ball,cat)
        if top and math.abs(ball.vy or 0)<.05 and cat.vy<=0 and oldY>=top-.04 and nextY<=top and top>=surface then
            surface,landingBall=top,ball.id
        end
    end
    for otherIndex,other in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        local otherTop=otherIndex~=index and not other.arrived and SupportTop(game,otherIndex,index) or nil
        if otherTop and cat.vy<=0 and oldY>=otherTop-EPS and nextY<=otherTop and otherTop>=surface then
            surface,landingSupport,landingBall=otherTop,otherIndex,nil
            other.squash=.045
        end
    end
    if cat.vy <= 0 and oldY >= surface - 0.04 and nextY <= surface then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded = surface, 0, true
        cat.support,cat.supportBall=landingSupport,landingBall
    else
        cat.y, cat.grounded, cat.support = math.max(-1.5, nextY), false, 0
        cat.supportBall=nil
    end
    if cat.y < -1.4 then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = 0, 0, true, -6
        cat.x = math.max(0.5, cat.x - 1.0)
    end
    if game.def.gap and cat.y<=game.def.gap.depth+.05 and cat.weight+(Room.CarriedBall(game,index) and Room.CarriedBall(game,index).weight or 0)>1 then
        cat.x=cat.x<(game.def.gap.x0+game.def.gap.x1)*.5 and game.def.gap.x0-1.1 or game.def.gap.x1+.1
        cat.y,cat.vy,cat.grounded=0,0,true
        game.campaign.notice,game.campaign.noticeTimer="gapSafeReturn",2.5
    end
    for _,zone in ipairs(game.campaign.zones) do
        if zone.kind=="water" and cat.x+CAT_W*.5>zone.x0 and cat.x+CAT_W*.5<zone.x1 and cat.y<.05 then
            cat.x=cat.x<(zone.x0+zone.x1)*.5 and zone.x0-CAT_W-.1 or zone.x1+.1
            cat.y,cat.vy,cat.stunTimer=0,0,.25
            game.campaign.notice,game.campaign.noticeTimer="waterRetreat",2
        end
    end
    cat.dx, cat.dy = cat.x - oldX, cat.y - oldY
    cat.squash = math.max(0, cat.squash - dt * 3)
    if cat.grounded and not wasGrounded and game.AddEffect then game:AddEffect(cat.x + CAT_W / 2, cat.y, "dust") end
    if cat.grounded and not wasGrounded and oldY>cat.y+.02 and game.level==8 then
        local soft=false
        for _,p in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
            if p.soft and cat.x+CAT_W>p.x and cat.x<p.x+p.w and math.abs(cat.y-p.y-p.h)<.05 then soft=true end
        end
        if game.campaign.padX and math.abs(cat.x-game.campaign.padX)<1.3 then soft=true end
        if not soft and cat.weight>=3 and game.campaign.dog.phase~="contained" then
            game.campaign.dog.phase,game.campaign.dog.timer,game.campaign.dog.targetX="inspect",2,cat.x
            game.campaign.notice,game.campaign.noticeTimer="landingNoise",2
        end
    end
end

-- Moving supports and restored snapshots can place two visible cat volumes into the
-- same space without either cat crossing the normal horizontal sweep.  Resolve that
-- residual overlap after every fixed step so models never remain interpenetrating.
local function ResolveCatOverlaps(game)
    -- A short iterative solve is enough for three cats and prevents fixing one
    -- pair from recreating overlap in a pair already visited this frame.
    for _=1,4 do
        local changed=false
        for aIndex=1,#game.sheep-1 do
            local a=game.sheep[aIndex]
            if not a.arrived then
                for bIndex=aIndex+1,#game.sheep do
                    local b=game.sheep[bIndex]
                    if not b.arrived then
                        local overlapX=VolumeOverlap(game,aIndex,a.x,a.y,bIndex,b.x,b.y)
                        if overlapX and overlapX>EPS then
                            local upper,upperIndex,lower,lowerIndex
                            if a.y+a.bodyH*.5>=b.y+b.bodyH*.5 then
                                upper,upperIndex,lower,lowerIndex=a,aIndex,b,bIndex
                            else
                                upper,upperIndex,lower,lowerIndex=b,bIndex,a,aIndex
                            end
                            local lowerTop=SupportTop(game,lowerIndex,upperIndex)
                            local nearTop=lowerTop and upper.y>=lowerTop-.24 and upper.y<=lowerTop+.08
                            if nearTop and (upper.vy or 0)<=.5 then
                                local correction=lowerTop-upper.y
                                upper.y,upper.vy,upper.grounded,upper.support=lowerTop,0,true,lowerIndex
                                upper.supportBall=nil
                                upper.dy=(upper.dy or 0)+correction
                                changed=true
                            else
                                local left,right,leftIndex,rightIndex
                                -- Every body is horizontally centered inside the same CAT_W slot.
                                -- Use that invariant directly instead of allocating two body rectangles.
                                local aCenter=a.x+CAT_W*.5
                                local bCenter=b.x+CAT_W*.5
                                if aCenter<=bCenter then
                                    left,leftIndex,right,rightIndex=a,aIndex,b,bIndex
                                else
                                    left,leftIndex,right,rightIndex=b,bIndex,a,aIndex
                                end
                                local push=overlapX*.5+.002
                                local leftX=math.max(.3,left.x-push)
                                local rightX=math.min(game.def.roomWidth-CAT_W-.3,right.x+push)
                                local canLeft=leftX<left.x and not WallBlocks(game,left,leftIndex,leftX)
                                local canRight=rightX>right.x and not WallBlocks(game,right,rightIndex,rightX)
                                if canLeft then
                                    left.dx=(left.dx or 0)+(leftX-left.x)
                                    left.x=leftX
                                    changed=true
                                end
                                if canRight then
                                    right.dx=(right.dx or 0)+(rightX-right.x)
                                    right.x=rightX
                                    changed=true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
    end
end

local function BallSurface(game, ball, oldY, nextY)
    local surface = Details.Ground(game,ball.x,nil,ball.w)
    for _, platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        if PlatformSolid(game,platform,nil) and ball.x + ball.w > platform.x and ball.x < platform.x + platform.w then
            local y = Details.PlatformY(game,platform,ball.x+ball.w*.5)
            local top=y+platform.h
            if (oldY>=top-0.04 or platform.ramp and top-oldY<.18) and nextY<=top then surface = math.max(surface, top) end
        end
    end
    return surface
end

local function BallCeilingAt(game,ball,ignoredPlatform)
    local ceiling=math.huge
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        if platform~=ignoredPlatform and PlatformSolid(game,platform,nil)
            and ball.x+ball.w>platform.x+.04 and ball.x<platform.x+platform.w-.04 then
            local bottom=Details.PlatformY(game,platform,ball.x+ball.w*.5)
            if bottom>=ball.y+ball.w-.03 then ceiling=math.min(ceiling,bottom) end
        end
    end
    return ceiling
end

local function MoveBallWithPlatform(game,ball)
    for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
        if platform.movingMachine and ball.x+ball.w>platform.x and ball.x<platform.x+platform.w then
            local machine=Find(game,platform.movingMachine)
            local lift=machine and machine.lift or 0
            local oldLift=platform.lastLift or 0
            local oldTop=oldLift+(platform.h or 0)
            if math.abs((ball.y or 0)-oldTop)<.06 then
                local delta=lift-oldLift
                local ceiling=BallCeilingAt(game,ball,platform)
                if delta>0 and ball.y+delta+ball.w>ceiling-.02 then
                    if machine then machine.lift=oldLift;machine.blockedByCat=true end
                else
                    ball.y=ball.y+delta
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function SweepBallX(game,ball,oldX,nextX)
    local movingRight=nextX>oldX+EPS
    local movingLeft=nextX<oldX-EPS
    for _,box in ipairs(BlockingRects(game,false)) do
        if ball.y+ball.w>box.y+.01 and ball.y<box.y+box.h-.01 then
            if movingRight and oldX+ball.w<=box.x+.03 and nextX+ball.w>box.x then
                nextX,ball.vx=box.x-ball.w-.02,0
            elseif movingLeft and oldX>=box.x+box.w-.03 and nextX<box.x+box.w then
                nextX,ball.vx=box.x+box.w+.02,0
            end
        end
    end
    return nextX
end

local function UpdateBalls(game, dt)
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy then
            local cat = game.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
            ball.x = cat.x + CAT_W / 2 - ball.w / 2
            ball.y = cat.y + cat.bodyH
        elseif ball.inTransit or ball.inWasher then
            -- Updated once by CampaignMechanics.
        elseif ball.state == "world" and not ball.lost then
            MoveBallWithPlatform(game,ball)
            local oldY=ball.y
            ball.vy = ball.vy - GRAVITY * dt
            ball.y = ball.y + ball.vy * dt
            local floor = BallSurface(game, ball, oldY, ball.y)
            if ball.y <= floor then ball.y, ball.vy = floor, 0 end
            local oldX=ball.x
            local nextX=math.max(0.3,math.min(game.def.roomWidth-ball.w-.3,oldX+ball.vx*dt))
            ball.x=SweepBallX(game,ball,oldX,nextX)
            ball.vx = ball.vx * math.max(0, 1 - dt * 2.2)
            local inWell=false
            for _,plate in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
                if plate.maxDiameter and ball.w>plate.maxDiameter and math.abs(ball.y-(plate.y or 0))<0.5
                    and ball.x+ball.w>plate.x and ball.x<plate.x+(plate.w or 1) then
                    local center=plate.x+(plate.w or 1)/2
                    ball.x=ball.x+ball.w/2<center and plate.x-ball.w-0.02 or plate.x+(plate.w or 1)+0.02
                    ball.vx=0
                end
                if plate.ballWell and math.abs(ball.y-(plate.y or 0))<0.04
                    and ball.x+ball.w/2>=plate.x and ball.x+ball.w/2<=plate.x+(plate.w or 1)
                    and (not plate.maxDiameter or ball.w<=plate.maxDiameter) then
                    inWell,ball.vx=true,0
                end
            end
            for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.x + CAT_W / 2 - (ball.x + ball.w / 2)) < (CAT_W + ball.w) * 0.5
                    and math.abs(cat.y - ball.y) < 0.24 then
                    if not inWell and math.abs(cat.vx) > 0.5 then ball.vx = cat.vx * 0.65 end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function UpdateMachines(game, dt)
    Mechanics.Update(game, dt)
end

local function UpdateInteractions(game)
    local secret = game.campaign.secret
    if secret and Details.SecretReady(game) and not game.campaign.secretCollected then
        for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and math.abs(cat.x + CAT_W / 2 - secret.x) < 1.1
                and math.abs(cat.y - secret.y) < 1.2 then
                game.campaign.secretCollected = true
                print("[隐藏收集] 唯一散线已拾取；本关奖励6单位")
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if game.campaign.secretCollected and game.campaign.secret then game.campaign.secret = nil end
    if game.level == Levels.HIDDEN then
        local e = game.campaign.evidence
        game.campaign.allEvidence = e.yarnInBasket and e.toolsInBox and e.machineCovered
    end
end

local function CheckHome(game)
    -- 归窝接触示意： [空窝1] [空窝2] [空窝3]
    --                 ^猫中心落在有效宽w内、脚底贴homeY才占用
    -- 飞过/仅越homeX/已有睡猫的窝不触发；就地睡下，禁止跨窝瞬移。
    local occupied,changed={},false
    local slots=Room.HomeSlots(game)
    for _,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do if cat.arrived and cat.homeSlot then occupied[cat.homeSlot]=true end end
    local allowed=game.level~=Levels.HIDDEN or game.campaign.allEvidence==true
    for index,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        if allowed and not cat.arrived and cat.grounded then
            local best,distance=nil,math.huge
            for slot,target in ipairs(slots) do
                local d=math.abs(cat.x+CAT_W*.5-target.x)
                if not occupied[slot] and math.abs(cat.y-target.y)<.08 and d<=target.w*.5 and d<distance then
                    best,distance=slot,d
                end
            end
            if best then
                cat.arrived,cat.napping,cat.homeSlot=true,true,best
                cat.vx,cat.vy,cat.dx,cat.dy,cat.support,cat.supportBall=0,0,0,0,0,nil
                occupied[best],changed=true,true
                if game.AddEffect then game:AddEffect(cat.x,cat.y+.35,"home") end
                print("[进窝] "..cat.name.." 占用空窝"..best)
                if game.active==index then
                    game.jumpBuffer=0
                    for nextIndex=1,3 do if not game.sheep[nextIndex].arrived then game.active=nextIndex;break end end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if Room.ArrivedCount(game)==3 then
        game.won=true
        if not game.demoMode and (game.level==10 or game.level==Levels.HIDDEN) then
            local ok=Progress.SetCheckpoint(game.level,nil)
            if not ok then
                game.campaign.saveFailed,game.campaign.saveReason=true,"checkpoint_clear"
            else
                game.campaign.checkpointSnapshot,game.campaign.checkpointId=nil,nil
                if game.campaign.saveReason=="checkpoint" or game.campaign.saveReason=="checkpoint_clear" then
                    game.campaign.saveFailed,game.campaign.saveReason=false,nil
                end
            end
        end
        print(string.format("[通关] Campaign关卡%d；星级%d；正篇净收益%d单位",game.level,Room.Stars(game),
            (game.campaign.secretCollected and 6 or 0)-game.campaign.lossUnits))
    end
    return changed
end

function Room.Update(game, dt, direction)
    -- Process normal low-frame-rate frames fully; suspend spikes remain bounded.
    dt = math.max(0, math.min(dt, 0.25))
    direction = direction or 0
    FX.StepEffects(game.effects,dt,"fall")
    if game.won then return end
    game.clock = game.clock + dt
    if direction ~= 0 then
        game.started = true
        if game.campaign.tutorialStep==1 then game.campaign.tutorialStep=2 end
    end
    if game.started then game.elapsed = game.elapsed + dt end
    game.accumulator = game.accumulator + dt
    while game.accumulator >= STEP do
        game.accumulator = game.accumulator - STEP
        for _,machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do machine.blockedByCat=false end
        local active = game.active
        local recalled=nil
        local gathering=nil
        local gatherPlan=Room.IsGathering(game) and GatherPlan(game) or {}
        for i,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if cat.gatherX then
                if i==active or not gatherPlan[i] or math.abs(cat.x-cat.gatherX)<.08 then cat.gatherX=nil
                elseif not gathering or cat.x>game.sheep[gathering].x then gathering=i end
            end
        end
        if game.def.recallStartX then
            local ready=RecallRouteOpen(game)
            for i,cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                if i==active and direction~=0 or not ready or not RecallSafe(game,cat) then cat.recallHome=nil end
                if cat.recallHome and not cat.arrived and (not recalled or cat.x>game.sheep[recalled].x) then recalled=i end
            end
        end
        local function CatDirection(i)
            if i==active and direction~=0 then return direction end
            if i==recalled then return 1 end
            if i==gathering then return 1 end
            return 0
        end
        local first, second, third = 1, 2, 3
        if game.sheep[first].y > game.sheep[second].y then first, second = second, first end
        if game.sheep[second].y > game.sheep[third].y then second, third = third, second end
        if game.sheep[first].y > game.sheep[second].y then first, second = second, first end
        MoveCat(game, first, CatDirection(first), STEP)
        MoveCat(game, second, CatDirection(second), STEP)
        MoveCat(game, third, CatDirection(third), STEP)
        if not game.testMode then ResolveCatOverlaps(game) end
        UpdateBalls(game, STEP)
        for _,platform in ipairs(game.campaign.platforms) do
            if platform.movingMachine then platform.lastLift=(Find(game,platform.movingMachine) or {}).lift or 0 end
        end
        game.jumpBuffer = math.max(0, game.jumpBuffer - STEP)
        UpdateInteractions(game)
        game.campaign.lossUnits = CurrentLossUnits(game)
        local arrived=CheckHome(game)
        -- 归窝先退出物理支撑，再计重；最后一猫不会留在压板/队友底座上。
        UpdateMachines(game, STEP)
        if game.level==10 or game.def.hidden then
            local cat=game.sheep[game.active]
            for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
                local ready=m.id=="checkpointA" and Active(game,"aExitLatch")
                    or m.id=="checkpointB" and Active(game,"bInnerBrace")
                    or m.id=="evidenceCheckpoint" and game.campaign.allEvidence
                if ready and not m.used and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.x+.475-m.x)<.65
                    and math.abs(cat.y-(m.y or 0))<.08 then
                    local saved=Room.Checkpoint(game,m)
                    if saved then game.campaign.notice,game.campaign.noticeTimer="checkpointSaved",3 end
                end
            end
        end
        game.campaign.lossUnits = CurrentLossUnits(game)
        game.undoTimer = game.undoTimer + STEP
        if arrived or game.undoTimer >= 1.2 then game.undoTimer = 0; Room.PushUndo(game) end
        if game.won then break end
    end
end

local function HintText(game, stage)
    local english=I18n.Get()=="en"
    if game.won then return english and (game.def.hidden and "Evidence complete; hidden badge earned." or "All three cats are home; this attempt is settled.") or game.def.hidden and "三项证据齐全，隐藏徽章已获得。" or "三只猫都回到窝里；本关成绩已结算。" end
    local index = math.max(1, math.min(3, stage or HintState.Sync(game)))
    if game.campaign.lossUnits>0 and not game.campaign.hasWool then
        if english then return ({"Check the start area or pause menu.","Losses still count; spare yarn can replace missing puzzle material.","Borrow spare yarn from the pause menu, then cut or weave it for the current mechanism."})[index] end
        return ({"检查起点和暂停面板。","损失仍会扣分，备用线可以替代材料继续解谜。","在暂停面板借用备用线，再按当前机关需求剪球或织绳。"})[index]
    end
    local _,taskIndex=HintState.Task(game)
    if taskIndex then
        if english and Hints.tasks[game.level] and Hints.tasks[game.level][taskIndex] then return Hints.tasks[game.level][taskIndex][index] end
        return game.def.hintTasks[taskIndex].hints[index]
    end
    if english then return (game.def.hidden and Hints.hiddenFinal or game.level==3 and Hints.bathFinal or Hints.final)[index] end
    if game.def.finalHints then return game.def.finalHints[index] end
    return game.def.hints[index] or game.def.sub or "先观察机关标识，再切换合适的猫操作。"
end

function Room.Hint(game,stage)
    -- Substitute once at the display boundary: definitions remain readable and
    -- remapped keys cannot be substituted a second time (for example E -> Q).
    local actions={E="interact",S="action",Q="meow",U="undo",R="restart"}
    local text=HintText(game,stage)
    return (text:gsub("%f[%a]([ESQUR])%f[^%a]",function(key) return Input.Name(actions[key]) end))
end

function Room.GetStatus(game)
    local c = game.campaign
    local bits = { game.active, Room.ArrivedCount(game), Room.YarnAmount(game), tostring(c.secretCollected), tostring(c.lossUnits) }
    for _, machine in ipairs(c.machines) do
        bits[#bits + 1] = machine.id .. ":" .. tostring(machine.active) .. ":" .. tostring(machine.open)
            .. ":" .. tostring(machine.pressed) .. ":" .. tostring(machine.used) .. ":" .. tostring(machine.mode)
            .. ":" .. tostring(machine.stored)
    end
    for index, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(cat.carry) .. tostring(cat.arrived)
        local ball = Room.CarriedBall(game, index)
        bits[#bits + 1] = ball and tostring(ball.id) or "none"
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(ball.id) .. ":" .. tostring(ball.state) .. ":" .. tostring(ball.kind)
            .. ":" .. tostring(ball.carriedBy) .. ":" .. tostring(ball.felt) .. ":" .. tostring(ball.charged)
    end
    bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(c.dog.phase)
    bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(c.washerRunning)
    bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(c.evidence.yarnInBasket)
    bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(c.evidence.toolsInBox)
    bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(c.evidence.machineCovered)
    bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(c.vacuumOff)
    return table.concat(bits, "|")
end
function Room.TutorialText(game)
    if game.won then return "" end
    if game.campaign.tutorialStep <= 3 then
        local controls={Input.KeyHint("move"),Input.KeyHint("switch").." · "..Input.KeyHint("jump"),
            Input.KeyHint("action").." · "..Input.KeyHint("interact")}
        return controls[game.campaign.tutorialStep]
    end
    return ""
end

function Room.SkipTutorial(game)
    game.campaign.tutorialStep = 4
end

function Room.SetHintStage(game, stage)
    HintState.Set(game,stage)
    return Room.Hint(game)
end

function Room.AdvanceHint(game)
    HintState.Advance(game)
    return Room.Hint(game)
end

function Room.EatFish(game)
    local ok = Mechanics.EatFish(game,{kind="eatFish"})
    if ok then Room.PushUndo(game) end
    return ok
end

function Room.GetHintStage(game)
    return HintState.Sync(game)
end

function Room.GetContextAction(game)
    local nearest=InteractCandidate(game,game.active)
    return nearest and nearest.label or "",nearest~=nil,nearest and nearest.id
end

function Room.PressKey(game, key)
    if key == KEY_1 then Room.Select(game, 1)
    elseif key == KEY_2 then Room.Select(game, 2)
    elseif key == KEY_3 then Room.Select(game, 3)
    elseif key == KEY_TAB then Room.Select(game, game.active % 3 + 1)
    elseif key == KEY_S then Room.ToggleCarry(game, game.active)
    elseif key == KEY_E then Room.Interact(game)
    elseif key == KEY_Q then Room.Meow(game)
    elseif key == KEY_SPACE or key == KEY_W or key == KEY_UP then Room.Jump(game)
    elseif key == KEY_U then Room.Undo(game)
    elseif key == KEY_R then Room.Reset(game)
    else return false end
    return true
end

Room.Copy = Copy
Room.LossUnits = CurrentLossUnits
Room.GrantRescue = GrantRescueImpl
Room.PlateWeight = PlateWeight
Room.RestoreSnapshot = RestoreSnapshot
Room.Snapshot = Snapshot
Room.IsBallUsable = IsBallUsable

return Room
CampaignSaveUI:
-- 保存失败不冒充成功：保留可重试任务，弹窗关闭后仍能从暂停菜单重试。
local UI = require("urhox-libs/UI")
local UIF = require("UIFactory")
local I18n = require("I18n")
local Save = require("SaveStore")
local Progress = require("CampaignProgress")
local Room = require("CampaignRoom")
local Dialog = {}
Dialog.__index = Dialog

function Dialog.New()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Dialog)
    self:init()
    return self
end

function Dialog:init()
    self.tasks = {}
    self.queued = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    self.blocking = false
end

local function sameSnapshot(a, b)
    if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
    if type(a) ~= "table" then return a == b end
    for key, value in pairs(a) do if not sameSnapshot(value, b[key]) then return false end end
    for key in pairs(b) do if a[key] == nil then return false end end
    return true
end

-- 捕获失败时的关卡、内存快照和磁盘基线；重试只可提交仍未被更新的检查点。
function Dialog:QueueGameFailure(game, inputState)
    local c = game.campaign
    if not c.saveFailed then return end
    local reason, level = c.saveReason, game.level
    local checkpointAtQueue = (reason == "checkpoint" or reason == "checkpoint_clear") and c.checkpointSnapshot or nil
    local baselineKnown, persistedAtQueue = true, nil
    if reason == "checkpoint" or reason == "checkpoint_clear" then
        local readOk, checkpoint = pcall(Progress.GetCheckpoint, level)
        baselineKnown, persistedAtQueue = readOk, readOk and checkpoint or nil
    end
    local previous = self.queued[c]
    if previous and previous.reason == reason and previous.checkpoint == checkpointAtQueue
        and (reason ~= "checkpoint_clear" or previous.attemptId == c.attemptId) then return end
    self.queued[c] = { reason = reason, checkpoint = checkpointAtQueue, attemptId = c.attemptId }
    local queueMarker = self.queued[c]
    local snapshot = reason == "checkpoint" and checkpointAtQueue and Room.Copy(checkpointAtQueue) or nil
    if snapshot then snapshot.attemptId = c.attemptId end
    local queuedTask = {
        campaign = c, game = game, reason = reason, level = level, queueMarker = queueMarker,
        checkpointAtQueue = checkpointAtQueue, snapshot = snapshot,
        baselineKnown = baselineKnown, persistedAtQueue = Room.Copy(persistedAtQueue),
    }
    queuedTask.isCurrent = function()
        if game.level ~= level or game.campaign ~= c then return false end
        if reason == "attempt" then return c.saveFailed and c.saveReason == "attempt" end
        if not baselineKnown then return nil end
        local currentSnapshot = c.checkpointSnapshot
        if reason == "checkpoint_clear" and c.saveReason ~= "checkpoint_clear" then
            -- A clear task may only clear the checkpoint from the same attempt.
            return c.attemptId == (previous and previous.attemptId)
                and c.saveReason == nil and sameSnapshot(Progress.GetCheckpoint(level), persistedAtQueue)
        end
        if c.saveReason ~= reason or currentSnapshot ~= checkpointAtQueue then return false end
        local persisted = Progress.GetCheckpoint(level)
        return sameSnapshot(persisted, persistedAtQueue)
    end
    self.tasks[#self.tasks + 1] = queuedTask
    inputState.Reset(true)
    game.jumpBuffer = 0
    self:Show()
end

function Dialog:HasPending()
    return #self.tasks > 0
end

function Dialog:IsBlocking()
    return self.blocking
end

function Dialog:Show(retry)
    if retry then self.tasks[#self.tasks + 1] = { run = retry, campaign = nil } end
    self.blocking = true
    if self.page then self.page:Show() end
    print("[存档] 尚未写入永久进度，保留旧档与重试任务")
end

function Dialog:Retry()
    local pending = {}
    for index, task in ipairs(self.tasks) do
        local ok, saved
        if task.run then
            ok, saved = pcall(task.run)
        else
            local c, reason = task.campaign, task.reason
            local currentOk, stillCurrent = pcall(task.isCurrent)
            if not currentOk then
                ok, saved = false, false
            elseif stillCurrent == nil then
                -- Baseline read failed at queue time; refuse an unsafe overwrite and allow retry.
                ok, saved = false, false
            elseif not stillCurrent then
                -- A newer in-memory or persisted operation superseded this task; discard it.
                ok, saved = true, true
            elseif reason == "attempt" then
                ok, saved = pcall(function()
                    local attemptId, allocated = Progress.NewAttemptId()
                    if not attemptId or allocated == false then return false end
                    c.attemptId = attemptId
                    return true
                end)
            else
                ok, saved = pcall(function()
                    return Progress.SetCheckpoint(task.level, task.snapshot)
                end)
            end
            if ok and saved and not task.run and c then
                if self.queued[c] == task.queueMarker then self.queued[c] = nil end
                if c.saveFailed and c.saveReason == reason
                    and (reason == "attempt" or c.checkpointSnapshot == task.checkpointAtQueue) then
                    if reason == "checkpoint_clear" then c.checkpointSnapshot, c.checkpointId = nil, nil end
                    c.saveFailed, c.saveReason = false, nil
                end
            end
        end
        if not ok or not saved then
            -- 按提交顺序重试，跳过过期任务，不让旧快照覆盖更新数据。
            for nextIndex = index, #self.tasks do pending[#pending + 1] = self.tasks[nextIndex] end
            break
        end
    end
    self.tasks = pending
    if #pending == 0 then
        self.blocking = false
        if self.page then self.page:Hide() end
        print("[存档] 重试成功，进度已经保存")
        return true
    end
    self:Show()
    return false
end

function Dialog:CreateUI(onClose)
    self.page = UI.Panel {
        id = "saveFailurePage", visible = false, position = "absolute", left = 0, top = 0, right = 0, bottom = 0,
        zIndex = 110, pointerEvents = "auto", backgroundColor = { 52, 45, 35, 172 },
        alignItems = "center", justifyContent = "center",
        children = { UI.Panel { width = 390, maxWidth = "92%", padding = 24, gap = 14,
            backgroundColor = UIF.P.cream, borderRadius = 20, borderWidth = 1, borderColor = UIF.P.line,
            children = {
                UIF.Title(I18n.T("saveRetry"), 20, { fontColor = UIF.P.woolDark }),
                UIF.Label(I18n.T("saveFailed"), 12, UIF.P.ink, { whiteSpace = "normal", maxLines = 5 }),
                UIF.Button(I18n.T("saveRetry"), function() self:Retry(); if onClose then onClose() end end,
                    { id = "retrySaveButton", height = 44, backgroundColor = UIF.P.sage }),
                UIF.Button(I18n.T("close"), function()
                    self.blocking = false
                    self.page:Hide()
                    if onClose then onClose() end
                end, { id = "dismissSaveFailure", height = 40 }),
            },
        } },
    }
    return self.page
end

return Dialog

-- 背景退后、真实台面描清；不创建球、字体、上下文，也不修改输入/碰撞/账本。
local Details = require("CampaignDetails")
local Art = {}
local INK = { 106, 113, 102, 255 }
local BG_INK = { 165, 162, 140, 150 }
local CREAM = { 249, 241, 216, 255 }
local METAL = { 143, 168, 161, 255 }
local SAGE = { 157, 180, 148, 255 }

local function Fill(ctx, c)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
end
local function Stroke(ctx, c, w)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255))
    nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, w or .019); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, c, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r or 0); Fill(ctx, c)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline) end
end
local function Oval(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, c, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry); Fill(ctx, c)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline) end
end
local function Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, c, w)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x1, y1); nvgLineTo(ctx, x2, y2); Stroke(ctx, c, w)
end
local function Poly(ctx, points, c, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, points[1], points[2])
    for i = 3, #points, 2 do nvgLineTo(ctx, points[i], points[i + 1]) end
    nvgClosePath(ctx); Fill(ctx, c)
    if outline then Stroke(ctx, outline) end
end
local function Gradient(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, a, b)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r)
    nvgFillPaint(ctx, nvgLinearGradient(ctx, x, y, x, y + h,
        nvgRGBA(a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4] or 255), nvgRGBA(b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4] or 255)))
    nvgFill(ctx)
end
local function Shadow(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, feather, alpha)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRect(ctx, x - feather, y - feather, w + feather * 2, h + feather * 2)
    nvgFillPaint(ctx, nvgBoxGradient(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, feather,
        nvgRGBA(113, 100, 76, alpha or 22), nvgRGBA(113, 100, 76, 0)))
    nvgFill(ctx)
end
local function Mark(ctx, x, y, value, unit, size, color)
    -- 抵消米制缩放再栅格化，复用上层已建立的 sans 字体和逻辑像素。
    local scale = math.max(1, unit)
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, x, y); nvgScale(ctx, 1 / scale, 1 / scale)
    nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans"); nvgFontSize(ctx, math.floor(math.max(8, scale * (size or .15))))
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER + NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    local c = color or INK
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255)); nvgText(ctx, 0, 0, value, nil)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end
local function Key(ctx, x, y, unit)

    Mark(ctx, x, y, "E", unit, .14)
end
local function Lamp(ctx, x, y, active)
    Oval(ctx, x, y, .056, .056, active and GREEN or { 170, 161, 128, 255 }, INK)
    if active then
        Line(ctx, x - .025, y, x - .002, y + .023, CREAM, .016)
        Line(ctx, x - .002, y + .023, x + .032, y - .025, CREAM, .016)
    end
end
local function Arrow(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, c)
    Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, c, .024)
    local angle = math.atan(y2 - y1, x2 - x1)

        x2 - math.cos(angle + .55) * .095, y2 - math.sin(angle + .55) * .095 }, c)

local function Paw(ctx, x, y, s, c)

local function Shield(ctx, x, y, s, c, outline)
    Poly(ctx, { x - s * .32, y - s * .34, x + s * .32, y - s * .34,
        x + s * .29, y + s * .08, x, y + s * .38, x - s * .29, y + s * .08 }, c, outline)
end
local function Grain(ctx, x, y, w, h)
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local yy = y + h * i / 4
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x + .08, yy)

local function FoldedCloth(ctx, x, y, w, h, c)
