    Line(ctx, x + w * .80, y + .03, x + w * .80, y + h - .025,
        { 146, 154, 136, 65 }, .014)
end
local function Detergent(ctx, x, y, w, h, c)
    -- 瓶身和把手不是球形收藏，标签用叶片/水滴而非毛线图案。
    Rect(ctx, x, y - h, w, h, .07, c, BG_INK)
    Rect(ctx, x + w * .22, y - h - .07, w * .33, .10, .022,
        { 182, 184, 152, 255 }, BG_INK)

---@param ctx NVGContextWrapper
---@param game table
---@param layout table
---@param ground number
---@param unit number
---@param wx fun(x:number):number
---@param gy fun(y:number):number
---@return boolean
function Art.Background(ctx, game, layout, ground, unit, wx, gy)
    local level = game.level
    local palette = ROOM[level]
    if not palette then return false end
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, layout.x, layout.y, layout.w, layout.h)
    nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(0), ground); nvgScale(ctx, unit, unit); nvgLineCap(ctx, NVG_ROUND)
    local x0 = (layout.x - wx(0)) / unit
    local x1 = x0 + layout.w / unit
    local top = (layout.y - ground) / unit
    local bottom = math.max(.10, (layout.y + layout.h - ground) / unit)
    Gradient(ctx, x0, top, x1 - x0, math.max(.10, -top), 0, palette.wall, palette.low)
    if level == 7 then
        Rect(ctx, x0, -1.90, x1 - x0, 1.90, 0, { 225, 232, 213, 255 })
        for row = 0, 3 do
            local yy = -1.90 + row * .48
            Line(ctx, x0, yy, x1, yy, { 184, 197, 168, 72 }, .012)
            for col = math.floor(x0 / .72) - 1, math.ceil(x1 / .72) + 1 do
                local xx = col * .72 + (row % 2) * .36
                Line(ctx, xx, yy, xx, yy + .48, { 187, 198, 173, 70 }, .012)
            end
        end
        if x0 < 4.2 and x1 > 1 then LaundryWindow(ctx) end
        if x0 < 33 and x1 > 4 then LaundryStorage(ctx, game) end
        if x1 > 18 then DryingRail(ctx) end
        Poly(ctx, { 1.27, -3.02, 3.90, -3.02, 6.53, -.13, 2.16, -.13 }, { 254, 245, 186, 19 })
    else
        -- 木护墙线随世界移动，淡淡纸纹不争抢机关轮廓。
        for col = math.floor(x0 / 1.3) - 1, math.ceil(x1 / 1.3) + 1 do
            Line(ctx, col * 1.3, top, col * 1.3 + .035, -.12, { 199, 183, 153, 42 }, .011)
        end
        if level == 8 then
            if x0 < 21 and x1 > 1 then EntryCabinets(ctx, game) end
            if x0 < 28 and x1 > 5 then EntryCoats(ctx) end
            if x1 > 29 then EntryDoor(ctx) end
            SafetyCover(ctx, game)
        else
            if x0 < 8 and x1 > 1 then ToolBoard(ctx, 1.33, -4.55, 6.23, 2.05) end
            if PlatformInView(PlatformById(game, "mirrorStand"), x0, x1) then Bench(ctx, game) end
            if x1 > 11 then StudioPapers(ctx) end
            if x0 < 27 and x1 > 24 then ToolBoard(ctx, 24.60, -4.23, 2.30, 1.75) end
        end
    end
    Floor(ctx, level, x0, x1, bottom, palette)
    -- 地毯全部落在 ground 以下，避免被当成台面或新的机关。

-- 仅计算镜头与布局，世界米制单位和正式玩法坐标保持不变。
local Visual = {}
local envelopes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local cameras = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local CAT_W = .95

local function Clamp(value, low, high)
    if high < low then return (low + high) * .5 end
    return math.max(low, math.min(high, value))
end

local function MachineHeight(machine)
    local kind = machine.kind or ""
    if kind == "door" or kind == "timedDoor" or kind == "finale_timed_gate" then return (machine.h or 3.6) + .55 end
    if kind == "metal" then return 1.85 end
    if kind == "washer" then return 1.9 end
    if kind == "ropeBridge" and machine.manualEnds then return .8 end
    return math.max(machine.h or 0, 1.1)
end

-- 包围范围包含未启动的升降台和坡道终点，避免全景漏掉高处落脚点。
---@param game table
local function Envelope(game)
    local c, def = game.campaign, game.def
    local cached = envelopes[game]
    local platforms, walls, machines = c.platforms or {}, c.walls or {}, c.machines or {}
    if cached and cached.def == def and cached.attempt == c.attemptId
        and cached.platforms == platforms and cached.walls == walls and cached.machines == machines
        and cached.count == #platforms + #walls + #machines then return cached end
    local out = { def = def, attempt = c.attemptId, platforms = platforms, walls = walls,
        machines = machines, count = #platforms + #walls + #machines, entries = {},
        minX = 0, maxX = def.roomWidth or 34, minY = -.28, maxY = 1.8 }
    local function Include(x0, x1, low, high)
        out.minX, out.maxX = math.min(out.minX, x0), math.max(out.maxX, x1)
        out.minY, out.maxY = math.min(out.minY, low), math.max(out.maxY, high)
        out.entries[#out.entries + 1] = { x0 = x0, x1 = x1, low = low, high = high }
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(platforms) do
        local low = math.min(p.y or 0, p.y1 or p.y or 0)
        local high = math.max(p.y or 0, p.y1 or p.y or 0, p.riseHeight or 0, p.liftHeight or 0)
        if p.movingMachine then
            -- 两种既有移动载台的终点由正式玩法明确规定。
            local source = game.machineById and game.machineById[p.movingMachine]
            high = math.max(high, source and source.lift or 0, p.movingMachine == "washer" and 2.38 or 1.15)
        end
        Include(p.x, p.x + p.w, low - .22, high + (p.h or .14) + 1.65)
    end
    for _, wall in ipairs(walls) do
        Include(wall.x, wall.x + (wall.w or .55), wall.y or .66,
            (wall.y or .66) + (wall.h or 3.2) + .3)
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(machines) do
        Include((machine.x or 0) - .85, (machine.x or 0) + (machine.w or 0) + .85,
            (machine.y or 0) - .22, (machine.y or 0) + MachineHeight(machine))
    end
    if def.gap then
        Include(def.gap.x0, def.gap.x1, math.min(def.gap.depth or 0, def.gap.tunnelY or 0) - .22, .2)
    end
    if c.secret then Include(c.secret.x - .3, c.secret.x + .3, c.secret.y - .3, c.secret.y + .5) end
    local slots = require("CampaignRoom").HomeSlots(game)
    for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do
        Include(slot.x - slot.w * .5, slot.x + slot.w * .5, (slot.y or 0) - .25, (slot.y or 0) + 1.65)
    end
    envelopes[game] = out
    return out
end

---@param game table
---@return table
function Visual.WorldBounds(game)
    local envelope = Envelope(game)
    local low, high = envelope.minY, envelope.maxY
    -- 仅检查三猫和少量动态球体，不重复扫描地形。
    for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep or {}) do
        low = math.min(low, (cat.y or 0) - .22)
        high = math.max(high, (cat.y or 0) + (cat.bodyH or 1) + (cat.carry and .55 or 0) + .45)
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
        if not ball.lost and ball.state ~= "consumed" and ball.state ~= "stored" then
            low = math.min(low, (ball.y or 0) - .18)
            high = math.max(high, (ball.y or 0) + (ball.w or .42) + .3)
        end
    end
    return { minX = envelope.minX, maxX = envelope.maxX, minY = low, maxY = high }
end

---@param game table
function Visual.Invalidate(game)
    if game then envelopes[game], cameras[game] = nil, nil
    else envelopes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }); cameras = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) end
end

local function LocalHeight(envelope, camera, center, span)
    local bucket = math.floor(center * 2)
    if camera.bucket == bucket and camera.span == span and camera.envelope == envelope then return camera.localHigh end
    local high = 1.8
    for _, entry in ipairs(envelope.entries) do
        if entry.x1 >= center - span * .5 and entry.x0 <= center + span * .5 then high = math.max(high, entry.high) end
    end
    camera.bucket, camera.span, camera.envelope, camera.localHigh = bucket, span, envelope, high
    return high
end

-- 保持既有 unit/left/ground 渲染与屏幕转世界坐标契约。
-- layout 已是 UI 基准像素，不再次应用 DPR 或非等比缩放。
---@param game table
---@param layout table
---@param fx table
---@param overview boolean?
---@return table
function Visual.Metrics(game, layout, fx, overview)
    local full = overview == true
    local envelope, bounds = Envelope(game), Visual.WorldBounds(game)
    local width, height = math.max(1, layout.w), math.max(1, layout.h)
    local padX = math.min(16, width * .035)
    local padY = math.min(20, height * .06)
    local usableW, usableH = math.max(1, width - padX * 2), math.max(1, height - padY * 2)
    local worldW = bounds.maxX - bounds.minX
    local viewWidth = full and worldW or math.min(worldW, width < 900 and 11.5 or 14.5)
    -- Short landscape playfields need a closer view, rather than shrinking the
    -- cats until almost the whole room fits horizontally. Full overview stays exact.
    local viewHeight = full and bounds.maxY - bounds.minY or Clamp(height/80,3.2,5.35)
    -- 全景始终完整容纳关卡，不受此前跟随镜头缩放影响。
    local zoom = full and 1 or Clamp(fx.zoom or 1, .65, 1.7)
    local unit = math.max(.001, math.min(usableW / viewWidth, usableH / viewHeight)) * zoom
    local span = usableW / unit
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active] or game.sheep[1]
    local catX = cat.x + CAT_W * .5
    local targetX = full and (bounds.minX + bounds.maxX) * .5
        or Clamp(catX + (cat.facing or 1) * 1.05, bounds.minX + span * .5, bounds.maxX - span * .5)
    if span >= worldW then targetX = (bounds.minX + bounds.maxX) * .5 end
    local camera = cameras[game]
    local clock = game.clock or 0
    local reset = not camera or camera.attempt ~= game.campaign.attemptId or camera.full ~= full
        or camera.width ~= width or camera.height ~= height or clock < camera.clock or camera.active ~= game.active
    if reset then
        camera = { x = targetX, ground = 0, clock = clock, full = full, attempt = game.campaign.attemptId,
            width = width, height = height, active = game.active }
        cameras[game] = camera
    end
    local dt = Clamp(clock - camera.clock, 0, .08)
    local ease = 1 - math.exp(-dt * 8)
    camera.x = reset and targetX or camera.x + (targetX - camera.x) * ease
    if not full then
        -- 回溯或检查点可能在同一尝试与时刻搬回当前猫，需立即恢复可见范围。
        camera.x = Clamp(camera.x, catX - span * .5 + .75, catX + span * .5 - .75)
    end
    local targetGround = 0
    if full then
        -- 居中实际解谜区域而非固定地面比例，让高台与地下路线都可见。
        targetGround = layout.y + height * .48 + (bounds.minY + bounds.maxY) * unit * .5
        targetGround = Clamp(targetGround, layout.y + padY + bounds.maxY * unit,
            layout.y + height - padY + bounds.minY * unit)
    else
        local localHigh = LocalHeight(envelope, camera, camera.x, span)
        local feet = cat.y or 0
        local head = feet + (cat.bodyH or 1) + (cat.carry and .55 or 0)
        local bandLow = math.max(bounds.minY, feet - 1.15)
        local bandHigh = math.max(head + .55, math.min(localHigh, feet + 3.55))
        targetGround = layout.y + height * .49 + (bandLow + bandHigh) * unit * .5
        -- 跳跃、窄屏和放大时保持猫脚与携带毛线在裁剪区域内。
        targetGround = Clamp(targetGround, layout.y + padY + (head + .20) * unit,
            layout.y + height - padY + (feet - .18) * unit)
    end
    camera.ground = reset and targetGround or camera.ground + (targetGround - camera.ground) * ease
    if full then
        camera.ground = Clamp(camera.ground, layout.y + padY + bounds.maxY * unit,
            layout.y + height - padY + bounds.minY * unit)
    else
        local feet = cat.y or 0
        local head = feet + (cat.bodyH or 1) + (cat.carry and .55 or 0)
        camera.ground = Clamp(camera.ground, layout.y + padY + (head + .05) * unit,
            layout.y + height - padY + (feet - .10) * unit)
    end
    camera.clock = clock
    local dx, dy = 0, 0
    if fx.Offset then dx, dy = fx.Offset() end
    return { unit = unit, left = layout.x + width * .5 - camera.x * unit + dx,
        ground = camera.ground + dy, bounds = bounds, overview = full,
        followWidth = viewWidth, cameraX = camera.x,
        visible = { minX = camera.x - width / unit * .5, maxX = camera.x + width / unit * .5,
            minY = (camera.ground - layout.y - height) / unit, maxY = (camera.ground - layout.y) / unit } }
end

-- 操作部件使用已有控件的准确世界几何范围。
-- 无专用部件时沿用美术主体，并绘制有界的候选轮廓。
---@param game table
---@param m table
---@return table?
function Visual.ControlPart(game, m)
    local kind, x, y = m.kind, m.x or 0, m.y or 0
    if kind == "washerControl" then return { x = x, y = y + .10, radius = .10, state = game.campaign.washerRunning == true } end
    if kind == "finale_latch" then return { x = x + (m.active and .18 or -.18), y = y + .57, radius = .072, state = m.active == true } end
    if kind == "finale_timed_switch" then return { x = x, y = y + .40, radius = .10, state = m.active == true } end
    if game.level == 4 and m.id == "airLatch" then return nil end
    if game.level == 4 and kind == "windControl" then
        return { x = x + ((game.campaign.windDirection or 1) > 0 and .50 or -.50), y = y + .05,
            radius = .065, state = m.active == true }
    end
    if kind == "switch" or kind == "windControl" then
        local active = m.active == true
        local dx, up = ((m.mode or 1) == 2 and .16 or -.16), .55
        if game.level == 1 or game.level == 2 or game.level == 5 then dx, up = active and .12 or -.12, .56
        elseif game.level == 7 then
            if m.id == "unload" then active = game.campaign.unloadSet == true; dx, up = active and .13 or -.13, .53
            else active = game.campaign.carrierEnabled == true; dx, up = active and .14 or -.14, .58 end
        elseif game.level == 6 and m.id == "routeSwitch" then dx, up = (m.mode or 1) == 1 and -.19 or .19, .70
        elseif game.level == 6 and m.id == "cargoLatch" then dx, up = active and .12 or -.12, .44
        elseif game.level == 3 then
            if m.id=="bridgeSwitch" or m.id=="rampSwitch" then dx,up=active and .15 or -.15,.58
            else return nil end
        elseif game.level == 4 then dx = (m.mode or 1)==2 and .16 or -.16
        end
        return { x = x + dx, y = y + up, radius = .072, state = active }
    end
    if kind == "ropeNear" or kind == "ropeFar" then return { x = x + .17, y = y + .18, radius = .11, state = m.active == true } end
    return nil
end

---@param game table
---@param m table
---@return table
function Visual.ActionShape(game, m)
    local part = Visual.ControlPart(game, m)
    if part then return { x = part.x, y = part.y, radius = part.radius + .11 } end
    local kind, x, y, w = m.kind, m.x or 0, m.y or 0, m.w or .9
    if kind == "cutStation" then return { x = x, y = y + .30, radius = .35 } end
    if kind == "mirror" or kind == "mirror2" then return { x = x, y = y + .32, w = .49, h = .70 } end
    if kind == "washer" then return { x = x + .16, y = y + .62, radius = .48 } end
    if kind == "weaveStation" then return { x = x, y = y + .24, w = 1.37, h = .60 } end
    if kind == "ropeBridge" and m.manualEnds then return { x = x - .375, y = y + .41, w = .59, h = .40 } end
    if kind == "receiver" or kind == "resetTray" then return { x = x + w * .5, y = y + .08, w = w + .16, h = .30 } end
    if kind == "prop" or kind == "toolItem" then return { x = x, y = y + .24, w = .77, h = .60 } end
    return { x = x, y = y + .28, w = math.min(1.7, math.max(.70, w + .18)), h = .77 }
end

return Visual
CatHole:
-- 05 猫洞：球专用的连续滚球路径；所有动态状态保存在球上，可直接回溯。
local CatHole = {}

-- 碰撞示意（米；1米=1格）：
-- 猫 -> | 4格隔墙 | -> 出口小斜坡 -> [B凹槽]
-- 球 -> | 1格圆孔 | ----------------> 停稳
-- 猫的墙碰撞不因圆孔而挖空；另一个受B控制的木门通道供猫通行。
-- 只有地面无主球能进入；头顶球、空猫和空中的球不能借洞穿墙。
-- 贴边、反向、回溯途中和出口端取球都使用同一条路径，不复制球。

function CatHole.CanEnter(hole, ball)
    if ball.carriedBy or ball.holeRoute or ball.inBasket or ball.swallowWait then return false end
    if (ball.y or 0) > 0.08 or ball.w > hole.aperture then return false end
    local cx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
    return cx >= hole.x - hole.entryReach and cx <= hole.x + hole.w
end

function CatHole.Enter(hole, ball)
    if not CatHole.CanEnter(hole, ball) then return false end
    ball.holeRoute = { id = hole.id, t = 0, fromX = ball.x, fromY = ball.y or 0 }
    ball.holeSettled = nil
    ball.vx = 0
    return true
end

function CatHole.Tick(hole, ball, dt)
    local route = ball.holeRoute
    if not route or route.id ~= hole.id then return false end
    route.t = math.min(hole.travelTime, route.t + dt)
    local progress = route.t / hole.travelTime
    local outletX = hole.x + hole.w + 0.2
    local destinationX = hole.stopX - ball.w / 2
    if progress < 0.45 then
        ball.x = route.fromX + (outletX - route.fromX) * progress / 0.45
        ball.y = route.fromY
    else
        local slope = (progress - 0.45) / 0.55
        ball.x = outletX + (destinationX - outletX) * slope
        ball.y = route.fromY + (hole.stopY - route.fromY) * slope
    end
    if progress < 1 then return false end
    ball.x, ball.y, ball.vx = destinationX, hole.stopY, 0
    ball.holeRoute, ball.holeSettled = nil, hole.id
    return true
end

function CatHole.BlocksGrab(hole, catX, ballX)
    return (catX < hole.x and ballX >= hole.x)
        or (catX > hole.x + hole.w and ballX <= hole.x + hole.w)
end

return CatHole

    toggle("followCamera","默认跟随镜头","Start with follow camera","小屏更容易看清猫和附近机关。","Keep cats and nearby mechanisms readable on small screens.")
    toggle("switchPause","切猫时短暂停顿","Pause briefly when switching","给你时间确认新角色的位置。","Give yourself a moment to locate the selected cat.")

function M.Key(key,scope)
    if captureAction~="" then
        if key==KEY_ESCAPE then
            if captureButton then captureButton:SetText(captureName.." · "..Input.Name(captureAction)) end
            captureAction,captureName="","";captureButton=nil;return true
        end
        if Input.Bind(captureAction,key) then
            if captureButton then captureButton:SetText(captureName.." · "..Input.Name(captureAction)) end
            captureAction,captureName="","";captureButton=nil
        else Sound.Reject() end
        return true
    end
    if M.IsOpen() and key==KEY_ESCAPE then M.Close();return true end
    local activate=key==KEY_RETURN or key==KEY_SPACE
    local adjust=key==KEY_LEFT or key==KEY_RIGHT or key==KEY_UP or key==KEY_DOWN or key==KEY_HOME or key==KEY_END
    if key~=KEY_TAB and not activate and not adjust then return false end
    if not scope then return false end
    scope=panel or scope
    if focusScope~=scope then M.ResetFocus();focusScope=scope end
    ---@type Widget[]
    local buttons={}
    local function walk(widget)
        if not widget:IsVisible() then return end
        local props=widget.props --[[@as table<string, any>]]
        local adjustable=props.onChange and (type(props.value)=="boolean"
            or type(props.value)=="number" and type(props.min)=="number" and type(props.max)=="number")
        if (props.onClick or adjustable) and props.disabled~=true and not props.juiceLocked then buttons[#buttons+1]=widget end
        for _,child in ipairs(widget:GetChildren()) do walk(child) end
    end
    walk(scope)
    if #buttons==0 then return false end
    if key==KEY_TAB then
        focusIndex=focusIndex%#buttons+1
        for i,button in ipairs(buttons) do
            if focusBorders[button]==nil then focusBorders[button]=button.props.borderWidth or 0 end
            button:SetStyle({borderWidth=i==focusIndex and 3 or focusBorders[button]})
        end
        if UI.SetFocus then UI.SetFocus(buttons[focusIndex]) end
        -- Keep keyboard focus visible inside scrollable menus and companion panels.
        local focused=buttons[focusIndex]
        local ancestor=focused.parent --[[@as any]]
        while ancestor do
            if ancestor.props.scrollY and ancestor.ScrollBy then
                local item=focused:GetAbsoluteLayout()
                local viewport=ancestor:GetAbsoluteLayout()
                local delta=item.y<viewport.y+6 and item.y-viewport.y-6
                    or item.y+item.h>viewport.y+viewport.h-6 and item.y+item.h-viewport.y-viewport.h+6 or 0
                if delta~=0 then ancestor:ScrollBy(0,delta) end
            end
            ancestor=ancestor.parent
        end
    else
        local button=buttons[math.max(1,math.min(#buttons,focusIndex))] --[[@as any]]
        local callback=button.props --[[@as table<string, any>]]
        if callback.onChange and type(callback.value)=="number" then
            if adjust then
                local direction=(key==KEY_LEFT or key==KEY_DOWN) and -1 or 1
                local value=key==KEY_HOME and callback.min or key==KEY_END and callback.max
                    or callback.value+direction*(callback.step or (callback.max-callback.min)/20)
                button:SetValue(math.max(callback.min,math.min(callback.max,value)))
                if callback.onChangeEnd then callback.onChangeEnd(button,button:GetValue()) end
            end
        elseif callback.onChange and type(callback.value)=="boolean" then
            if activate then button:SetValue(not callback.value) end
        elseif activate and callback.onClick then callback.onClick(button) end
    end
    return true
end
return M
FX:
-- 公共层·FX 质感层（Juice）：屏幕震动分级 / hit-stop / punch zoom / 粒子对象池
-- 受「震动反馈」开关（yarn.settings.haptic）控制：关闭时屏幕震动降级为 0（粒子/下沉不受影响）。
local Sound = require("AudioManager")
local FX = {}

FX.shake = { x = 0, y = 0, t = 0, dur = 0, amp = 0, phase = 0 }
FX.freeze = 0
FX.punch = 0
FX.zoom = 1

local pool_ = {}

function FX.Acquire(x, y, vx, vy, life, kind, color)
    local e = table.remove(pool_)
    if not e then e = {} end
    e.x, e.y, e.vx, e.vy = x, y, vx, vy
    e.life, e.maxLife, e.kind, e.color = life, life, kind, color or 1
    return e
end

function FX.Release(e)
    e.x, e.y, e.vx, e.vy, e.life, e.maxLife, e.kind, e.color = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
    if #pool_ < 256 then pool_[#pool_ + 1] = e end
end

-- 分级震动（skill 规范）：轻 2px/150ms 落地/抱放/切猫 · 中 5px/250ms 剪开/传送/多米诺 · 重 10px/400ms 翻缸/炸毛撞墙
-- 「震动反馈」关闭时：不启动新震动，且把正在进行的震动立即清零（降级为 0）
function FX.Shake(intensity, duration, mobileLevel)
    if Sound.GetSettings().reducedMotion or not Sound.GetSettings().haptic then
        local s = FX.shake
        s.t, s.amp, s.x, s.y = 0, 0, 0, 0
        return
    end
    local s = FX.shake
    if intensity >= s.amp or s.t <= 0 then
        s.amp, s.dur, s.t = intensity, duration, duration
    end
    if mobileLevel then Sound.Vibrate(mobileLevel) end
end

function FX.Freeze(seconds)
    if Sound.GetSettings().reducedMotion then return end
    if seconds > FX.freeze then FX.freeze = seconds end
end

function FX.PunchZoom(amount)
    if Sound.GetSettings().reducedMotion then return end
    if amount > FX.punch then FX.punch = amount end
end

-- 事件总线：音画同一帧触发（ballDrop → 落球音 + 轻震 + 粒子 + hit-stop）
FX.EVENTS = {
    jump      = { sfx = "Jump",     shake = { 0, 0 } },
    land      = { sfx = "Land",     shake = { 2, 0.15 }, vibrate = "light" },
    grab      = { sfx = "Grab",     shake = { 2, 0.15 }, freeze = 0.04, vibrate = "light" },
    drop      = { sfx = "Drop",     shake = { 2, 0.15 }, vibrate = "light" },
    ballDrop  = { sfx = "Drop",     shake = { 2, 0.15 }, freeze = 0.05, vibrate = "light" },
    scissors  = { sfx = "Scissors", shake = { 5, 0.25 }, freeze = 0.06, vibrate = "medium", punch = 0.05 },
    felt      = { sfx = "Felt",     shake = { 5, 0.25 }, vibrate = "medium" },
    home      = { sfx = "Home" },
    undo      = { sfx = "Undo" },
    restart   = { sfx = "Restart" },
    meow      = { sfx = "Meow" },
    warning   = { sfx = "Warning" },
    rescue    = { sfx = "Home",     shake = { 2, 0.15 } },
    heavy     = { shake = { 10, 0.4 }, freeze = 0.08, vibrate = "heavy", punch = 0.08 },
}

function FX.Fire(name)
    local ev = FX.EVENTS[name]
    if not ev then return end
    if ev.sfx and Sound[ev.sfx] then Sound[ev.sfx]() end
    if ev.shake and ev.shake[1] > 0 then FX.Shake(ev.shake[1], ev.shake[2], ev.vibrate) end
    if ev.freeze and ev.freeze > 0 then FX.Freeze(ev.freeze) end
    if ev.punch then FX.PunchZoom(ev.punch) end
end

-- 统一粒子步进（对象池）：list = game.effects
-- mode: nil=纯生命衰减 · "move"=x/y 位移 · "fall"=位移+重力
---@param list table[]
---@param dt number
---@param mode string|nil
function FX.StepEffects(list, dt, mode)
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        e.life = e.life - dt
        if mode then
            e.x, e.y = e.x + e.vx * dt, e.y + e.vy * dt
            if mode == "fall" then e.vy = e.vy - 3 * dt end
        end
        if e.life <= 0 then
            table.remove(list, i)
            FX.Release(e)
        end
    end
end

-- 生成粒子（复用池对象）
function FX.SpawnInto(list, x, y, kind, count)
    local settings=Sound.GetSettings() or {}
    if settings.reducedMotion then return end
    for i = 1, count do
        list[#list + 1] = FX.Acquire(x, y + 0.1,
            (math.random() - 0.5) * 3, math.random() * 2 + 0.7,
            kind == "home" and 1.4 or 0.4, kind, i % 3 + 1)
    end
end

---@param dt number
function FX.Update(dt)
    if Sound.GetSettings().reducedMotion then
        FX.shake.t,FX.shake.x,FX.shake.y,FX.punch,FX.freeze,FX.zoom=0,0,0,0,0,1
    end
    local s = FX.shake
    if s.t > 0 then
        s.t = math.max(0, s.t - dt)
        local decay = s.dur > 0 and s.t / s.dur or 0
        s.phase = s.phase + dt * 46
        local k = s.amp * decay
        s.x = k * math.sin(s.phase * 2.1)
        s.y = k * math.cos(s.phase * 3.7)
        if s.t <= 0 then s.amp, s.x, s.y = 0, 0, 0 end
    else
        s.amp = 0
    end
    FX.freeze = math.max(0, FX.freeze - dt)
    FX.punch = math.max(0, FX.punch - dt * 1.8)
    FX.zoom = FX.zoom + ((1 + FX.punch) - FX.zoom) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
end

function FX.Offset()
    return FX.shake.x, FX.shake.y
end

return FX

local lang_ = "zh"

function I18n.Set(lang)
    if lang == "en" or lang == "zh" then lang_ = lang end
end

function I18n.Get() return lang_ end

---@param key string
---@vararg string|number
function I18n.T(key, ...)
    local entry = TEXT[key]
    local text
    if type(entry) == "table" then text = entry[lang_] or entry.zh or key
    else text = entry or key end
    if select("#", ...) > 0 then
        local ok, formatted = pcall(string.format, text, ...)
        if ok then return formatted end
    end
    return text
end

I18n.TEXT = TEXT
return I18n

-- 公共层·InputState：键盘与触屏写入同一份输入状态，逻辑层不感知平台
-- Actions and cat selection are edge-triggered; undo repeats use Input.Poll's timer.
-- 触屏按钮与键盘各自调用同一批动作闭包，任何关卡不为平台写特例。
local Input = {}
local Save = require("SaveStore")
local I18n = require("I18n")

local state_ = { moveX = 0, jump = false }
local touch_ = { left = false, right = false, jump = false, undo = false, restart = false }
local undoHold_ = 0
local undoRepeat_ = false
local restartHold_, restartFired_, undoNext_ = 0, false, 0.35
local pulses_ = {}
function Input.Keys()
    return {left=KEY_A,right=KEY_D,jump=KEY_W,action=KEY_S,interact=KEY_E,
        meow=KEY_Q,undo=KEY_U,restart=KEY_R,switch=KEY_TAB}
end
function Input.Binding(action)
    local custom=Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("bindings") or {}
    return custom and custom[action] or Input.Keys()[action]
end
function Input.Bind(action,key)
    if type(key)~="number" or key<=0 or key%1~=0 then return false end
    if key==KEY_ESCAPE or key==KEY_H or key==KEY_RETURN or key==KEY_SPACE
        or key==KEY_LEFT or key==KEY_RIGHT or key==KEY_UP
        or key==KEY_1 or key==KEY_2 or key==KEY_3 then return false end
    if not Input.Keys()[action] then return false end
    local custom=Save.GetSetting("bindings") or {}
    for name in pairs(Input.Keys()) do if name~=action and Input.Binding(name)==key then return false end end
    custom[action]=key;Save.SetSetting("bindings",custom);return true
end
function Input.Name(action)
    local key=Input.Binding(action)
    if key==nil then return tostring(action) end
    if input and input.GetKeyName then
        local name=input:GetKeyName(key)
        if name and name~="" then return name end
    end
    local names={left="A",right="D",jump="W",action="S",interact="E",meow="Q",undo="U",restart="R",switch="Tab"}
    if key==Input.Keys()[action] then return names[action] end
    return tostring(key)
end
function Input.TakePulse(action)
    local value=pulses_[action];pulses_[action]=nil;return value==true

end

local blockedKeys_ = {}
function Input.IsBlocked(key)
    if not blockedKeys_[key] then return false end
    if not input:GetKeyDown(key) then blockedKeys_[key]=nil;return false end
    return true
end
function Input.Release(key)
    blockedKeys_[key]=nil
    if key==Input.Binding("undo") then undoHold_,undoNext_,undoRepeat_=0,.3,false end
end
function Input.BeginUndoRepeat() undoHold_,undoNext_,undoRepeat_=0,.3,true end
local function KeyDown(key) return not Input.IsBlocked(key) and input:GetKeyDown(key) end

-- 触屏写入（UI 虚拟键回调）
function Input.SetTouch(key, value) touch_[key] = value end

-- 键盘边沿 → token（main 映射到共享动作闭包；与触屏按钮调用同一闭包）
---@param key integer
---@param repeatKey boolean
---@return string|integer|nil token
function Input.KeyEdge(key, repeatKey)

    if key==Input.Binding("undo") then return "undo" end
    if repeatKey then return nil end
    if key == Input.Binding("undo") then undoHold_,undoNext_=0,.35;return "undo"
    elseif key == Input.Binding("action") then return "action"
    elseif key == Input.Binding("interact") then return "interact"
    elseif key == Input.Binding("meow") then return "meow"
    elseif key == Input.Binding("restart") then return "restartHold"
    elseif key == KEY_1 then return 1
    elseif key == KEY_2 then return 2
    elseif key == KEY_3 then return 3
    elseif key == Input.Binding("switch") then return "cycle"
    elseif key == KEY_SPACE or key == Input.Binding("jump") or key == KEY_UP then return "jump"
    else return nil end
end

-- Each Poll reports one timed repeat; main dispatches it through the shared Undo action.
function Input.Poll(dt)
    local dir = 0
    if KeyDown(Input.Binding("left")) or KeyDown(KEY_LEFT) or touch_.left then dir = dir - 1 end
    if KeyDown(Input.Binding("right")) or KeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) or touch_.right then dir = dir + 1 end
    state_.moveX = dir
    state_.jump = KeyDown(KEY_SPACE) or KeyDown(Input.Binding("jump"))
        or KeyDown(KEY_UP) or touch_.jump
    -- U 长按连续回溯的补充节流（keydown repeat 已覆盖大部分，这里保证无 repeat 环境也生效）
    state_.undo=false
    if undoRepeat_ and KeyDown(Input.Binding("undo")) or touch_.undo then
        undoHold_ = undoHold_ + dt
        if undoHold_+1e-9 >= undoNext_ then pulses_.undo=true;state_.undo=true;undoNext_=undoHold_+.3 end

    else
        undoHold_,undoNext_,undoRepeat_ = 0,.3,false
    end
    if KeyDown(Input.Binding("restart")) or touch_.restart then
        restartHold_=restartHold_+dt
        if restartHold_>=.8 and not restartFired_ then pulses_.restart=true;restartFired_=true end
    else restartHold_,restartFired_=0,false end
    return state_
end

function Input.Reset(rearmKeys, preserveUndoRepeat)
    -- Loading a room while R is still held must not arm a second restart.
    local restartLatched=restartFired_ or touch_.restart
        or (input and input.GetKeyDown and KeyDown(Input.Binding("restart"))==true)
    for key in pairs(touch_) do touch_[key]=false end
    undoRepeat_=preserveUndoRepeat==true and input:GetKeyDown(Input.Binding("undo"))
    undoHold_ = 0
    undoNext_,restartHold_,restartFired_,pulses_=.3,0,restartLatched==true,{}
    state_.moveX,state_.jump,state_.undo=0,false,false
    if rearmKeys then
        for action in pairs(Input.Keys()) do
            local key=Input.Binding(action)
            if not (preserveUndoRepeat and key==Input.Binding("undo")) then blockedKeys_[key]=input:GetKeyDown(key) or nil end
        end
        for _,key in ipairs({KEY_LEFT,KEY_RIGHT,KEY_SPACE,KEY_UP,KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3}) do blockedKeys_[key]=input:GetKeyDown(key) or nil end
    end

end

-- 教学气泡按键名双标：「按 S / 点 ✋」
function Input.KeyHint(name)
    local hint = Input.Hint[name]
    if not hint then return name end
    local pc
    if name=="move" then pc=Input.Name("left").."/"..Input.Name("right").." · ←/→"
    elseif name=="jump" then pc=Input.Name("jump").." · Space/↑"
    elseif name=="switch" then pc="1/2/3 · "..Input.Name("switch")
    else pc=Input.Name(name) end
    return I18n.Get()=="en" and string.format("Press %s / Tap %s",pc,hint.mobile)
        or string.format("按 %s / 点 %s",pc,hint.mobile)
end

Input.Hint = {
    move = { pc = "A/D 或 ←/→", mobile = "◀▶" },
    jump = { pc = "空格/W/↑", mobile = "↑" },
    switch = { pc = "1/2/3 或 Tab", mobile = "猫头像" },
    action = { pc = "S", mobile = "✋" },
    interact = { pc = "E", mobile = "↻" },
    meow = { pc = "Q", mobile = "🐱" },
    undo = { pc = "U", mobile = "🔄" },
    restart = { pc = "R", mobile = "↺" },
}

return Input

-- 公共层·跨关遗产系统（yarn.legacy，单位=缕）
-- 规则（skill 锁定）：初始 9 缕（3 整球×3）；每关开始按配置发放球；场上另藏散线团(+3缕)；
-- 通关时场上剩余折算缕数：自有球永久损失才扣遗产，补给线（主人留的）不计入遗产，散线团另 +3。
-- 理论最大 9 + 10关×3 = 39 缕。第11隐藏关复用第10关遗产，不参与星级/散线团累加。
--
-- 落账模型（纯函数，可反复 R/退出无副作用）：
--   ownGranted = min(进关遗产, 本关发放缕数)        -- 本关自有的球
--   lostOwn    = max(0, ownGranted - 场上剩余缕数)   -- 自有永久损失（坠渊/被偷/被吸）
--   新遗产 = clamp(进关遗产 - lostOwn + 散线团3, 0, 39)
--   （补给线 = 发放 - ownGranted，玩家照常可用，永不计遗产增减）
local Save = require("SaveStore")
local LevelData = require("LevelData")
local Legacy = {}

Legacy.INITIAL = 9
Legacy.MAX = 39
Legacy.SCATTER_STRANDS = 3

-- 各关标准发放（缕）：现有 10 关引擎一律 3 整球 = 9 缕；关卡 JSON 的 yarn.strands 若存在则以 JSON 为准。
Legacy.PAYOUT = {
    [1] = 9, [2] = 9, [3] = 9, [4] = 9, [5] = 9,
    [6] = 9, [7] = 9, [8] = 9, [9] = 9, [10] = 9,
}

-- 场上的线折算缕数（skill 口径：整/毡=3缕，半=1.5缕，绳=2缕；吞线在途/已私吞不计）
function Legacy.StrandsOf(ball)
    if ball.swallowWait or ball.stolen then return 0 end
    if ball.kind == "rope" then return ball.amount or 2 end
    if ball.felt then return 3 end
    if ball.kind == "half" then return 1.5 end
    return 3
end

function Legacy.SumStrands(balls)
    local total = 0
    for _, b in ipairs(balls) do total = total + Legacy.StrandsOf(b) end
    return total
end

---@param level integer
---@return number 本关应发放缕数
function Legacy.PayoutFor(level)
    local json = LevelData.Get(level)
    if json and json.yarn and json.yarn.strands then return json.yarn.strands end
    return Legacy.PAYOUT[level] or 9
end

---@return number 进关时遗产（供各关 HUD/发放参考）
function Legacy.EntrySnapshot()
    return Save.Load().legacy
end

-- 标记本关进关遗产（main.LoadLevel 调用）：结算以此为基准，保证 R 后重复通关不多扣
function Legacy.MarkEntry(level)
    local data = Save.Load()
    data.legacyAtEntry = data.legacyAtEntry or {}
    if data.legacyAtEntry[level] == nil then
        data.legacyAtEntry[level] = data.legacy
        Save.Save(data)
    end
    return data.legacyAtEntry[level]
end

-- 通关落账
---@param level integer 1~11
---@param remainingStrands number 场上剩余缕数
---@param collectedScatter boolean 本关散线团是否拿到
---@param stars integer 0~3
---@param returnedStrands number|nil 本关开始时吐回的毛球袋缕数（计入剩余）
function Legacy.Settle(level, remainingStrands, collectedScatter, stars, returnedStrands)
    local data = Save.Load()
    data.legacyAtEntry = data.legacyAtEntry or {}
    local entry = data.legacyAtEntry[level] or data.legacy
    data.legacyAtEntry[level] = nil -- 结算完成，重玩时重新标记
    local payout = Legacy.PayoutFor(level)
    local ownGranted = math.min(entry, payout)
    local countOwn = math.max(0, remainingStrands - (returnedStrands or 0))
    local lostOwn = math.max(0, ownGranted - countOwn)
    local scatter = collectedScatter and Legacy.SCATTER_STRANDS or 0
    -- 第11隐藏关不参与散线团累加
    if level >= 11 then scatter = 0 end
    data.legacy = math.max(0, math.min(Legacy.MAX,
        entry - lostOwn + scatter + (returnedStrands or 0)))
    Save.Save(data)
    Save.RecordClear(level, stars or 0)
    return data.legacy
end

-- 结局分档（第10关结束后按遗产结算）
---@return string endingKey endingThick|endingMid|endingThin|endingBare
function Legacy.EndingKey(legacy)
    legacy = legacy or Save.Load().legacy
    if legacy >= 33 then return "endingThick" end
    if legacy >= 24 then return "endingMid" end
    if legacy >= 12 then return "endingThin" end
    return "endingBare"
end

-- 现场编织（第5关解锁）：织工具花遗产、永久持有
Legacy.TOOLS = {
    { name = "网兜", en = "Net", cost = 3 },
    { name = "护垫", en = "Pad", cost = 5 },
    { name = "假球", en = "Decoy", cost = 2 },
}

---@param toolName string
---@return boolean ok
function Legacy.Weave(toolName)
    local data = Save.Load()
    for _, t in ipairs(Legacy.TOOLS) do
        if t.name == toolName then
            for _, owned in ipairs(data.tools) do
                if owned == toolName then return false end -- 已持有
            end
            if data.legacy < t.cost then return false end
            data.legacy = data.legacy - t.cost
            data.tools[#data.tools + 1] = toolName
            return Save.Save(data) == true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- 毛球袋（吞线，13 号机关）：跨关保留，outLv = inLv+3 吐出为毡球
---@param inLv integer 吞下发生关
---@param strands integer 暂扣缕数
function Legacy.StorePellet(inLv, strands)
    local data = Save.Load()
    data.pellet = { inLv = inLv, outLv = inLv + 3, kind = "felt", strands = strands or 3 }
    data.legacy = math.max(0, data.legacy - (strands or 3))
    Save.Save(data)
    return data.pellet
end

-- 关卡开始时检查吐出（毡球3缕回出生点）
---@param level integer
---@return table|nil pellet 吐出信息
function Legacy.CheckPellet(level)
    local data = Save.Load()
    if data.pellet and data.pellet.outLv == level then
        local out = data.pellet
        data.pellet = nil
        Save.Save(data)
        return out
    end
    return nil
end

-- 显示用整数（缕可含半缕，HUD 向下取整；精确值用 GetTable().legacy）
function Legacy.Get() return math.floor(Save.Load().legacy + 0.001) end
function Legacy.GetTable() return Save.Load() end

return Legacy

    [33]="爬帘坍塌",[34]="现场编织",[35]="踩键盘",[36]="鱼缸",[37]="主人巡逻" }
LevelData.MECH_NUMBERS = MECH_NUMBERS

-- 读取顺序：games/levels/（开发态，与 skill 路径一致）→ assets/levels/（构建打包态）
local function readText(relative)
    local f = cache:GetFile(relative)
    if f then
        local text = f:ReadString()
        if text and #text > 0 then return text end
    end
    return nil
end

local function decode(text)
    local ok, data = pcall(cjson.decode, text)
    if ok and type(data) == "table" then return data end
    return nil
end

function LevelData.Load(level)
    if CACHE[level] then return CACHE[level] end
    if MISSING[level] then return nil end
    local fileName = string.format("level%02d.json", level)
    local data = decode(readText("games/levels/" .. fileName) or "")
        or decode(readText("assets/levels/" .. fileName) or "")
    if data then
        data.fromFile = true
        CACHE[level] = data
    else
        MISSING[level] = true
    end
    return data
end

-- 取关卡定义：优先 JSON 文件，缺失用兜底
---@param level integer
function LevelData.Get(level)
    return LevelData.Load(level) or LevelData.FALLBACK[level]

function LevelData.ClearCache()
    for k in pairs(CACHE) do CACHE[k] = nil end
    for k in pairs(MISSING) do MISSING[k] = nil end
end

    local viewportWidth = UI.GetViewportSize()
    return math.max(1, viewportWidth)

    local _, viewportHeight = UI.GetViewportSize()
    return math.max(1, viewportHeight)

local function RefreshAdaptiveLayout(force)
    local width, height = UIBaseWidth(), UIBaseHeight()
    if not force and width == adaptiveWidth and height == adaptiveHeight then return false end
    adaptiveWidth, adaptiveHeight = width, height
    local previousCompactWidth, previousCompactLayout = compactWidth, compactLayout
    compactWidth = width < 720
    compactLayout = height < 560 or width < 900
    if previousCompactWidth == compactWidth and previousCompactLayout == compactLayout then return true end
    if root and menuPage and CreateMenu then
        local wasVisible = menuPage:IsVisible()
        menuPage:Destroy()
        local rebuiltMenu = CreateMenu()
        menuPage = rebuiltMenu
        root:AddChild(rebuiltMenu)
        rebuiltMenu:SetVisible(wasVisible)
    end
    if root and mode == "select" and BuildSelect then
        local wasVisible = selectPage and selectPage:IsVisible() or false
        BuildSelect()
        if selectPage then selectPage:SetVisible(wasVisible) end
    end
    if root and BuildGame then
        local rootWidget = root --[[@as Widget]]
        local previousGame = rootWidget:FindById("gameLayer")
        local previousPause = rootWidget:FindById("pausePage")
        local previousVictory = rootWidget:FindById("victoryOverlay")
        local previousEnding = rootWidget:FindById("endingPage")
        local wasGameVisible = previousGame and previousGame:IsVisible() or false
        local wasPauseVisible = previousPause and previousPause:IsVisible() or false
        local wasVictoryVisible = previousVictory and previousVictory:IsVisible() or false
        local wasEndingVisible = previousEnding and previousEnding:IsVisible() or false
        BuildGame()
        local rebuiltGame = rootWidget:FindById("gameLayer")
        local rebuiltPause = rootWidget:FindById("pausePage")
        local rebuiltVictory = rootWidget:FindById("victoryOverlay")
        local rebuiltEnding = rootWidget:FindById("endingPage")
        local rebuiltHint = rootWidget:FindById("hintPanel")
        if rebuiltGame then rebuiltGame:SetVisible(wasGameVisible) end
        if rebuiltPause then rebuiltPause:SetVisible(wasPauseVisible and wasGameVisible) end
        if rebuiltVictory then rebuiltVictory:SetVisible(wasVictoryVisible and wasGameVisible) end
        if rebuiltEnding then rebuiltEnding:SetVisible(wasEndingVisible) end
        if rebuiltHint then rebuiltHint:SetVisible(hintVisible and wasGameVisible) end
    end
    if root and settingsPage and settingsPage.IsVisible and settingsPage:IsVisible() then
        Menus.CloseSettings(settingsPage)
        BuildSettings()
        if settingsPage then settingsPage:SetVisible(true) end
    end
    return true
end

local function Metrics()
    if not board then return { unit = 1, left = 0, ground = 0 } end
    local l = board:GetAbsoluteLayout()
    if game.campaignV2 then return CampaignArt.Metrics(game, l, FX, overview) end
    local roomWidth = game.def.roomWidth or ROOM_W
    local zoom = FX.zoom or 1
    local unit = math.max(1, math.min((l.w - 24) / roomWidth, (l.h - 40) / 6.2)) * zoom
    local sx, sy = FX.Offset()
    return { unit = unit, left = l.x + (l.w - roomWidth * unit) / 2 + sx,
        ground = l.y + l.h * 0.78 + sy }
end

local function NearestActionLabel()
    if not game.campaignV2 or not game.campaign then return "" end
    if game.GetContextAction then
        local ok, action, _, machineId = pcall(function() return game:GetContextAction() end)
        if ok and action then
            if machineId and game.GetMachine then return MachineLabel(game:GetMachine(machineId)) end
            if type(action) == "table" then return action.text or action.label or MachineLabel(action.machine) or "" end
            return tostring(action)
        end
    end
    local cat = game.sheep[game.active]
    if not cat then return "" end
    local best, distance = nil, 1.35
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.campaign.machines or {}) do
        local x = (machine.x or 0) + (machine.kind == "ropeBridge" and 0 or (machine.w or 0) * 0.5)
        local d = math.abs(cat.x + 0.475 - x)
        if d < distance and math.abs((cat.y or 0) - (machine.y or 0)) < 0.75 then
            best, distance = machine, d
        end
    end
    return best and MachineLabel(best) or ""
end

local function AnyCatFed()
    for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep or {}) do
        if (cat.weightBonus or 0) > 0 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function HasDecoy()
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
        if ball.source == "decoy" then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function CanMeowAction()
    if not game.campaignV2 then return true end
    if CampaignRoom.IsRecalling(game) or CampaignRoom.CanRecall(game)
        or CampaignRoom.IsGathering(game) or CampaignRoom.CanGather(game) then return true end
    return game.level == 6 or game.level == 10
end

local function ToolVisible(name)
    return game.campaignV2 and game.campaign and game.campaign.inventoryTools
        and game.campaign.inventoryTools[name] == true
end

local mechanismFeedbackGame = nil --[[@as table?]]
local mechanismFeedbackStates = {}
local contextSelectedCat = nil --[[@as integer?]]
local function UpdateMechanismFeedback()
    if mechanismFeedbackGame~=game then
        mechanismFeedbackGame=game
        mechanismFeedbackStates={}
        contextSelectedCat=nil
    end
    for _,m in ipairs(game.campaign.machines) do
        local state=m.open==true or m.active==true
        local previous=mechanismFeedbackStates[m.id]
        if previous==false and state and (m.kind=="door" or m.kind=="bridge" or m.kind=="divider") then
            actionNotice=Experience.Name(m)..L("已开启／固定，可以通行", " opened / secured; the route is clear")
            actionNoticeUntil=uiClock+3
        end
        if previous==false and state then
            if m.kind=="door" or m.kind=="bridge" then Sound.Sfx("sfx_home",.3,.8)
            elseif m.kind=="plate" or m.kind=="laserPlate" then Sound.Sfx("sfx_drop",.25,1.15)
            elseif m.kind:sub(1,4)=="exp_" then Sound.Sfx("ui_transition",.35,1) end
        end
        mechanismFeedbackStates[m.id]=state
    end
end

local function UpdateContextHud()
    if not game.campaignV2 or not game.campaign then return end
    local c = game.campaign
    if gameLayer then
        local show=TouchControlsVisible()
        if shownTouchControls~=show then
            for _,id in ipairs({"verticalControls","horizontalControls","interactButton","woolButton"}) do
                local widget=gameLayer:FindById(id)
                if widget then widget:SetVisible(show) end
            end
            local controls=gameLayer:FindById("gameControls")

            if keyHintsLabel then keyHintsLabel:SetVisible(not show) end
            shownTouchControls=show
        end
    end
    UpdateMechanismFeedback()
    if contextSelectedCat~=game.active then
        contextSelectedCat=game.active
        actionNotice=game.sheep[game.active].name.." · "..Experience.CatStatus(game,game.active)
        actionNoticeUntil=uiClock+1.5
    end
    if objectiveLabel then objectiveLabel:SetText(Experience.Objective(game)) end
    if feedbackLabel then
        local _,_,targetId=game:GetContextAction()

            or Experience.DefaultContext(game)

            context=L("队友挡在前面，点它的头像挪开，或跳上它的背", "A teammate is blocking the way; select them to move aside, or jump onto their back")
        end
        -- Mechanism warnings used to be appended only to the retired status
        -- label. Keep them in the visible feedback dock, ahead of routine actions.
        local notice=c.notice and T("notice_"..c.notice)
        feedbackLabel:SetText(notice or (uiClock<actionNoticeUntil and actionNotice or context))
    end
    if saveStatusLabel and Save.Status then
        local status=Save.Status()
        saveStatusLabel:SetText(status.error~="" and L("成绩待保存 · 自动重试", "Save pending · Retrying")

    if woolLabel then woolLabel:SetText(YarnText()) end
    if legacyLabel then

    end
    local parts = {}

    local phases={alert="预警",inspect="查看",play="玩耍",["return"]="返回",contained="隔板已锁",pickup="捡玩具",repair="扶正倒书",patrol="巡逻"}
    local function phaseText(phase) return I18n.Get()=="zh" and (phases[phase] or phase) or phase end
    if c.dog and c.dog.phase and c.dog.phase ~= "idle" then parts[#parts + 1] = T("statusDog", phaseText(c.dog.phase)) end
    if c.ownerPhase then parts[#parts + 1] = T("statusOwner", phaseText(c.ownerPhase)) end
    if c.laserFollowing then parts[#parts + 1] = T("statusLaserFollow") end
    if c.evidence and game.level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL then

        parts[#parts + 1] = T("statusEvidence", done)

    local action = NearestActionLabel()

    if toolNetButton then toolNetButton:SetVisible(ToolVisible("网兜")) end

    end
    if laserToggleButton then
        laserToggleButton:SetVisible(game.level == 9)
        laserToggleButton:SetText(T("laserToggle") .. " " .. (c.laserOff and T("laserOn") or T("laserOff")))
    end
    if meowButton then
        meowButton:SetVisible(CanMeowAction())

            or CampaignRoom.CanRecall(game) and L("回窝", "Home")

    end
    if eatFishButton then

    end

    if keyHintsLabel then keyHintsLabel:SetText(Input.Name("left").."/"..Input.Name("right").." "..L("移动", "Move")
        .." · "..Input.Name("jump").." "..L("跳跃", "Jump")
        .." · "..Input.Name("action").." "..L("抱放", "Carry").." · "..Input.Name("interact").." "..L("使用", "Use")) end

local function CardDanger(index)
    if game.active==index or game.sheep[index].arrived or not game.campaignV2 then return "" end
    local c=game.campaign
    local sourceX=nil
    if c.finale and c.finale.owner and c.finale.owner.warningCat==index then
        sourceX=c.finale.owner.x
    elseif c.dog and c.dog.phase=="alert" and c.dog.lastCat==index then
        for _,machine in ipairs(c.machines or {}) do
            if machine.kind=="dog" then sourceX=machine.x;break end
        end
    end
    if not sourceX then return game.sheep[index].coverExposure and ("⚠ "..T("coverExposedShort")) or "" end
    return "⚠ "..(sourceX<game.sheep[index].x and "←" or "→")
end

local function CatDirection(index)
    local cat,active=game.sheep[index],game.sheep[game.active]
    if index==game.active or cat.arrived or math.abs(cat.x-active.x)<1 then return "" end
    return cat.x<active.x and "← " or "→ "
end

local function BallText(ball)
    if not ball then return T("ballNone") end
    return T(ball.felt and "ballFelt" or ball.kind=="half" and "ballHalf" or ball.kind=="rope" and "ballRope" or "ballFull")
end

local function RefreshCards()
    for i, card in ipairs(cards) do
        local s = game.sheep[i]
        if s then
            local selected = game.active == i and not s.arrived
            card:SetStyle({
                backgroundColor = selected and P.sage or P.cream,
                hoverBackgroundColor = selected and "#D8E4C5" or "#F7EEDB",
                borderColor = selected and P.green or P.line,
                borderWidth = selected and 2 or 1,
                borderBottomColor = selected and P.greenDark or "#C5B99F",
                shadowColor = selected and { 79, 104, 64, 42 } or { 72, 58, 38, 22 },
                opacity = 1,
            })
            local state = card:FindById("state" .. i) --[[@as Label?]]
            if state then
                local text
                if s.arrived then text = T("arrived")
                elseif s.napping then text = T("napping")
                elseif selected then text = s.carry and T("carry", BallText(game:CarriedBall(i))) or T("idle")
                else text = T("idle") end
                state:SetText((selected and "▶ " or s.arrived and "✓ " or CatDirection(i))..text)
                state:SetFontColor(selected and P.greenDark or P.muted)
            end
            local ballLine = card:FindById("ball" .. i) --[[@as Label?]]
            if ballLine then ballLine:SetText(T("carry", BallText(s.carry and game:CarriedBall(i) or nil))) end

            local danger = card:FindById("danger" .. i) --[[@as Label?]]
            if danger then
                local text=CardDanger(i)
                danger:SetText(text)
                danger:SetVisible(text~="")
            end
        end
    end
    if game.campaignV2 then
        if pelletLabel then pelletLabel:SetText("") end
    else
        if legacyLabel then legacyLabel:SetText(T("legacy", math.floor(Legacy.Get() + 0.5))) end
        if pelletLabel then
            local data = Legacy.GetTable()
            if game.level >= 4 and data.pellet then
                pelletLabel:SetText(T("pelletIn", data.pellet.strands)
                    .. " → " .. T("pelletOutDay", data.pellet.outLv))
            else
                pelletLabel:SetText("")
            end
        end
    end
    if countLabel then countLabel:SetText(T("inNest", game:ArrivedCount())) end
    if aiLabel then
        aiLabel:SetText((game.def.profile == "seesaw-room" or game.def.profile == "scissors-room"
            or game.def.profile == "tutorial-room") and T("aiWeights") or "")
    end
    if woolButton then woolButton:SetText(game.sheep[game.active].carry and T("dropWool") or T("holdWool")) end
    if undoButton then undoButton:SetDisabled(not game:CanUndo()) end
    for i = 1, Game.GetLevelCount(game) do
        local btn = levelButtons[i]
        if btn then
            local cur = game.level == i
            btn:SetStyle({
                backgroundColor = cur and P.green or P.cream,
                textColor = cur and P.cream or P.ink,
                borderColor = cur and P.greenDark or P.line,
                borderBottomColor = cur and P.greenDark or "#CCCDB6",
            })
        end
    end
    if headerLevelLabel then
        headerLevelLabel:SetText(LevelHeader(game.def, game.level))
    end
    if headerSubLabel then headerSubLabel:SetText(game.campaignV2 and LevelNameText(game.level) or (game.def.sub or "")) end
    if overlayTitleLabel then overlayTitleLabel:SetText(LevelTitle(game.def, game.level)) end
    if overlaySubLabel then overlaySubLabel:SetText(game.campaignV2 and SubText(game.level, game.def.sub) or (game.def.sub or "")) end
    if tutorialBubble and tutorialLabel then
        local text = Guide.BubbleText() or game:TutorialText()
        tutorialBubble:SetVisible(not hintVisible and (text or "") ~= "")
        if text then tutorialLabel:SetText(text) end
    end
    UpdateContextHud()
end

-- ===== 共享动作闭包（键盘与触屏调用同一批函数，逻辑层不感知平台） =====
local Select, NextCat, DoJump, ToggleWool, Meow, EatFish, Interact, Undo, Restart, LoadLevel
local TogglePause, ToggleHint, ToggleAI, SetMode, OnVictory, CloseHint, SetHintPanelVisible

local function QueueGameSaveFailure()
    SaveDialog:QueueGameFailure(game, Input)
end


Select = function(index)
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end
    game:Select(index)
    if Save.GetSetting("switchPause") then switchGrace=.35 end
    Guide.Note("switch")
    Sound.CatSwitch(index)
    FX.Shake(2, 0.15, "light")
    RefreshCards()
end

NextCat = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end
    game:Next()
    if Save.GetSetting("switchPause") then switchGrace=.35 end
    Sound.CatSwitch(game.active)
    Guide.Note("switch")
    RefreshCards()

end

DoJump = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end
    Guide.Note("jump")
    game:Jump()
    FX.Fire("jump")
end

ToggleWool = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end
    local before = game.sheep[game.active].carry
    local ok=game:ToggleCarry(game.active)
    if ok then Guide.Note("action") else
        actionNotice,actionNoticeUntil=Experience.Failure(game,"carry"),uiClock+4
        runStats.failures=runStats.failures+1
    end
    local after = game.sheep[game.active].carry
    if before ~= after then
        FX.Fire(after and "grab" or "drop")
    elseif before == false then
        Sound.Reject() -- 抱不起来 = 此路不通
    end
    RefreshCards()
end

Meow = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end
    if not CanMeowAction() then Sound.Reject(); return end
    if game:Meow() then Guide.Note("meow");FX.Fire("meow") else Sound.Reject() end
    RefreshCards()
end

EatFish = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won or not game.campaignV2 then return end
    local ok = false
    if game.EatFish then ok = game:EatFish() else ok = CampaignRoom.EatFish(game) end
    if ok then
        Guide.Note("interact")
        Sound.Click()
        FX.Fire("grab")
    else
        Sound.Reject()
    end
    RefreshCards()
end

Interact = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won or not game.Interact then return end
    local mode, label = game:Interact()
    if mode == "stored" and label then
        local parent = board and board.parent
        if parent and game.campaignV2 and (game.level == 4 or game.level == 6 or game.level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL) then
            if tutorialLabel then tutorialLabel:SetText(T("statusFishHeld")) end
        end
    end
    if mode then
        runStats.interactions=runStats.interactions+1
        actionNotice,actionNoticeUntil=tostring(label or L("机关", "Mechanism"))..L(" · 已操作", " · Used"),uiClock+2
        Guide.Note("interact")
        Sound.Click()
        print("[交互] " .. tostring(label or "机关"))
        RefreshCards()
    else
        actionNotice,actionNoticeUntil=Experience.Failure(game,"interact"),uiClock+4
        runStats.failures=runStats.failures+1
        Sound.Reject()
    end
end

Undo = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible then return end
    if not game:CanUndo() then Sound.Reject(); return end
    game:Undo()
    Input.Reset(true)
    game.jumpBuffer = 0
    runStats.rewinds=runStats.rewinds+1
    actionNotice,actionNoticeUntil=L("已恢复先前现场 · 猫、毛线和机关已回溯", "Earlier scene restored · Cats, yarn and mechanisms rewound"),uiClock+2.5

    if not game.won then victoryShown=false end
    Sound.Undo()
    FX.Freeze(0.05)
    if victory and not game.won then victory:Hide() end
    lastStatus = ""
    RefreshCards()
end

LoadLevel = function(level)
    if game.campaignV2 and not CampaignProgress.IsUnlocked(level) then
        Sound.Reject()
        print("[关卡] 仍未解锁：" .. tostring(level))
        return false
    end
    CloseHint()
    Input.Reset(true)
    hintStage = 0
    game:LoadLevel(level)
    Save.Remember("lastLevel",level)
    runStats={rewinds=0,interactions=0,failures=0}
    victoryShown=false
    overview=Save.GetSetting("followCamera")==false
    paused,focusPaused=false,false
    lastStatus,warnTimer="",0
    Guide.Opening(level,game.def);Guide.Reset()
    if victory then victory:Hide() end
    if endingPage then endingPage:Hide() end
    if pausePage then pausePage:Hide() end
    if pauseButton then pauseButton:SetText(T("paused")) end
    if warningBubble then warningBubble:Hide() end
    RefreshCards()
    if hintPanel then SetHintPanelVisible(false) end

    return true
end

FinishDemo = function()
    Input.Reset(true)
    game.jumpBuffer = 0
    RefreshCards()
end

BeginDemo = function()
    if game.level ~= 1 or game.won or paused or hintVisible or SaveDialog:IsBlocking() then return end
    Input.Reset(true)
    game.jumpBuffer = 0
    Demo:Begin()
end

Restart = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() then return end
    if game.campaignV2 then
        local level=game.level
        local saved=CampaignProgress.SetCheckpoint(level,nil)
        if not saved then
            SaveDialog:Show(function()
                if not CampaignProgress.SetCheckpoint(level,nil) then return false end
                LoadLevel(level);return true
            end)
            return
        end
    end
    LoadLevel(game.level)
    FX.Fire("restart")
    Guide.Note("restart")
end

function Game.GetFrame()
    return {
        setMode = SetMode,
        loadLevel = LoadLevel,
        restart = Restart,
        getMode = function() return mode end,
        isPaused = function() return paused end,
        buildSelect = BuildSelect,
        buildSettings = BuildSettings,
        finishDemo = function() Demo:Finish() end,
        startDemo = BeginDemo,
        isDemoRunning = function() return Demo.running end,
        getDemo = function() return Demo end,
        undo = Undo,
        retrySave = function() return SaveDialog:Retry() end,
        isSavePending = function() return SaveDialog:HasPending() end,

    }
end

SetMode = function(nextMode)
    if root then RefreshAdaptiveLayout() end
    if nextMode ~= "game" then
        Demo:Finish(true)
        CloseHint()
        Input.Reset(true)
    end
    ExperienceUI.Close()
    ExperienceUI.ResetFocus()
    if settingsPage then settingsPage:Hide() end

    if nextMode == "select" and BuildSelect then BuildSelect() end
    mode = nextMode
    if menuPage then menuPage:SetVisible(nextMode == "menu") end
    if selectPage then selectPage:SetVisible(nextMode == "select") end
    if gameLayer then gameLayer:SetVisible(nextMode == "game") end
    if nextMode ~= "game" then Sound.StopBGM() else Sound.PlayBGM() end
end

TogglePause = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or mode ~= "game" or game.won then return end
    if hintVisible then CloseHint() end
    paused = not paused
    Input.Reset(true)
    if retrySaveButton then retrySaveButton:SetVisible(SaveDialog:HasPending()) end
    if pausePage then pausePage:SetVisible(paused) end
    if pauseButton then pauseButton:SetText(paused and T("resume") or T("paused")) end
end

SetHintPanelVisible = function(visible)
    if hintPanel then hintPanel:SetVisible(visible) end
end

ToggleHint = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or game.won then return end
    Input.Reset(true)
    if game.campaignV2 then
        if hintVisible then game:AdvanceHint() end
        hintStage = game:GetHintStage()
    else
        hintStage = 1
    end
    hintVisible = true
    if hintLabel then hintLabel:SetText(game:Hint()) end
    if tutorialBubble then tutorialBubble:SetVisible(false) end
    if warningBubble then warningBubble:SetVisible(false) end
    SetHintPanelVisible(true)
end

CloseHint = function()
    if not hintVisible then return end
    hintVisible = false
    SetHintPanelVisible(false)
    Input.Reset(true)
end


ToggleAI = function()
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end
    if game.def.profile == "tutorial-room" or game.def.profile == "seesaw-room"
        or game.def.profile == "scissors-room" then return end
    game.autonomy = not game.autonomy
    print("[AI] 待机猫" .. (game.autonomy and "自由行动" or "原地待命"))
    RefreshCards()

end

OnVictory = function()
    victoryShown = true
    if game.campaignV2 then
        local stars = game:Stars()
        local remaining = game:YarnAmount()
        local netUnits = game.level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL and 0 or
            (game.campaign.secretCollected and 6 or 0) - game.campaign.lossUnits
        local _, committed, reason = CampaignProgress.CommitClear(game.level, netUnits, stars, game.campaign.attemptId)
        if not committed and reason == "save_failed" then
            local level, attemptId, settled = game.level, game.campaign.attemptId, game.campaign
            SaveDialog:Show(function()
                local _, saved, retryReason = CampaignProgress.CommitClear(level, netUnits, stars, attemptId)
                if saved or retryReason == "duplicate" then
                    if game.campaign == settled and game.won and resultLabel then
                        resultLabel:SetText(level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL and T("resultHidden")
                            or T("resultCampaign", netUnits / 2, CampaignProgress.GetTotalStrands(), stars,
                                CampaignProgress.GetBestStars(level)))
                    end
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end)

        end
        if committed then
            local journal=Save.Load().journal or {}
            journal[tostring(game.level)]={stars=stars,elapsed=game.elapsed,rewinds=runStats.rewinds,
                failures=runStats.failures,netUnits=netUnits,secret=game.campaign.secretCollected}
            Save.Remember("journal",journal);Save.Remember("tutorialSeen",true)
        end
        if game.level == Game.LEVEL_COUNT and committed then
            print("[正篇结局] " .. CampaignProgress.GetEndingKey() .. "；" .. CampaignProgress.GetTotalStrands() .. "缕")
        elseif game.level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL then
            print("[隐藏结局] 三项证据" .. (game.campaign.allEvidence and "完成" or "未完成"))
        end
        local data = CampaignProgress.GetCampaignData()
        if resultLabel then
            local details = game.level == Game.HIDDEN_LEVEL
                and T("resultHidden")
                or string.format(T("resultCampaign"),
                    netUnits / 2, data.totalStrands, stars, CampaignProgress.GetBestStars(game.level))
            local summary=Experience.RouteSummary(game)
            if summary~="" then details=details.."\n"..summary end
            resultLabel:SetText(reason == "save_failed" and (details .. "\n" .. T("saveFailed")) or details)
        end
        if nextLevelButton then
            nextLevelButton:SetText(game.level < Game.LEVEL_COUNT and T("nextLevel")
                or game.level == Game.LEVEL_COUNT and T("viewEnding") or T("toSelect"))
        end

        Sound.Home()
        if victory then victory:Show() end
        RefreshCards()
        return
    end

    local stars = game:Stars()
    local remaining = game:YarnAmount()
    local strands = Legacy.SumStrands(game.balls)
    Legacy.Settle(game.level, strands, game.scatterCollected == true, stars, game.pelletReturned or 0)
    game.pelletReturned = 0
    game.scatterCollected = false
    if resultLabel then
        local seconds = math.floor(game.elapsed)
        local line = string.format("%d 星 · 剩余毛线 %d/%d · 用时 %02d:%02d · " .. T("legacy", Legacy.Get()),
            stars, remaining, game.def.yarnTotal or 6, seconds // 60, seconds % 60)
        resultLabel:SetText(line)
    end
    if nextLevelButton then
        if game.level < #Game.LEVELS then nextLevelButton:SetText(T("nextLevel"))
        else nextLevelButton:SetText(T("toSelect")) end
    end
    Sound.Home()
    FX.Shake(2, 0.15, "light")
    if victory then victory:Show() end
end

RefreshEnding = function(key)
    local gallery=CampaignProgress.GetEndingGallery()
    displayedEnding=key or gallery.endingKey
    endingStarted=uiClock
    if endingTitleLabel then endingTitleLabel:SetText(T("endingAlbum")) end
    if endingLabel then endingLabel:SetText(T(displayedEnding)) end
    if endingDescLabel then endingDescLabel:SetText(T(displayedEnding=="endingHidden" and "endingHiddenDesc" or displayedEnding.."Desc")) end
    if endingTotalLabel then endingTotalLabel:SetText(T("endingTotal",CampaignProgress.GetTotalStrands())) end
    for name,button in pairs(endingButtons) do
        button:SetText(T(name))
        button:SetDisabled(name=="endingHidden" and not gallery.hiddenEnding or name~="endingHidden" and not gallery.unlocked[name])
    end
end

ShowEnding = function(key)
    local gallery=CampaignProgress.GetEndingGallery()
    if key=="endingHidden" and not gallery.hiddenEnding or key~="endingHidden" and not gallery.available then return end
    SetMode("select")
    RefreshEnding(key)
    if victory then victory:Hide() end
    if endingPage then endingPage:Show() end
end

local EndingPicture=UI.Widget:Extend("EndingPicture")
function EndingPicture:Render(ctx)
    local l=self:GetAbsoluteLayout()
    local thick=displayedEnding=="endingThick" or displayedEnding=="endingHidden"
    local padHeight=thick and 25 or displayedEnding=="endingMid" and 15 or displayedEnding=="endingThin" and 7 or 2
    local cx,base=l.x+l.w*.5,l.y+l.h-10
    nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgRoundedRect(ctx,cx-115,base-padHeight,230,padHeight+4,math.min(12,padHeight))
    nvgFillColor(ctx,nvgRGBA(thick and 210 or 191,thick and 177 or 146,thick and 134 or 99,255));nvgFill(ctx)
    if padHeight>=7 then
        Craft.Stitches(ctx,cx-115,base-padHeight,230,padHeight+4,{250,229,190,170},9)
        for fringe=1,22 do
            Craft.Line(ctx,cx-111+fringe*10,base+3,cx-111+fringe*10,base+7,{161,121,82,180},1)
        end
    end
    local reduced=Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion")==true
    local palette={{213,134,110,255},{119,166,141,255},{142,159,193,255}}
    local data=CampaignProgress.GetCampaignData()
    for day=1,10 do if (data.levelBestUnits[tostring(day)] or 0)>0 then
        local color=palette[(day-1)%3+1]
        nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgMoveTo(ctx,cx-110+day*20,base-padHeight+2);nvgLineTo(ctx,cx-100+day*20,base)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx,nvgRGBA(table.unpack(color)));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,2);nvgStroke(ctx)
    end end
    for i=1,3 do
        local color=game.sheep[i].color
        local asleep=displayedEnding~="endingBare"
        if displayedEnding=="endingHidden" then asleep=reduced or uiClock-endingStarted>1.5+i*.35 end
        local rolling=not reduced and displayedEnding=="endingThick" and i==1 and math.sin(uiClock*1.4)*.045 or 0
        local hiddenPose=displayedEnding=="endingHidden" and {peek=not asleep,tailTuck=reduced and 1 or math.max(0,math.min(1,(uiClock-endingStarted-2)/1.1))} or nil
        Cats.Draw(ctx,cx-94+(i-1)*65,base-padHeight,62,1,color,0,false,uiClock,rolling,nil,i,asleep or hiddenPose~=nil,hiddenPose)
    end
    if thick and data.totalStrands>=39 then
        for i=1,3 do Craft.Paw(ctx,cx+70+i*10,base-5,7,{120,98,70,190}) end
    end
    if displayedEnding=="endingHidden" then
        local t=reduced and 1 or math.min(1,(uiClock-endingStarted)/3)
        for step=0,3 do
            local px=l.x+24+t*34+step*15
            Craft.Ellipse(ctx,px,l.y+22+(step%2)*6,5,2.5,{125,109,90,70+step*30})
            Craft.Ellipse(ctx,px+4,l.y+20+(step%2)*6,2,2,{125,109,90,70+step*30})
        end
    end
end

local function SetMenuSetting(key, value)
    local ok, reason = Save.SetSetting(key, value)
    if not ok then
        SaveDialog:Show(function()
            local saved = Save.SetSetting(key, value)
            if saved then
                Sound.SetSettings()
                pendingSettingsRefresh = true
                if CampaignArt.InvalidateVisualCache then CampaignArt.InvalidateVisualCache(game) end
            end
            return saved
        end)
        Input.Reset(true)
        print("[设置] 保存失败：" .. tostring(reason))
        return false
    end
    Sound.SetSettings()
    if CampaignArt.InvalidateVisualCache then CampaignArt.InvalidateVisualCache(game) end
    if key == "sfx" and value == true then Sound.Click() end
    if key == "haptic" and value == true then Sound.Vibrate("light") end
    return true
end

local lastLayoutLog=""
---@param eventType string
---@param eventData TouchBeginEventData
function HandleTouchBegin(eventType, eventData)
    touchInput=true
    UpdateContextHud()
end

---@param eventType string
---@param eventData UpdateEventData
function HandleUpdate(eventType, eventData)
    if UI.GetScale then
        local metrics=string.format("%dx%d DPR=%.2f UI=%.3f",graphics:GetWidth(),graphics:GetHeight(),graphics:GetDPR(),UI.GetScale())
        if metrics~=lastLayoutLog then lastLayoutLog=metrics;print("[UI布局] "..metrics) end
    end
    local dt = eventData:GetFloat("TimeStep")
    RefreshAdaptiveLayout()
    uiClock = uiClock + dt
    localization:Apply()
    if pendingSettingsRefresh then
        pendingSettingsRefresh = false
        local visible = settingsPage and settingsPage:IsVisible()
        if settingsPage then BuildSettings(); settingsPage:SetVisible(visible) end
    end
    if Save.Update then Save.Update(dt) end
    switchGrace=math.max(0,switchGrace-dt)
    if pendingTextRefresh then pendingTextRefresh=false;UIF.RefreshTextScale(root) end

    FX.Update(dt)
    if not input.focus then
        Input.Reset(true)
        if mode == "game" and not game.won and not Demo.running then
            paused = true
            if pausePage then pausePage:Show() end
            if pauseButton then pauseButton:SetText(T("resume")) end
        end
        return
    end
    if mode ~= "game" then return end
    QueueGameSaveFailure()
    if SaveDialog:IsBlocking() then return end
    if Demo.running then Demo:Update(dt); return end
    local state = Input.Poll(dt)
    if paused or hintVisible or ExperienceUI.IsOpen() then Input.Reset() end
    if not paused and not hintVisible and not ExperienceUI.IsOpen() then
        if Input.TakePulse("undo") then Undo() end
        if Input.TakePulse("restart") then Restart() end
    end
    if not paused and not hintVisible and not ExperienceUI.IsOpen() and switchGrace<=0 and FX.freeze<=0 then
        Guide.Update(dt)

        game:Update(dt, state.moveX)

    end
    if tutorialBubble and tutorialLabel then
        local text = Guide.BubbleText() or game:TutorialText()
        tutorialBubble:SetVisible(not hintVisible and (text or "") ~= "")
        if text then tutorialLabel:SetText(text) end
    end
    -- 警告气泡倒计时
    if warnTimer > 0 then
        warnTimer = warnTimer - dt
        if warnTimer <= 0 and warningBubble then warningBubble:SetVisible(false) end
    end
    -- HUD 节流
    hudClock = hudClock + dt
    if hudClock < 0.12 then return end
    hudClock = 0
    local seconds = math.floor(game.elapsed)
    if timerLabel then timerLabel:SetText(string.format("%02d:%02d", seconds // 60, seconds % 60)) end
    if countLabel then countLabel:SetText(T("inNest", game:ArrivedCount())) end
    if hintLabel and hintVisible then hintLabel:SetText(game:Hint()) end
    UpdateContextHud()
    local status = table.concat({ game.active,CatDirection(1),CatDirection(2),CatDirection(3),CardDanger(1),CardDanger(2),CardDanger(3), tostring(game.latched), tostring(game.latched2),
        tostring(game.basketSet), tostring(game.oneWayPassed), tostring((game.pinTimer or 0) > 0),
        tostring(game.ramp), tostring(game.towerDone), tostring(game.thief ~= nil),
        game:ArrivedCount(), #game.balls, game:LooseBallCount(),
        game.sheep[1].carry and 1 or 0, game.sheep[2].carry and 1 or 0, game.sheep[3].carry and 1 or 0,
        game.sheep[1].napping and 1 or 0, game.sheep[2].napping and 1 or 0, game.sheep[3].napping and 1 or 0,
        game.autonomy and 1 or 0, game:YarnAmount(),
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.fishInHand) or "",
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.meowCooldown) or "",
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.borrowed) or "",
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.checkpointId) or "",
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.dog and game.campaign.dog.phase) or "",
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.ownerPhase) or "",
        game.campaignV2 and tostring(game.campaign.laserFollowing) or "",
    }, "|")
    if status ~= lastStatus then lastStatus = status; RefreshCards() end
    if game.won and not victoryShown then OnVictory() end
    -- 警告气泡（一次性 + 3秒展示）：逻辑层设置 game.pendingWarning = "felt" 等
    if not hintVisible and warningBubble and warningLabel and game.pendingWarning then
        local id = game.pendingWarning
        game.pendingWarning = nil
        if Guide.WarnOnce(id, "") then
            local text = Guide.WarningText(id)
            if text then
                warningLabel:SetText(text)
                warningBubble:SetVisible(true)
                warnTimer = 3.2
                Sound.Warning()
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param eventType string
---@param eventData KeyDownEventData
function HandleKeyDown(eventType, eventData)
    local key = eventData:GetInt("Key")
    touchInput=false
    if SaveDialog:IsBlocking() then return end
    if Demo.running then
        if key == KEY_ESCAPE and not eventData:GetBool("Repeat") then Demo:Finish() end
        return
    end
    if Input.IsBlocked(key) then return end
    if eventData:GetBool("Repeat") then return end
    if ExperienceUI.IsOpen() then ExperienceUI.Key(key,root);return end
    local scope=settingsPage and settingsPage:IsVisible() and settingsPage
        or endingPage and endingPage:IsVisible() and endingPage
        or mode=="game" and victory and victory:IsVisible() and victory
        or mode=="game" and paused and pausePage or mode=="menu" and menuPage or mode=="select" and selectPage or nil
    if scope and ExperienceUI.Key(key,scope) then return end
    if mode ~= "game" then
        if key == KEY_ESCAPE and settingsPage and settingsPage:IsVisible() then
            Menus.CloseSettings(settingsPage)
        end
        return
    end
    if key == Input.Binding("undo") then
        if not eventData:GetBool("Repeat") then
            Undo()
            Input.BeginUndoRepeat()
        end
        return
    end

    if eventData:GetBool("Repeat") then return end
    if key == Input.Binding("restart") then
        actionNotice,actionNoticeUntil=L("长按0.8秒重开整关", "Hold 0.8s to restart the room"),uiClock+3;return
    end
    if key == KEY_ESCAPE then TogglePause(); return end
    if key == KEY_H then ToggleHint(); return end
    if key == KEY_X then ToggleAI(); return end
    if GameplayBlocked() or paused or hintVisible or game.won then return end

    local token = Input.KeyEdge(key, false)
    if token == 1 then Select(1)
    elseif token == 2 then Select(2)
    elseif token == 3 then Select(3)
    elseif token == "cycle" then NextCat()
    elseif token == "action" then ToggleWool()
    elseif token == "interact" then Interact()
    elseif token == "jump" then DoJump()
    elseif token == "meow" then Meow() end
end

---@param eventType string
---@param eventData KeyUpEventData
function HandleKeyUp(eventType, eventData)
    Input.Release(eventData:GetInt("Key"))
end

function Stop()
    Demo:Finish(true)
    Input.Reset()
    if Save.Flush then Save.Flush() end
    ExperienceUI.Close()

    UI.Shutdown()
    print("[退出] UI 资源已释放")
end
