-- 第4关「一剪两断」：基于WoolRoom房间式脚手架，仅扩展石台与双保持按钮。
local Room = require("WoolRoom")
local Scissors = require("YarnScissors")
local Hold = require("ButtonHold")
local FX = require("FX")
local Four = {}
local GRAVITY, STEP, CAT_W, EPS = 19, 1 / 120, 0.95, 0.0001

Four.DEFINITION = {
    name = "一剪两断", sub = "剪开了，就回不去了。", profile = "scissors-room",
    roomWidth = 30, homeX = 24.375,
    mechanisms = {
        { kind = "scissors", number = 11, id = "cut", x = 5.175, y = 0, w = 1.4, h = 0.45 },
        { kind = "button", id = "A", mode = "hold", x = 8.275, y = 0, w = 1.2, need = 1, releaseDelay = 2 },
        { kind = "button", id = "B", mode = "hold", x = 18.275, y = 0, w = 1.2, need = 1, releaseDelay = 2 },
        { kind = "woodDoor", id = "wood-AB", x = 21.875, y = 0, w = 0.5, h = 4.1,
            buttons = { "A", "B" } },
        { kind = "nest", id = "home", x = 24.375, y = 0, w = 3.5 },
    },
}

-- 碰撞设计（1格=1米；坐标Y向上）：
-- 出生  --4格-- [剪刀石台 h0.45] --3格-- A --10格-- B --3格-- |门h4.1| --2格-- 窝
-- 猫宽0.95，汤圆/煤球/奶盖跳高1/2/1；汤圆背高1；半球直径0.28。
-- 石台：顶整球猫站稳才剪；擦边或从上方跳过不剪。半球落两侧平地。
-- 按钮：落地的猫/自由球中心在区间内才算压住；头顶球不单独计重。
-- 门：A、B同时生效才开；离开2秒关门；关门时把重叠物体夹逼到最近侧。
-- 本关无吞线、水池、深渊或偷球机关；剪线改形态不改amount，总量始终6。

local function Copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local result = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do result[key] = Copy(item) end
    return result
end

function Four.Machine(game, id)
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do if machine.id == id then return machine end end
    error("第4关缺少机关 " .. id)
end

function Four.Init(game)
    game.roomMachines = Room.CreateMachines(game.def.mechanisms)
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        cat.x, cat.y = 1.4 + (i - 1) * 1.25, 0
        cat.w, cat.bodyH, cat.weight = CAT_W, i == 1 and 1 or 0.58, 4 - i
        cat.jumpHeight = i == 2 and 2 or 1
        cat.jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * cat.jumpHeight)
        cat.birthX, cat.birthY = cat.x, cat.y
        cat.grounded, cat.support, cat.carry = true, -6, true
        cat.vx, cat.vy, cat.pullDir, cat.napping, cat.arrived = 0, 0, 0, false, false
        cat.rearmNest, cat.facing, cat.coyote, cat.gait, cat.squash = nil, 1, 0.1, 0, 0
    end
    game.balls = {}
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        game.balls[i] = { id = i, owner = i, kind = "full", felt = false, carriedBy = i,
            weight = 3, amount = 2, w = 0.34, x = cat.x, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0 }
    end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.kind == "button" then machine.pressed, machine.remaining = false, 0 end
        if machine.kind == "scissors" then machine.rearmCats = {} end
    end
    game.nextBallId, game.cutCount = 4, 0
    game.undoStack, game.accumulator, game.undoTimer, game.jumpBuffer = {}, 0, 0, 0
    game.won, game.latched, game.started, game.autonomy = false, false, false, false
    game.elapsed, game.switches, game.gateLift, game.active = 0, 0, 0, 1
    game.effects = {}
    print("[第4关初始化] A/B中心相距10格；整球重3，半球重1；毛线6；三猫跳高1/2/1")
end

function Four.Size(game, index) return Room.Size(game, index) end
function Four.Jump(game) return Room.Jump(game) end
function Four.PressKey(game, key) return Room.PressKey(game, key) end
function Four.CanUndo(game) return #game.undoStack >= 2 end
function Four.GateOpen(game) return Four.Machine(game, "wood-AB").open end

function Four.WorldBoxes(game)
    local boxes = Room.Boxes(game)
    local tableTop = Four.Machine(game, "cut")
    boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = tableTop.x, y = 0, w = tableTop.w, h = tableTop.h, id = "cut" }
    return boxes
end

local function ClampBallX(game, x, ball, direction)
    local result = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - ball.w - 0.3, x))
    for _, box in ipairs(Four.WorldBoxes(game)) do
        if (ball.y or 0) < box.y + box.h - EPS and (ball.y or 0) + ball.w > box.y
            and result < box.x + box.w and result + ball.w > box.x then
            result = direction >= 0 and box.x - ball.w or box.x + box.w
        end
    end
    return result
end

function Four.Select(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won or game.active == index then return end
    game:PushUndo()
    game.active, game.jumpBuffer = index, 0
    game.switches = game.switches + 1
    game:PushUndo()
    print("[第4关选猫] " .. cat.name)
end

function Four.GrabCandidate(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won then return nil end
    local carried = game:CarriedBall(index)
    if carried then return { mode = "drop", ball = game:IndexOfBall(carried) } end
    local nearest, distance = nil, 0.86
    local cx = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
    for i, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        local bx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
            and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.65 then
            local blocked = false
            for _, box in ipairs(Four.WorldBoxes(game)) do
                if math.min(cx, bx) < box.x and math.max(cx, bx) > box.x + box.w
                    and cat.y < box.y + box.h then blocked = true end
            end
            local d = math.abs(bx - cx)
            if not blocked and d < distance then nearest, distance = i, d end
        end
    end
    if not nearest then return nil end
    return { mode = "grab", ball = nearest, blocked = false }
end

function Four.ToggleCarry(game, index)
    local candidate = Four.GrabCandidate(game, index)
    if not candidate then return false end
    game:PushUndo()
    local cat, ball = game.sheep[index], game.balls[candidate.ball]
    if candidate.mode == "drop" then
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy = false, nil
        ball.y = cat.y
        ball.x = ClampBallX(game, cat.facing > 0 and cat.x + CAT_W + 0.02 or cat.x - ball.w - 0.02,
            ball, cat.facing)
        ball.vx, ball.vy = 0, 0
        print(string.format("[第4关放球] %s · %s · 球ID%d", cat.name, ball.kind, ball.id))
    else
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.vx, ball.vy = true, index, 0, 0
        print(string.format("[第4关抱球] %s · %s · 球ID%d", cat.name, ball.kind, ball.id))
    end
    game:PushUndo()
    return true
end

function Four.Cut(game, index, machine)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    local original = game:CarriedBall(index)
    if cat.support ~= "cut" or not Scissors.Contains(machine, cat) or not Scissors.CanSplit(original) then return false end
    local left, right = Scissors.Split(original, machine)
    left.x = math.max(0.3, left.x)
    right.x = math.min(game.def.roomWidth - right.w - 0.3, right.x)
    if left.x + left.w > machine.x or right.x < machine.x + machine.w then return false end
    for _, ball in ipairs({ left, right }) do
        for _, box in ipairs(Four.WorldBoxes(game)) do
            if game:Overlaps(ball.x, ball.y, ball.w, ball.w, box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h) then return false end
        end
    end
    game:PushUndo()
    local before = game:YarnAmount()
    left.id, right.id = original.id, game.nextBallId
    game.nextBallId = game.nextBallId + 1
    local slot = game:IndexOfBall(original)
    game.balls[slot] = left
    game.balls[#game.balls + 1] = right
    cat.carry = false
    game.cutCount = game.cutCount + 1
    game:AddEffect(machine.x + machine.w / 2, machine.h + 0.7, "wool")
    FX.Fire("scissors")
    game.pendingWarning = "cut"
    assert(game:YarnAmount() == before, "剪线事务不得增加或减少毛线量")
    game:PushUndo()
    local full, half, felt = game:YarnStats()
    print(string.format("[剪刀台11] %s：整球→半球×2；线团%d整%d半%d毡；毛线%d；U可反悔",
        cat.name, full, half, felt, before))
    return true
end

function Four.TickCat(game, index, direction, dt)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived then return end
    local oldX, oldY = cat.x, cat.y
    local wasGrounded = cat.grounded
    cat.coyote = wasGrounded and 0.1 or math.max(0, cat.coyote - dt)
    if index == game.active and game.jumpBuffer > 0 and cat.coyote > 0 then
        game:PushUndo()
        cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support, cat.coyote = cat.jump, false, 0, 0
        game.jumpBuffer = 0
        game:PushUndo()
        FX.Fire("jump")
    end
    local x = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - CAT_W - 0.3, cat.x + direction * cat.speed * dt))
    local _, height = Four.Size(game, index)
    local boxes = Four.WorldBoxes(game)
    for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
        if game:Overlaps(x, cat.y, CAT_W, height, box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h)
            and cat.y < box.y + box.h - EPS then
            if direction > 0 then x = box.x - CAT_W elseif direction < 0 then x = box.x + box.w end
        end
    end
    cat.x, cat.vx = x, direction * cat.speed
    if direction ~= 0 then cat.facing, cat.gait = direction, cat.gait + dt * cat.speed * 4 end
    local nextY = cat.y + cat.vy * dt - GRAVITY * dt * dt / 2
    cat.vy = cat.vy - GRAVITY * dt
    cat.y, cat.grounded, cat.support = nextY, false, 0
    local surface, support = 0, -6
    for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
        local top = box.y + box.h
        if cat.x + CAT_W > box.x + EPS and cat.x < box.x + box.w - EPS then
            if cat.vy <= 0 and oldY >= top - EPS and nextY <= top and top > surface then
                surface, support = top, box.id or -7
            elseif cat.vy > 0 and oldY + height <= box.y + EPS and nextY + height >= box.y then
                cat.y, cat.vy = box.y - height, 0
            end
        end
    end
    local orange = game.sheep[1]
    if index ~= 1 and not orange.arrived and cat.vy <= 0 and oldY >= orange.y + 1 - EPS
        and nextY <= orange.y + 1 and cat.x + CAT_W > orange.x + 0.08
        and cat.x < orange.x + CAT_W - 0.08 and orange.y + 1 > surface then
        surface, support = orange.y + 1, 1
    end
    if cat.vy <= 0 and nextY <= surface then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = surface, 0, true, support
    end
    cat.dx, cat.dy = cat.x - oldX, cat.y - oldY
    cat.squash = math.max(0, cat.squash - dt * 3)
    if cat.grounded and not wasGrounded then cat.squash = 0.1; FX.Fire("land") end
    -- 按钮上的球仍可推走；玩家须跳过球，不能靠隐藏锁定球来维持开门。
    if direction ~= 0 and cat.grounded then
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            local delta = ball.x + ball.w / 2 - (cat.x + CAT_W / 2)
            if not ball.carriedBy and direction * delta > 0 and math.abs(delta) < CAT_W / 2 + ball.w / 2
                and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.3 then
                ball.x = ClampBallX(game, direction > 0 and cat.x + CAT_W or cat.x - ball.w, ball, direction)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Four.TickBalls(game, dt)
    local tableTop = Four.Machine(game, "cut")
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy then
            local cat = game.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
            ball.x, ball.y = cat.x + CAT_W / 2 - ball.w / 2, cat.y + cat.bodyH
        else
            local surface = 0
            if ball.x + ball.w > tableTop.x and ball.x < tableTop.x + tableTop.w
                and ball.y >= tableTop.h - EPS then surface = tableTop.h end
            local nextY = ball.y + ball.vy * dt - GRAVITY * dt * dt / 2
            ball.vy = ball.vy - GRAVITY * dt
            ball.y = math.max(surface, nextY)
            if ball.y == surface then ball.vy = 0 end
        end
    end
end

function Four.TickMachines(game, dt)
    local scissors = Four.Machine(game, "cut")
    scissors.rearmCats = scissors.rearmCats or {}
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        local center = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
        if center <= scissors.x or center >= scissors.x + scissors.w then scissors.rearmCats[i] = nil end
        if not scissors.rearmCats[i] then Four.Cut(game, i, scissors) end
    end
    local a, b = Four.Machine(game, "A"), Four.Machine(game, "B")
    local changed = false
    for _, button in ipairs({ a, b }) do
        if Hold.Tick(button, Hold.Weight(game, button), dt) then
            changed = true
            print(string.format("[第4关按钮%s] %s", button.id, button.pressed and "压住" or "松开，2秒宽限"))
        end
    end
    local door = Four.Machine(game, "wood-AB")
    local open = Hold.AllActive({ a, b })
    if door.open ~= open then
        changed = true
        door.open, game.latched = open, open
        print("[第4关木门] A AND B → " .. (open and "打开" or "关闭"))
        if not open then
            for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                local cw, ch = Four.Size(game, i)
                if not cat.arrived and game:Overlaps(cat.x, cat.y, cw, ch, door.x, 0, door.w, door.h) then
                    cat.x = cat.x + cw / 2 < door.x + door.w / 2 and door.x - cw or door.x + door.w
                end
            end
            for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                if not ball.carriedBy and game:Overlaps(ball.x, ball.y, ball.w, ball.w, door.x, 0, door.w, door.h) then
                    local leftX, rightX = door.x - ball.w, door.x + door.w
                    ball.x = math.abs(ball.x - leftX) <= math.abs(rightX - ball.x) and leftX or rightX
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local target = door.open and 1 or 0
    door.lift = door.lift + math.max(-dt * 3, math.min(dt * 3, target - door.lift))
    game.gateLift = door.lift
    if changed then game:PushUndo() end
    local nest = Four.Machine(game, "home")
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        local inNest = cat.x + CAT_W / 2 >= nest.x and cat.x + CAT_W / 2 <= nest.x + nest.w
        if cat.rearmNest and not inNest then cat.rearmNest = nil end
        if not cat.arrived and not cat.rearmNest and cat.grounded and cat.y < 0.08 and inNest then
            game:PushUndo()
            cat.arrived, cat.x, cat.y, cat.vx, cat.vy = true, nest.x + 0.12 + (i - 1), 0, 0, 0
            FX.Fire("home")
            print("[第4关进窝] " .. cat.name)
            if game:ArrivedCount() == 3 then
                game.won = true
                print(string.format("[第4关通关] PASS；进窝3／3；毛线%d／6；%d星", game:YarnAmount(), game:Stars()))
            elseif game.active == i then game:Next() end
            game:PushUndo()
        end
    end
end

function Four.Update(game, dt, direction)
    local capped = math.max(0, math.min(dt, 0.08))
    game.clock = game.clock + capped
    if game.won then return end
    if direction ~= 0 then game.started = true end
    if game.started then game.elapsed = game.elapsed + capped end
    game.accumulator = game.accumulator + capped
    while game.accumulator >= STEP do
        game.accumulator = game.accumulator - STEP
        local active = game.active
        for i = 1, 3 do Four.TickCat(game, i, i == active and direction or 0, STEP) end
        game.jumpBuffer = math.max(0, game.jumpBuffer - STEP)
        Four.TickBalls(game, STEP)
        Four.TickMachines(game, STEP)
        game.undoTimer = game.undoTimer + STEP
        if game.undoTimer >= 1.2 then game.undoTimer = 0; game:PushUndo() end
        if game.won then break end
    end
    FX.StepEffects(game.effects, capped, nil)
end

local function Snapshot(game)
    return { sheep = Copy(game.sheep), balls = Copy(game.balls), machines = Copy(game.roomMachines),
        active = game.active, elapsed = game.elapsed, started = game.started, won = game.won,
        switches = game.switches, nextBallId = game.nextBallId, cutCount = game.cutCount, latched = game.latched }
end

-- 去重只忽略动画/用时及不到一帧的位移；球数量、ID、形态、毛线量和机关状态逐项比较。
local function Same(a, b)
    if a.active ~= b.active or a.won ~= b.won or a.cutCount ~= b.cutCount or a.nextBallId ~= b.nextBallId
        or a.latched ~= b.latched or #a.balls ~= #b.balls then return false end
    for i, cat in ipairs(a.sheep) do
        local other = b.sheep[i]
        if math.abs(cat.x - other.x) > 0.05 or math.abs(cat.y - other.y) > 0.05
            or math.abs(cat.vy - other.vy) > 0.2 or cat.carry ~= other.carry or cat.arrived ~= other.arrived
            or cat.rearmNest ~= other.rearmNest then return false end
    end
    for i, ball in ipairs(a.balls) do
        local other = b.balls[i]
        if ball.id ~= other.id or ball.owner ~= other.owner or ball.kind ~= other.kind or ball.felt ~= other.felt
            or ball.weight ~= other.weight or ball.amount ~= other.amount or ball.carriedBy ~= other.carriedBy
            or math.abs(ball.x - other.x) > 0.05 or math.abs(ball.y - other.y) > 0.05 then return false end
    end
    for i, machine in ipairs(a.machines) do
        local other = b.machines[i]
        if machine.open ~= other.open or machine.pressed ~= other.pressed or machine.activated ~= other.activated
            or math.abs((machine.remaining or 0) - (other.remaining or 0)) > 0.05 then return false end
        for catIndex = 1, 3 do
            if (machine.rearmCats or {})[catIndex] ~= (other.rearmCats or {})[catIndex] then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Four.PushUndo(game)
    local snap = Snapshot(game)
    local last = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    if last and Same(last, snap) then return end
    game.undoStack[#game.undoStack + 1] = snap
    if #game.undoStack > 300 then table.remove(game.undoStack, 1) end
end

function Four.Undo(game)
    if not Four.CanUndo(game) then return false end
    Four.PushUndo(game)
    table.remove(game.undoStack)
    local snap = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    local arrived = {}
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do arrived[i] = cat.arrived end
    game.sheep, game.balls, game.roomMachines = Copy(snap.sheep), Copy(snap.balls), Copy(snap.machines)
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        if arrived[i] and not cat.arrived then cat.rearmNest = true end
    end
    -- 任何回溯恢复到触发台范围内，都要等猫离开再重新进入，避免长按U后落地又自动剪。
    local scissors = Four.Machine(game, "cut")
    scissors.rearmCats = scissors.rearmCats or {}
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        local center = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
        if Scissors.CanSplit(game:CarriedBall(i)) and center > scissors.x and center < scissors.x + scissors.w then
            scissors.rearmCats[i] = true
        end
    end
    game.active, game.elapsed, game.started, game.won = snap.active, snap.elapsed, snap.started, snap.won
    game.switches, game.nextBallId, game.cutCount, game.latched = snap.switches, snap.nextBallId, snap.cutCount, snap.latched
    game.jumpBuffer, game.accumulator, game.undoTimer, game.effects = 0, 0, 0, {}
    game.gateLift = Four.Machine(game, "wood-AB").lift
    -- 重新武装是恢复状态的一部分，不制造额外撤销层；连续U仍沿原时间轴前进。
    game.undoStack[#game.undoStack] = Snapshot(game)
    print("[第4关回溯] 恢复猫、动态球数组、剪线事务、A/B计时和门；毛线" .. game:YarnAmount())
    return true
end

function Four.Hint(game)
    if game.won then return "剩余毛线" .. game:YarnAmount() .. "份，剪开没有损失，三猫回家！" end
    if Four.GateOpen(game) then return "把半球留在A、B上，跳过它们，三只猫依次进窝。" end
    if game.cutCount == 0 then return "汤圆顶整球跳上剪刀台；整球变两个半球，U可回到剪之前。" end
    return "F抱半球：一个放A，一个由煤球放B；A与B必须同时压住。" 
end

return Four
RoomFourArt:
-- 第4关美术：复用WoolArt场景、猫、木地板和线团，只绘制新石台与保持按钮。
local Four = require("RoomFour")
local FourArt = {}
local function Color(c) return nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255) end
local function Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, radius, fill, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, radius)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, Color(fill)); nvgFill(ctx)
    if outline then nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(outline)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.5); nvgStroke(ctx) end
end
local function Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x1, y1); nvgLineTo(ctx, x2, y2)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, width or 1.5); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Ring(ctx, x, y, radius, color, width)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgCircle(ctx, x, y, radius)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, width or 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Text(ctx, x, y, text, size, color)
    nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans"); nvgFontSize(ctx, size or 9)
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER + NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, Color(color or { 113, 102, 80, 255 })); nvgText(ctx, x, y, text)
end

-- 在WoolArt中于地板之后、猫和球之前调用，避免新增渲染管线或HUD层级冲突。
function FourArt.Scene(ctx, game, metrics)
    local unit, left, ground = metrics.unit, metrics.left, metrics.ground
    local function X(x) return left + x * unit end
    local scissors = Four.Machine(game, "cut")
    local sx, sw, sh = X(scissors.x), scissors.w * unit, scissors.h * unit
    Rect(ctx, sx + 4, ground - sh + 4, sw, sh, 5, { 92, 87, 72, 32 })
    Rect(ctx, sx, ground - sh, sw, sh, 5, { 174, 173, 158, 255 }, { 115, 113, 97, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, sx - 3, ground - sh - 4, sw + 6, 8, 4, { 214, 211, 193, 255 }, { 128, 125, 107, 255 })
    Line(ctx, sx + sw * 0.2, ground - sh + 10, sx + sw * 0.34, ground - sh + 14, { 146, 144, 126, 255 })
    local cx, cy = sx + sw / 2, ground - sh - 15
    local blink = game.cutCount > 0 and 1 or (0.85 + math.sin(game.clock * 2) * 0.15)
    -- 剪刀始终固定在台上，铁刃和木色圆柄沿用场景色板。
    Line(ctx, cx - 10, cy - 11, cx + 8, cy + 6, { 116, 127, 128, 255 }, 4)
    Line(ctx, cx + 10, cy - 11, cx - 8, cy + 6, { 179, 183, 174, 255 }, 4)
    Ring(ctx, cx - 12, cy + 9, 6, { 167, 104, 76, 255 }, 3)
    Ring(ctx, cx + 12, cy + 9, 6, { 167, 104, 76, 255 }, 3)
    Ring(ctx, cx, cy, 2.2, { 224, 212, 176, 255 }, 2)
    Text(ctx, cx, ground - sh - 51, "11 剪刀台", 11)
    Text(ctx, cx, ground + 26, "整球 → 半球×2", 9)
    if game.cutCount > 0 then
        Text(ctx, cx, ground - sh - 70, "形态改变 · 毛线未损失", 9, { 96, 126, 80, 255 })
    else
        Ring(ctx, cx, ground - sh - 42, 3 * blink, { 204, 171, 99, 170 }, 1)
    end
    local a, b = Four.Machine(game, "A"), Four.Machine(game, "B")
    local door = Four.Machine(game, "wood-AB")
    for _, button in ipairs({ a, b }) do
        local bx, bw = X(button.x), button.w * unit
        Rect(ctx, bx - 3, ground - 4, bw + 6, 7, 3, { 131, 108, 77, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, bx, ground - (button.pressed and 3 or 9), bw, button.pressed and 4 or 9, 3,
            button.activated and { 128, 156, 97, 255 } or { 218, 163, 105, 255 }, { 139, 105, 74, 255 })
        Text(ctx, bx + bw / 2, ground - 28, "按钮 " .. button.id, 11)
        Text(ctx, bx + bw / 2, ground + 24, button.pressed and "已压住" or button.activated
            and string.format("%.1f秒后失效", button.remaining) or "保持式 · 半球就够", 9)
        Line(ctx, bx + bw / 2, ground + 34, X(door.x), ground + 34,
            button.activated and { 117, 146, 83, 160 } or { 173, 151, 120, 95 }, 1)
    end
    local dx, dw, dh = X(door.x), door.w * unit, door.h * unit
    Rect(ctx, dx - 7, ground - dh - 6, dw + 14, 8, 3, { 138, 103, 70, 255 })
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, dx - 3, ground - dh, dw + 6, dh)
    local top = ground - dh - door.lift * dh
    Rect(ctx, dx, top, dw, dh, 3, { 193, 143, 94, 255 }, { 132, 95, 63, 255 })
    for k = 1, 6 do Line(ctx, dx + 2, top + k * dh / 7, dx + dw - 2, top + k * dh / 7, { 158, 116, 77, 255 }) end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    Text(ctx, dx + dw / 2, ground - dh - 24, door.open and "A + B · 木门打开" or "木门 · A + B", 10)
    local nest = Four.Machine(game, "home")
    Text(ctx, X(nest.x + nest.w / 2), ground - 1.7 * unit, "猫窝 · 三猫全进窝", 10)
    local ax, bx = X(a.x + a.w / 2), X(b.x + b.w / 2)
    Line(ctx, ax, ground + 46, bx, ground + 46, { 169, 140, 105, 150 })
    Line(ctx, ax, ground + 43, ax, ground + 49, { 169, 140, 105, 150 })
    Line(ctx, bx, ground + 43, bx, ground + 49, { 169, 140, 105, 150 })
    Text(ctx, (ax + bx) / 2, ground + 46, string.format("中心相距 %.0f 格", (bx - ax) / unit), 9)
end

return FourArt
RoomThree:
-- 第 3 关独立规则组件，沿用主工程的 Game/UI 接口，不改变旧关卡。
-- 基于 scaffold-2d 的逻辑/显示分离结构；所有碰撞采用同一固定步长。
local Seesaw = require("YarnSeesaw")
local Sofa = require("BounceSofa")
local FX = require("FX")
local Room = {}
local STEP, GRAVITY, EPS = 1 / 120, 19, 0.0001

Room.Def = { name = "跷跷板", sub = "一头沉，一头飞。", profile = "seesaw-room",
    homeX = 15, homeY = 3, roomWidth = 20, platformX = 14, platformHeight = 3 }

local function Clone(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local result = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do result[key] = Clone(item) end
    return result
end

function Room.Load(g)
    g.def = Room.Def
    g.level = 3
    g.active, g.clock, g.elapsed, g.accumulator = 1, 0, 0, 0
    g.started, g.won, g.jumpBuffer, g.switches = false, false, 0, 0
    g.effects, g.undoStack, g.undoTimer = {}, {}, 0
    g.balls, g.sheep = {}, {}
    g.autonomy = false
    g.latched, g.latched2, g.ramp = false, false, false
    g.gateLift, g.gateLift2 = 0, 0
    g.shearedAny, g.thornUsed = false, false
    g.oneWayPassed, g.basketSet, g.towerDone = false, false, false
    g.pinTimer, g.holdGrace, g.thief = 0, 0, nil
    g.roomThree = { seesaw = Seesaw.New(), sofa = Sofa.New(), ticks = 0,
        backLandings = 0, liftedRiders = 0, milestones = {}, movementTicks = 0 }
    local names = { "汤圆", "煤球", "奶盖" }
    local colors = { { 226, 158, 92, 255 }, { 68, 70, 72, 255 }, { 238, 228, 208, 255 } }
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local jumpHeight = i == 2 and 2 or 1
        g.sheep[i] = { x = 1.4 + (i - 1) * 1.8, y = 0, w = 0.82,
            h = i == 1 and 1 or 0.75, weight = 4 - i, jumpHeight = jumpHeight,
            jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * jumpHeight) + GRAVITY * STEP / 2,
            speed = 4.3, vx = 0, vy = 0, grounded = true, support = "floor",
            carry = true, arrived = false, name = names[i], color = colors[i],
            facing = 1, gait = 0, squash = 0, dx = 0, dy = 0, napping = false, pullDir = 0 }
        g.balls[i] = { owner = i, kind = "full", felt = false, w = 0.48,
            weight = 3, amount = 2, carriedBy = i, x = g.sheep[i].x, y = 1,
            vx = 0, vy = 0, support = "carried", lost = false }
    end
    Room.SyncBalls(g)
    print("[第3关] 跷跷板：猫重3/2/1，跳高1/2/1；左重≥4实时倾斜，沙发+2，踩汤圆背+1")
end

function Room.Size(g, index)
    local cat = g.sheep[index]
    return cat.w, cat.h + (cat.carry and 0.48 or 0)
end

function Room.CarriedBall(g, index)
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.lost and ball.carriedBy == index then return ball end
    end
    return nil
end

function Room.SyncBalls(g)
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy and ball.carriedBy > 0 then
            local cat = g.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
            ball.x, ball.y = cat.x + cat.w / 2 - ball.w / 2, cat.y + cat.h
        end
    end
end

local function Snapshot(g)
    return { sheep = Clone(g.sheep), balls = Clone(g.balls),
        active = g.active, elapsed = g.elapsed, clock = g.clock, started = g.started,
        won = g.won, switches = g.switches, jumpBuffer = g.jumpBuffer,
        seesaw = g.roomThree.seesaw:Snapshot(), sofa = g.roomThree.sofa:Snapshot(),
        ticks = g.roomThree.ticks, backLandings = g.roomThree.backLandings,
        liftedRiders = g.roomThree.liftedRiders, milestones = Clone(g.roomThree.milestones) }
end

function Room.PushUndo(g, state)
    g.undoStack[#g.undoStack + 1] = state or Snapshot(g)
    if #g.undoStack > 240 then table.remove(g.undoStack, 1) end
end

function Room.CanUndo(g) return #g.undoStack > 0 end

function Room.Undo(g)
    local state = table.remove(g.undoStack)
    if not state then return end
    local arrivedBefore = {}
    for i, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do arrivedBefore[i] = cat.arrived end
    g.sheep, g.balls = Clone(state.sheep), Clone(state.balls)
    -- 撤销进窝后停在原位置供玩家重新选择，不能下一帧自动吞回窝里。
    -- 离开窝口触发区域才重新武装；标记属于猫状态，也随后续事件快照保存。
    for i, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do
        if arrivedBefore[i] and not cat.arrived then cat.homeArmed = false end
    end
    g.active, g.elapsed, g.clock = state.active, state.elapsed, state.clock
    g.started, g.won, g.switches = state.started, state.won, state.switches
    g.jumpBuffer, g.accumulator, g.undoTimer = 0, 0, 0
    g.effects = {}
    g.roomThree.seesaw:Restore(state.seesaw)
    g.roomThree.sofa:Restore(state.sofa)
    g.roomThree.ticks = state.ticks
    g.roomThree.backLandings, g.roomThree.liftedRiders = state.backLandings, state.liftedRiders
    g.roomThree.milestones = Clone(state.milestones)
    g.roomThree.movementTicks = 0
    Room.SyncBalls(g)
    print("[第3关回溯] 恢复猫/球/板角/弹力/进窝/选中状态")
end

function Room.Select(g, index)
    if g.won or not g.sheep[index] or g.sheep[index].arrived or g.active == index then return end
    Room.PushUndo(g)
    g.active, g.jumpBuffer = index, 0
    g.switches = g.switches + 1
end

function Room.Jump(g)
    if g.won then return end
    Room.PushUndo(g)
    g.jumpBuffer = 0.14
    g.started = true
end

function Room.GrabCandidate(g, index)
    local cat = g.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived or g.won then return nil end
    if cat.carry then
        for i, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do if ball.carriedBy == index then return { mode = "drop", ball = i } end end
    end
    for i, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.lost and not ball.carriedBy
            and math.abs(ball.x + ball.w / 2 - cat.x - cat.w / 2) < 1.05
            and math.abs(ball.y - cat.y) < 0.7 then
            return { mode = "grab", ball = i, blocked = false }
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Room.ToggleCarry(g, index)
    local candidate = Room.GrabCandidate(g, index)
    if not candidate then return end
    Room.PushUndo(g)
    local cat, ball = g.sheep[index], g.balls[candidate.ball]
    if candidate.mode == "drop" then
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy = false, nil
        ball.x = cat.facing > 0 and cat.x + cat.w + 0.06 or cat.x - ball.w - 0.06
        ball.x = math.max(0.1, math.min(19.5, ball.x))
        -- 窝台侧壁是实体，低处不能把球放进墙里；贴墙时改放身后。
        if cat.y < g.def.platformHeight - EPS and ball.x + ball.w > g.def.platformX then
            ball.x = math.max(0.1, math.min(g.def.platformX - ball.w - 0.06, cat.x - ball.w - 0.06))
        end
        ball.y, ball.vx, ball.vy, ball.support = cat.y, 0, 0, "air"
        local y = g.roomThree.seesaw:SurfaceAt(ball.x + ball.w / 2)
        if y and math.abs(y - ball.y) < 0.65 then
            ball.y, ball.support = y, "seesaw"
        end
        print(string.format("[第3关放球] %s → x=%.2f y=%.2f，整球重3", cat.name, ball.x, ball.y))
    else
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.support = true, index, "carried"
        ball.vx, ball.vy = 0, 0
        for _, rider in ipairs(g.sheep) do
            if rider.support == "ball" and rider.supportBall == candidate.ball then
                rider.grounded, rider.support = false, "air"
            end
        end
        if not g.sheep[1].grounded then
            for _, rider in ipairs(g.sheep) do
                if rider.support == "back" then rider.grounded, rider.support = false, "air" end
            end
        end
        print("[第3关抱球] " .. cat.name .. " 顶起线团")
    end
    Room.SyncBalls(g)
end

-- 碰撞设计：猫 x 是左边、y 是脚底；球 x 是左边、y 是底边。
--                   煤球跳 2 + 汤圆背 1 → 台顶 3
--              [煤球]   . . . . . . . . ┌──────────┐
--              [汤圆] y=1                │  猫窝    │
-- 地板 y=0 ───────────── [沙发 y=.25] ───│ y=3      │
-- 侧壁仅高度不足时拦横移；落脚使用下降穿越顶面，不能穿墙/蹭墙增高。
-- 仅汤圆背可提供 1 格实体；踩上后需要新的空格，空中不允许任意二段跳。
local function Surface(g, x)
    if x >= g.def.platformX then return g.def.platformHeight, "platform" end
    local board = g.roomThree.seesaw
    local y = board:SurfaceAt(x)
    if y then return y, "seesaw" end
    y = board:RampAt(x)
    if y then return y, "ramp" end
    if g.roomThree.sofa:Contains(x) then return g.roomThree.sofa.y, "sofa" end
    return 0, "floor"
end

local function BallGroup(g, first, direction)
    local group, seen = {}, {}
    local function Visit(index)
        if seen[index] then return end
        seen[index] = true
        local ball = g.balls[index]
        group[#group + 1] = index
        for j, other in ipairs(g.balls) do
            if j ~= index and not other.carriedBy and not other.lost
                and math.abs(other.y - ball.y) < 0.55 then
                local separation = direction > 0 and other.x - ball.x - ball.w or ball.x - other.x - other.w
                local ahead = direction > 0 and other.x > ball.x + EPS or direction < 0 and other.x < ball.x - EPS
                if ahead and separation >= -0.22 and separation < 0.12 then Visit(j) end
            end
        end
    end
    Visit(first)
    return group
end

local function PushGroup(g, first, movement, cat)
    local direction = movement > 0 and 1 or -1
    local group = BallGroup(g, first, direction)
    local weight = 0
    for _, index in ipairs(group) do weight = weight + g.balls[index].weight end
    if cat.weight < 3 and weight > cat.weight then return 0 end
    local allowed = movement
    for _, index in ipairs(group) do
        local ball = g.balls[index]
        if direction > 0 and ball.y < 3 - EPS and ball.x + ball.w <= 14 + EPS then
            allowed = math.min(allowed, 14 - ball.w - ball.x)
        end
        if direction < 0 then allowed = math.max(allowed, 0.1 - ball.x) end
    end
    for _, index in ipairs(group) do
        local ball = g.balls[index]
        ball.x = ball.x + allowed
        local y, support = Surface(g, ball.x + ball.w / 2)
        if support == "seesaw" or support == "ramp" or math.abs(y - ball.y) < 0.35 then
            ball.y, ball.support, ball.vy = y, support, 0
        end
        ball.vx = 0
    end
    return allowed
end

local function MoveCat(g, index, direction, dt, stepState)
    local cat = g.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived then return end
    local oldX, oldY = cat.x, cat.y
    local wasGrounded, oldSupport = cat.grounded, cat.support
    -- 起跳前先验证实际支撑：抱走脚下球、汤圆起跳都不能留下幽灵落脚点。
    if oldSupport == "ball" then
        local ball = g.balls[cat.supportBall]
        if not ball or ball.carriedBy or ball.lost
            or cat.x + cat.w <= ball.x + 0.1 or cat.x >= ball.x + ball.w - 0.1 then
            cat.grounded, cat.support = false, "air"
        else
            cat.y = ball.y + ball.w
            oldY = cat.y
        end
    elseif oldSupport == "back" then
        local orange = g.sheep[1]
        cat.x = cat.x + orange.dx
        if orange.arrived or not orange.grounded
            or math.abs(cat.x + cat.w / 2 - orange.x - orange.w / 2) > 0.65 then
            cat.grounded, cat.support = false, "air"
        else
            cat.y = orange.y + 1
            oldY = cat.y
        end
    end
    if index == g.active and g.jumpBuffer > 0 and cat.grounded then
        -- 空格命令已保存弹前快照；不能再压入带弹射速度的弹后快照。
        cat.vy = cat.jump
        if cat.support == "sofa" then
            cat.vy = g.roomThree.sofa:LaunchSpeed(cat.jumpHeight, GRAVITY, STEP)
            print("[第3关沙发] " .. cat.name .. " 跳高" .. cat.jumpHeight .. "+弹力2格")
        end
        cat.grounded, cat.support, g.jumpBuffer = false, "air", 0
    end
    local movement = direction * cat.speed * dt
    if direction ~= 0 then cat.facing = direction; cat.gait = cat.gait + dt * 12 end
    cat.x = math.max(0.1, math.min(19.0, cat.x + movement))
    if cat.y < 3 - EPS and cat.x + cat.w > 14 and oldX + cat.w <= 14 + EPS then
        cat.x = 14 - cat.w
    elseif cat.y < 3 - EPS and cat.x < 20 and cat.x + cat.w > 14 and oldX >= 20 then
        cat.x = 20
    end
    for j, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost and cat.y < ball.y + ball.w - EPS
            and cat.y + cat.h > ball.y + EPS and cat.x + cat.w > ball.x + EPS
            and cat.x < ball.x + ball.w - EPS then
            if movement > 0 and oldX + cat.w <= ball.x + 0.06 then
                local displacement = cat.x + cat.w - ball.x
                local pushed = PushGroup(g, j, displacement, cat)
                cat.x = cat.x - (displacement - pushed)
            elseif movement < 0 and oldX >= ball.x + ball.w - 0.06 then
                local displacement = cat.x - ball.x - ball.w
                local pushed = PushGroup(g, j, displacement, cat)
                cat.x = cat.x - (displacement - pushed)
            end
        end
    end
    local cx = cat.x + cat.w / 2
    local surface, support = Surface(g, cx)
    -- 圆球也有上表面：猫可以正常落脚后再次跳，不会落进配重球再把它推走。
    for ballIndex, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        local top = ball.y + ball.w
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost and cat.x + cat.w > ball.x + 0.1
            and cat.x < ball.x + ball.w - 0.1 and oldY >= top - 0.035
            and top > surface then
            surface, support = top, "ball"
            cat.supportBall = ballIndex
        end
    end
    if wasGrounded and oldSupport == "ball" and cat.support ~= "air" and support == "ball" then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = surface, 0, true, support
    elseif wasGrounded and (oldSupport == "seesaw" or oldSupport == "ramp") and cat.support ~= "air"
        and (support == "seesaw" or support == "ramp") then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = surface, 0, true, support
    else
        cat.vy = math.max(-18, cat.vy - GRAVITY * dt)
        cat.y = cat.y + cat.vy * dt
        cat.grounded, cat.support = false, "air"
        -- 台阶落脚按身体与平台水平重叠判定，保证峰值处可越过平台边。
        if cat.x + cat.w > 14 + EPS and cat.x < 20 and oldY >= 3 - EPS and cat.y <= 3 then
            surface, support = 3, "platform"
        end
        if cat.vy <= 0 and oldY >= surface - 0.055 and cat.y <= surface + EPS then
            cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = surface, 0, true, support
            if not wasGrounded then FX.Fire("land") end
            if support == "sofa" and (not wasGrounded or oldY > g.roomThree.sofa.y + 0.04) then
                Room.PushUndo(g, stepState)
                cat.vy = g.roomThree.sofa:LaunchSpeed(cat.jumpHeight, GRAVITY, STEP)
                cat.grounded, cat.support = false, "air"
                print("[第3关沙发] " .. cat.name .. " 落到坐垫，弹起+2格")
            end
        end
        -- 坐垫作为 0.25 格矮台可直接走上，只有跳跃才加弹力。
        if wasGrounded and support == "sofa" and oldY <= 0.25 and cat.y < surface then
            cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = surface, 0, true, support
        end
    end
    if index ~= 1 then
        local orange = g.sheep[1]
        local overlap = cat.x + cat.w > orange.x + 0.12 and cat.x < orange.x + orange.w - 0.12
        local backY = orange.y + 1
        if not orange.arrived and orange.grounded and overlap and cat.vy <= 0
            and oldY >= backY - 0.02 and cat.y <= backY then
            if oldSupport ~= "back" then Room.PushUndo(g, stepState) end
            cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = backY, 0, true, "back"
            if oldSupport ~= "back" then
                g.roomThree.backLandings = g.roomThree.backLandings + 1
                print("[第3关踩背] " .. cat.name .. " 站上汤圆背，高度+1格；再按空格起跳")
            end
        end
    end
    if cat.y < 0 then cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = 0, 0, true, "floor" end
    cat.vx, cat.dx, cat.dy = direction * cat.speed, cat.x - oldX, cat.y - oldY
end

local function MoveBalls(g, dt)
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost then
            local y, support = Surface(g, ball.x + ball.w / 2)
            if ball.support == "seesaw" or ball.support == "ramp" then
                if support == "seesaw" or support == "ramp" then ball.y, ball.vy = y, 0
                else ball.support = "air" end
            end
            if ball.support == "air" or ball.y > y + EPS then
                local oldY = ball.y
                ball.vy = ball.vy - GRAVITY * dt
                ball.y = ball.y + ball.vy * dt
                if ball.y <= y and oldY >= y - 0.6 then
                    ball.y, ball.vy, ball.support = y, 0, support
                end
            elseif ball.y <= y + EPS then ball.y, ball.support = y, support end
            -- 本关没有深渊；任何下降球都应落地，不能穿地后仍在毛线账本里。
            if ball.y < 0 then ball.y, ball.vy, ball.support = 0, 0, "floor" end
        end
    end
    Room.SyncBalls(g)
end

local function TiltBoard(g, dt)
    local board = g.roomThree.seesaw
    -- 支撑链：上层猫(含顶球) → 汤圆背/自由球 → 板面。
    -- 所有重量落在根接触点上；转动时按同一根位移携带，不能只搬最下层。
    local function Anchor(cat, visited)
        if cat.arrived or not cat.grounded then return nil end
        visited = visited or {}
        if visited[cat] then return nil end
        visited[cat] = true
        if cat.support == "seesaw" or cat.support == "ramp" then return cat end
        if cat.support == "ball" then
            local ball = g.balls[cat.supportBall]
            if ball and not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost
                and (ball.support == "seesaw" or ball.support == "ramp") then return ball end
        elseif cat.support == "back" then
            return Anchor(g.sheep[1], visited)
        end
        return nil
    end
    local entries, roots, positions = {}, {}, {}
    for i, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do
        local root = Anchor(cat)
        roots[i] = root
        if root then
            positions[root] = { x = root.x, y = root.y }
            local weight = cat.weight
            local ball = Room.CarriedBall(g, i)
            if ball then weight = weight + ball.weight end
            entries[#entries + 1] = { x = root.x + root.w / 2, support = root.support, weight = weight }
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.lost then
            positions[ball] = { x = ball.x, y = ball.y }
            entries[#entries + 1] = { x = ball.x + ball.w / 2, support = ball.support, weight = ball.weight }
        end
    end
    if board:Weigh(entries) then
        -- 倾斜是放球/移动/起跳的持续结果，归入引发它的操作快照。
        -- 不压入仍满足新承重的自动事件，否则 U 下一帧会不断重建同一倾斜事件。
        print(string.format("[第3关跷跷板] 左重%g / 右重%g → %s", board.leftWeight, board.rightWeight,
            board.target > 0 and "左沉右翘" or board.target < 0 and "右沉左翘" or "回到平衡"))
    end
    local oldAngle = board:Update(dt)
    if oldAngle == board.angle then return end
    for _, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do
        if cat.support == "seesaw" and not cat.arrived then
            local distance = (cat.x + cat.w / 2 - board.pivotX) / math.cos(oldAngle)
            local x, y = board:Point(distance)
            if distance > 0 and y > cat.y + EPS then
                g.roomThree.liftedRiders = g.roomThree.liftedRiders + 1
            end
            cat.x, cat.y = x - cat.w / 2, y
        elseif cat.support == "ramp" then
            local y = board:RampAt(cat.x + cat.w / 2)
            if y then cat.y = y end
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy and ball.support == "seesaw" then
            local distance = (ball.x + ball.w / 2 - board.pivotX) / math.cos(oldAngle)
            local x, y = board:Point(distance)
            ball.x, ball.y = x - ball.w / 2, y
        elseif not ball.carriedBy and ball.support == "ramp" then
            local y = board:RampAt(ball.x + ball.w / 2)
            if y then ball.y = y end
        end
    end
    for i, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do
        local root = roots[i]
        if root and root ~= cat then
            local previous = positions[root]
            cat.x, cat.y = cat.x + root.x - previous.x, cat.y + root.y - previous.y
        end
    end
    Room.SyncBalls(g)
end

local function CheckHome(g)
    for i, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do
        local inside = cat.x >= g.def.homeX and math.abs(cat.y - 3) < 0.08 and cat.grounded
        if not inside then cat.homeArmed = true end
        if not cat.arrived and inside and cat.homeArmed ~= false then
            Room.PushUndo(g)
            cat.arrived, cat.vx, cat.vy = true, 0, 0
            cat.support, cat.y = "home", 3
            cat.x = 15.3 + (i - 1) * 1.2
            print("[第3关进窝] " .. cat.name)
            if g.active == i then
                for j = 1, 3 do if not g.sheep[j].arrived then g.active = j; break end end
            end
        end
    end
    Room.SyncBalls(g)
    if Room.ArrivedCount(g) == 3 then
        g.won = true
        print(string.format("[第3关通关] 进窝3/3 · 毛线量%d · %d星 · %.2f秒", Room.YarnAmount(g), Room.Stars(g), g.elapsed))
    end
end

function Room.Update(g, dt, direction)
    dt, direction = math.min(math.max(dt, 0), 0.08), direction or 0
    g.clock = g.clock + dt
    if direction ~= 0 then g.started = true end
    if g.won then return end
    if g.started then g.elapsed = g.elapsed + dt end
    if direction ~= 0 and g.roomThree.movementTicks == 0 then Room.PushUndo(g) end
    g.accumulator = g.accumulator + dt
    while g.accumulator + EPS * 0.001 >= STEP do
        g.accumulator = math.max(0, g.accumulator - STEP)
        local stepState = Snapshot(g)
        g.roomThree.ticks = g.roomThree.ticks + 1
        g.roomThree.sofa:Update(STEP)
        local order = { 1, 2, 3 }
        table.sort(order, function(a, b) return g.sheep[a].y < g.sheep[b].y end)
        for _, i in ipairs(order) do MoveCat(g, i, i == g.active and direction or 0, STEP, stepState) end
        MoveBalls(g, STEP)
        TiltBoard(g, STEP)
        g.jumpBuffer = math.max(0, g.jumpBuffer - STEP)
        CheckHome(g)
        if direction ~= 0 then
            g.roomThree.movementTicks = g.roomThree.movementTicks + 1
            if g.roomThree.movementTicks >= 144 then
                Room.PushUndo(g)
                g.roomThree.movementTicks = 0
            end
        else g.roomThree.movementTicks = 0 end
        if g.won then break end
    end
end

function Room.ArrivedCount(g)
    local count = 0
    for _, cat in ipairs(g.sheep) do if cat.arrived then count = count + 1 end end
    return count
end

function Room.LooseBallCount(g)
    local count = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do if not ball.lost and not ball.carriedBy then count = count + 1 end end
    return count
end

function Room.YarnStats(g)
    local full, half, felt = 0, 0, 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do
        if not ball.lost then
            if ball.felt then felt = felt + 1
            elseif ball.kind == "half" then half = half + 1
            else full = full + 1 end
        end
    end
    return full, half, felt
end

function Room.YarnAmount(g)
    local amount = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(g.balls) do if not ball.lost then amount = amount + ball.amount end end
    return amount
end

function Room.Stars(g)
    local amount = Room.YarnAmount(g)
    return amount == 6 and 3 or amount >= 4 and 2 or amount >= 2 and 1 or 0
end

function Room.Hint(g)
    if g.won then return "三猫进窝，三个整球留下；毛线量6，三星无损！" end
    if not g.sheep[3].arrived then return "汤圆把两个整球推上左盘；奶盖沿板到右端，起跳越过空隙进窝。" end
    if not g.sheep[2].arrived then return "汤圆站到高台边；煤球落到汤圆背上，再按空格：背1格＋跳2格＝3格。" end
    return "汤圆只能跳1格。跳落弹跳沙发，再向右：跳1格＋弹力2格＝3格。" 
end

function Room.PressKey(g, key)
    local keyMap = { [KEY_1] = "1", [KEY_2] = "2", [KEY_3] = "3", [KEY_F] = "F",
        [KEY_SPACE] = "SPACE", [KEY_U] = "U", [KEY_R] = "R" }
    local code = type(key) == "string" and string.upper(key) or keyMap[key]
    if code == "1" then Room.Select(g, 1)
    elseif code == "2" then Room.Select(g, 2)
    elseif code == "3" then Room.Select(g, 3)
    elseif code == "F" then Room.ToggleCarry(g, g.active)
    elseif code == "SPACE" or code == " " then Room.Jump(g)
    elseif code == "U" then Room.Undo(g)
    elseif code == "R" then Room.Load(g) end
end

return Room

-- 第三关「毛线守恒」：跷跷板 / 一头沉，一头飞。
-- 沿用 2D 脚手架的 UI.Widget 绘制入口；上下文、字体、分辨率均由共享 UI 管理。
local RoomThreeArt = {}
local WOOD = { 200, 168, 120, 255 }
local EDGE = { 140, 110, 74, 255 }
local CREAM = { 250, 246, 228, 255 }
local SAGE = { 170, 191, 143, 255 }
---@type integer[][]
local YARNS = { { 214, 96, 76, 255 }, { 88, 150, 110, 255 }, { 94, 124, 190, 255 } }

---@class R3ArtBall
---@field x number
---@field y number
---@field w number
---@field owner integer
---@field kind string
---@field felt boolean?
---@field carriedBy number?
---@class R3ArtCat
---@field x number
---@field y number
---@field w number?
---@field h number?
---@field color integer[]
---@field facing number
---@field gait number
---@field squash number?
---@field carry boolean?
---@field arrived boolean?
---@class R3ArtSeesaw
---@field pivotX number?
---@field pivotY number?
---@field halfLength number?
---@field angle number?
---@field leftWeight number?
---@field rightWeight number?
---@class R3ArtEffect
---@field x number
---@field y number
---@field kind string
---@field life number
---@field maxLife number
---@class R3ArtGame
---@field def {profile:string, platformX:number?, platformHeight:number?, homeX:number?, homeY:number?}
---@field sheep R3ArtCat[]
---@field balls R3ArtBall[]
---@field roomThree {seesaw:R3ArtSeesaw}?
---@field effects R3ArtEffect[]
---@field clock number
---@field active number

local function Color(c) return nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255) end
local function Fill(ctx, color, outline)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgFill(ctx)
    if outline then nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(outline)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.7); nvgStroke(ctx) end
end
local function Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Ellipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x1, y1); nvgLineTo(ctx, x2, y2)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, width or 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Poly(ctx, points, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, points[1], points[2])
    for i = 3, #points, 2 do nvgLineTo(ctx, points[i], points[i + 1]) end
    nvgClosePath(ctx); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Tag(ctx, cx, cy, text, size, color)
    nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans"); nvgFontSize(ctx, size)
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER | NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, Color(color or EDGE)); nvgText(ctx, cx, cy, text, nil)
end

---@param ctx NVGContextWrapper
---@param game R3ArtGame
---@param l {x:number, y:number, w:number, h:number}
---@param metrics {unit:number, left:number, ground:number}
function RoomThreeArt.Scene(ctx, game, l, metrics)
    -- 延迟引用，避免 WoolArt 分发到此模块时产生顶层循环依赖。
    local Art = require("WoolArt")
    local unit, left, ground = metrics.unit, metrics.left, metrics.ground
    if unit <= 0 then return end
    local function wx(m) return left + m * unit end
    local function gy(m) return ground - m * unit end
    local font = math.max(8, math.min(13, unit * 0.27))
    local clock = game.clock or 0
    local def = game.def
    local platformX, platformY = def.platformX or 14, def.platformHeight or 3
    local homeX, homeY = def.homeX or 15, def.homeY or 3
    local seesaw = (game.roomThree and game.roomThree.seesaw) or {}
    local px, py = seesaw.pivotX or 10, seesaw.pivotY or 1.5
    local half, angle = seesaw.halfLength or 2, seesaw.angle or 0
    local c, s = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    -- 世界 y 向上：正角左沉右翘。板面直接使用逻辑几何，不做独立动画。
    local lx, ly = px - c * half, py - s * half
    local rx, ry = px + c * half, py + s * half
    local lw, rw = seesaw.leftWeight or 0, seesaw.rightWeight or 0
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h)

    -- 米色墙纸、木地板：仅场景插画，不绘制 HUD 或按钮。
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRect(ctx, l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h)
    nvgFillPaint(ctx, nvgLinearGradient(ctx, l.x, l.y, l.x, ground,
        nvgRGBA(241, 229, 203, 255), nvgRGBA(235, 220, 190, 255))); nvgFill(ctx)
    for i = 0, 20, 2 do Line(ctx, wx(i), l.y, wx(i), ground, { 226, 210, 178, 70 }, 1) end
    Rect(ctx, l.x, ground, l.w, math.max(0, l.y + l.h - ground), 0, { 203, 158, 106, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, l.x, ground, l.w, 5, 0, { 216, 175, 122, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, l.x, ground - 5, l.w, 5, 0, { 166, 128, 84, 255 })
    for i = 1, 20 do
        Line(ctx, wx(i), ground + 5, wx(i), l.y + l.h, { 172, 128, 80, 180 }, 1)
    end

    -- 低饱和窗景与小盆栽，保留原房间的家具插画语言。
    Rect(ctx, wx(1.15), gy(3.55), 2.2 * unit, 1.75 * unit, 5, WOOD, EDGE)
    Rect(ctx, wx(1.27), gy(3.43), 1.96 * unit, 1.51 * unit, 3, { 190, 219, 228, 255 })
    Ellipse(ctx, wx(2.75), gy(3.12), 0.17 * unit, 0.17 * unit, { 252, 229, 158, 255 })
    Line(ctx, wx(2.25), gy(3.43), wx(2.25), gy(1.92), WOOD, 4)
    Line(ctx, wx(1.27), gy(2.66), wx(3.23), gy(2.66), WOOD, 4)
    Rect(ctx, wx(0.98), gy(1.83), 2.55 * unit, 0.12 * unit, 3, WOOD, EDGE)
    Rect(ctx, wx(0.25), gy(0.35), 0.43 * unit, 0.35 * unit, 3, { 176, 98, 62, 255 }, EDGE)
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local tip = wx(0.46 + (i - 2) * 0.23)
        Line(ctx, wx(0.46), gy(0.3), tip, gy(0.9 + (i % 2) * 0.14), { 104, 142, 92, 255 }, 3)
        Ellipse(ctx, tip, gy(0.88 + (i % 2) * 0.14), 0.13 * unit, 0.23 * unit, SAGE)
    end

    -- 三格高墙，台面从 x14 连续延伸到 x20；刻度刻在墙侧面。
    Rect(ctx, wx(platformX), gy(platformY), (20 - platformX) * unit, platformY * unit,
        3, { 221, 198, 161, 255 }, EDGE)
    Rect(ctx, wx(platformX + 0.12), gy(platformY - 0.2), (20 - platformX - 0.22) * unit,
        (platformY - 0.3) * unit, 3, { 238, 223, 193, 255 })
    for i = 1, 3 do
        Line(ctx, wx(platformX + 1), gy(i - 0.4), wx(19.8), gy(i - 0.4), { 210, 187, 149, 150 }, 1)
    end
    Rect(ctx, wx(platformX), gy(platformY), (20 - platformX) * unit, 0.13 * unit, 3, WOOD, EDGE)
    Line(ctx, wx(platformX), gy(platformY), wx(20), gy(platformY), EDGE, 2)
    Line(ctx, wx(platformX + 0.26), ground, wx(platformX + 0.26), gy(3), EDGE, 1.3)
    for i = 1, 3 do
        Line(ctx, wx(platformX + 0.12), gy(i), wx(platformX + 0.43), gy(i), EDGE, 2)
        Tag(ctx, wx(platformX + 0.76), gy(i - 0.13), i .. "格", font)
    end

    -- 窝门常开：洞口、软垫和向旁边收起的门叶，不画任何拦路门板。
    local nestCX = homeX + 1.45
    Rect(ctx, wx(homeX - 0.1), gy(homeY + 1.5), 3.3 * unit, 1.5 * unit,
        0.58 * unit, { 216, 186, 148, 255 }, { 158, 130, 100, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, wx(homeX + 0.1), gy(homeY + 1.27), 2.9 * unit, 1.27 * unit,
        0.5 * unit, { 187, 160, 126, 255 })
    Ellipse(ctx, wx(nestCX), gy(homeY + 0.08), 1.48 * unit, 0.18 * unit, { 236, 212, 176, 255 })
    Ellipse(ctx, wx(nestCX), gy(homeY + 0.12), 1.24 * unit, 0.12 * unit, CREAM)
    Rect(ctx, wx(homeX + 3.25), gy(homeY + 1.08), 0.16 * unit, 1.05 * unit, 3, WOOD, EDGE)
    Tag(ctx, wx(nestCX), gy(homeY + 1.7), "猫窝 · 门常开", font)

    -- 固定支点：顶端始终是 (pivotX, pivotY)，倾斜时不随木板移动。
    Ellipse(ctx, wx(px), ground + 3, 0.7 * unit, 0.1 * unit, { 100, 78, 50, 28 })
    Poly(ctx, { wx(px - 0.58), ground, wx(px + 0.58), ground, wx(px), gy(py) }, WOOD, EDGE)
    Poly(ctx, { wx(px - 0.32), ground - 2, wx(px + 0.32), ground - 2, wx(px), gy(py - 0.27) },
        { 176, 141, 104, 255 })

    -- 附属装载踏板的上边严格连接 (6,0) → 当前左端点，不伪造水平入口。
    local rampDX, rampDY = wx(lx) - wx(6), gy(ly) - ground
    local rampLength = math.sqrt(rampDX * rampDX + rampDY * rampDY)
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(6), ground); nvgRotate(ctx, math.atan(rampDY, rampDX))
    Rect(ctx, 0, 0, rampLength, 0.12 * unit, 0.035 * unit, { 214, 184, 140, 255 }, EDGE)
    Line(ctx, 0, 0, rampLength, 0, EDGE, 2)
    for i = 1, 4 do
        Line(ctx, rampLength * i / 5 - 3, 0.025 * unit, rampLength * i / 5 + 3, 0.07 * unit, WOOD, 1)
    end
    Poly(ctx, { rampLength * 0.45, -0.12 * unit, rampLength * 0.62, -0.12 * unit,
        rampLength * 0.55, -0.18 * unit }, EDGE)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    Tag(ctx, wx((6 + lx) / 2), gy(ly / 2 + 0.42), "装载坡面", font)

    -- 板面 = 左端—支点—右端；木板厚度只向板面下方延伸。
    -- 两个盘沿板各宽 2 格，圆角低挡边仅作木色装饰，不改变载物高度。
    nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(px), gy(py)); nvgRotate(ctx, -angle)
    Rect(ctx, -half * unit, 0, half * 2 * unit, 0.16 * unit, 0.045 * unit, WOOD, EDGE)
    Rect(ctx, -half * unit + 2, 0.03 * unit, half * unit - 4, 0.07 * unit, 2, { 222, 187, 142, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, 2, 0.03 * unit, half * unit - 4, 0.07 * unit, 2, { 207, 187, 142, 255 })
    Line(ctx, -half * unit, 0, half * unit, 0, EDGE, 2)
    Line(ctx, 0, 0, 0, 0.16 * unit, EDGE, 2)
    for _, endX in ipairs({ -half * unit, half * unit }) do
        Rect(ctx, endX - 0.045 * unit, -0.12 * unit, 0.09 * unit, 0.19 * unit, 0.04 * unit, WOOD, EDGE)
    end
    Ellipse(ctx, 0, 0.12 * unit, 0.07 * unit, 0.07 * unit, { 158, 130, 100, 255 }, EDGE)
    nvgRestore(ctx)

    -- 标牌固定在机关基座附近，用引线标明各自的载物盘，文字不会随角度歪斜。
    for _, side in ipairs({ { -1, lw, "左盘 · 2格" }, { 1, rw, "右盘 · 2格" } }) do
        local signX, signY = px + side[1] * 1.45, 0.45
        Line(ctx, wx(px + side[1] * c * half * 0.55), gy(py + side[1] * s * half * 0.55) + 6,
            wx(signX), gy(signY + 0.25), { 156, 135, 102, 170 }, 1)
        Rect(ctx, wx(signX - 0.7), gy(signY + 0.2), 1.4 * unit, 0.45 * unit, 4, CREAM, EDGE)
        Tag(ctx, wx(signX), gy(signY + 0.06), side[3], font * 0.88)
        Tag(ctx, wx(signX), gy(signY - 0.12), string.format("承重 %g", side[2]), font * 0.88)
    end
    Tag(ctx, wx(px), gy(3.9), "左≥4，右端抬高", font)
    -- 右端升高的提示线随真实端点起落；仅为场景标记，不暗示额外踏板。
    Line(ctx, wx(rx + 0.25), gy(ry - 0.3), wx(rx + 0.25), gy(ry + 0.35), EDGE, 1.5)
    Poly(ctx, { wx(rx + 0.17), gy(ry + 0.22), wx(rx + 0.33), gy(ry + 0.22), wx(rx + 0.25), gy(ry + 0.37) }, EDGE)

    -- 淡绿弹簧沙发：范围 x12.8..14，座面严格位于 y0.25。
    Rect(ctx, wx(12.87), gy(0.17), 1.06 * unit, 0.13 * unit, 3, WOOD, EDGE)
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local springX = wx(12.92 + i * 0.19)
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, springX, gy(0.19))
        for k = 1, 8 do nvgLineTo(ctx, springX + (k % 2 == 0 and -2 or 2), gy(0.19 - k * 0.018)) end
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(EDGE)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.1); nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
    Rect(ctx, wx(12.8), gy(0.7), 1.2 * unit, 0.43 * unit, 0.15 * unit, { 153, 177, 128, 255 }, { 114, 139, 96, 255 })
    Line(ctx, wx(13.4), gy(0.61), wx(13.4), gy(0.32), { 126, 154, 109, 255 }, 1.5)
    Rect(ctx, wx(12.8), gy(0.25), 1.2 * unit, 0.12 * unit, 0.06 * unit, SAGE, { 114, 139, 96, 255 })
    Line(ctx, wx(12.9), gy(0.25), wx(13.9), gy(0.25), { 215, 225, 196, 255 }, 2)
    Tag(ctx, wx(13.35), gy(1.02), "跳1+弹2", font)

    -- 球的 y 是脚底真实高度；不吸附到地面或再次按跷跷板角度变换。
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil then
            Art.YarnBall(ctx, wx(ball.x + ball.w / 2), gy(ball.y + ball.w / 2), ball.w * unit / 2,
                YARNS[ball.owner] or YARNS[1], 0.94, ball.felt and "felt" or ball.kind)
        end
    end

    ---@type R3ArtCat[]
    local cats = game.sheep
    ---@type integer[]
    local order = { 1, 2, 3 }
    ---@param a integer
    ---@param b integer
    local function HigherFirst(a, b) return cats[a].y > cats[b].y end
    table.sort(order, HigherFirst)
    for _, index in ipairs(order) do
        local cat = cats[index]
        local width = (cat.w or 0.82) * unit
        local height = (cat.h or (index == 1 and 1 or 0.75)) * unit
        -- 保留旧猫的轮廓和毛纹，按本关宽高适配；脚底变换原点固定在 cat.y。
        local stretch = height / (width * 0.61 * 1.2)
        nvgSave(ctx); nvgTranslate(ctx, wx(cat.x), gy(cat.y)); nvgScale(ctx, 1, stretch)
        Art.Cat(ctx, 0, 0, width, cat.facing, cat.color, cat.gait, false, clock, cat.squash, nil, index, false)
        nvgRestore(ctx)
        -- 旧 Cat 内部会再次换算球宽：这里单独调用 WornYarn，传入像素宽而非世界宽。
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls or {}) do
            if cat.carry and ball.carriedBy == index then
                local headX = cat.x + (cat.w or 0.82) * (0.5 + cat.facing * 0.29)
                Art.WornYarn(ctx, wx(headX), gy(cat.y) - height * 0.92,
                    { owner = ball.owner, kind = ball.kind, felt = ball.felt, w = ball.w * unit * 0.59 }, index)
                break
            end
        end
        if index == game.active and not cat.arrived then
            local markerY = gy(cat.y) - height - (cat.carry and 0.62 or 0.25) * unit
            Poly(ctx, { wx(cat.x) + width / 2 - 4, markerY - 5, wx(cat.x) + width / 2 + 4, markerY - 5,
                wx(cat.x) + width / 2, markerY + 1 }, YARNS[index])
        end
        if index == 1 and not cat.arrived then
            local bx, by = wx(cat.x + (cat.w or 0.82) * 0.22), gy(cat.y + 1)
            Line(ctx, bx, by, bx - 0.25 * unit, by - 0.23 * unit, EDGE, 1)
            Tag(ctx, bx - 0.7 * unit, by - 0.32 * unit, "踩背+1", font)
        end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(game.effects or {}) do
        local alpha = math.floor(180 * math.max(0, math.min(1, e.life / math.max(0.001, e.maxLife))))
        if e.kind == "home" then
            Poly(ctx, { wx(e.x) - 4, gy(e.y), wx(e.x), gy(e.y) - 6, wx(e.x) + 4, gy(e.y) }, { 226, 200, 140, alpha })
        elseif e.kind == "wool" then
            Ellipse(ctx, wx(e.x), gy(e.y), 4, 4, { 255, 252, 240, alpha })
        else
            Ellipse(ctx, wx(e.x), gy(e.y), 3, 2, { 228, 217, 167, alpha })
        end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

return RoomThreeArt

local function Copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local copied = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do copied[key] = Copy(item) end
    return copied
end

local function Equal(a, b)
    if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
    if type(a) ~= "table" then return a == b end
    for key, item in pairs(a) do if not Equal(item, b[key]) then return false end end
    for key in pairs(b) do if a[key] == nil then return false end end
    return true
end

function RoomTwo.Machine(game, id)
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.id == id then return machine end
    end
    error("第2关缺少机关 " .. id)
end

function RoomTwo.Init(game)
    game.roomMachines = Room.CreateMachines(game.def.mechanisms)
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.kind == "button" then
            machine.pressed, machine.remaining = false, 0
        end
    end
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        cat.weight, cat.jumpHeight = 4 - i, i == 2 and 2 or 1
        cat.jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * cat.jumpHeight)
        cat.bodyH = i == 1 and 1 or 0.58
        cat.birthX, cat.birthY = cat.x, cat.y
        cat.pullDir, cat.napping = 0, false
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        ball.weight, ball.amount, ball.y, ball.vx = 3, 2, 0, 0
    end
    game.holdGrace, game.buttonPressed, game.ballDelivered = 0, false, false
    game.autonomy = false
    print("[第2关初始化] 猫洞只过球；B控制两扇木门；松开2秒关门；毛线总量6")
end

function RoomTwo.Size(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    local ball = game:CarriedBall(index)
    return CAT_W, cat.bodyH + (ball and ball.w * 0.85 or 0)
end

function RoomTwo.GateOpen(game)
    return RoomTwo.Machine(game, "door02").open
end

function RoomTwo.WorldBoxes(game)
    return Room.Boxes(game)
end

function RoomTwo.ClampBallX(game, x, ball, direction)
    local result = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - ball.w - 0.3, x))
    -- 圆孔处的球通过；窝前的木门仍然挡住自由球。
    local door = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "door02")
    if not door.open and result < door.x + door.w and result + ball.w > door.x then
        result = direction >= 0 and door.x - ball.w or door.x + door.w
    end
    return result
end

function RoomTwo.GrabCandidate(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won then return nil end
    local carried = game:CarriedBall(index)
    if carried then return { mode = "drop", ball = carried.owner } end
    local nearest, distance = nil, 0.85
    local hole = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "hole05")
    local cx = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
    for i, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        local bx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
        local d = math.abs(bx - cx)
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.holeRoute and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
            and not CatHole.BlocksGrab(hole, cx, bx)
            and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.65 and d < distance then
            nearest, distance = i, d
        end
    end
    if not nearest then return nil end
    local ball = game.balls[nearest]
    local blocked = false
    for _, box in ipairs(RoomTwo.WorldBoxes(game)) do
        if game:Overlaps(cat.x, cat.y, CAT_W, cat.bodyH + ball.w * 0.85,
            box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h) then blocked = true end
    end
    return { mode = "grab", ball = nearest, blocked = blocked }
end

function RoomTwo.ToggleCarry(game, index)
    local candidate = RoomTwo.GrabCandidate(game, index)
    if not candidate or candidate.blocked then return false end
    game:PushUndo()
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if candidate.mode == "drop" then
        local ball = game:CarriedBall(index)
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy = false, nil
        ball.x = RoomTwo.ClampBallX(game,
            cat.facing >= 0 and cat.x + CAT_W + 0.02 or cat.x - ball.w - 0.02, ball, cat.facing)
        ball.y, ball.vx, ball.holeSettled = cat.grounded and 0 or cat.y, 0, nil
        local hole = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "hole05")
        if cat.facing > 0 and CatHole.Enter(hole, ball) then
            print("[猫洞05] 放球进入圆孔，沿出口斜坡滚向B；猫不能走圆孔")
        end
        print("[放球] " .. cat.name .. "；毛线总量 " .. RoomTwo.YarnAmount(game))
    else
        local ball = game.balls[candidate.ball]
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.vx, ball.holeSettled = true, index, 0, nil
        print("[抱球] " .. cat.name .. "；毛线总量 " .. RoomTwo.YarnAmount(game))
    end
    -- 立即同步按钮占用，使取回压板球后的2秒从F事件准确开始。
    RoomTwo.MachineStep(game, 0)
    game.undoTimer = 0
    game:PushUndo()
    return true
end

function RoomTwo.Select(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won or game.active == index then return end
    game:PushUndo()
    game.active, game.jumpBuffer = index, 0
    game.switches = game.switches + 1
    game.undoTimer = 0
    game:PushUndo()
    print("[选猫] " .. cat.name)
end

function RoomTwo.Jump(game)
    if not game.won then game.jumpBuffer, game.started = 0.14, true end
end

-- 猫碰撞：宽0.95米，隔墙4米；圆孔1米不从猫的碰撞盒挖空。
-- B未压：整面墙阻挡所有猫（包括空手奶盖）；B已压：经独立木门通道绕过圆孔。
-- 球处于B的地板凹槽时不被路过猫踢走，F仍能取回；没有新增锁球规则。
function RoomTwo.MoveSheep(game, index, direction, dt)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived then return end
    local oldX, oldY, wasGrounded = cat.x, cat.y, cat.grounded
    local w, h = RoomTwo.Size(game, index)
    local nextX = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - CAT_W - 0.3,
        cat.x + direction * cat.speed * dt))
    local boxes = RoomTwo.WorldBoxes(game)
    for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
        if game:Overlaps(nextX, cat.y, w, h, box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h) then
            if direction > 0 then nextX = math.min(nextX, box.x - w)
            elseif direction < 0 then nextX = math.max(nextX, box.x + box.w) end
        end
    end
    cat.x, cat.vx = nextX, direction * cat.speed
    if direction ~= 0 then
        cat.facing = direction
        cat.gait = cat.gait + dt * cat.speed * 4
    end
    cat.coyote = wasGrounded and 0.1 or math.max(0, cat.coyote - dt)
    if index == game.active and game.jumpBuffer > 0 and cat.coyote > 0 then
        game:PushUndo()
        cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support, cat.coyote = cat.jump, false, 0, 0
        game.jumpBuffer = 0
        game:AddEffect(cat.x + CAT_W / 2, cat.y, "dust"); FX.Fire("jump")
        game:PushUndo()
    end
    local nextY = cat.y + cat.vy * dt - GRAVITY * dt * dt / 2
    cat.vy = cat.vy - GRAVITY * dt
    cat.y, cat.grounded, cat.support = nextY, false, 0
    for _, box in ipairs(boxes) do
        if game:Overlaps(cat.x, cat.y, w, h, box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h) then
            if cat.vy <= 0 and oldY >= box.y + box.h - EPS then
                cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = box.y + box.h, 0, true, -7
            elseif cat.vy > 0 and oldY + h <= box.y + EPS then
                cat.y, cat.vy = box.y - h, 0
            end
        end
    end
    if cat.y <= 0 and cat.vy <= 0 then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = 0, 0, true, -6
    end
    local orange = game.sheep[1]
    if index ~= 1 and not orange.arrived and cat.vy <= 0 and oldY >= orange.y + 1 - EPS
        and nextY <= orange.y + 1 and cat.x + CAT_W > orange.x + 0.08
        and cat.x < orange.x + CAT_W - 0.08 then
        cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = orange.y + 1, 0, true, 1
    end
    cat.dx, cat.dy = cat.x - oldX, cat.y - oldY
    cat.squash = math.max(0, cat.squash - dt * 3)
    if cat.grounded and not wasGrounded then cat.squash = 0.1; FX.Fire("land") end
    if direction ~= 0 and cat.grounded then
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            local delta = ball.x + ball.w / 2 - (cat.x + CAT_W / 2)
            if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.holeRoute and not ball.holeSettled
                and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.2
                and direction * delta > 0 and math.abs(delta) < (CAT_W + ball.w) / 2 then
                ball.x = RoomTwo.ClampBallX(game,
                    direction > 0 and cat.x + CAT_W or cat.x - ball.w, ball, direction)
                ball.vx = direction * 1.2
            end
        end
    end
end

function RoomTwo.PlateWeight(game)
    local button = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "B")
    local weight = 0
    for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        local cx = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
        if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.y - button.y) < 0.08
            and cx >= button.x and cx <= button.x + button.w then weight = weight + cat.weight end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        local cx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
        if not ball.carriedBy and not ball.holeRoute and (ball.y or 0) <= button.y + 0.08
            and cx >= button.x and cx <= button.x + button.w then weight = weight + ball.weight end
    end
    return weight
end

function RoomTwo.MachineStep(game, dt)
    local hole = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "hole05")
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if CatHole.Enter(hole, ball) then game:PushUndo() end
        if ball.holeRoute and CatHole.Tick(hole, ball, dt) then
            game.ballDelivered = true
            game:AddEffect(ball.x + ball.w / 2, 0.3, "wool")
            print("[猫洞05] 原球滚到B凹槽停稳，没有生成或损失毛线")
            game:PushUndo()
        end
    end
    local button = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "B")
    local changed = ButtonHold.Tick(button, RoomTwo.PlateWeight(game), dt)
    local pressed = button.pressed
    game.buttonPressed, game.holdGrace = pressed, button.remaining
    local open = button.activated
    local door = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "door02")
    if open ~= door.open then changed = true end
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.kind == "woodDoor" then
            machine.open = open
            local target = open and 1 or 0
            machine.lift = machine.lift + math.max(-dt * 3, math.min(dt * 3, target - machine.lift))
            if not open then
                -- 关门前夹逼到靠近的一侧，避免身体与门重叠后穿墙。
                for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                    local cw, ch = RoomTwo.Size(game, i)
                    if not cat.arrived and game:Overlaps(cat.x, cat.y, cw, ch,
                        machine.x, machine.y, machine.w, machine.h) then
                        cat.x = cat.x + cw / 2 < machine.x + machine.w / 2
                            and machine.x - cw or machine.x + machine.w
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    game.gateLift = door.lift
    if changed then
        if pressed then print("[按钮B] 压住：猫通道及窝前木门打开")
        elseif open then print("[按钮B] 已松开：2秒后关闭两扇木门")
        else print("[按钮B] 2秒到：两扇木门关闭，U可回溯") end
        game:PushUndo()
    end
end

function RoomTwo.YarnAmount(game)
    local total = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        total = total + (ball.amount or (ball.kind == "half" and 1 or 2))
    end
    return total
end

function RoomTwo.Stars(game)
    local amount = RoomTwo.YarnAmount(game)
    if amount == 6 then return 3 end
    if amount >= 4 then return 2 end
    if amount >= 2 then return 1 end
    return 0
end

function RoomTwo.Update(game, dt, direction)
    local capped = math.min(dt, 0.08)
    if game.won then return end
    game.clock = game.clock + capped
    if direction ~= 0 then game.started = true end
    if game.started then game.elapsed = game.elapsed + capped end
    game.accumulator = game.accumulator + capped
    while game.accumulator >= STEP do
        game.accumulator = game.accumulator - STEP
        local active = game.active
        for i = 1, 3 do RoomTwo.MoveSheep(game, i, i == active and direction or 0, STEP) end
        game.jumpBuffer = math.max(0, game.jumpBuffer - STEP)
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy then
                local cat = game.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
                ball.x, ball.y = cat.x + CAT_W / 2 - ball.w / 2, cat.y + cat.bodyH
            elseif not ball.holeRoute and not ball.holeSettled then
                ball.y = math.max(0, (ball.y or 0) - GRAVITY * STEP)
                if math.abs(ball.vx or 0) > 0.01 then
                    ball.x = RoomTwo.ClampBallX(game, ball.x + ball.vx * STEP, ball, ball.vx)
                    ball.vx = ball.vx * 0.96
                end
            end
        end
        RoomTwo.MachineStep(game, STEP)
        local nest = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "home01")
        for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
            if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and cat.y < 0.08
                and cat.x + CAT_W / 2 >= nest.x and cat.x + CAT_W / 2 <= nest.x + nest.w then
                game:PushUndo()
                cat.arrived = true
                cat.x, cat.y, cat.vx, cat.vy = nest.x + 0.12 + (i - 1), 0, 0, 0
                game:AddEffect(cat.x + CAT_W / 2, 0.5, "home")
                FX.Fire("home")
                print("[进窝] " .. cat.name)
                if game:ArrivedCount() == 3 then
                    game.won = true
                    print(string.format("[通关] 第2关；进窝3/3；毛线%d；%d星；地上%d",
                        RoomTwo.YarnAmount(game), RoomTwo.Stars(game), game:LooseBallCount()))
                elseif game.active == i then game:Next() end
                game:PushUndo()
            end
        end
        game.undoTimer = game.undoTimer + STEP
        if game.undoTimer >= 1.2 then game.undoTimer = 0; game:PushUndo() end
        if game.won then break end
    end
    FX.StepEffects(game.effects, capped, nil)
end

function RoomTwo.PushUndo(game)
    local snap = { sheep = Copy(game.sheep), balls = Copy(game.balls), machines = Copy(game.roomMachines),
        active = game.active, elapsed = game.elapsed, started = game.started, won = game.won,
        switches = game.switches, ballDelivered = game.ballDelivered }
    local last = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    if last and Equal(last, snap) then return end
    game.undoStack[#game.undoStack + 1] = snap
    if #game.undoStack > 150 then table.remove(game.undoStack, 1) end
end

function RoomTwo.Undo(game)
    if #game.undoStack < 2 then return false end
    RoomTwo.PushUndo(game)
    table.remove(game.undoStack)
    local snap = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    game.sheep, game.balls, game.roomMachines = Copy(snap.sheep), Copy(snap.balls), Copy(snap.machines)
    game.active, game.elapsed, game.started, game.won = snap.active, snap.elapsed, snap.started, snap.won
    game.switches, game.ballDelivered = snap.switches, snap.ballDelivered
    game.jumpBuffer, game.accumulator, game.undoTimer = 0, 0, 0
    local button = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "B")
    game.holdGrace, game.buttonPressed = button.remaining, button.pressed
    game.gateLift = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "door02").lift
    game.effects = {}
    print("[回溯] 恢复猫、原球滚球进度、按钮B的2秒计时和两扇木门")
    return true
end

function RoomTwo.CanUndo(game)
    return #game.undoStack >= 2
end

function RoomTwo.Hint(game)
    if game.won then return "三猫已进窝。球留在按钮上也计入毛线总量：6单位，3星。" end
    if RoomTwo.GateOpen(game) then
        return "把球留在B上，三猫依次沿旁边的猫通道过墙，再过木门进窝。"
    end
    return "汤圆顶球到圆孔左侧，按F；球滚过洞压住B。圆孔只让球过，B另开猫通道。"
end

return RoomTwo

-- 第2关机关插画：复用WoolArt的米色房间、木地板、猫与毛线绘制。
local RoomTwo = require("RoomTwo")
local Art = {}

local function Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, color, radius)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, radius or 4)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(color[1], color[2], color[3], color[4] or 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(145, 113, 77, 255)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.4); nvgStroke(ctx)
end

local function Text(ctx, x, y, text, size)
    nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans"); nvgFontSize(ctx, size or 9)
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER + NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(91, 86, 67, 255)); nvgText(ctx, x, y, text, nil)
end

function Art.Machines(ctx, game, metrics)
    local unit, left, ground = metrics.unit, metrics.left, metrics.ground
    local function wx(x) return left + x * unit end
    local hole = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "hole05")
    local passage = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "passage02")
    local button = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "B")
    local hx, hw, hh = wx(hole.x), hole.w * unit, hole.h * unit
    -- 隔墙不升起、不消失；绿色前景地板明确表示独立猫通道。
    Rect(ctx, hx - 4, ground - hh, hw + 8, hh, { 222, 194, 151, 255 }, 5)
    for i = 1, 8 do
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, hx - 3, ground - i * hh / 9)
        nvgLineTo(ctx, hx + hw + 3, ground - i * hh / 9)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(181, 151, 111, 140)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1); nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
    local radius = 0.5 * unit
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgCircle(ctx, hx + hw / 2, ground - radius, radius)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(120, 92, 63, 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(171, 137, 94, 255)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 4); nvgStroke(ctx)
    Text(ctx, hx + hw / 2, ground - hh - 12, "05 猫洞 · 只过球", 9)
    local slopeStart, slopeEnd = wx(hole.x + hole.w), wx(hole.stopX)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, slopeStart, ground - 2)
    nvgLineTo(ctx, slopeEnd, ground - hole.stopY * unit)
    nvgLineTo(ctx, slopeEnd, ground + 0.46 * unit)
    nvgLineTo(ctx, slopeStart, ground + 0.12 * unit); nvgClosePath(ctx)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(184, 144, 96, 255)); nvgFill(ctx)
    -- 小凹槽接住球，路过猫的脚位于凹槽上方，避免踢走压板球。
    local sink = button.pressed and 3 or 0
    Rect(ctx, wx(button.x), ground + 0.2 * unit + sink, button.w * unit, 0.2 * unit,
        button.pressed and { 132, 166, 101, 255 } or { 195, 154, 106, 255 })
    Text(ctx, wx(button.x + button.w / 2), ground + 0.74 * unit,
        button.pressed and "B · 球压住，门开" or (button.remaining > 0
            and string.format("B · %.1f秒后关门", button.remaining) or "B · 保持式按钮"), 9)
    Rect(ctx, hx - 0.65 * unit, ground + 0.05 * unit, hw + 1.3 * unit, 0.16 * unit,
        passage.open and { 152, 181, 117, 245 } or { 196, 161, 115, 245 })
    if not passage.open then
        Rect(ctx, hx + hw + 0.12 * unit, ground - 0.65 * unit, 0.4 * unit, 0.75 * unit,
            { 173, 132, 86, 255 }, 3)
    else
        Text(ctx, hx + hw + 0.28 * unit, ground + 0.12 * unit, "→", 12)
    end
    Text(ctx, hx + hw / 2, ground + 1.3 * unit,
        passage.open and "02 猫通道 · B已开启" or "02 猫通道 · 等待B", 9)
    local door = RoomTwo.Machine(game, "door02")
    Text(ctx, wx(door.x + door.w / 2), ground - door.h * unit - 18,
        door.open and "02 木门 · 开" or "02 木门 · 关", 9)
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, wx(door.x) - 2, ground - door.h * unit, door.w * unit + 4, door.h * unit)
    local top = ground - door.h * unit - door.lift * door.h * unit
    Rect(ctx, wx(door.x), top, door.w * unit, door.h * unit, { 193, 143, 94, 255 }, 3)
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    Text(ctx, wx(game.def.homeX + 1.1), ground + 0.8 * unit, "01 猫窝", 9)
end

return Art
