local function deepCopy(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
    local out = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do out[k] = deepCopy(v) end
    return out
end

local function finiteNumber(value)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

local function integerInRange(value, low, high)
    return finiteNumber(value) and value % 1 == 0 and value >= low and value <= high
end

local function validLevelKey(key)
    local level = type(key) == "number" and key or type(key) == "string" and tonumber(key) or nil
    return integerInRange(level, 1, 11)
end

local function validMap(value, keyValidator, valueValidator)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        if keyValidator and not keyValidator(key) then return false end
        if valueValidator and not valueValidator(item) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function validArray(value, itemValidator)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
    local count, maximum = 0, 0
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        if not integerInRange(key, 1, math.huge) or not itemValidator(item) then return false end
        count, maximum = count + 1, math.max(maximum, key)
    end
    return count == maximum
end

local function validSettings(value)
    if value == nil then return true end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
    if value.sound ~= nil and (not finiteNumber(value.sound) or value.sound < 0 or value.sound > 100) then return false end
    if value.lang ~= nil and value.lang ~= "zh" and value.lang ~= "en" then return false end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "sfx", "haptic", "highContrast" }) do
        if value[key] ~= nil and type(value[key]) ~= "boolean" then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function validClearRecord(value)
    if type(value) == "boolean" then return true end -- 兼容早期只记录 attempt 的版本。
    return type(value) == "table"
        and integerInRange(value.level, 1, 11)
        and finiteNumber(value.netUnits)
        and integerInRange(value.stars, 0, 3)
end

local function validSnapshot(value, depth)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or (depth or 0) > 24 then return false end
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        if type(key) ~= "string" and not integerInRange(key, 1, math.huge) then return false end
        if type(item) == "table" and not validSnapshot(item, (depth or 0) + 1) then return false
        elseif type(item) == "number" and not finiteNumber(item) then return false
        elseif type(item) ~= "table" and type(item) ~= "string" and type(item) ~= "number" and type(item) ~= "boolean" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function validCheckpoint(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
    if not validArray(value.sheep, function(item) return type(item) == "table" end) or #value.sheep ~= 3 then return false end
    if not validArray(value.balls, function(item) return type(item) == "table" end) or #value.balls < 1 then return false end
    if type(value.campaign) ~= "table"
        or not validArray(value.campaign.machines, function(item) return type(item) == "table" end)
        or not validArray(value.campaign.platforms, function(item) return type(item) == "table" end)
        or not validArray(value.campaign.walls, function(item) return type(item) == "table" end)
        or not validArray(value.campaign.zones, function(item) return type(item) == "table" end) then return false end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "active", "elapsed", "clock", "nextBallId" }) do
        if not finiteNumber(value[key]) then return false end
    end
    if not integerInRange(value.active, 1, 3) or value.elapsed < 0 or value.clock < 0
        or not integerInRange(value.nextBallId, 1, math.huge) then return false end
    if value.started ~= nil and type(value.started) ~= "boolean"
        or value.won ~= nil and type(value.won) ~= "boolean"
        or value.switches ~= nil and not integerInRange(value.switches, 0, math.huge) then return false end
    for _, cat in ipairs(value.sheep) do
        if type(cat) ~= "table" or not finiteNumber(cat.x) or not finiteNumber(cat.y)
            or not finiteNumber(cat.vx) or not finiteNumber(cat.vy)
            or type(cat.arrived) ~= "boolean" or type(cat.grounded) ~= "boolean" then return false end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(value.balls) do
        if type(ball) ~= "table" or not finiteNumber(ball.id) or not finiteNumber(ball.x)
            or not finiteNumber(ball.y) or not finiteNumber(ball.vx) or not finiteNumber(ball.vy)
            or type(ball.kind) ~= "string" or type(ball.state) ~= "string" then return false end
    end
    return validSnapshot(value, 0)
end

local function validCampaign(value)
    if value == nil then return true end -- 旧存档会在读取时补入 Campaign V2 默认结构。
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
    if value.saveVersion ~= nil and not integerInRange(value.saveVersion, 1, 100) then return false end
    if value.unlockedLevel ~= nil and not integerInRange(value.unlockedLevel, 1, 11) then return false end
    if value.nextAttemptId ~= nil and not integerInRange(value.nextAttemptId, 0, math.huge) then return false end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "migratedFromLegacy", "migrationNotice", "hiddenUnlocked", "hiddenBadge" }) do
        if value[key] ~= nil and type(value[key]) ~= "boolean" then return false end
    end
    if value.totalUnits ~= nil and not finiteNumber(value.totalUnits) then return false end
    if value.completedLevels ~= nil and not validMap(value.completedLevels, validLevelKey, function(item) return type(item) == "boolean" end) then return false end
    if value.levelBestUnits ~= nil and not validMap(value.levelBestUnits, validLevelKey, finiteNumber) then return false end
    if value.bestStars ~= nil and not validMap(value.bestStars, validLevelKey, function(item) return integerInRange(item, 0, 3) end) then return false end
    if value.toolUnlocks ~= nil and not validMap(value.toolUnlocks, function(key) return type(key) == "string" end,
        function(item) return type(item) == "boolean" end) then return false end
    if value.endingGallery ~= nil then
        local gallery = value.endingGallery
        if type(gallery) ~= "table" then return false end
        if gallery.endingKey ~= nil and type(gallery.endingKey) ~= "string" then return false end
        if gallery.hiddenEnding ~= nil and type(gallery.hiddenEnding) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        if gallery.unlocked ~= nil and not validMap(gallery.unlocked,
            function(key) return type(key) == "string" end, function(item) return type(item) == "boolean" end) then return false end
    end
    if value.clearRecords ~= nil and not validMap(value.clearRecords,
        function(key) return type(key) == "string" end, validClearRecord) then return false end
    if value.checkpoints ~= nil and not validMap(value.checkpoints, validLevelKey,
        validCheckpoint) then return false end
    return true
end

-- Validate fields used by gameplay before accepting a primary save or rotating it to backup.
local function validSaveData(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    if data.unlockedLevel ~= nil and not integerInRange(data.unlockedLevel, 1, 11) then return false end
    if data.legacy ~= nil and (not finiteNumber(data.legacy) or data.legacy < 0) then return false end
    if data.hiddenUnlocked ~= nil and type(data.hiddenUnlocked) ~= "boolean" then return false end
    if data.settings ~= nil and not validSettings(data.settings) then return false end
    if data.stars ~= nil and not validMap(data.stars, validLevelKey, function(item) return integerInRange(item, 0, 3) end) then return false end
    if data.tools ~= nil and not validArray(data.tools, function(item) return type(item) == "string" end) then return false end
    if data.clearShots ~= nil and type(data.clearShots) ~= "table" then return false end
    if data.legacyAtEntry ~= nil and not validMap(data.legacyAtEntry, validLevelKey,
        function(item) return finiteNumber(item) and item >= 0 end) then return false end
    if data.pellet ~= nil then
        local pellet = data.pellet
        if type(pellet) ~= "table"
            or pellet.inLv ~= nil and not integerInRange(pellet.inLv, 1, 11)
            or pellet.outLv ~= nil and not integerInRange(pellet.outLv, 1, 14)
            or pellet.strands ~= nil and (not finiteNumber(pellet.strands) or pellet.strands < 0)
            or pellet.kind ~= nil and type(pellet.kind) ~= "string" then return false end
    end
    return validCampaign(data.campaignV2)
end

-- 规范化：缺字段用默认值补，保证任何历史存档读进来都是完整结构
local function normalize(data)
    local out = deepCopy(defaults)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return out end
    -- 遍历传入数据（defaults 里值为 nil 的键不存在，不能用 defaults 迭代）
    for k, v in pairs(data) do
        if k == "settings" then
            out.settings = deepCopy(defaults.settings)
            if type(v) == "table" then
                for sk, sv in pairs(v) do out.settings[sk] = sv end
            end
        elseif k == "campaignV2" then
            out.campaignV2 = deepCopy(defaults.campaignV2)
            if type(v) == "table" then
                for ck, cv in pairs(v) do
                    if type(out.campaignV2[ck]) == "table" and type(cv) == "table" then
                        for itemKey, itemValue in pairs(cv) do out.campaignV2[ck][itemKey] = deepCopy(itemValue) end
                    else
                        out.campaignV2[ck] = deepCopy(cv)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            out[k] = deepCopy(v)
        end
    end
    if type(out.stars) ~= "table" then out.stars = {} end
    if type(out.campaignV2) ~= "table" then out.campaignV2 = deepCopy(defaults.campaignV2) end
    for key, value in pairs(defaults.campaignV2) do
        if type(out.campaignV2[key]) ~= type(value) then out.campaignV2[key] = deepCopy(value) end
    end
    for key, value in pairs(DEFAULT_SETTINGS) do
        if type(out.settings[key]) ~= type(value) then out.settings[key] = deepCopy(value) end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({"sound", "music", "effects"}) do
        local v = out.settings[key]
        out.settings[key] = v == v and math.max(0, math.min(100, v)) or 80
    end
    out.settings.textScale = Validation.Finite(out.settings.textScale) and math.max(1, math.min(1.4, out.settings.textScale)) or 1
    if out.settings.lang ~= "en" then out.settings.lang = "zh" end
    out.lastLevel = Validation.Finite(tonumber(out.lastLevel)) and math.max(1, math.min(11, math.floor(tonumber(out.lastLevel)))) or 1
    if type(out.journal) ~= "table" then out.journal = {} end
    local c = out.campaignV2
    c.unlockedLevel = Validation.Finite(c.unlockedLevel) and math.max(1, math.min(10, math.floor(c.unlockedLevel))) or 1
    c.nextAttemptId = Validation.Finite(c.nextAttemptId) and math.max(0, math.floor(c.nextAttemptId)) or 0
    out.unlockedLevel = Validation.Finite(out.unlockedLevel) and math.max(1, math.min(11, math.floor(out.unlockedLevel))) or 1
    if type(out.tools) ~= "table" then out.tools = {} end
    c.endingGallery.unlocked = type(c.endingGallery.unlocked) == "table" and c.endingGallery.unlocked or {}
    for _, map in ipairs({c.toolUnlocks, c.endingGallery.unlocked}) do
        for key, value in pairs(map) do if type(key) ~= "string" or type(value) ~= "boolean" then map[key] = nil end end
    end
    local actions = {left=true,right=true,jump=true,action=true,interact=true,meow=true,undo=true,restart=true,switch=true}
    for action, key in pairs(out.settings.bindings) do
        if not actions[action] or not Validation.Finite(key) or key <= 0 or key % 1 ~= 0 then out.settings.bindings[action] = nil end
    end
    for level, record in pairs(out.journal) do
        if type(record) ~= "table" then out.journal[level] = nil
        else
            for _, field in ipairs({"stars", "elapsed", "rewinds", "failures", "netUnits"}) do
                if not Validation.Finite(record[field]) then record[field] = 0 end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({"completedLevels", "bestStars", "levelBestUnits"}) do
        for level, value in pairs(c[key]) do
            local n = tonumber(level)
            if not n or n < 1 or n > 11 or n % 1 ~= 0
                or (key == "completedLevels" and type(value) ~= "boolean")
                or (key ~= "completedLevels" and (type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value)) then
                c[key][level] = nil
            elseif key == "bestStars" then c[key][level] = math.max(0, math.min(3, math.floor(value))) end
        end
    end
    for level, snapshot in pairs(c.checkpoints) do
        local ok, valid = pcall(Validation.Checkpoint, snapshot, tonumber(level))
        if not ok or not valid then
            c.checkpoints[level] = nil
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- 语法错误、非对象 JSON 或关键字段结构损坏都视为坏档，继续读取有效备份。
local function readFile(name)
    if not fileSystem:FileExists(name) then return false, nil end
    local file = File(name, FILE_READ)
    if not file or not file:IsOpen() then return false, nil end
    local readOk, raw = pcall(function() return file:ReadString() end)
    file:Close()
    if not readOk then return false, nil end
    local decodedOk, data = pcall(cjson.decode, raw)
    return decodedOk and validSaveData(data), data, raw

end

---@return table 最新存档（始终返回非 nil 的完整结构）
function Save.Load()
    if cached then return deepCopy(cached) end
    recovered=false
    local ok, data = readFile(FILE_NAME)
    if not ok then ok, data = readFile(BACKUP_FILE); recovered=ok end

    if not ok then data = nil end
    cached = normalize(data)
    return deepCopy(cached)
end

---@param data table
---@return boolean saved
---@return string reason
function Save.Save(data)
    if not validSaveData(data) then
        print("[存档] 写入失败：数据结构无效")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "invalid_data"
    end
    data=normalize(data)
    if testSession then cached=deepCopy(data);pendingData=nil;dirty=false;lastError="";revision=revision+1;return true,"saved" end
    pendingData=deepCopy(data)
    local encodedOk, encoded = pcall(cjson.encode, data)
    if not encodedOk then
        print("[存档] 写入失败：数据无法编码")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "encode_failed"

    end
    local file = File(TEMP_FILE, FILE_WRITE)
    if not file or not file:IsOpen() then
        print("[存档] 写入失败：无法打开临时文件")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "open_failed"

    end
    local writeOk, written = pcall(function() return file:WriteString(encoded) end)
    file:Close()
    if not writeOk or written ~= true then
        fileSystem:Delete(TEMP_FILE)
        print("[存档] 写入失败：临时文件未完整写入，旧档未改动")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "write_failed"
    end
    -- 安装前验证落盘内容，避免 WriteString 成功但关闭/短写后产生坏档。
    local verified, _, raw = readFile(TEMP_FILE)
    if not verified or raw ~= encoded then
        fileSystem:Delete(TEMP_FILE)
        print("[存档] 写入失败：临时文件校验失败，旧档未改动")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "verify_failed"
    end

    local hadOriginal = fileSystem:FileExists(FILE_NAME)
    local originalValid = readFile(FILE_NAME)
    local backupValid = readFile(BACKUP_FILE)
    local backedUp = false
    if hadOriginal and (originalValid or not backupValid) then
        -- 有效主档优先备份；没有有效备份时也先保留原文件，不能直接删唯一旧档。
        if fileSystem:FileExists(BACKUP_FILE) and not fileSystem:Delete(BACKUP_FILE) then
            fileSystem:Delete(TEMP_FILE)
            print("[存档] 写入失败：无法替换备份，旧主档未改动")
            lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "backup_failed"
        end
        if not fileSystem:Rename(FILE_NAME, BACKUP_FILE) then
            fileSystem:Delete(TEMP_FILE)
            print("[存档] 写入失败：无法备份旧存档")
            lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "backup_failed"
        end
        backedUp = true
    elseif hadOriginal and not fileSystem:Delete(FILE_NAME) then
        -- 主档已损坏时保留可读备份，不把坏主档覆盖到它上面。
        fileSystem:Delete(TEMP_FILE)
        print("[存档] 写入失败：无法移开损坏主档，备份未改动")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "backup_failed"
    end
    if not fileSystem:Rename(TEMP_FILE, FILE_NAME) then
        local restored = backedUp and fileSystem:Rename(BACKUP_FILE, FILE_NAME)
        fileSystem:Delete(TEMP_FILE)
        print(restored and "[存档] 写入失败：无法安装新存档，已还原旧主档"
            or "[存档] 写入失败：无法安装新存档；已有备份未改动，可再次读取")
        lastError="save_failed"
        return false, "install_failed"
    end
    cached=deepCopy(data);pendingData=nil;dirty=false;lastError="";revision=revision+1
    return true, "saved"

end

---@param key string 顶级字段名（settings 用 Save.SetSetting）
function Save.Set(key, value)
    local data = deepCopy(Save.Load())
    data[key] = deepCopy(value)
    return Save.Save(data)
end

---@param key string sound|lang|sfx|haptic
function Save.SetSetting(key, value)
    local data = deepCopy(Save.Load())
    data.settings[key] = value
    return Save.Save(normalize(data))
end

function Save.GetSetting(key)
    return deepCopy(Save.Load().settings[key])
end

function Save.Update(dt)
    if not dirty then return end
    flushTimer = flushTimer - dt
    if flushTimer <= 0 then
        local ok = Save.Flush()
        if not ok then flushTimer = 3 end
    end
end

function Save.Flush()
    if pendingData then return Save.Save(pendingData) end
    if not dirty then return true end
    return Save.Save(cached)
end

function Save.Status() return { error = lastError, pending = dirty, recovered = recovered, revision = revision } end
function Save.Reload() cached = nil; return Save.Load() end
function Save.Revision() return revision end

function Save.Remember(key, value)
    local data = Save.Load()
    data[key] = value
    cached, dirty, flushTimer = normalize(data), true, 0.45
    revision = revision + 1
end

function Save.RecordClear(level, stars)
    local persisted = Save.Load()
    local data = deepCopy(persisted)
    if level >= 1 and level <= 10 then
        data.stars[level] = math.max(data.stars[level] or 0, stars)
        data.unlockedLevel = math.max(data.unlockedLevel, level + 1)
        if level == 10 then data.hiddenUnlocked = true end
    elseif level == 11 then
        data.unlockedLevel = math.max(data.unlockedLevel, 11)
    end
    local saved, reason = Save.Save(data)
    if not saved then return persisted, false, reason end
    return data, true, reason
end

function Save.IsUnlocked(level)
    local data = Save.Load()
    if level <= 1 then return true end
    if level == 11 then return data.hiddenUnlocked and data.unlockedLevel >= 11 end
    return data.unlockedLevel >= level
end

function Save.Wipe()
    return Save.Save(deepCopy(defaults))
end

-- Test entry points opt into an isolated memory store before any game module loads.
function Save.BeginTestSession()
    testSession = true
    pendingData=nil
    cached, dirty, flushTimer = deepCopy(defaults), false, 0
    lastError, recovered = "", false
    revision = revision + 1
end

function Save.IsTestSession() return testSession end


return Save
SaveValidation:
-- Validate persisted state before it can reach arithmetic or entity lookups.
local V = {}
function V.Finite(value)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end
local function numbers(value, keys)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do if not V.Finite(value[key]) then return false end end
    return true
end
local function booleans(value, keys)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do if type(value[key]) ~= "boolean" then return false end end
    return true
end
local numericFields={}
for _,key in ipairs({"x","y","vx","vy","w","h","x0","x1","y1","lift","liftHeight","riseHeight",
    "timer","remaining","mode","weight","amount","speed","bodyH","bodyW","jump","jumpHeight",
    "baseWeight","baseJumpHeight","weightBonus","elapsed","clock","switches","nextBallId","support",
    "coyote","facing","gait","squash","dx","dy","stunTimer","reverseTimer","mintCooldown",
    "noticeTimer","meowCooldown","meowPulse","washerTimer","ownerX","ownerDir","ownerAlertCooldown",
    "ownerDistracted","theftTimer","scaredTimer","reactionTimer","magnetCooldown","vacuumTimer",
    "transitTimer","transitDuration","transitStartX","transitStartY","transitTarget","transitY",
    "stored","storedUnits","overload","sag","lastLift","carrierClock","alertTimer","distracted",
    "paperTimer","ropeTipX","ropeTipY","laserTarget","lossUnits","tutorialStep","hintStage",
    "rattle","rattleWindow","ratTrips","homeSlot","targetX","pushMin","need","maxDiameter",
    "decoyX","actionX","toyId","total"}) do numericFields[key]=true end
local booleanFields={}
for _,key in ipairs({"open","pressed","used","grounded","carry","felt","charged","lost","inTransit",
    "inWasher","napping","started","won","hasWool","rescueGranted","borrowed","fishAvailable",
    "fishInHand","washerRunning","secretCollected","allEvidence","yarnInBasket","toolsInBox",
    "machineCovered","laserOff","laserManual","laserFollowing","vacuumOff","carrierEnabled","unloadSet",
    "dragging","fed","running","loaded","tipped","repaired","ownerPicked","dogPlayed","collapsed",
    "warning","sucking","gust","flat","noiseWarning","coverExposure","floorSeen","mintSeen","aiJump",
    "rearmHome","blockedByCat"}) do booleanFields[key]=true end
local function tree(value, depth)
    if depth > 40 then return false end
    if type(value) == "number" then return V.Finite(value) end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "boolean" end
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        if type(key) ~= "string" and type(key) ~= "number" or not tree(item, depth + 1)
            or numericFields[key] and not V.Finite(item)
            or booleanFields[key] and type(item)~="boolean" then return false end
    end
    return true
end
-- Definitions describe the required shapes of nested configuration, including
-- requirements lists; dynamic values (positions, timers, flags) may change.
local function shape(value, template)
    if type(value) ~= type(template) then return false end
    if type(template) ~= "table" then return true end
    for key, item in pairs(template) do if not shape(value[key], item) then return false end end
    return true
end
function V.Checkpoint(snapshot, level)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or not tree(snapshot, 0) then return false end
    if not numbers(snapshot, {"active", "elapsed", "clock", "switches", "nextBallId"})
        or snapshot.active % 1 ~= 0 or snapshot.active < 1 or snapshot.active > 3
        or snapshot.elapsed < 0 or snapshot.clock < 0 or snapshot.nextBallId % 1 ~= 0
        or not booleans(snapshot, {"started", "won"}) then return false end
    if type(snapshot.sheep) ~= "table" or #snapshot.sheep ~= 3 or type(snapshot.balls) ~= "table" then return false end
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local cat = snapshot.sheep[i]
        if not numbers(cat, {"x", "y", "vx", "vy", "weight", "baseWeight", "weightBonus", "jumpHeight",
            "baseJumpHeight", "speed", "jump", "bodyH", "bodyW", "support", "coyote", "facing", "gait", "squash", "dx", "dy"})
            or not booleans(cat, {"carry", "grounded", "arrived", "napping"})
            or type(cat.name) ~= "string" or type(cat.color) ~= "table" or #cat.color < 3
            or cat.bodyH <= 0 or cat.bodyW <= 0 then return false end
        for j = 1, 3 do if not V.Finite(cat.color[j]) then return false end end
    end
    local ids, carriers = {}, {}
    local states = {world=true,carried=true,consumed=true,stored=true,installed=true,dustbin=true,
        inTransit=true,inWasher=true,lost=true}
    for _, ball in ipairs(snapshot.balls) do
        if not numbers(ball, {"id", "x", "y", "vx", "vy", "w", "weight", "amount"})
            or ball.id % 1 ~= 0 or ball.id < 1 or ids[ball.id] or ball.id >= snapshot.nextBallId
            or ball.w <= 0 or ball.amount < 0 or ball.weight < 0 or not states[ball.state]
            or type(ball.kind) ~= "string" or type(ball.source) ~= "string" then return false end
        ids[ball.id] = true
        if ball.carriedBy ~= nil then
            local index = ball.carriedBy
            if not V.Finite(index) or index % 1 ~= 0 or index < 1 or index > 3 or carriers[index]
                or ball.state ~= "carried" or not snapshot.sheep[index].carry then return false end
            carriers[index] = true
        end
        if ball.inTransit and not numbers(ball, {"transitTimer", "transitTarget"}) then return false end
        if ball.transitDuration~=nil and (ball.transitDuration<=0 or (ball.transitTimer or 0)>ball.transitDuration) then return false end
        if ball.ledger ~= nil then
            if type(ball.ledger) ~= "table" then return false end
            for source, units in pairs(ball.ledger) do
                if type(source) ~= "string" or not V.Finite(units) or units < 0 then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    for i, cat in ipairs(snapshot.sheep) do if cat.carry ~= (carriers[i] == true) then return false end end
    local c = snapshot.campaign
    if not numbers(c, {"lossUnits", "tutorialStep", "meowCooldown", "washerTimer", "ownerX", "ownerDir"})
        or type(c.attemptId) ~= "string" or type(c.inventoryTools) ~= "table"
        or not booleans(c, {"hasWool", "rescueGranted", "borrowed", "fishInHand", "fishAvailable", "washerRunning"})
        or type(c.machines) ~= "table" or type(c.platforms) ~= "table" or type(c.walls) ~= "table"
        or type(c.zones) ~= "table" or type(c.dog) ~= "table" or type(c.dog.phase) ~= "string"
        or not V.Finite(c.dog.timer) or not booleans(c.evidence or {}, {"yarnInBasket", "toolsInBox", "machineCovered"}) then return false end
    local def = require("CampaignLevels").Get(level) --[[@as table<string, any>?]]
    if not def or #c.machines ~= #(def.machines or {}) then return false end
    if c.secret~=nil and (not def.secret or not shape(c.secret,def.secret)) then return false end
    if c.secretTransit~=nil and (not numbers(c.secretTransit,{"timer","total","x","target"})
        or c.secretTransit.total<=0 or c.secretTransit.timer<0 or c.secretTransit.timer>c.secretTransit.total) then return false end
    local machines = {}
    for _, machine in ipairs(c.machines) do
        if type(machine) ~= "table" or type(machine.id) ~= "string" or machines[machine.id]
            or not numbers(machine, {"x", "timer", "remaining", "mode"})
            or not booleans(machine, {"active", "open", "pressed", "used"}) then return false end
        machines[machine.id] = machine
    end
    for _, definition in ipairs(def.machines or {}) do
        local machine = machines[definition.id]
        if not machine or machine.kind ~= definition.kind or not shape(machine, definition) then return false end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({"platforms", "walls", "zones"}) do
        if not shape(c[key], def[key] or {}) then return false end
        for _, item in ipairs(c[key]) do
            if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
            for _, field in ipairs({"x", "y", "w", "h", "x0", "x1", "sag", "lastLift"}) do
                if item[field] ~= nil and not V.Finite(item[field]) then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    if def.finale then
        local f = c.finale
        if type(f) ~= "table" or type(f.timers) ~= "table" or type(f.completed) ~= "table"
            or not numbers(f.owner, {"x", "dir", "alertTimer", "distracted"})
            or not numbers(f.vacuum, {"paperTimer"}) or type(f.vacuum.warning) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        for id, timer in pairs(f.timers) do if not machines[id] or not V.Finite(timer) then return false end end
        if f.owner.warningCat ~= nil and (not V.Finite(f.owner.warningCat)
            or not snapshot.sheep[f.owner.warningCat]) then return false end
    end
    return true
end
return V
Tutorial:
-- 公共层·玩家引导框架三件套：①开场字幕（第N天·房间）②教学气泡（按序/可跳过/按键双标）③危险警告词（⚠）
-- 文案由各关分关提示词提供；本模块只提供机制与触发器。
local I18n = require("I18n")
local Input = require("InputState")
local Guide = {}

local state_ = {
    opening = nil,      -- {title, sub, t, dur}
    bubbles = {},       -- [{id, when, trigger, text, done, timer}]
    cursor = 1,
    warned = {},        -- [id]=true 一次性
    skipped = false,
}

local function keyHint(name)
    return Input.KeyHint(name)
end

local function openingTitle(level, def)
    if def.hidden then return I18n.T("hiddenTag") end
    if def.day then return I18n.T("day", def.day) end
    return I18n.T("levelFmt", level, def.room or def.name or "")
end

-- 开场只保留日期/关卡编号。房间由环境标志物表达，不显示地点或解法副标题。
---@param level integer
---@param def table {day, room, hidden, subtitle, name}
function Guide.Opening(level, def)
    if def == nil then return end
    state_.opening = { title = openingTitle(level,def), sub = "", t = 0, dur = 2.2,
        level=level, def={hidden=def.hidden,day=def.day,room=def.room,name=def.name} }
end

function Guide.RefreshLanguage()
    local opening=state_.opening
    if opening and opening.def then opening.title=openingTitle(opening.level,opening.def) end
end

function Guide.OpeningText()
    local o = state_.opening
    if not o then return nil end
    local a = math.min(1, o.t / 0.4)
    local fade = o.t > o.dur - 0.5 and math.max(0, (o.dur - o.t) / 0.5) or a
    if o.t >= o.dur then state_.opening = nil; return nil end
    return o.title, o.sub, fade
end

-- ② 教学气泡：按序触发。step = {id?, when="move"|"jump"|"action"|"switch"|"meow"|"undo"|"time"|nil,
--    delay?, text={zh,en} 或 i18n key}
-- 触发器由 Guide.Note("move") 等驱动（逻辑层在对应动作发生时调用）。
function Guide.SetBubbles(steps)
    state_.bubbles = {}
    for i, s in ipairs(steps or {}) do
        state_.bubbles[i] = { id = s.id or i, when = s.when, delay = s.delay or 0,
            text = s.text, done = false, timer = 0, trigger = false }
    end
    state_.cursor = 1
    state_.skipped = false
    state_.opening = state_.opening -- 开场与气泡独立
end

local function current()
    if state_.skipped then return nil end
    return state_.bubbles[state_.cursor]
end

function Guide.Note(action)
    local step = current()
    if step and step.when and step.when == action then step.trigger = true end
end

---@param dt number
function Guide.Update(dt)
    if state_.opening then
        state_.opening.t = state_.opening.t + dt
    end
    local step = current()
    if not step then return end
    if step.delay and step.delay > 0 then
        step.timer = step.timer + dt
        if step.timer < step.delay then return end
    end
    if step.when == nil or step.trigger then
        state_.cursor = state_.cursor + 1
    end
end

---@return string|nil 当前气泡文本（无则 nil）
function Guide.BubbleText()
    local step = current()
    if not step then return nil end
    local t = step.text
    if type(t) == "table" then return t[I18n.Get()] or t.zh end
    if type(t) == "string" then return I18n.TEXT[t] and I18n.T(t) or t end
    return nil
end

function Guide.Skip()
    state_.skipped = true
end

-- ③ 危险警告词：一次性弹出（⚠），由逻辑层在不可逆动作前调用
---@param id string
---@param text string|table {zh,en}
function Guide.WarnOnce(id, text)
    if state_.warned[id] then return false end
    state_.warned[id] = true
    return true
end

Guide.WARNINGS = {
    felt = { zh = "⚠ 泡水变毡球：总量保留，重量变4", en = "⚠ Felted: same yarn amount, weight becomes 4" },
    cut = { zh = "剪开为两半：总量保留，两半可织绳", en = "Cut into two halves: same amount; both can weave a rope" },
    swallow = { zh = "⚠ 吞线暂扣：3 天后才吐出毡球", en = "⚠ Swallowed: returned in 3 days" },
    fence = { zh = "⚠ 围栏单向：球进得去出不来", en = "⚠ One-way fence" },
    oneway = { zh = "⚠ 钉条过去即封死", en = "⚠ Ratchet seals behind you" },
    rat = { zh = "⚠ 老鼠私吞=永久损失（可喵叫吓退）", en = "⚠ Rats steal for good (meow scares)" },
    vacuum = { zh = "⚠ 吸尘器吸走无主球", en = "⚠ Vacuum sucks loose balls" },
    aquarium = { zh = "⚠ 翻缸水漫：高危险高回报", en = "⚠ Tank flood: risky reward" },
    curtain = { zh = "⚠ 第二次爬帘必塌（一次性）", en = "⚠ 2nd climb collapses the curtain" },
    blocked = { zh = "⚠ 此路不通", en = "⚠ Blocked" },
}

-- 文案查询（纯函数，不受"是否已弹过"影响）
function Guide.WarningText(id)
    local t = Guide.WARNINGS[id]
    if not t then return nil end
    return t[I18n.Get()] or t.zh
end

Guide.keyHint = keyHint
Guide.state = state_
Guide.Reset = function() state_.warned = {} end

return Guide
UIFactory:
-- 公共层·UIFactory：质感规范（Juice ①②）的统一控件工厂
-- 按下瞬间：缩放 0.95 + 下移 2px + 阴影加深，松开 easeOutBack ~120ms 回弹；
-- 移动端 pointerType==touch 按下边沿 navigator.vibrate(10)（经 Sound.Vibrate，受 haptic 开关）；
-- PC 悬停：上浮 1px（hover 提亮）；🔒 锁定态不做下沉、仅播"噔"拒绝音。
local UI = require("urhox-libs/UI")
local Sound = require("AudioManager")
local I18n = require("I18n")
local Save = require("SaveStore")

local Craft = require("CraftArt")
local Factory = {}
local fontBases = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function rememberFont(widget,base)
    fontBases[widget]=base
    return widget
end

local PALETTE = {
    -- Warm wool-and-paper palette: clearer hierarchy without losing the handmade tone.
    paper = "#F4EBD8", ink = "#423E32", muted = "#696452", line = "#D8CDB7",
    green = "#5E7448", greenDark = "#4F6840", sage = "#E1E9D2", cream = "#FFF9EA",
    wool = "#C98B55", woolDark = "#9B643E", blush = "#E9C6AE",
}
Factory.P = PALETTE

local function pressAnim(widget)
    if Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion") then return end
    if not widget or not widget.Animate then return end
    widget:Animate({
        keyframes = {
            [0] = { scale = 1, translateY = 0 },
            [0.25] = { scale = 0.95, translateY = 2 },
            [0.6] = { scale = 0.97, translateY = 1 },
            [1] = { scale = 1, translateY = 0 },
        },
        duration = 0.2, easing = "easeOutBack", fillMode = "none",
    })
end
Factory.PressAnim = pressAnim

-- JuiceButton：继承 Button（复用 pressed/hover 背景与 SetDisabled），
-- 覆写透传基类 Widget 处理器，保证 props.onPointerDown/Up（触屏按键用）照常触发。
local JuiceButton = UI.Button:Extend("JuiceButton")

function JuiceButton:Render(ctx)
    UI.Button.Render(self,ctx)
    local l=self:GetAbsoluteLayout()
    Craft.Stitches(ctx,l.x+2,l.y+2,l.w-4,l.h-4,{162,137,101,85},10)
end

function JuiceButton:OnPointerDown(event)
    UI.Widget.OnPointerDown(self, event) -- 透传 props.onPointerDown
    if not event or self.props.disabled then return end
    if event:IsPrimaryAction() then
        self:SetState({ pressed = true })
        self:TransitionToStateBgColor()
        if self.props.juiceLocked then
            Sound.Reject()
        else
            pressAnim(self)
            if event:IsTouch() then Sound.Vibrate("light") end
        end
    end
end

function JuiceButton:OnPointerUp(event)
    UI.Widget.OnPointerUp(self, event) -- 透传 props.onPointerUp
    if event and event:IsPrimaryAction() then
        self:SetState({ pressed = false })
        self:TransitionToStateBgColor()
    end
end

function JuiceButton:OnPointerCancel(event)
    UI.Widget.OnPointerCancel(self, event)
    self:SetState({ pressed = false })
    self:TransitionToStateBgColor()
end

function JuiceButton:OnMouseEnter()
    UI.Button.OnMouseEnter(self)
    if not self.props.disabled and not self.props.juiceLocked then
        self:SetStyle({ translateY = -1 })
    end
end

function JuiceButton:OnMouseLeave()
    UI.Button.OnMouseLeave(self)
    self:SetStyle({ translateY = 0 })
end

-- 用法：Factory.Button(optsTable) 或 Factory.Button(text, onClick, extraTable)
function Factory.Button(...)
    local opts, cb, extra
    local first = select(1, ...)
    if type(first) == "table" then
        opts = first
    else
        opts = { text = first }
        if select("#", ...) >= 2 then
            local second = select(2, ...)
            if type(second) == "function" then
                cb = second
                extra = select(3, ...)
            else
                extra = second
            end
        end
        if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do opts[k] = v end end
        if cb then opts.onClick = cb end
    end
    local locked = opts.locked == true
    local props = {
        height = 38, fontSize = 10, borderRadius = 10, borderWidth = 1,
        borderColor = opts.border or PALETTE.line, backgroundColor = opts.bg or PALETTE.cream,
        textColor = opts.textColor or PALETTE.ink,
        hoverBackgroundColor = opts.hover or (opts.textColor==PALETTE.cream and PALETTE.greenDark or PALETTE.sage),
        pressedBackgroundColor = opts.pressed or (opts.textColor==PALETTE.cream and "#405633" or "#D3DEC1"),
        borderBottomWidth = 3, borderBottomColor = opts.borderBottom or "#C5B99F",
        shadowBlur = 7, shadowColor = { 72, 58, 38, 28 },
        paddingHorizontal = 14,
        juiceLocked = locked,
    }
    props.onClick = function(self, event)
        if locked then return end -- 锁定：OnPointerDown 已播"噔"
        if opts.sound ~= false then Sound.Click() end
        if opts.onClick then opts.onClick(self, event) end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(opts) do
        if k ~= "onClick" and k ~= "locked" and k ~= "sound" then props[k] = v end
    end
    local baseFont=math.max(12, props.fontSize or 12)
    props.fontSize = baseFont * ((Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("textScale")) or 1)
    props.focusable = true
    return rememberFont(JuiceButton(props),baseFont)
end

-- 可点击面板（卡片/圆钮通用）：直接走基类 props 回调 + Animate
function Factory.Panel(opts)
    local locked = opts.locked == true
    local props = {
        borderRadius = 12, borderWidth = 1, borderColor = opts.border or PALETTE.line,
        backgroundColor = opts.bg or PALETTE.cream, juiceLocked = locked,
        shadowBlur = 9, shadowColor = { 72, 58, 38, 24 },
        onPointerDown = function(event, widget)
            if not event:IsPrimaryAction() then return end
            if locked then
                Sound.Reject()
                return
            end
            pressAnim(widget)
            if event:IsTouch() then Sound.Vibrate("light") end
        end,
        onClick = function(self, event)
            if locked then return end
            Sound.Click()
            if opts.onClick then opts.onClick(self, event) end
        end,
    }
    for k, v in pairs(opts) do
        if k ~= "locked" and k ~= "onClick" then props[k] = v end
    end
    return UI.Panel(props)
end

Factory.Label = function(text, size, color, extra)
    local props = { text = text, fontSize = math.max(11,size or 12) * ((Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("textScale")) or 1), fontColor = color or PALETTE.ink }
    if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do props[k] = v end end
    local scale=(Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("textScale")) or 1
    return rememberFont(UI.Label(props),props.fontSize/scale)
end

Factory.Title = function(text, size, extra)
    local props = { text = text, fontSize = size or 21, fontColor = PALETTE.ink, fontWeight = "bold" }
    if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do props[k] = v end end
    local baseFont=props.fontSize
    props.fontSize=baseFont*((Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("textScale")) or 1)
    return rememberFont(UI.Label(props),baseFont)
end

function Factory.RefreshTextScale(widget)
    if not widget then return end
    local base=fontBases[widget]
    if base then widget:SetStyle({fontSize=base*((Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("textScale")) or 1)}) end
    for _,child in ipairs(widget:GetChildren()) do Factory.RefreshTextScale(child) end
end

-- 语言即时切换：登记刷新回调，返回解绑函数
local refreshers_ = {}
function Factory.OnLanguageChange(fn)
    refreshers_[#refreshers_ + 1] = fn
    return function()
        for i = #refreshers_, 1, -1 do
            if refreshers_[i] == fn then table.remove(refreshers_, i) end
        end
    end
end

function Factory.RefreshLanguage()
    for _, fn in ipairs(refreshers_) do pcall(fn) end
end

Factory.I18n = I18n
return Factory

-- 「毛线守恒 V2」场景美术：单屏房间，纯程序化矢量。覆盖 21 种机关 + 三态线团。
local Craft = require("CraftArt")
local Art = {}
local RoomTwoArt = require("RoomTwoArt")
local Room = require("WoolRoom")
local TAU = math.pi * 2
local INK = { 77, 74, 63, 255 }
local BASE_W_PX = function(unit) return 0.95 * unit end

-- 球色（owner 1..3；半球/毡球做降饱和/降明处理由调用处负责）
local YARNS = {
    { 214, 96, 76, 255 },
    { 88, 150, 110, 255 },
    { 94, 124, 190, 255 },
    { 200, 150, 90, 255 },
    { 150, 120, 180, 255 },
    { 110, 160, 160, 255 },
}

local function Color(c) return nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255) end
local function Shade(c, f, a)
    return { math.floor(c[1] * f + 0.5), math.floor(c[2] * f + 0.5),
        math.floor(c[3] * f + 0.5), a or c[4] or 255 }
end
local function Fill(ctx, color, outline)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgFill(ctx)
    if outline then nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(outline)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.7); nvgStroke(ctx) end
end
local function Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Ellipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x1, y1); nvgLineTo(ctx, x2, y2)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, width or 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Poly(ctx, points, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, points[1], points[2])
    for i = 3, #points, 2 do nvgLineTo(ctx, points[i], points[i + 1]) end
    nvgClosePath(ctx); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Tag(ctx, cx, cy, text, s, color)
    nvgFontSize(ctx, s or 7); nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans")
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER + NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, color or nvgRGBA(120, 110, 90, 220)); nvgText(ctx, cx, cy, text, nil)
end

-- 线团：kind=full 圆球；half 半球（切口）；felt 毡化缩小的毛疙瘩。
function Art.YarnBall(ctx, cx, cy, r, color, squash, kind)
    if kind=="rope" then
        -- Open coils leave visible negative space and identify a woven rope at HUD size.
        for coil=0,2 do
            nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgEllipse(ctx,cx,cy-r*.22+coil*r*.23,r*.7,r*.5)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx,Color(Shade(color,.58)));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,math.max(1.5,r*.22));nvgStroke(ctx)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx,Color(color));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,math.max(.8,r*.13));nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
        nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgMoveTo(ctx,cx+r*.65,cy+r*.26)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx,cx+r*.95,cy+r*.45,cx+r*.55,cy+r*.78,cx+r*.94,cy+r*.82)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx,Color(Shade(color,.65)));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,math.max(1,r*.13));nvgStroke(ctx)
        for strand=-1,1 do
            Line(ctx,cx+r*.9,cy+r*.82,cx+r*(1.02+strand*.06),cy+r*(.82+strand*.08),Shade(color,.8),.8)
        end
        return
    end
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    for i = 0, 44 do
        local angle = i / 44 * TAU
        local radial = 1 + (kind == "felt" and 0.025 or 0.012) * math.cos(angle * 8)
        local px = cx + math.cos(angle) * r * radial
        local py = cy + math.sin(angle) * r * radial * (squash or 1)
        if i == 0 then nvgMoveTo(ctx, px, py) else nvgLineTo(ctx, px, py) end
    end
    nvgClosePath(ctx)
    local fill = color
    if kind == "felt" then fill = Shade(color, 0.82) end
    Fill(ctx, fill, Shade(color, 0.62))
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2)
    if kind ~= "felt" then
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local offset=(i-3)*r*.22
            nvgBeginPath(ctx)
            nvgMoveTo(ctx,cx-r*.72,cy+offset-r*.25)
            nvgBezierTo(ctx,cx-r*.25,cy+offset-r*.6,cx+r*.4,cy+offset+r*.45,cx+r*.72,cy+offset+r*.18)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx,Color(Shade(color,.7,210)));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,math.max(.7,r*.065));nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
    end
    if kind == "felt" then
        for i = 1, 6 do
            nvgBeginPath(ctx)
            nvgCircle(ctx, cx + (i % 3 - 1) * r * 0.4, cy + ((i // 3) - 0.5) * r * 0.5, r * 0.1)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(Shade(color, 0.6, 160))); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 0.8); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
    if kind ~= "half" then
        Ellipse(ctx, cx - r * 0.32, cy - r * 0.38, r * 0.26, r * 0.15, { 255, 255, 252, 90 })
    end
    if kind == "half" then
        -- A wound cross-section reads as cut yarn without an opaque square mask.
        Ellipse(ctx,cx-r*.37,cy,r*.3,r*.87,Shade(color,1.12),Shade(color,.65))
        for ring=1,3 do
            nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgEllipse(ctx,cx-r*.37,cy,r*(.08+ring*.055),r*(.18+ring*.17))
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx,Color(Shade(color,.82,185)));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,.8);nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
        Line(ctx,cx-r*.55,cy+r*.56,cx-r*.75,cy+r*.85,Shade(color,.7),1)
    elseif kind=="decoy" then
        -- Sewn cloth toy: contrasting patch and X stitches work without a text label.
        Rect(ctx,cx-r*.36,cy-r*.35,r*.7,r*.62,r*.12,{235,208,157,240},Shade(color,.65))
        for i=-1,1 do
            local px=cx+i*r*.2
            Line(ctx,px-r*.06,cy-r*.12,px+r*.06,cy+r*.06,Shade(color,.55),.9)
            Line(ctx,px+r*.06,cy-r*.12,px-r*.06,cy+r*.06,Shade(color,.55),.9)
        end
    end
end
