-- ===== 家具 & 机关（每个 helper 用世界坐标，接收 ctx, left, ground, unit, game, LV） =====
local function Window(ctx, cx, by, w, h)
    local x, y = cx - w / 2, by - h
    Rect(ctx, x - 8, y - 8, w + 16, h + 16, 6, { 176, 141, 104, 255 }, { 130, 103, 72, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, 3, { 190, 219, 228, 255 })
    Ellipse(ctx, x + w * 0.68, y + h * 0.28, h * 0.1, h * 0.1, { 252, 229, 158, 255 })
    Line(ctx, cx, y, cx, y + h, { 176, 141, 104, 255 }, 4)
    Line(ctx, x, y + h * 0.5, x + w, y + h * 0.5, { 176, 141, 104, 255 }, 4)
    Rect(ctx, cx - w / 2 - 22, y - 14, w + 44, 7, 3, { 130, 103, 72, 255 })
end
local function Painting(ctx, cx, cy, s)
    Rect(ctx, cx - s / 2 - 4, cy - s / 2 - 4, s + 8, s + 8, 2, { 176, 141, 104, 255 }, { 126, 99, 68, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, cx - s / 2, cy - s / 2, s, s, 1, { 240, 234, 210, 255 })
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, cx - s * 0.4, cy + s * 0.32)
    nvgBezierTo(ctx, cx - s * 0.1, cy - s * 0.15, cx + s * 0.15, cy + s * 0.05, cx + s * 0.42, cy - s * 0.2)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(139, 158, 116, 255)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 3); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Bookshelf(ctx, x, ground, w, h)
    Rect(ctx, x, ground - h, w, h, 2, { 147, 106, 66, 255 }, { 112, 80, 50, 255 })
    local bk = { { 190, 102, 90, 255 }, { 118, 148, 106, 255 }, { 116, 132, 172, 255 }, { 214, 168, 96, 255 } }
    local bi = 1
    for row = 0, 2 do
        local sy = ground - h + 8 + row * (h - 14) / 3
        local bx = x + 6
        while bx < x + w - 12 and bi <= #bk do
            local bw = 6 + (bi % 3) * 3
            Rect(ctx, bx, sy + 3, bw, (h - 14) / 3 - 9, 1, bk[bi]); bx = bx + bw + 3; bi = bi + 1
        end
    end
end
local function Plant(ctx, x, ground, s)
    Rect(ctx, x - s * 0.24, ground - s * 0.34, s * 0.48, s * 0.34, 3, { 176, 98, 62, 255 }, { 130, 70, 44, 255 })
    for i = 1, 5 do
        local a = -0.9 + i * 0.42
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x, ground - s * 0.32)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx, x + math.cos(a) * s * 0.25, ground - s * 0.8, x + math.cos(a) * s * 0.62, ground - s * 1.0, x + math.cos(a) * s * 0.82, ground - s * 1.28)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(104, 142, 92, 255)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, s * 0.14); nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
end

function Art.Scene(ctx, game, l, metrics)
    if game.def.profile == "seesaw-room" then
        return require("RoomThreeArt").Scene(ctx, game, l, metrics)
    end
    local x, y, w, h = l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h
    local unit, left, ground = metrics.unit, metrics.left, metrics.ground
    local LV = game.def
    local function wx(m) return left + m * unit end
    local function gy(m) return ground - m * unit end
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, x, y, w, h)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgRect(ctx, x, y, w, h)
    nvgFillPaint(ctx, nvgLinearGradient(ctx, x, y, x, ground, nvgRGBA(241, 229, 203, 255), nvgRGBA(235, 220, 190, 255)))
    nvgFill(ctx)
    for i = 0, 8 do Line(ctx, x + i * w / 8, y, x + i * w / 8, ground, { 226, 210, 178, 70 }, 1) end
    Window(ctx, wx(2.4), gy(1.5), 1.8 * unit, 1.3 * unit)
    Painting(ctx, wx(9.4), gy(2.6), 0.7 * unit)
    if not LV.wallX and LV.profile ~= "cat-hole-room" and LV.profile ~= "scissors-room" then
        Bookshelf(ctx, wx(12.6), ground, 1.0 * unit, 1.6 * unit)
    end
    Plant(ctx, wx(0.5), ground, 0.7 * unit)

    -- 地板
    Rect(ctx, x, ground, w, h, 0, { 203, 158, 106, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, x, ground, w, 6, 0, { 216, 175, 122, 255 })
    Rect(ctx, x, ground - 7, w, 7, 0, { 166, 128, 84, 255 })
    for i = 1, 26 do Line(ctx, x + ((i * 97.31) % w), ground + 6, x + ((i * 97.31) % w), y + h, { 172, 128, 80, 235 }, 1.2) end

    -- 第4关新机关复用场景背景和猫咪绘制，放在同一机关层。
    if LV.profile == "scissors-room" then require("RoomFourArt").Scene(ctx, game, metrics) end

    -- 教学浅坑：实体底面与绘制轮廓一致，斜坡允许直接步行。
    if LV.practicePit then
        local pit = LV.practicePit
        local p0, p1 = wx(pit.x), wx(pit.x + pit.w)
        local bottom = gy(-pit.depth)
        Poly(ctx, { p0, ground - 7, p1, ground - 7,
            wx(pit.x + pit.w - pit.rampW), bottom, wx(pit.x + pit.rampW), bottom },
            { 235, 220, 190, 255 })
        local edges = { { p0, ground - 2 }, { wx(pit.x + pit.rampW), bottom },
            { wx(pit.x + pit.w - pit.rampW), bottom }, { p1, ground - 2 } }
        for i = 1, 3 do Line(ctx, edges[i][1], edges[i][2], edges[i + 1][1], edges[i + 1][2], { 166, 128, 84, 255 }, 5) end
        Tag(ctx, (p0 + p1) / 2, bottom + 14, "练习浅坑 · 无危险", 9)
    end

    -- 触发式按钮与木门，来自同一组可复用机关数据。
    if LV.profile == "tutorial-room" then
        for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
            if machine.kind == "button" then
                local sx, sw = wx(machine.x), machine.w * unit
                Rect(ctx, sx - 4, ground - 5, sw + 8, 7, 3, { 133, 109, 79, 255 })
                Rect(ctx, sx, ground - (machine.activated and 2 or 10), sw, machine.activated and 3 or 10, 3,
                    machine.activated and { 124, 157, 93, 255 } or { 222, 163, 103, 255 }, { 130, 98, 68, 255 })
                Tag(ctx, sx + sw / 2, ground - 25, machine.activated and "A · 已触发" or "按钮 A · 踩一次", 9)
            elseif machine.kind == "woodDoor" then
                local dx, dw, dh = wx(machine.x), machine.w * unit, machine.h * unit
                Rect(ctx, dx - 7, ground - dh - 6, dw + 14, 8, 3, { 138, 103, 70, 255 })
                nvgSave(ctx)
                nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, dx - 3, ground - dh, dw + 6, dh)
                local top = ground - dh - machine.lift * dh
                Rect(ctx, dx, top, dw, dh, 3, { 193, 143, 94, 255 }, { 132, 95, 63, 255 })
                for k = 1, 6 do Line(ctx, dx + 2, top + k * dh / 7, dx + dw - 2, top + k * dh / 7, { 158, 116, 77, 255 }, 1.5) end
                nvgRestore(ctx)
                Tag(ctx, dx + dw / 2, ground - dh - 20, machine.open and "木门 · 已打开" or "木门", 9)
            end
        end
    end

    -- 猫窝
    local nest = (LV.profile == "tutorial-room" or LV.profile == "scissors-room") and Room.Machine(game, "nest") or nil
    local bx = wx(nest and nest.x + nest.w / 2 or (LV.homeX or 26) + 1.1)
    Ellipse(ctx, bx, ground - 1, 1.35 * unit, 0.4 * unit, { 246, 240, 200, 120 })
    Ellipse(ctx, bx, ground - 6, 1.2 * unit, 0.4 * unit, { 216, 186, 148, 255 }, { 158, 130, 100, 255 })
    Ellipse(ctx, bx, ground - 12, (nest and 1.45 or 0.92) * unit, 0.26 * unit, { 236, 212, 176, 255 })
    if nest and LV.profile ~= "scissors-room" then Tag(ctx, bx, ground - 1.7 * unit, "猫窝 · 全员回家", 10) end

    -- 蹭线柱
    if LV.shearX0 then
        local pmid = wx((LV.shearX0 + LV.shearX1) / 2)
        Rect(ctx, pmid - 0.14 * unit, gy(3.2), 0.28 * unit, 3.2 * unit, 5, { 216, 179, 128, 255 }, { 148, 116, 78, 255 })
        for yy = 0.4, 3.0, 0.24 do Line(ctx, pmid - 0.14 * unit, gy(yy), pmid + 0.14 * unit, gy(yy - 0.12), { 190, 152, 102, 255 }, 2) end
        Rect(ctx, pmid - 0.5 * unit, ground - 0.16 * unit, 1.0 * unit, 0.16 * unit, 4, { 160, 122, 82, 255 }, { 120, 92, 60, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, pmid - 34, gy(3.5) - 16, 68, 15, 7, { 250, 246, 228, 235 }, { 150, 148, 118, 255 })
        Tag(ctx, pmid, gy(3.5) - 8, "蹭线柱", 8)
    end

    -- 猫洞矮墙（下缝 0.62）
    if LV.doorX then
        local dx, dw, gap = wx(LV.doorX), 0.5 * unit, 0.62 * unit
        Rect(ctx, dx - 8, gy(4.1), dw + 16, 4.1 * unit, 2, { 198, 166, 120, 80 })
        Rect(ctx, dx, gy(4.1), dw, 4.1 * unit - gap, 2, { 214, 178, 128, 255 }, { 158, 124, 82, 255 })
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, dx + dw / 2, ground - gap / 2 + 1, dw * 0.44, gap * 0.62); Fill(ctx, { 120, 96, 70, 90 })
        Tag(ctx, dx + dw / 2, gy(4.1) - 8, "猫洞·滚球过", 7)
    end

    -- 窄缝门（下缝 0.64，只钻空猫）
    if LV.slotX then
        local sx, sw, gapH = wx(LV.slotX), 0.5 * unit, 0.64 * unit
        Rect(ctx, sx - 6, gy(4.1), sw + 12, 4.1 * unit, 2, { 198, 166, 120, 80 })
        Rect(ctx, sx, gy(4.1), sw, 4.1 * unit - gapH, 2, { 214, 178, 128, 255 }, { 158, 124, 82, 255 })
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, sx + sw / 2, ground - gapH / 2, sw * 0.46, gapH * 0.46); Fill(ctx, { 120, 96, 70, 90 })
        Tag(ctx, sx + sw / 2, gy(4.1) - 8, "只钻空猫", 7)
    end

    -- 顶针感应门（戴毛蹭开）
    if LV.pinGateX then
        local gx, gw = wx(LV.pinGateX), 0.55 * unit
        Rect(ctx, gx - 8, gy(4.4), gw + 16, 6, 3, { 108, 92, 64, 255 })
        for i = 1, 3 do Ellipse(ctx, gx + gw * (i - 0.5) / 3, gy(4.4) + 9, 3, 3, { 250, 214, 120, 255 }, { 178, 140, 70, 255 }) end
        local lift = game.pinTimer > 0 and 1 or 0
        nvgSave(ctx); nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, gx - 1, gy(4.0), gw + 2, 4.0 * unit)
        Rect(ctx, gx, gy(4.0) - lift * 3.9 * unit, gw, 4.0 * unit, 1, { 210, 190, 200, 255 }, { 138, 118, 130, 255 })
        nvgRestore(ctx)
        Tag(ctx, gx + gw / 2, gy(4.6) - 4, game.pinTimer > 0 and "感应中!" or "戴毛来蹭", 7)
    end

    -- 压力键盘
    local function DrawPlate(px0, pw, need, weight, hold, lit)
        local sink = math.min(3, weight)
        Rect(ctx, px0 - 2, ground - 10 + sink, pw + 4, 11, 3, { 72, 78, 88, 255 }, { 46, 50, 58, 255 })
        for k = 0, 11 do
            local kx = px0 + 4 + k * (pw - 10) / 12
            Rect(ctx, kx, ground - 8 + sink, (pw - 10) / 12 - 2.5, 6, 1.5,
                lit and { 158, 214, 130, 255 } or { 122, 130, 142, 255 })
        end
        Tag(ctx, px0 + pw / 2, ground - 16, hold and ("压住门才开·需" .. need) or ("承重" .. need .. "·猫1球按重量"), 7)
    end
    if LV.plateX and LV.profile ~= "cat-hole-room" then
        DrawPlate(wx(LV.plateX), LV.plateW * unit, LV.plateNeed, game:PlateWeight(), LV.plateHold, game:GateOpen(1))
    end
    if LV.plateX2 then
        DrawPlate(wx(LV.plateX2), LV.plateW2 * unit, LV.plateNeed2, game:PlateWeight2(), false, game.latched2)
    end
    if LV.platePinX then
        local px = wx(LV.platePinX)
        Rect(ctx, px - 6, ground - 26, 12, 26, 3, { 206, 178, 128, 255 }, { 150, 120, 78, 255 })
        Ellipse(ctx, px, ground - 30, 7, 6, game.latched and { 150, 200, 130, 255 } or { 224, 150, 110, 255 }, { 140, 100, 70, 255 })
        Tag(ctx, px, ground - 42, game.latched and "已锁门" or "拍顶针锁门", 7)
    end

    -- 跷跷板
    if LV.seesawX then
        local cx = wx(LV.seesawX + 1.2)
        local tilt = game.seesawTilt or 0
        local ang = tilt * 0.14
        nvgSave(ctx)
        Poly(ctx, { cx - 12, ground, cx + 12, ground, cx, ground - 22 }, { 150, 120, 84, 255 }, { 110, 84, 56, 255 })
        nvgTranslate(ctx, cx, ground - 22); nvgRotate(ctx, ang)
        Rect(ctx, -1.2 * unit, -6, 2.4 * unit, 6, 3, { 200, 168, 120, 255 }, { 140, 110, 74, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, -1.2 * unit, -8, 0.9 * unit, 3, 1, { 176, 140, 96, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, 0.3 * unit, -8, 0.9 * unit, 3, 1, { 176, 140, 96, 255 })
        nvgRestore(ctx)
        local L, R = game:SeesawWeights()
        Tag(ctx, cx, ground - 0.9 * unit - 34, string.format("跷跷板 %g : %g → 2:1", L, R), 8)
    end

    -- 吊门（主 gate + 第二 gate2）
    local function DrawGate(gx0, lift, open)
        local gw = 0.55 * unit
        Rect(ctx, gx0 - 20, gy(4.1) - 12, gw + 40, 6, 3, { 108, 92, 64, 255 })
        nvgSave(ctx); nvgIntersectScissor(ctx, gx0 - 1, gy(4.0), gw + 2, 4.0 * unit)
        local doorY = gy(4.0) - lift * 4.0 * unit
        Rect(ctx, gx0, doorY, gw, 4.0 * unit, 1, { 226, 216, 196, 255 }, { 158, 148, 126, 255 })
        for i = 1, 7 do Line(ctx, gx0 + 1, doorY + i * 0.45 * unit, gx0 + gw - 1, doorY + i * 0.45 * unit, { 200, 190, 168, 255 }, 1) end
        nvgRestore(ctx)
        Ellipse(ctx, gx0 + gw / 2, gy(4.1) - 4, 3, 3, open and { 168, 214, 130, 255 } or { 209, 180, 120, 255 })
    end
    if LV.gateX then DrawGate(wx(LV.gateX), game.gateLift, game:GateOpen(1)) end
    if LV.gateX2 then DrawGate(wx(LV.gateX2), game.gateLift2, game.latched2) end
    if LV.towerGateX then DrawGate(wx(LV.towerGateX), game.towerDone and 1 or 0, game.towerDone) end
    if LV.basketGateX then DrawGate(wx(LV.basketGateX), game.basketSet and 1 or 0, game.basketSet) end

    -- 立柜 + 顶开关
    if LV.wallX then
        local wx0, ww, wh = wx(LV.wallX), 1.8 * unit, (game.ramp and 0.52 or 1.75) * unit
        Rect(ctx, wx0, ground - wh, ww, wh, 3, { 168, 122, 84, 255 }, { 122, 88, 58, 255 })
        Line(ctx, wx0 + ww / 2, ground - wh + 6, wx0 + ww / 2, ground - 4, { 150, 108, 72, 255 }, 2)
        if LV.lever and not game.ramp then
            local pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(game.clock * 4)
            Ellipse(ctx, wx0 + ww / 2, ground - wh - 5, 6, 5, { 250, 214, 120, math.floor(255 * pulse) }, { 178, 140, 70, 255 })
        end
    end

    -- 猫爬架：立柱 + 三层板 + 顶开关
    if LV.towerX then
        local tx, tw = wx(LV.towerX), 1.3 * unit
        Rect(ctx, tx + 0.5 * unit, gy(1.75), 0.16 * unit, 1.75 * unit, 3, { 216, 186, 148, 255 }, { 158, 130, 96, 255 })
        local shelves = { { tx, 0.45, 1.3 }, { tx + 0.15, 1.05, 1.1 }, { tx + 0.3, 1.65, 0.9 } }
        for _, sh in ipairs(shelves) do
            Rect(ctx, wx(sh[1]), gy(sh[2]), sh[3] * unit, 0.1 * unit, 3, { 196, 164, 126, 255 }, { 140, 112, 80, 255 })
        end
        if not game.towerDone then
            Ellipse(ctx, wx(LV.towerX + 0.75), gy(1.72), 5, 4, { 250, 214, 120, 255 }, { 178, 140, 70, 255 })
        end
        Tag(ctx, tx + tw / 2, gy(1.9) - 8, "猫爬架", 7)
    end

    -- 猫抓板弹床
    if LV.trampolineX then
        local px, pw = wx(LV.trampolineX), LV.trampolineW * unit
        Rect(ctx, px, ground - 0.26 * unit, pw, 0.26 * unit, 4, { 214, 178, 128, 255 }, { 150, 120, 80, 255 })
        for i = 1, 4 do
            nvgBeginPath(ctx)
            nvgMoveTo(ctx, px + i * pw / 5, ground - 0.26 * unit)
            for t = 0, 1, 0.2 do
                nvgLineTo(ctx, px + i * pw / 5 + math.sin(t * TAU + game.clock * 3) * 3, ground - 0.26 * unit + t * 0.26 * unit)
            end
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(180, 140, 90, 200)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
        Tag(ctx, px + pw / 2, ground - 0.26 * unit - 10, "弹床", 7)
    end

    -- 滚筒传送带
    if LV.conveyorX0 then
        local cx0, cx1 = wx(LV.conveyorX0), wx(LV.conveyorX1)
        local cyh = 0.14 * unit
        Rect(ctx, cx0 - 6, ground - cyh * 2, cx1 - cx0 + 12, cyh * 2, cyh, { 90, 96, 104, 255 }, { 60, 64, 70, 255 })
        local dir = LV.conveyorDir or 1
        local off = (game.clock * 40 * dir) % 20
        for rx = cx0 + off, cx1, 20 do
            Poly(ctx, { rx - 4 * dir, ground - 6, rx, ground - 3, rx - 4 * dir, ground }, { 150, 200, 140, 200 })
        end
        for i = 1, 5 do Ellipse(ctx, cx0 + i * (cx1 - cx0) / 6, ground - cyh, 4, 4, { 60, 64, 70, 255 }) end
    end

    -- 玩具火车
    if LV.trainX0 then
        local rail0, rail1 = wx(LV.trainX0), wx(LV.trainX1)
        Line(ctx, rail0, ground + 3, rail1, ground + 3, { 130, 120, 100, 200 }, 2)
        local cx0 = wx(game.trainX)
        Rect(ctx, cx0, ground - 0.26 * unit, 1.3 * unit, 0.12 * unit, 2, { 180, 90, 80, 255 }, { 130, 60, 55, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, cx0 + 0.8 * unit, ground - 0.5 * unit, 0.4 * unit, 0.24 * unit, 2, { 210, 130, 90, 255 }, { 150, 90, 60, 255 })
        for i = 1, 3 do Ellipse(ctx, cx0 + 0.25 * unit * i, ground - 0.1 * unit, 5, 5, { 60, 55, 50, 255 }, { 30, 28, 26, 255 }) end
        local puff = (game.clock * 30) % 40
        Ellipse(ctx, cx0 + 1.2 * unit, ground - 0.6 * unit - puff * 0.4, 4 + puff * 0.2, 4 + puff * 0.2, { 255, 255, 255, math.floor(90 - puff * 2) })
    end

    -- 毛絮水池（水碗）
    if LV.poolX0 then
        local p0, p1 = wx(LV.poolX0), wx(LV.poolX1)
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, (p0 + p1) / 2, ground - 2, (p1 - p0) / 2 + 8, 0.16 * unit)
        Fill(ctx, { 176, 141, 104, 255 }, { 130, 103, 72, 255 })
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, (p0 + p1) / 2, ground - 4, (p1 - p0) / 2, 0.11 * unit)
        Fill(ctx, { 150, 200, 220, 235 })
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local wx2 = p0 + (p1 - p0) * (0.25 + 0.25 * i)
            nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, wx2, ground - 4 + math.sin(game.clock * 2 + i) * 1.5, 6, 1.5)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(255, 255, 255, 130)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
        Tag(ctx, (p0 + p1) / 2, ground - 0.35 * unit, "水·球遇水缩水", 7)
    end

    -- 围栏锁球（缝 0.15 球滚不出）
    if LV.fenceX0 then
        local f0, f1 = wx(LV.fenceX0), wx(LV.fenceX1)
        Rect(ctx, f0, ground - 0.9 * unit, f1 - f0, 6, 1, { 190, 158, 122, 200 })
        for _, fx in ipairs({ f0 - 3, f0 + 3, f1 - 3, f1 + 3 }) do
            Rect(ctx, fx, ground - 0.9 * unit, 6, 0.9 * unit, 2, { 160, 128, 92, 255 }, { 120, 92, 60, 255 })
        end
        Tag(ctx, (f0 + f1) / 2, ground - 0.9 * unit - 10, "围栏·球进得来出不去", 7)
    end

    -- 剪线刺帘
    if LV.thornX then
        local tx0, th = wx(LV.thornX), 0.4 * unit
        Rect(ctx, tx0 - 8, gy(1.6), th + 16, 8, 3, { 108, 92, 64, 255 })
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local spx = tx0 + (i - 0.5) * th / 4
            Line(ctx, spx, gy(1.6) + 8, spx, ground - 4, { 150, 120, 90, 220 }, 1.4)
            Poly(ctx, { spx - 2, ground - 0.4 * unit, spx + 2, ground - 0.4 * unit, spx, ground - 6 }, { 180, 130, 90, 255 })
            Poly(ctx, { spx - 2, ground - 0.9 * unit, spx + 2, ground - 0.9 * unit, spx, ground - 0.5 * unit }, { 180, 130, 90, 255 })
        end
        Tag(ctx, tx0 + th / 2, gy(1.7) - 8, "剪线刺", 7)
    end

    -- 吞线地垫（单行道）
    if LV.matX0 then
        local m0, m1 = wx(LV.matX0), wx(LV.matX1)
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, (m0 + m1) / 2, ground - 3, (m1 - m0) / 2, 0.13 * unit)
        Fill(ctx, { 128, 92, 132, 240 }, { 74, 56, 78, 255 })
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, (m0 + m1) / 2, ground - 6, (m1 - m0) / 2 - 7, 0.09 * unit); Fill(ctx, { 30, 22, 34, 255 })
        Tag(ctx, (m0 + m1) / 2, ground - 0.2 * unit, "吞线垫→" .. string.format("%g", LV.matOutX), 7)
    end

    -- 绑架地毯 + 死胡同 + 野猫
    if LV.rugX0 then
        local r0, r1 = wx(LV.rugX0), wx(LV.rugX1)
        Rect(ctx, r0, ground - 6, r1 - r0, 6, 2, { 200, 150, 150, 255 }, { 150, 100, 100, 255 })
        for i = 1, 5 do Line(ctx, r0 + i * (r1 - r0) / 6, ground - 6, r0 + i * (r1 - r0) / 6, ground, { 150, 100, 100, 180 }, 1) end
        local timer = 0
        for _, t in ipairs(game.rugTimers or {}) do timer = math.max(timer, t) end
        if timer > 0.05 and not game.thief then
            nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgArc(ctx, (r0 + r1) / 2, ground - 14, 10, -math.pi / 2, -math.pi / 2 + timer / 2 * TAU, NVG_CW)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(210, 90, 80, 220)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 3); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
        Tag(ctx, (r0 + r1) / 2, ground - 0.4 * unit, "地毯·球停2秒", 7)
    end
    if LV.pocketX then
        local pk0, pk1 = wx(LV.pocketX), wx(LV.pocketX + LV.pocketW)
        Rect(ctx, pk0, ground - 0.7 * unit, 6, 0.7 * unit, 2, { 160, 128, 92, 255 }, { 120, 92, 60, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, pk1, ground - 0.7 * unit, 6, 0.7 * unit, 2, { 160, 128, 92, 255 }, { 120, 92, 60, 255 })
        Line(ctx, pk0, ground - 0.7 * unit, pk1, ground - 0.7 * unit, { 160, 128, 92, 200 }, 3)
        if game.thief then
            local th = game.thief
            local tx0 = wx(th.x)
            local wig = math.sin(game.clock * 18) * 2
            Poly(ctx, { tx0 - 6, ground - 12 + wig, tx0 + 6, ground - 12 + wig, tx0, ground - 4 + wig }, { 150, 110, 70, 255 })
            Poly(ctx, { tx0 - 6, ground - 12 + wig, tx0 - 9, ground - 20 + wig, tx0 - 2, ground - 14 + wig }, { 150, 110, 70, 255 })
            Poly(ctx, { tx0 + 6, ground - 12 + wig, tx0 + 9, ground - 20 + wig, tx0 + 2, ground - 14 + wig }, { 150, 110, 70, 255 })
            Ellipse(ctx, tx0, ground - 16 + wig, 6, 6, { 170, 130, 90, 255 })
        end
    end
    if LV.vacuumX0 then
        local v0, v1 = wx(LV.vacuumX0), wx(LV.vacuumX1)
        Rect(ctx, v0, ground - 0.5 * unit, v1 - v0, 0.5 * unit, 6, { 120, 130, 140, 255 }, { 80, 88, 96, 255 })
        Rect(ctx, (v0 + v1) / 2 - 4, ground - 0.7 * unit, 8, 0.2 * unit, 2, { 90, 96, 104, 255 })
        local ring = (game.clock * 2) % 1
        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgCircle(ctx, (v0 + v1) / 2, ground - 0.3 * unit, ring * 22)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(210, 120, 90, math.floor(150 * (1 - ring)))); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
        Tag(ctx, (v0 + v1) / 2, ground - 0.85 * unit, "吸尘器", 7)
    end

    -- 配重吊篮
    if LV.basketX then
        local bxc = wx(LV.basketX + 0.35)
        Line(ctx, bxc, gy(3.9), bxc, gy(2.2), { 120, 96, 60, 255 }, 2)
        Rect(ctx, bxc - 0.42 * unit, gy(2.2), 0.84 * unit, 0.5 * unit, 4,
            game.basketSet and { 196, 158, 108, 255 } or { 214, 184, 140, 255 }, { 140, 108, 70, 255 })
        if game.basketSet then
            for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
                if ball.inBasket then
                    Art.YarnBall(ctx, bxc, gy(1.9), ball.w / 2 * unit, YARNS[ball.owner], 1.0,
                        ball.felt and "felt" or (ball.kind == "half" and "half" or "full"))
                end
            end
        end
        Tag(ctx, bxc, gy(3.9) - 6, "吊篮", 7)
    end
    if LV.basketReleaseX then
        local rx = wx(LV.basketReleaseX)
        Rect(ctx, rx - 7, ground - 24, 14, 24, 3, { 200, 170, 120, 255 }, { 150, 120, 80, 255 })
        Ellipse(ctx, rx, ground - 26, 6, 5, { 214, 120, 100, 255 }, { 150, 80, 66, 255 })
        Tag(ctx, rx, ground - 38, "释放钮", 7)
    end

    -- 棘轮钉门
    if LV.oneWayX then
        local ox, ow = wx(LV.oneWayX), 0.18 * unit
        if not game.oneWayPassed then
            Rect(ctx, ox - 2, gy(3.6), ow + 4, 3.6 * unit, 2, { 200, 170, 130, 120 })
            for k = 1, 5 do
                Poly(ctx, { ox, gy((k - 0.5) * 0.62), ox + ow, gy((k - 0.75) * 0.62), ox + ow, gy((k - 0.25) * 0.62) }, { 150, 130, 96, 210 })
            end
        else
            Rect(ctx, ox - 2, gy(4.1), ow + 4, 4.1 * unit, 2, { 120, 96, 66, 255 }, { 84, 66, 44, 255 })
            for k = 1, 8 do
                Ellipse(ctx, ox + ow / 2 - 2, gy(k * 0.5), 1.6, 1.6, { 70, 60, 48, 255 })
                Ellipse(ctx, ox + ow / 2 + 2, gy((k - 0.5) * 0.5), 1.6, 1.6, { 70, 60, 48, 255 })
            end
        end
    end

    if LV.profile == "cat-hole-room" then RoomTwoArt.Machines(ctx, game, metrics) end

    -- 地上的线团（三态 + 可抱高亮 + 钓线）
    local cand = game:GrabCandidate(game.active)
    for i, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait then
            local bcx = wx(ball.x + ball.w / 2)
            if cand and cand.mode == "grab" and cand.ball == i then
                local rr = ball.w / 2 * unit * (1.45 + 0.1 * math.sin(game.clock * 5))
                nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, bcx, ground - ((ball.y or 0) + ball.w / 2) * unit, rr, rr * 0.9)
                nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, cand.blocked and 1.6 or 2.2)
                nvgStrokeColor(ctx, cand.blocked and nvgRGBA(214, 120, 100, 190) or nvgRGBA(255, 226, 140, 230))
                nvgStroke(ctx)
            end
            local kind = ball.felt and "felt" or (ball.kind == "half" and "half" or "full")
            local ballGround = ground - (ball.y or 0) * unit
            Art.YarnBall(ctx, bcx, ballGround - ball.w / 2 * unit, ball.w / 2 * unit, YARNS[ball.owner], 0.94, kind)
            if game.def.chase and ball.x + ball.w / 2 then
                -- 附近 AI 猫 → 画钓线
                for _, s in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                    if s.pullDir ~= 0 and math.abs(s.x + 0.475 - (ball.x + ball.w / 2)) < 3.2 then
                        nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, bcx, ground - ball.w * unit)
                        nvgBezierTo(ctx, bcx, gy(1.6), bcx + (s.pullDir > 0 and 12 or -12), gy(1.9), bcx, gy(2.2))
                        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(200, 150, 110, 140)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.2); nvgStroke(ctx)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 猫（戴球=按 ball 对象画）
    local drawOrder = { 1, 2, 3 }
    table.sort(drawOrder, function(a, b) return game.sheep[a].y > game.sheep[b].y end)
    for _, i in ipairs(drawOrder) do
        local s = game.sheep[i]
        local worn = s.carry and game:CarriedBall(i) or nil
        Art.Cat(ctx, wx(s.x), ground - s.y * unit, BASE_W_PX(unit), s.facing, s.color, s.gait,
            i == game.active and not s.arrived, game.clock, s.squash, worn, i, s.napping)
        if s.pullDir ~= 0 and not s.napping then
            nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgCircle(ctx, wx(s.x + 0.475), gy(s.y + 1.25), 4 + math.sin(game.clock * 6) * 1.2)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(214, 150, 96, 170)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.4); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(game.effects) do
        local alpha = math.floor(180 * e.life / e.maxLife)
        if e.kind == "wool" then
            Ellipse(ctx, wx(e.x), gy(e.y), 4, 4, { 255, 252, 240, alpha })
        elseif e.kind == "home" then
            Poly(ctx, { wx(e.x), gy(e.y), wx(e.x) + 4, gy(e.y) - 6, wx(e.x) + 8, gy(e.y) }, { 226, 200, 140, alpha })
        else
            Ellipse(ctx, wx(e.x), gy(e.y), 3, 2, { 228, 217, 167, alpha })
        end
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

return Art
WoolCats:
-- 公共层·三只猫外观规范（skill 锁定，全项目唯一来源，各关禁止另起一套）
-- 汤圆=橘猫 体重3 跳1格 圆胖/奶油肚/虎斑/粗蓬尾/憨厚
-- 煤球=黑猫 体重2 跳2格 修长/亮黑冷高光/胸口漏白/黄绿杏眼/机敏
-- 奶盖=白猫 体重1 跳1格 幼态蓬松/奶白/头顶尾尖浅灰斑/最大眼/蓝灰瞳/懵懂
-- 剪影一眼可分辨：圆胖矮宽 / 瘦长高挑 / 小团大耳。
local Craft = require("CraftArt")
local Save = require("SaveStore")
local Cats = {}
local TAU = math.pi * 2

local function Color(c) return nvgRGBA(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4] or 255) end
local function Shade(c, f, a)
    return { math.floor(c[1] * f + 0.5), math.floor(c[2] * f + 0.5),
        math.floor(c[3] * f + 0.5), a or c[4] or 255 }
end
local function Fill(ctx, color, outline)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgFill(ctx)
    if outline then nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(outline)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.7); nvgStroke(ctx) end
end
local function Ellipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Line(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, x1, y1); nvgLineTo(ctx, x2, y2)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(color)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, width or 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
end
local function Poly(ctx, points, color, outline)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgMoveTo(ctx, points[1], points[2])
    for i = 3, #points, 2 do nvgLineTo(ctx, points[i], points[i + 1]) end
    nvgClosePath(ctx); Fill(ctx, color, outline)
end
local function Tag(ctx, cx, cy, text, s, color)
    nvgFontSize(ctx, s or 7); nvgFontFace(ctx, "sans")
    nvgTextAlign(ctx, NVG_ALIGN_CENTER + NVG_ALIGN_MIDDLE)
    nvgFillColor(ctx, color or nvgRGBA(120, 110, 90, 220)); nvgText(ctx, cx, cy, text, nil)
end

-- 外观档案（与数值绑定；fur 供旧调用方兜底，主体按 index 取档案）
Cats.SPEC = {
    { name = "汤圆", weight = 3, jumpHeight = 1, bodyH = 1.0,
        fur = { 232, 156, 82, 255 }, dark = { 199, 122, 56, 255 }, belly = { 248, 226, 186, 255 },
        eye = { 240, 196, 84, 255 }, eyeRim = { 66, 52, 34, 255 }, nose = { 224, 138, 140, 255 },
        innerEar = { 236, 178, 160, 255 }, stripes = { 205, 126, 58, 255 }, patch = nil,
        tail = "fluffy", build = "round", expression = "憨厚" },
    { name = "煤球", weight = 2, jumpHeight = 2, bodyH = 0.62,
        fur = { 58, 60, 64, 255 }, dark = { 38, 40, 44, 255 }, belly = { 96, 98, 104, 255 },
        eye = { 196, 214, 96, 255 }, eyeRim = { 24, 26, 28, 255 }, nose = { 210, 130, 140, 255 },
        innerEar = { 226, 156, 160, 255 }, stripes = nil, patch = { 244, 242, 236, 255 },
        tail = "thin", build = "sleek", expression = "机敏" },
    { name = "奶盖", weight = 1, jumpHeight = 1, bodyH = 0.58,
        fur = { 246, 239, 226, 255 }, dark = { 214, 206, 190, 255 }, belly = { 252, 248, 240, 255 },
        eye = { 138, 162, 196, 255 }, eyeRim = { 88, 96, 110, 255 }, nose = { 232, 158, 160, 255 },
        innerEar = { 240, 190, 190, 255 }, stripes = nil, patch = { 210, 210, 218, 255 },
        tail = "pom", build = "chubby-baby", expression = "懵懂" },
}

local INK = { 70, 64, 52, 255 }

local function Eyes(ctx, spec, cx, cy, rx, ry, blink, mood)
    if blink then
        Line(ctx, cx - rx * 1.1, cy, cx + rx * 1.1, cy, spec.eyeRim, math.max(1.4, rx * 0.5))
        return
    end
    -- 大眼带高光（幼态）；瞳孔竖向随情绪微缩
    Ellipse(ctx, cx, cy, rx, ry, { 252, 250, 244, 255 })
    local pw = rx * (mood == "alert" and 0.42 or 0.55)
    Ellipse(ctx, cx, cy, pw, ry * 0.78, spec.eye)
    Ellipse(ctx, cx, cy + ry * 0.08, pw * 0.42, ry * 0.52, spec.eyeRim)
    Ellipse(ctx, cx - pw * 0.3, cy - ry * 0.3, rx * 0.2, ry * 0.16, { 255, 255, 255, 235 })
    Ellipse(ctx, cx + pw * 0.35, cy + ry * 0.28, rx * 0.09, ry * 0.07, { 255, 255, 255, 170 })
end

-- 通用：尾巴。fluffy=粗蓬（橘）；thin=细长微翘（黑）；pom=蓬松小绒球（白）
local function Tail(ctx, spec, bx, by, bodyW, clock)
    local sway = math.sin(clock * 1.7) * bodyW * 0.04
    if spec.tail == "fluffy" then
        nvgBeginPath(ctx)
        nvgMoveTo(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.34, by + bodyW * 0.02)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.66, by - bodyW * 0.06,
            bx - bodyW * 0.72 + sway, by - bodyW * 0.5,
            bx - bodyW * 0.5 + sway, by - bodyW * 0.66)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(spec.dark)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, bodyW * 0.17); nvgStroke(ctx)
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local t = 0.25 + i * 0.2
            local px = bx - bodyW * (0.5 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 3))
            local py = by - bodyW * (0.12 + t * 0.5)
            Line(ctx, px - bodyW * 0.05, py, px + bodyW * 0.06, py - bodyW * 0.05, Shade(spec.stripes, 0.9, 220), 2)
        end
    elseif spec.tail == "thin" then
        nvgBeginPath(ctx)
        nvgMoveTo(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.32, by)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.7, by - bodyW * 0.02,
            bx - bodyW * 0.86 + sway * 1.6, by - bodyW * 0.42,
            bx - bodyW * 0.68 + sway * 2, by - bodyW * 0.72)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color({ 44, 46, 50, 255 })); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, bodyW * 0.06); nvgStroke(ctx)
    else
        nvgBeginPath(ctx)
        nvgMoveTo(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.3, by - bodyW * 0.04)
        nvgBezierTo(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.55, by - bodyW * 0.1,
            bx - bodyW * 0.6 + sway, by - bodyW * 0.36,
            bx - bodyW * 0.48 + sway, by - bodyW * 0.5)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(spec.dark)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, bodyW * 0.1); nvgStroke(ctx)
        Ellipse(ctx, bx - bodyW * 0.47 + sway, by - bodyW * 0.54, bodyW * 0.11, bodyW * 0.1,
            spec.patch)
    end
end

local function Ears(ctx, spec, hx, hy, bodyW, clock, twitch)
    local earH=bodyW*(spec.build=="chubby-baby" and .34 or .26)
    local tw = math.sin(clock * 2.3 + hx) * twitch
    Poly(ctx, { hx - bodyW * 0.12, hy - earH * 0.75,
        hx - bodyW * 0.05 + tw, hy - earH,
        hx + bodyW * 0.03, hy - earH * 0.7 }, spec.fur, spec.dark)
    Poly(ctx, { hx + bodyW * 0.06, hy - earH * 0.72,
        hx + bodyW * 0.14, hy - earH * 0.96 + tw,
        hx + bodyW * 0.2, hy - earH * 0.66 }, spec.fur, spec.dark)
    Poly(ctx, { hx - bodyW * 0.09, hy - earH * 0.74,
        hx - bodyW * 0.045 + tw, hy - earH * 0.9,
        hx + bodyW * 0.005, hy - earH * 0.72 }, spec.innerEar)
end

-- 主绘制：签名与 WoolArt.Cat 完全一致，index 决定物种外观
---@param ctx NVGcontext
function Cats.Draw(ctx, x, feetY, bodyW, facing, fur, gait, selected, clock, squash, ball, index, napping, pose)
    local spec = Cats.SPEC[index] or Cats.SPEC[1]
    local h = bodyW * (spec.build == "round" and 0.74 or spec.build == "sleek" and 0.58 or 0.55)
    clock = (Save.GetSetting and Save.GetSetting("reducedMotion")) and 0 or (clock or 0)
    gait = gait or 0
    nvgSave(ctx)
    nvgTranslate(ctx, x + bodyW / 2, feetY)
    nvgScale(ctx, facing, 1)
    local breath = math.sin(clock * 1.6 + x) * 1.1 -- 待机呼吸微动
    local blink = math.sin(clock * 0.53 + x * 0.37) > 0.994
    local twitch = spec.build == "sleek" and 1.5 or 0.8
    if napping then
        local nh = bodyW * (spec.build == "round" and 0.46 or 0.42)
        Ellipse(ctx, 0, -nh * 0.5 + breath * 0.4, bodyW * (spec.build == "round" and 0.5 or 0.44),
            nh * 0.55, spec.fur, spec.dark)
        Poly(ctx, { -bodyW * 0.34, -nh * 0.7, -bodyW * 0.2, -nh * 1.32, -bodyW * 0.1, -nh * 0.75 }, spec.fur, spec.dark)
        Poly(ctx, { bodyW * 0.1, -nh * 0.75, bodyW * 0.2, -nh * 1.32, bodyW * 0.34, -nh * 0.7 }, spec.fur, spec.dark)
        if pose and pose.peek then
            Eyes(ctx,spec,bodyW*.1,-nh*.5,bodyW*.045,bodyW*.055,false,"alert")
            Eyes(ctx,spec,-bodyW*.1,-nh*.5,bodyW*.045,bodyW*.055,false,"alert")
        else
            Line(ctx, bodyW * 0.04, -nh * 0.5, bodyW * 0.15, -nh * 0.5, INK, 1.5)
            Line(ctx, -bodyW * 0.15, -nh * 0.5, -bodyW * 0.04, -nh * 0.5, INK, 1.5)
        end
        Ellipse(ctx, 0, -nh * 0.34, bodyW * 0.05, bodyW * 0.04, spec.nose)
        if index==1 then
            Ellipse(ctx,bodyW*.38,-nh*.14,bodyW*.14,bodyW*.055,spec.belly,spec.dark)
        elseif index==2 then
            nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgArc(ctx,bodyW*.18,-nh*.35,bodyW*.21,-1,2.3,NVG_CW)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx,Color(spec.dark));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,bodyW*.07);nvgStroke(ctx)
        else
            Ellipse(ctx,-bodyW*.3,-nh*.24,bodyW*.11,bodyW*.065,spec.patch)
        end
        local tailOut=1-(pose and pose.tailTuck or 1)
        if tailOut>0 then Line(ctx,-bodyW*.4,-nh*.25,-bodyW*(.4+tailOut*.25),-nh*.18,spec.dark,bodyW*.08) end
        local zzz = math.sin(clock * 2)
        if not pose or not pose.peek then Tag(ctx, bodyW * 0.44, -nh - 8 + zzz * 3, "z", 9 + zzz, { 150, 140, 110, 200 }) end
        if selected then
            nvgBeginPath(ctx); nvgEllipse(ctx, 0, -nh * 0.5, bodyW * 0.54, nh * 0.62)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(120, 150, 80, 150)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 1.4); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
        nvgRestore(ctx)
        return
    end
    local bounce = math.sin(gait * 2) * math.min(2, math.abs(gait) * 0.04)
    local sq = squash or 0
    local bodyY = -h * 0.52 + bounce + breath * 0.4
    local puffX, puffY = 1 + sq * 0.5, 1 - sq * 0.55
    -- 影子
    Ellipse(ctx, 0, 2, bodyW * 0.42, 3.4, { 59, 55, 47, 30 })
    if selected then
        nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgEllipse(ctx,0,1,bodyW*.52,math.max(3,bodyW*.10))
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx,nvgRGBA(224,183,102,220));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,1.8);nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
    -- 腿（橘=短粗 / 黑=细长 / 白=短圆）
    local legW = spec.build == "sleek" and 0.05 or spec.build == "round" and 0.075 or 0.07
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local legX = -bodyW * 0.24 + (i - 1) * bodyW * 0.145
        local swing = math.sin(gait + i * math.pi) * (spec.build == "chubby-baby" and 2 or 3)
        Line(ctx, legX, -h * 0.2, legX + swing, -3, spec.dark, math.max(2.2, bodyW * legW))
        Ellipse(ctx, legX + swing, -3, bodyW * 0.045, 2.6, spec.fur, spec.dark)
    end
    Tail(ctx, spec, 0, bodyY, bodyW, clock)
    -- 身体：椭圆 + 边缘光 + 肚皮浅一档
    nvgBeginPath(ctx)
    local rx = bodyW * (spec.build == "round" and 0.47 or spec.build == "sleek" and 0.36 or 0.4)
    local ry = h * (spec.build == "round" and 0.37 or spec.build == "sleek" and 0.3 or 0.33)
    for i = 0, 56 do
        local angle = i / 56 * TAU
        local radial = 1 + (spec.build == "chubby-baby" and 0.035 or 0.02) * math.cos(angle * 10)
        local px = math.cos(angle) * rx * radial * puffX
        local py = bodyY + math.sin(angle) * ry * radial * puffY
        if i == 0 then nvgMoveTo(ctx, px, py) else nvgLineTo(ctx, px, py) end
    end
    nvgClosePath(ctx)
    Fill(ctx, spec.fur, spec.dark)
    nvgBeginPath(ctx);nvgArc(ctx,0,bodyY,rx*.82,-2.8,-.8,NVG_CW)
    nvgStrokeColor(ctx,nvgRGBA(245,230,204,100));nvgStrokeWidth(ctx,math.max(1,bodyW*.025));nvgStroke(ctx)
    Ellipse(ctx, bodyW * 0.12, bodyY + ry * 0.35, rx * 0.5, ry * 0.5, Shade(spec.belly, 1, 235))
    if spec.stripes then -- 虎斑：背/尾深，腹浅
        for i = 1, 3 do
            nvgBeginPath(ctx)
            nvgArc(ctx, -bodyW * 0.06 + (i - 2) * bodyW * 0.13, bodyY - h * 0.05, h * 0.26,
                -2.5, -0.7, NVG_CW)
            nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(Shade(spec.stripes, 0.92, 235))); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 2.4); nvgStroke(ctx)
        end
    end
    if spec.build == "sleek" then -- 冷调高光
        nvgBeginPath(ctx)
        nvgArc(ctx, 0, bodyY, rx * 0.8, -2.6, -1.2, NVG_CW)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, nvgRGBA(150, 162, 178, 70)); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, 2); nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
    if spec.patch and spec.build == "sleek" then -- 煤球胸口漏白
        Ellipse(ctx, bodyW * 0.2, bodyY + ry * 0.2, rx * 0.16, ry * 0.22, spec.patch)
    end
    -- 头（幼态 1:1.15）
    local headR = bodyW * (spec.build == "round" and 0.24 or spec.build == "sleek" and 0.2 or 0.245)
    local headX, headY = bodyW * 0.32, bodyY - h * 0.22
    Ears(ctx, spec, headX, headY - headR * 0.6, bodyW, clock, twitch)
    Ellipse(ctx, headX, headY, headR * (spec.build == "round" and 1.05 or 0.95),
        headR * (spec.build == "sleek" and 0.92 or 1.02), spec.fur, spec.dark)
    if spec.patch and spec.build == "chubby-baby" then -- 奶盖头顶浅灰斑
        nvgBeginPath(ctx)
        nvgArc(ctx, headX, headY, headR * 0.9, -2.9, -1.0, NVG_CW)
        nvgStrokeColor(ctx, Color(Shade(spec.patch, 1, 200))); nvgStrokeWidth(ctx, headR * 0.34); nvgStroke(ctx)
    end
    if spec.build == "round" then -- 汤圆腮帮鼓鼓
        Ellipse(ctx, headX + headR * 0.55, headY + headR * 0.22, headR * 0.4, headR * 0.3, Shade(spec.belly, 1, 250))
        Ellipse(ctx, headX - headR * 0.4, headY + headR * 0.18, headR * 0.3, headR * 0.24, Shade(spec.belly, 1, 200))
    end
    -- 眼：奶盖占比最大
    local eyeScale = spec.build == "chubby-baby" and 0.26 or spec.build == "round" and 0.2 or 0.17
    local eyeY = headY - headR * 0.05
    Eyes(ctx, spec, headX + headR * 0.42, eyeY, headR * eyeScale, headR * eyeScale * 1.15, blink,
        spec.build == "sleek" and "alert" or "calm")
    if pose and pose.dizzy then
        Tag(ctx,headX,headY-headR*1.6,"~ ~",bodyW*.18,{150,128,86,225})
    end
    if not blink then
        -- 黑猫竖瞳更明显
        if spec.build == "sleek" then
            Ellipse(ctx, headX + headR * 0.42, eyeY, headR * 0.03, headR * 0.12, { 20, 22, 24, 255 })
        end
    else
        Line(ctx, headX + headR * 0.2, eyeY, headX + headR * 0.62, eyeY, spec.eyeRim, 1.4)
    end
    -- 鼻 + 嘴 + 胡须
    Poly(ctx, { headX + headR * 0.62, eyeY + headR * 0.28, headX + headR * 0.78, eyeY + headR * 0.28,
        headX + headR * 0.7, eyeY + headR * 0.42 }, spec.nose)
    for i = -1, 1 do
        Line(ctx, headX + headR * 0.7, eyeY + headR * (0.3 + i * 0.09),
            headX + headR * 1.5, eyeY + headR * (0.12 + i * 0.18), { 120, 108, 90, 160 }, 0.9)
        Line(ctx, headX + headR * 0.7, eyeY + headR * (0.3 + i * 0.09),
            headX - headR * 0.5, eyeY + headR * (0.18 + i * 0.16), { 120, 108, 90, 110 }, 0.8)
    end
    -- 戴球
    if ball then
        local drawnBall = { owner = ball.owner, kind = ball.kind, felt = ball.felt,
            w = ball.w * bodyW / 0.95 * 0.59 }
        local WoolArt = require("WoolArt")
        WoolArt.WornYarn(ctx, headX - bodyW * 0.03, headY - headR * 1.25 - drawnBall.w * 0.4, drawnBall, index)
    end
    nvgRestore(ctx)
end

-- 静态头像（HUD 卡片等）：与 Cats.Draw 同一档案，保证"一眼可辨"

-- 「毛线守恒 V2」逻辑引擎：十关、21 种机关、事件式回溯。
-- 规则修订（经三视角评审）：
--  1) 毛线只会变少不会变多：满球=1.0 / 半球=0.5 / 毡球=0.5（网格 0.5，避免浮点配比碎裂）。
--  2) 承重/跷跷板语义：戴球猫只算本体 1.0（球在头上没在板上），自由球按自身重量。
--  3) 抱球增高 = 0.58 + 球高×0.85 ∈ [0.77,0.87]，全部 > 洞缝 0.62 →「戴毛即墙」对一切球态成立。
--  4) 跷跷板/锁存键盘达标即永久开（一次性）；限时键盘带 1.2s 宽限 + 顶针可锁。
--  5) 追球 AI：只跟随不抱不推，禁区（板/跷/围栏/管道/水池/地毯/顶针门）不踏入；X 键全局待命。
--  6) 叠睡只发生在未戴球猫；醒来=被踩/被选中；睡猫高 0.4 可当墩子。
--  7) 回溯事件驱动（机关触发/抱放/换猫/进窝各压一层，移动每 1.2s 合并一层），U 可长按连续回溯。

local GATE_H, GATE_W = 4.0, 0.55

local SLOT_GAP = 0.64 -- 窄缝底缝: 空身猫0.58和滚球过，戴毛猫(>=0.72)卡住

local BALL_SPEC = {
    full = { w = 0.34, weight = 1.0 },
    half = { w = 0.30, weight = 0.5 },
}
local FELT_SHRINK = 0.64

---@return table<string, any>
local function NewBall(x, owner, kind)
    local spec = BALL_SPEC[kind]
    return { x = x, owner = owner, kind = kind, felt = false,
        w = spec.w, weight = spec.weight, carriedBy = nil, dx = 0, vx = 0 }
end

-- 球毡化：重量落到 0.5 网格（满球→0.5，半球保持 0.5 但更小），体积 ×0.64。
local function Felt(ball)
    if ball.felt then return false end
    ball.felt = true
    ball.w = ball.w * FELT_SHRINK
    ball.weight = 0.5
    return true
end

Game.BallWeight = function(_, b) return b.weight end

function Game:BallH(b) return b.w end
