function Game.GetLevelCount(game)
    return game and game.campaignV2 and CampaignRoom.GetLevelCount() or #Game.LEVELS
end

function Game.GetSelectableCount(game)
    return game and game.campaignV2 and CampaignRoom.GetSelectableCount() or #Game.LEVELS
end

function Game.GetDefinition(level, game)
    if game and game.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.GetDefinition(level) end
    if type(level) == "number" then return Game.LEVELS[level] end
    return nil
end

function Game.IsUnlocked(level, game)
    if game and game.campaignV2 then return CampaignProgress.IsUnlocked(level) end
    return true
end

function Game.NewCampaign(level)
    ---@type table<string, any>
    local self = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(instance, key)
        local definition = rawget(instance, "def")
        if definition and definition.profile == "campaign-room" and CampaignRoom[key] then return CampaignRoom[key] end
        return Game[key]
    end })
    self.clock = 0
    CampaignRoom.Init(self, level or 1)
    return self
end

function Game.New(level)
    ---@type table<string, any>
    local self = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(instance, key)
        local definition = rawget(instance, "def")
        if definition and definition.profile == "campaign-room" and CampaignRoom[key] then return CampaignRoom[key] end
        if definition and definition.profile == "cat-hole-room" and RoomTwo[key] then return RoomTwo[key] end
        if definition and definition.profile == "seesaw-room" and RoomThree[key] then return RoomThree[key] end
        if definition and definition.profile == "scissors-room" and RoomFour[key] then return RoomFour[key] end
        return Game[key]
    end })
    self.clock = 0
    self:LoadLevel(level or 1)
    return self
end

function Game:LoadLevel(level)
    if self.campaignV2 then
        CampaignRoom.LoadLevel(self, level)
        return
    end
    self.level = math.max(1, math.min(#Game.LEVELS, level))
    self.def = Game.LEVELS[self.level]
    if self.def.profile == "seesaw-room" then RoomThree.Load(self); return end
    self.sheep = {}
    self.balls = {}
    self.active = 1
    self.elapsed = 0
    self.accumulator = 0
    self.undoStack = {}
    self.undoTimer = 0
    self.latched = false
    self.latched2 = false
    self.ramp = false
    self.gateLift = 0
    self.gateLift2 = 0
    self.won = false
    self.started = false
    self.jumpBuffer = 0
    self.switches = 0
    self.shearedAny = false
    self.thornUsed = false
    self.effects = {}
    self.autonomy = true
    -- 机关状态
    self.oneWayPassed = false
    self.pinTimer = 0
    self.holdGrace = 0
    self.basketSet = false
    self.thief = nil          -- {ball=idx, x=, dropX=, phase="run"|"drop"}
    self.rugTimers = {}       -- ballIndex -> 静止秒数
    self.swallowQueue = {}    -- {ball, at, outX}
    self.trainT = 0
    self.trainX = (self.def.trainX0 or 0)
    self.napTimers = { 0, 0, 0 } ---@type number[]
    self.towerDone = false
    self.floor = { x = -4, y = -2, w = 40, h = 2, id = -6 }
    local names = {
        { "汤圆", { 226, 158, 92, 255 } },
        { "煤球", { 122, 124, 126, 255 } },
        { "奶盖", { 238, 228, 208, 255 } },
    }
    for i = 1, 3 do
        self.sheep[i] = {
            x = 1.4 + (i - 1) * 1.8, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0,
            name = names[i][1], color = names[i][2], carry = true,
            speed = 4.3, jump = 6.6, grounded = true, coyote = 0.1, support = -6,
            facing = 1, gait = 0, squash = 0, arrived = false, dx = 0, dy = 0,
            napping = false, pullDir = 0,
        }
        self.balls[i] = NewBall(self.sheep[i].x, i, "full")
        self.balls[i].carriedBy = i
    end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then Room.Init(self)
    elseif self.def.profile == "cat-hole-room" then RoomTwo.Init(self)
    elseif self.def.profile == "scissors-room" then RoomFour.Init(self) end
    self:PushUndo()
    print(string.format("[关卡 %d] %s · %s", self.level, self.def.name, self.def.sub))
end

function Game:Reset()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Reset(self) end
    return self:LoadLevel(self.level)
end

function Game:NextLevel()
    if self.campaignV2 then
        if self.level < CampaignRoom.GetLevelCount() then self:LoadLevel(self.level + 1); return true end
        return false
    end
    if self.level < #Game.LEVELS then self:LoadLevel(self.level + 1) return true end
    return false
end

-- ---------- 尺寸/重量 ----------
function Game:Size(index)
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Size(self, index) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.Size(self, index) end
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    if s.carry then
        local ball = self:CarriedBall(index)
        return BASE_W + 0.10, BASE_H + ball.w * 0.85
    end
    return BASE_W, BASE_H
end

function Game:CarriedBall(index)
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.CarriedBall(self, index) end
    for _, b in ipairs(self.balls) do if b.carriedBy == index then return b end end
    return nil
end

function Game:Select(index)
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Select(self, index) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.Select(self, index) end
    if self.won or not self.sheep[index] or self.sheep[index].arrived then return end
    if self.sheep[index].napping then self:WakeCat(index) end
    if self.active ~= index then self.switches = self.switches + 1 end
    self.active = index
    self.jumpBuffer = 0
    self:PushUndo()
end

function Game:Next()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Next(self) end
    for offset = 1, 3 do
        local ni = (self.active + offset - 1) % 3 + 1
        if not self.sheep[ni].arrived then self:Select(ni) return end
    end
end

function Game:Jump()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Jump(self) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.Jump(self) end
    if not self.won then self.jumpBuffer = 0.14; self.started = true end
    self.napTimers[self.active] = 0
end

-- 喵叫（Q，第6关起生效）：声波半径3格——吓退正在拖球的野猫（丢球逃跑）
function Game:Meow()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Meow(self) end
    if self.won then return end
    if self.thief then
        local s = self.sheep[self.active]
        if math.abs(s.x - self.thief.x) < 3.2 then
            local ball = self.thief.ball
            ball.carriedBy = nil
            ball.x = self.thief.x
            self.thief = nil
            self:AddEffect(ball.x, 0.4, "wool")
            self:PushUndo()
            FX.Fire("rescue")
            print("[喵叫] 声波吓退野猫，它丢下球跑了")
            return
        end
    end
    print("[喵叫] " .. self.sheep[self.active].name .. " 叫了一声（半径3格）")
end

function Game:WakeCat(index)
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    if not s.napping then return end
    s.napping = false
    self:AddEffect(s.x + BASE_W / 2, s.y + 0.5, "dust")
    print("[午睡] " .. s.name .. " 被惊醒了")
end

-- ---------- 抱/放 ----------
-- 禁区：这些区域内 AI 不追、球不触发绑架计时（实现“球在机关里=不可得”）。
function Game:BallInMachine(ball)
    local LV = self.def
    local cx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
    local function inZone(a, b) return cx > a - 0.2 and cx < b + 0.2 end
    if ball.inBasket or ball.swallowWait then return true end
    if LV.plateX and inZone(LV.plateX, LV.plateX + LV.plateW) then return true end
    if LV.seesawX and inZone(LV.seesawX, LV.seesawX + 2.4) then return true end
    if LV.fenceX0 and cx > LV.fenceX0 and cx < LV.fenceX1 then return true end
    if LV.matX0 and inZone(LV.matX0, LV.matX1) then return true end
    if LV.poolX0 and inZone(LV.poolX0, LV.poolX1) then return true end
    if LV.rugX0 and inZone(LV.rugX0, LV.rugX1) then return true end
    return false
end

function Game:GrabCandidate(index)
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.GrabCandidate(self, index) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.GrabCandidate(self, index) end
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    if s.arrived or s.napping or self.won then return nil end
    if s.carry then return { mode = "drop", ball = self:CarriedBall(index).owner } end
    local cx = s.x + BASE_W / 2
    for i, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
            and not self:InFence(ball)
            and math.abs(ball.x + ball.w / 2 - cx) < 0.85 then
            s.carry = true
            ball.carriedBy = index
            local blocked = self:SizeOverlapsWorld(index)
            s.carry = false
            ball.carriedBy = nil
            return { mode = "grab", ball = i, blocked = blocked }
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Game:DropBall(index)
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    local ball = self:CarriedBall(index)
    ball.carriedBy = nil
    s.carry = false
    if s.facing >= 0 then ball.x = s.x + BASE_W + 0.06
    else ball.x = s.x - ball.w - 0.06 end
    ball.x = self:ClampBallX(ball.x, ball, s.facing >= 0 and 1 or -1)
    return ball.x
end

function Game:ToggleCarry(index)
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.ToggleCarry(self, index) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.ToggleCarry(self, index) end
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    if s.arrived or self.won then return end
    if s.napping then self:WakeCat(index); self:PushUndo(); return end
    local cand = self:GrabCandidate(index)
    if cand and cand.mode == "drop" then
        local bx = self:DropBall(index)
        self:PushUndo()
        FX.Fire("drop")
        print(string.format("[放球] %s 在 %.2f 放下线团", s.name, bx))
    elseif cand and cand.mode == "grab" and not cand.blocked then
        local ball = self.balls[cand.ball]
        s.carry = true
        ball.carriedBy = index
        self:PushUndo()
        FX.Fire("grab")
        print("[抱球] " .. s.name .. " 顶起了线团")
    elseif cand then
        print("[抱球] " .. s.name .. "：头顶空间不够，这个线团抱不起来")
    else
        print("[抱球] " .. s.name .. "：脚边没有线团")
    end
end

function Game:SizeOverlapsWorld(index)
    local w, h = self:Size(index)
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    for _, b in ipairs(self:WorldBoxes()) do
        if s.x < b.x + b.w - EPS and s.x + w > b.x + EPS
            and s.y < b.y + b.h - EPS and s.y + h > b.y + EPS then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- 静态世界碰撞盒（不含地板/猫/球）。
function Game:WorldBoxes()
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.Boxes(self) end
    local LV = self.def
    local boxes = {}
    if LV.doorX then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.doorX, y = GAP, w = DOOR_W, h = DOOR_H - GAP } end
    if LV.slotX then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.slotX, y = SLOT_GAP, w = DOOR_W, h = DOOR_H - SLOT_GAP } end
    if LV.gateX and not self:GateOpen(1) then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.gateX, y = 0, w = GATE_W, h = GATE_H } end
    if LV.gateX2 and not self.latched2 then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.gateX2, y = 0, w = GATE_W, h = GATE_H } end
    if LV.basketGateX and not self.basketSet then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.basketGateX, y = 0, w = GATE_W, h = GATE_H } end
    if LV.pinGateX and self.pinTimer <= 0 then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.pinGateX, y = 0, w = GATE_W, h = GATE_H } end
    if LV.wallX then
        local wallH = self.ramp and 0.52 or WALL_H
        boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.wallX, y = 0, w = WALL_W, h = wallH }
    end
    if LV.towerGateX and not self.towerDone then boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.towerGateX, y = 0, w = GATE_W, h = GATE_H } end
    if LV.oneWayX and self.oneWayPassed then
        boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = LV.oneWayX, y = 0, w = 0.18, h = 4.1 }
    end
    return boxes
end

function Game:GateOpen(which)
    if which == 2 then return self.latched2 end
    if self.def.plateHold then return self.holdGrace > 0 or self.latched end
    return self.latched
end

-- 线团夹逼：未解开前不得穿过机关门/围栏/立柜（按运动方向贴边）。
function Game:ClampBallX(x, ball, dir)
    x = math.max(0.3, math.min(31.9, x))
    local LV = self.def
    local blockers = {}
    if LV.gateX and not self:GateOpen(1) then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.gateX, w = GATE_W } end
    if LV.gateX2 and not self.latched2 then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.gateX2, w = GATE_W } end
    if LV.basketGateX and not self.basketSet then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.basketGateX, w = GATE_W } end
    if LV.pinGateX and self.pinTimer <= 0 then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.pinGateX, w = GATE_W } end
    if LV.wallX and not self.ramp then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.wallX, w = WALL_W } end
    if LV.towerGateX and not self.towerDone then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.towerGateX, w = GATE_W } end
    if LV.oneWayX and self.oneWayPassed then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.oneWayX, w = 0.18 } end
    -- 围栏（单向陷阱）：右推可进 fenceX0，左推被拦；右墙 fenceX1 两面都拦。进栏后抱不出。
    if LV.fenceX0 then
        if dir < 0 then blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.fenceX0, w = 0.15 } end
        blockers[#blockers + 1] = { x = LV.fenceX1 - 0.15, w = 0.15 }
    end
    for _, b in ipairs(blockers) do
        if x < b.x + b.w - EPS and x + ball.w > b.x + EPS then
            if dir > 0 then x = math.min(x, b.x - ball.w)
            elseif dir < 0 then x = math.max(x, b.x + b.w) end
        end
    end
    return x
end

-- 猫可站的实体。每块带 kind：block(贴边)/land(可站)/ball(推或撞)/bouncer(弹床)。
-- id 仅用于机关读取（land 类：wall-7 爬架顶-22）。
function Game:Solids(index)
    local w, h = self:Size(index)
    local solids = { { x = self.floor.x, y = self.floor.y, w = self.floor.w, h = self.floor.h, id = -6, kind = "land" } }
    local LV = self.def
    local function block(x, y, bw, bh, id) solids[#solids + 1] = { x = x, y = y, w = bw, h = bh, id = id, kind = "block" } end
    if LV.doorX then block(LV.doorX, GAP, DOOR_W, DOOR_H - GAP, -4) end
    if LV.slotX then block(LV.slotX, SLOT_GAP, DOOR_W, DOOR_H - SLOT_GAP, -8) end
    if LV.gateX and not self:GateOpen(1) then block(LV.gateX, 0, GATE_W, GATE_H, -5) end
    if LV.gateX2 and not self.latched2 then block(LV.gateX2, 0, GATE_W, GATE_H, -52) end
    if LV.basketGateX and not self.basketSet then block(LV.basketGateX, 0, GATE_W, GATE_H, -53) end
    if LV.pinGateX and self.pinTimer <= 0 then block(LV.pinGateX, 0, GATE_W, GATE_H, -9) end
    if LV.wallX then block(LV.wallX, 0, WALL_W, self.ramp and 0.52 or WALL_H, -7) end
    if LV.towerGateX and not self.towerDone then block(LV.towerGateX, 0, GATE_W, GATE_H, -54) end
    if LV.oneWayX and self.oneWayPassed then block(LV.oneWayX, 0, 0.18, 4.1, -55) end
    if LV.towerX then
        local tx = LV.towerX
        solids[#solids + 1] = { x = tx, y = 0.45, w = 1.3, h = 0.1, id = -20, kind = "land" }
        solids[#solids + 1] = { x = tx + 0.15, y = 1.05, w = 1.1, h = 0.1, id = -21, kind = "land" }
        solids[#solids + 1] = { x = tx + 0.3, y = 1.65, w = 0.9, h = 0.1, id = -22, kind = "land" }
    end
    if LV.trampolineX then
        solids[#solids + 1] = { x = LV.trampolineX, y = 0, w = LV.trampolineW, h = 0.26, id = -31, kind = "bouncer" }
    end
    if LV.trainX0 then
        solids[#solids + 1] = { x = self.trainX, y = 0.14, w = 1.3, h = 0.12, id = -30, kind = "land" }
    end
    if LV.pocketX then block(LV.pocketX + LV.pocketW, 0, 0.16, 0.7, -60) end
    for i, other in ipairs(self.sheep) do
        if i ~= index and not other.arrived then
            local ow, oh = self:Size(i)
            if other.napping then oh = 0.4; ow = BASE_W + 0.1 end
            solids[#solids + 1] = { x = other.x, y = other.y, w = ow, h = oh, id = i, kind = "cat" }
        end
    end
    for i, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait then
            solids[#solids + 1] = { x = ball.x, y = 0, w = ball.w, h = ball.w, id = i, kind = "ball" }
        end
    end
    return solids, w, h
end

function Game:AddEffect(x, y, kind)
    FX.SpawnInto(self.effects, x, y, kind, kind == "home" and 12 or 4)
end

function Game:PushBall(ballIndex, amount)
    local ball = self.balls[ballIndex]
    local oldX = ball.x
    ball.x = self:ClampBallX(ball.x + amount, ball, amount > 0 and 1 or -1)
    if ball.x ~= oldX then
        ball.vx = (ball.x - oldX) / STEP
        ball.pushed = true
    end
    return ball.x - oldX
end

-- 猫是否位于某段禁区之间与目标球同侧（AI 用）。
function Game:SameSide(a, b)
    local LV = self.def
    for _, wall in ipairs({ "gateX", "gateX2", "basketGateX", "pinGateX", "oneWayX", "towerGateX" }) do
        local wx = LV[wall]
        if wx then
            local open
            if wall == "gateX2" then open = self.latched2
            elseif wall == "basketGateX" then open = self.basketSet
            elseif wall == "pinGateX" then open = self.pinTimer > 0
            elseif wall == "oneWayX" then open = not self.oneWayPassed
            elseif wall == "towerGateX" then open = self.towerDone
            else open = self:GateOpen(1) end
            if not open and (a - wx) * (b - wx) < 0 then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- ---------- 移动主流程 ----------
function Game:MoveSheep(index, direction, dt)
    local s = self.sheep[index]
    local oldX, oldY = s.x, s.y
    s.dx, s.dy = 0, 0
    s.squash = math.max(0, s.squash - dt * 3)
    if s.arrived then return end
    if s.napping then
        -- 睡猫可能被传送带/火车带走（不自主）。
        local LV = self.def
        if LV.conveyorX0 and self:InZone(s.x, LV.conveyorX0, LV.conveyorX1) then
            s.x = s.x + LV.conveyorDir * 0.9 * dt
        end
        return
    end
    local carryX, carryY = 0, 0
    if s.support == -30 then
        carryX, carryY = self.trainDX or 0, 0
    elseif s.support > 0 then
        local support = self.sheep[s.support]
        if not support.arrived then carryX, carryY = support.dx, support.dy end
    end
    local wasGrounded = s.grounded
    s.coyote = wasGrounded and 0.1 or math.max(0, s.coyote - dt)
    if index == self.active and self.jumpBuffer > 0 and s.coyote > 0 then
        s.vy = s.jump
        s.grounded, s.coyote, s.support = false, 0, 0
        self.jumpBuffer = 0
        s.squash = 0.12
        self:AddEffect(s.x + 0.5, s.y, "dust")
        self:PushUndo()
        FX.Fire("jump")
    end
    local LV = self.def
    local speed = s.speed
    if direction ~= 0 and LV.vacuumX0 and s.x + BASE_W / 2 > LV.vacuumX0 and s.x + BASE_W / 2 < LV.vacuumX1 then
        speed = speed * 0.55
        if not self.vacuumWarned then self.vacuumWarned = true
            print("[怕响] " .. s.name .. " 被吸尘器吓得缩手缩脚") end
    end
    if LV.conveyorX0 and self:InZone(s.x + BASE_W / 2, LV.conveyorX0, LV.conveyorX1) then
        carryX = carryX + LV.conveyorDir * 0.9 * dt
    end
    local movement = direction * speed * dt + carryX
    s.vx = direction * speed
    if direction ~= 0 then s.facing = direction; s.gait = s.gait + dt * speed * 4 end
    s.x = math.max(0.3, math.min(31.0, s.x + movement))
    local solids, w, h = self:Solids(index)
    local walkBouncer = false
    for _, obstacle in ipairs(solids) do
        if obstacle.kind == "ball" then
            local ball = self.balls[obstacle.id]
            local ballCenter = obstacle.x + obstacle.w / 2
            local catCenter = s.x + w / 2
            if self:Overlaps(s.x, s.y, w, h, obstacle.x, obstacle.y, obstacle.w, obstacle.h) then
                if movement * (ballCenter - catCenter) > 0 then
                    self:PushBall(obstacle.id, movement)
                    obstacle.x = ball.x
                elseif ball.vx and math.abs(ball.vx) > 1.6 and s.carry and not s.arrived then
                    -- 弹路撞帽：快速滚来的球撞上戴球猫 → 猫掉球、球弹走。
                    self:DropBall(index)
                    ball.vx = -ball.vx * 0.6
                    ball.x = ball.x + (ball.x < catCenter and -0.12 or 0.12)
                    self:AddEffect(obstacle.x, 0.4, "wool")
                    self:PushUndo()
                    print("[撞帽] 滚球撞掉了 " .. s.name .. " 头上的线团！")
                end
            end
        elseif obstacle.kind == "bouncer" then
            -- 弹床矮到拦不住走路：贴地走过即触发弹跳（落地判定后统一处理）。
            if s.y < 0.5 and self:Overlaps(s.x, s.y, w, h, obstacle.x, obstacle.y, obstacle.w, obstacle.h) then
                walkBouncer = true
            end
        else
            if self:Overlaps(s.x, s.y, w, h, obstacle.x, obstacle.y, obstacle.w, obstacle.h) then
                if movement > 0 and oldX + w <= obstacle.x + EPS then s.x = math.min(s.x, obstacle.x - w)
                elseif movement < 0 and oldX >= obstacle.x + obstacle.w - EPS then s.x = math.max(s.x, obstacle.x + obstacle.w) end
            end
        end
    end
    s.vy = math.max(-14, s.vy - GRAVITY * dt)
    local vertical = s.vy * dt + carryY
    s.y = s.y + vertical
    s.grounded, s.support = false, 0
    local hitBouncer = false
    for _, obstacle in ipairs(solids) do
        if obstacle.kind ~= "ball" then
            if self:Overlaps(s.x, s.y, w, h, obstacle.x, obstacle.y, obstacle.w, obstacle.h) then
                if vertical <= 0 and oldY >= obstacle.y + obstacle.h - EPS then
                    s.y = math.max(s.y, obstacle.y + obstacle.h)
                    s.grounded, s.vy = true, 0
                    if obstacle.kind == "bouncer" then
                        s.support = 0
                        hitBouncer = true
                    else
                        s.support = obstacle.id
                        if obstacle.id > 0 and self.sheep[obstacle.id].napping then
                            self:WakeCat(obstacle.id)
                        end
                    end
                elseif vertical > 0 and oldY + h <= obstacle.y + EPS then
                    s.y = math.min(s.y, obstacle.y - h)
                    s.vy = 0
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- 猫抓板弹床：落地碰顶或贴地走过，都立刻高弹。
    if hitBouncer or walkBouncer then
        s.vy = 8.6
        s.grounded, s.support = false, 0
        self:AddEffect(s.x + 0.5, s.y, "dust")
        if not self.trampWarned then self.trampWarned = true
            print("[弹床] " .. s.name .. " 被猫抓板弹上了天") end
    end
    if s.grounded and not wasGrounded then
        s.squash = 0.14
        self:AddEffect(s.x + w / 2, s.y, "dust")
        FX.Fire("land")
    end
    s.dx, s.dy = s.x - oldX, s.y - oldY
end

function Game:InZone(cx, a, b) return cx > a and cx < b end
-- 球在围栏内：抱不出来（牺牲换压板），但仍计入键盘承重。
function Game:InFence(ball)
    local LV = self.def
    if not LV.fenceX0 or ball.carriedBy ~= nil or ball.inBasket or ball.swallowWait then return false end
    local cx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
    return cx > LV.fenceX0 + 0.1 and cx < LV.fenceX1 - 0.1
end
function Game:Overlaps(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh)
    return ax < bx + bw - EPS and ax + aw > bx + EPS and ay < by + bh - EPS and ay + ah > by + EPS
end

-- ---------- 机关结算 ----------
function Game:MachineStep(dt)
    local LV = self.def
    -- 蹭线柱
    if LV.shearX0 then
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            local w = select(1, self:Size(i))
            local cx = s.x + w / 2
            if s.carry and not s.arrived and cx > LV.shearX0 and cx < LV.shearX1 then
                self:DropBall(i)
                self.shearedAny = true
                self:AddEffect(cx, 1.6, "wool")
                self:PushUndo()
                print("[蹭线] " .. s.name .. " 的线团滚落")
            end
        end
    end
    -- 剪线刺：戴满球猫穿过 → 一分为二（半球），不可合。毡球已硬，不剪。
    if LV.thornX and not self.thornCut then self.thornCut = {} end
    if LV.thornX then
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            local w = select(1, self:Size(i))
            local cx = s.x + w / 2
            if s.carry and not s.arrived and math.abs(cx - LV.thornX - 0.2) < 0.35 then
                local ball = self:CarriedBall(i)
                if ball.kind == "full" and not self.thornCut[ball.owner] then
                    self.thornCut[ball.owner] = true
                    ball.carriedBy = nil
                    s.carry = false
                    -- 原球就地变第一半，再补一个同主半球：总数+1，总重不变
                    ball.kind = "half"
                    ball.w = BALL_SPEC.half.w
                    ball.weight = BALL_SPEC.half.weight
                    ball.x = LV.thornX - 0.2
                    self.balls[#self.balls + 1] = NewBall(LV.thornX + 0.5, ball.owner, "half")
                    self:AddEffect(LV.thornX + 0.2, 1.2, "wool")
                    self:PushUndo()
                    self.thornUsed = true
                    FX.Fire("scissors")
                    self.pendingWarning = "cut"
                    print("[剪线] 线团被剪成两个半球，拼不回去了")
                end
            end
        end
        self.balls = self:PackBalls(self.balls)
    end
    -- 毛絮水池：滚进/掉进球区的水毡化；戴球猫踩水=连球带帽缩水；猫本体无碍。
    if LV.poolX0 then
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
                and self:InZone(ball.x + ball.w / 2, LV.poolX0, LV.poolX1) then
                if Felt(ball) then
                    self:AddEffect(ball.x + ball.w / 2, 0.1, "dust")
                    FX.Fire("felt")
                    self.pendingWarning = "felt"
                    if not self.poolWarned then self.poolWarned = true
                        print("[毡化] 线团泡水缩水了，再也回不到原来的重量") end
                end
            end
        end
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            if s.carry and s.y < 0.05 and self:InZone(s.x + BASE_W / 2, LV.poolX0, LV.poolX1) then
                local ball = self:CarriedBall(i)
                if Felt(ball) then
                    self:AddEffect(s.x + BASE_W / 2, 0.4, "dust")
                    if not self.poolCarryWarned then self.poolCarryWarned = true
                        print("[毡化] 抱着球踩水：连球一起缩水") end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- 吞线地垫/管道：球进入 → 从出口滚出（单向传送）。
    if LV.matX0 then
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
                and self:InZone(ball.x + ball.w / 2, LV.matX0, LV.matX1) then
                ball.swallowWait = 0.7
                self.swallowQueue[#self.swallowQueue + 1] = { ball = ball }
                ball.x = -100
                if not self.matWarned then self.matWarned = true
                    print("[吞线] 地垫把线团吞了进去……单行道") end
            end
        end
        for i = #self.swallowQueue, 1, -1 do
            local q = self.swallowQueue[i]
            q.ball.swallowWait = q.ball.swallowWait - dt
            if q.ball.swallowWait <= 0 then
                q.ball.x = LV.matOutX
                q.ball.swallowWait = nil
                table.remove(self.swallowQueue, i)
                self:AddEffect(LV.matOutX + 0.2, 0.3, "wool")
                print("[吐线] 线团从房间另一头滚了出来")
            end
        end
    end
    -- 毛线绑架：地毯上静止 2s → 野猫叼球跑向死胡同。
    if LV.rugX0 then
        for i, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
                and self:InZone(ball.x + ball.w / 2, LV.rugX0, LV.rugX1) then
                if math.abs(ball.dx or 0) < 0.001 then
                    self.rugTimers[i] = (self.rugTimers[i] or 0) + dt
                else
                    self.rugTimers[i] = 0
                end
                if (self.rugTimers[i] or 0) > 2 and not self.thief then
                    self.thief = { ball = ball, x = LV.rugX1 + 0.4, dropX = LV.pocketX + 0.5, phase = "run" }
                    ball.carriedBy = -99
                    self.rugTimers[i] = 0
                    self:PushUndo()
                    print("[绑架] 野猫窜出来叼走了线团！追进死胡同能夺回来")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if self.thief then
        local th = self.thief
        if th.phase == "run" then
            th.x = th.x + 3.2 * dt
            th.ball.x = th.x
            for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
                if not s.arrived and math.abs(s.x + BASE_W / 2 - th.x) < 0.9 then
                    -- 玩家猫逼近 → 野猫丢球跑路
                    local ball = th.ball
                    ball.carriedBy = nil
                    ball.x = th.x
                    self.thief = nil
                    self:AddEffect(th.x, 0.4, "wool")
                    self:PushUndo()
                    print("[夺回] 野猫丢下球逃了！")
                    break
                end
            end
            if self.thief and th.x >= th.dropX then
                local ball = th.ball
                ball.carriedBy = nil
                ball.x = th.dropX
                self.thief = nil
                print("[绑架] 野猫把球丢进了死胡同（猫能跳进去，球滚不出来）")
            end
        end
    end
    -- 压力板（永久锁存 或 限时+顶针）
    local weight = self:PlateWeight()
    if LV.plateX then
        if LV.plateHold then
            if weight >= LV.plateNeed then
                self.holdGrace = 1.2
            else
                self.holdGrace = math.max(0, self.holdGrace - dt)
            end
            if LV.platePinX then
                for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
                    if not s.arrived and s.y < 0.05 and not s.napping
                        and math.abs(s.x + BASE_W / 2 - LV.platePinX) < 0.7 then
                        if not self.latched then
                            self.latched = true
                            self.holdGrace = 0
                            self:PushUndo()
                            FX.Shake(5, 0.25, "medium")
                            print("[顶针] 门闩拍下，吊门永久固定")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            if not self.latched and weight >= LV.plateNeed then
                self.latched = true
                self:PushUndo()
                FX.Shake(5, 0.25, "medium")
                print("[机关] 键盘承重达标，吊门升起（锁存）")
            end
        end
    end
    if LV.plateX2 then
        if not self.latched2 and self:PlateWeight2() >= LV.plateNeed2 then
            self.latched2 = true
            self:PushUndo()
            print("[机关] 第二架键盘达标，吊门 B 升起")
        end
    end
    -- 跷跷板：左右两盘，2:1（少的一边 ≥0.4）即锁存开门。
    if LV.seesawX then
        local L, R = self:SeesawWeights()
        self.seesawTilt = 0
        if L > 0 or R > 0 then
            if L > 2 * R + 0.01 and R >= 0.4 then self.seesawTilt = -1
            elseif R > 2 * L + 0.01 and L >= 0.4 then self.seesawTilt = 1 end
        end
        if not self.latched and ((L > 0 and math.abs(L - 2 * R) < 0.01 and R >= 0.4)
            or (R > 0 and math.abs(R - 2 * L) < 0.01 and L >= 0.4)) then
            self.latched = true
            self:PushUndo()
            print("[跷跷板] 恰好 2:1！吊门升起（锁存）")
        end
    end
    -- 配重吊篮：球推进篮 → 闸门开；另一猫踩释放钮 → 篮落、球被送过闸门。
    if LV.basketX then
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if not ball.inBasket and ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.swallowWait
                and self:InZone(ball.x + ball.w / 2, LV.basketX, LV.basketX + 0.7) then
                ball.inBasket = true
                ball.x = LV.basketX + 0.35
                self.basketSet = true
                self:PushUndo()
                print("[吊篮] 线团落进吊篮，闸门升起——球成了乘客")
            end
        end
        if self.basketSet then
            for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
                if not s.arrived and s.y < 0.05 and not s.napping
                    and math.abs(s.x + BASE_W / 2 - LV.basketReleaseX) < 0.7 then
                    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
                        if ball.inBasket then
                            ball.inBasket = false
                            ball.x = LV.ballDropX
                        end
                    end
                    self.basketSet = false
                    self:PushUndo()
                    print("[放篮] 篮落下——线团已经被送过了闸门（顺序题）")
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- 顶针感应门：戴毛线团的猫靠近门 → 感应开 1.3s（空身猫蹭不开）。
    if LV.pinGateX then
        self.pinTimer = math.max(0, self.pinTimer - dt)
        local pinCx = LV.pinGateX + GATE_W / 2
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            local w = select(1, self:Size(i))
            if s.carry and not s.arrived
                and s.x + w > pinCx - 0.5 and s.x < pinCx + 0.5 then
                if self.pinTimer <= 0 then
                    self.pinTimer = 1.3
                    self:PushUndo()
                    print("[顶针] 门楣感应到戴毛的脑袋，门开 1.3 秒！")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- 棘轮单向线：任何猫右穿一次即封死。
    if LV.oneWayX and not self.oneWayPassed then
        for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            if s.dx > 0 and s.x - s.dx < LV.oneWayX and s.x + BASE_W / 2 > LV.oneWayX then
                self.oneWayPassed = true
                self:PushUndo()
                print("[棘轮] 钉条合拢——这扇门已经回不去了")
                break
            end
        end
    end
    -- 立柜开关 / 猫爬架登顶开关
    if LV.wallX and not self.ramp then
        local leverX = LV.wallX + WALL_W / 2
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            if s.support == -7 and not s.arrived
                and math.abs(s.x + select(1, self:Size(i)) / 2 - leverX) < 0.9 then
                self.ramp = true
                self:AddEffect(leverX, WALL_H + 0.3, "wool")
                self:PushUndo()
                print("[机关] 开关拍下，立柜降成跳台")
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if LV.towerX and LV.towerGateX and not self.towerDone then
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            if s.support == -22 and not s.arrived then
                self.towerDone = true
                self:AddEffect(LV.towerX + 0.7, 1.8, "wool")
                self:PushUndo()
                print("[猫爬架] 爬到架顶拍下开关，对面闸门升起了")
                break
            end
        end
    end
    -- 滚筒传送带：自由球被带走。
    if LV.conveyorX0 then
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
                and self:InZone(ball.x + ball.w / 2, LV.conveyorX0, LV.conveyorX1) then
                ball.x = self:ClampBallX(ball.x + LV.conveyorDir * 1.8 * dt, ball, LV.conveyorDir)
            end
        end
    end
    -- 自由球惯性滚动（撞帽弹开后的延续），摩擦衰减；本步被猫推过的球不叠加。
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
            and ball.vx and not ball.pushed then
            if math.abs(ball.vx) > 0.2 then
                ball.x = self:ClampBallX(ball.x + ball.vx * dt, ball, ball.vx > 0 and 1 or -1)
            end
            ball.vx = ball.vx * 0.94
        end
    end
    -- 玩具火车：往返平台。
    if LV.trainX0 then
        local span = LV.trainX1 - LV.trainX0
        self.trainT = (self.trainT + dt * 0.16) % 2
        local phase = self.trainT < 1 and self.trainT or 2 - self.trainT
        local oldX = self.trainX
        self.trainX = LV.trainX0 + phase * span
        self.trainDX = self.trainX - oldX
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
                and self:InZone(ball.x, self.trainX - 0.1, self.trainX + 1.3) then
                ball.x = ball.x + self.trainDX
            end
        end
    end
    -- 叠睡：非激活、未戴球、原地 3s → 坐下成墩。
    if LV.nap then
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            if i ~= self.active and not s.arrived and not s.napping and not s.carry
                and s.grounded and math.abs(s.dx) < 0.001 then
                self.napTimers[i] = self.napTimers[i] + dt
                if self.napTimers[i] >= 3 then
                    s.napping = true
                    self:AddEffect(s.x + BASE_W / 2, s.y + 0.2, "dust")
                    print("[午睡] " .. s.name .. " 坐成一团，变成了 0.4 米的墩子")
                end
            else
                if i ~= self.active then self.napTimers[i] = 0 end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Game:PackBalls(balls)
    local out = {}
    for _, b in ipairs(balls) do out[#out + 1] = b end
    return out
end

function Game:PlateWeight()
    local LV = self.def
    if not LV.plateX then return 0 end
    local weight = 0
    for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
        if not s.arrived and s.y < 0.05 and not s.napping then
            local cx = s.x + BASE_W / 2
            if cx > LV.plateX and cx < LV.plateX + LV.plateW then
                weight = weight + 1
            end
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait then
            local cx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
            if cx > LV.plateX and cx < LV.plateX + LV.plateW then weight = weight + ball.weight end
        end
    end
    return weight
end

function Game:PlateWeight2()
    local LV = self.def
    if not LV.plateX2 then return 0 end
    local weight = 0
    for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
        if not s.arrived and s.y < 0.05 and s.x + BASE_W / 2 > LV.plateX2 and s.x + BASE_W / 2 < LV.plateX2 + LV.plateW2 then
            weight = weight + 1
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
            and ball.x + ball.w / 2 > LV.plateX2 and ball.x + ball.w / 2 < LV.plateX2 + LV.plateW2 then
            weight = weight + ball.weight
        end
    end
    return weight
end

function Game:SeesawWeights()
    local LV = self.def
    local L, R = 0, 0
    local function panOf(cx)
        if cx > LV.seesawX - 0.1 and cx < LV.seesawX + 1.0 then return 1 end
        if cx > LV.seesawX + 1.3 and cx < LV.seesawX + 2.4 then return 2 end
        return 0
    end
    for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
        if not s.arrived and s.y < 0.05 and not s.napping then
            local p = panOf(s.x + BASE_W / 2)
            if p == 1 then L = L + 1 elseif p == 2 then R = R + 1 end
        end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait then
            local p = panOf(ball.x + ball.w / 2)
            if p == 1 then L = L + ball.weight elseif p == 2 then R = R + ball.weight end
        end
    end
    return L, R
end

-- ---------- 追球 AI（只跟不抱不推，禁区内不踏入） ----------
function Game:UpdateChase(dt)
    if not self.def.chase or not self.autonomy then return end
    local LV = self.def
    for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
        if i ~= self.active and not s.arrived and not s.napping then
            local target, best = nil, 99
            local cx = s.x + BASE_W / 2
            for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
                if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait
                    and not self:BallInMachine(ball) then
                    local bx = ball.x + ball.w / 2
                    local d = math.abs(bx - cx)
                    if d < 3.2 and d < best and self:SameSide(cx, bx) then
                        best = d
                        target = bx
                    end
                end
            end
            s.pullDir = 0
            if target then
                local dir = target > cx and 1 or -1
                local stop = math.abs(target - cx)
                if stop > 0.95 then
                    -- 禁区/吸尘器挡路则停
                    local nx = cx + dir * 1.1 * dt
                    local blocked = LV.vacuumX0 and nx > LV.vacuumX0 - 0.2 and nx < LV.vacuumX1 + 0.2
                    if not blocked then
                        s.x = math.max(0.3, math.min(31.0, s.x + dir * 1.1 * dt))
                        s.facing = dir
                        s.gait = s.gait + dt * 4
                        s.pullDir = dir
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            s.pullDir = 0
        end
    end
end

-- ---------- 回溯（事件式） ----------
local function CopySheep(s)
    return { x = s.x, y = s.y, vx = s.vx, vy = s.vy, carry = s.carry, arrived = s.arrived,
        facing = s.facing, support = s.support, grounded = s.grounded, gait = s.gait,
        napping = s.napping }
end
local function CopyBall(b)
    return { x = b.x, owner = b.owner, kind = b.kind, felt = b.felt, w = b.w,
        weight = b.weight, carriedBy = b.carriedBy, inBasket = b.inBasket, swallowWait = b.swallowWait }
end

function Game:PushUndo()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.PushUndo(self) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.PushUndo(self) end
    local snap = {
        sheep = {}, balls = {},
        latched = self.latched, latched2 = self.latched2, ramp = self.ramp,
        gateLift = self.gateLift, gateLift2 = self.gateLift2,
        shearedAny = self.shearedAny, thornUsed = self.thornUsed,
        oneWayPassed = self.oneWayPassed, basketSet = self.basketSet,
        holdGrace = self.holdGrace, towerDone = self.towerDone,
        thief = self.thief and { owner = self.thief.ball.owner, x = self.thief.x, dropX = self.thief.dropX, phase = self.thief.phase } or false,
    }
    for i = 1, #self.sheep do snap.sheep[i] = CopySheep(self.sheep[i]) end
    for i = 1, #self.balls do snap.balls[i] = CopyBall(self.balls[i]) end
    local top = self.undoStack[#self.undoStack]
    if top and self:SnapEqual(top, snap) then return end
    self.undoStack[#self.undoStack + 1] = snap
    if #self.undoStack > 150 then table.remove(self.undoStack, 1) end
end

function Game:SnapEqual(a, b)
    if a.latched ~= b.latched or a.ramp ~= b.ramp or a.oneWayPassed ~= b.oneWayPassed
        or a.basketSet ~= b.basketSet or a.thornUsed ~= b.thornUsed or a.holdGrace ~= b.holdGrace then return false end
    if #a.balls ~= #b.balls then return false end
    if (not a.thief) ~= (not b.thief) then return false end
    if a.thief and (a.thief.x ~= b.thief.x or a.thief.owner ~= b.thief.owner) then return false end
    for i = 1, 3 do
        if math.abs(a.sheep[i].x - b.sheep[i].x) > 0.02 or math.abs(a.sheep[i].y - b.sheep[i].y) > 0.02 then return false end
        if a.sheep[i].carry ~= b.sheep[i].carry or a.sheep[i].arrived ~= b.sheep[i].arrived
            or a.sheep[i].napping ~= b.sheep[i].napping then return false end
    end
    for i = 1, #a.balls do
        if math.abs(a.balls[i].x - b.balls[i].x) > 0.02 or a.balls[i].carriedBy ~= b.balls[i].carriedBy
            or a.balls[i].kind ~= b.balls[i].kind or a.balls[i].felt ~= b.balls[i].felt then return false end
    end
    return true
end

function Game:Undo()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Undo(self) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.Undo(self) end
    if not self:CanUndo() then return end
    table.remove(self.undoStack)
    local snap = self.undoStack[#self.undoStack]
    if not snap then return end
    for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
        local v = snap.sheep[i]
        if v then
            s.x, s.y, s.vx, s.vy = v.x, v.y, v.vx, v.vy
            s.carry, s.arrived, s.facing = v.carry, v.arrived, v.facing
            s.support, s.grounded, s.gait, s.napping = v.support, v.grounded, v.gait, v.napping
            s.dx, s.dy, s.squash = 0, 0, 0
        end
    end
    local balls = {}
    for i = 1, #snap.balls do balls[i] = CopyBall(snap.balls[i]) end
    self.balls = balls
    self.latched = snap.latched
    self.latched2 = snap.latched2 or false
    self.ramp = snap.ramp
    self.gateLift = snap.gateLift
    self.gateLift2 = snap.gateLift2 or 0
    self.shearedAny = snap.shearedAny
    self.thornUsed = snap.thornUsed
    self.oneWayPassed = snap.oneWayPassed
    self.basketSet = snap.basketSet
    self.holdGrace = snap.holdGrace
    self.towerDone = snap.towerDone or false
    self.thief = snap.thief and { ball = nil, x = snap.thief.x, dropX = snap.thief.dropX, phase = snap.thief.phase } or nil
    if self.thief then
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            if ball.owner == snap.thief.owner then self.thief.ball = ball; break end
        end
        if self.thief.ball and self.thief.phase == "run" then self.thief.ball.carriedBy = -99 end
    end
    self.pinTimer = 0
    self.jumpBuffer = 0
    self.active = 1
    for i = 1, 3 do if not self.sheep[i].arrived then self.active = i break end end
    FX.Freeze(0.05)
    print("[回溯] 时间倒回上一个事件")
end

function Game:IndexOfBall(ball)
    for i, b in ipairs(self.balls) do if b == ball then return i end end
    return nil
end

function Game:CanUndo()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.CanUndo(self) end
    return #self.undoStack >= 2 and (self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" or not self.won)
end

-- ---------- 主循环 ----------
function Game:Update(dt, direction)
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Update(self, dt, direction) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then return Room.Update(self, dt, direction) end
    dt = math.min(dt, 0.08)
    self.clock = self.clock + dt
    if direction ~= 0 then self.started = true; self.napTimers[self.active] = 0 end
    if self.started and not self.won then self.elapsed = self.elapsed + dt end
    self.gateLift = math.min(self:GateOpen(1) and 1 or 0, self.gateLift + dt * 2.2)
    if self.def.gateX2 then self.gateLift2 = math.min(self.latched2 and 1 or 0, self.gateLift2 + dt * 2.2) end
    FX.StepEffects(self.effects, dt, "fall")
    if self.won then return end
    self.accumulator = self.accumulator + dt
    while self.accumulator >= STEP do
        self.accumulator = self.accumulator - STEP
        for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
            ball.dx = ball.x - (ball.lastX or ball.x)
            ball.lastX = ball.x
            ball.pushed = false
        end
        local order = { 1, 2, 3 }
        table.sort(order, function(a, b) return self.sheep[a].y < self.sheep[b].y end)
        for _, i in ipairs(order) do self:MoveSheep(i, i == self.active and direction or 0, STEP) end
        self:UpdateChase(STEP)
        self.jumpBuffer = math.max(0, self.jumpBuffer - STEP)
        self:MachineStep(STEP)
        local arrived = 0
        for i, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do
            if not s.arrived and s.x > self.def.homeX and s.y < 0.08 then
                s.arrived = true
                s.x = self.def.homeX + 0.7 + (i - 1) * 1.15
                s.y, s.vx, s.vy = 0, 0, 0
                s.napping = false
                self:AddEffect(s.x + 0.5, 0.5, "home")
                self:PushUndo()
                FX.Fire("home")
                print("[进窝] " .. s.name)
                if self.active == i then self:Next() end
            end
            if s.arrived then arrived = arrived + 1 end
        end
        if arrived == 3 then
            self.won = true
            print(string.format("[通关] 关卡 %d 完成，用时 %.1f 秒", self.level, self.elapsed))
        end
        self.undoTimer = self.undoTimer + STEP
        if self.undoTimer >= 1.2 then self.undoTimer = 0; self:PushUndo() end
    end
end

function Game:ArrivedCount()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.ArrivedCount(self) end
    local count = 0
    for _, s in ipairs(self.sheep) do if s.arrived then count = count + 1 end end
    return count
end

    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.LooseBallCount(self) end
    local count = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.carriedBy == nil and not ball.inBasket and not ball.swallowWait then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

function Game:VisibleYarnWeight()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.VisibleYarnWeight(self) end
    local total = 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if not ball.swallowWait then total = total + ball.weight end
    end
    return total
end

function Game:YarnStats()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.YarnStats(self) end
    local full, half, felt = 0, 0, 0
    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do
        if ball.felt then felt = felt + 1
        elseif ball.kind == "half" then half = half + 1
        else full = full + 1 end
    end
    return full, half, felt
end

    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.YarnAmount(self) end

    for _, ball in ipairs(self.balls) do

function Game:Hint()
    if self.campaignV2 then return CampaignRoom.Hint(self, self:GetHintStage()) end
    if self.def.profile == "tutorial-room" then
        local text = self:TutorialText()
        if text ~= "" then return text end
        return self.latched and "木门已开，带三只猫回窝。" or "踩下按钮 A，让木门永久打开。"
    end
    local LV = self.def
    if self.won then return "毛线各得其所，猫各回各窝。" end
    if LV.tutorial then return LV.tutorial end
    if LV.thornX and not self.thornUsed and LV.seesawX then
        return "跷跷板要 2:1：整球太粗。让戴球猫穿过剪线刺，一剪两半，0.5 才好凑比例。"
    end
    if LV.thornX then return "剪开的半球拼不回去了——毛线只会变少。" end
    if LV.seesawX and not self.latched then
        return "猫=1，满球=1，半球/毡球=0.5。哪边是谁、哪边是球，2:1 才开门。"
    end
    if LV.basketX and not self.basketSet then return "把线团推进吊篮——但篮落时球会落在闸门的另一边。" end
    if LV.basketX and self.basketSet then return "闸门已开。谁去踩对面的释放钮？球会替你过去。" end
    if LV.pinGateX then return "窄缝门钻空猫，顶针感应门要戴毛的脑袋去蹭（开 1.3 秒）。" end
    if LV.slotX then return "窄缝只有 0.5 米高：只有空身猫和滚地的球能过。" end
    if LV.matX0 then return "地垫是单行道：球滚进去，会从另一头出来——想清楚再喂。" end

WoolRoom:
-- 第 1 关及后续教学房间的可复用机关。旧关卡继续使用原逻辑。
local Room = {}
local FX = require("FX")
local GRAVITY = 19
local STEP = 1 / 120
local CAT_W = 0.95
local EPS = 0.0001

-- 碰撞区域（坐标单位：米；1 米为一格）：
-- 出生区 ──────╲        ╱──── 按钮 A ──────│木门│── 窝
--               ╲______╱                   │    │
--               1格深，左右斜坡             高4.1格
-- 猫：宽0.95；汤圆背高1格，其余背高0.58；球：直径0.34。
-- 检测目的：脚触按钮→永久开门；进入窝的矩形→计数；踩汤圆背→多1格。
-- 边界：浅坑没有死亡区，球不会丢失；坡上可停/跳；贴门不能穿过；
-- 只有落在汤圆背上的猫获得支撑，水平移动不因队友挡路而卡住。

local function Copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do result[k] = Copy(v) end
    return result
end

local LESSONS = {
    "按 A / D 移动，带着线团出发。",
    "按空格跳跃。浅坑没有危险，也能直接走过去。",
    "按 1 / 2 / 3，或点击下方卡片切换猫咪。",
    "按 F 放下球，再按 F 抱起来",
    "踩下按钮 A，木门就会永久打开。",
    "把三只猫都送进窝，回家吃饭！",
}

function Room.CreateMachines(definitions)
    local machines = {}
    for i, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
        machines[i] = Copy(definition)
        machines[i].activated = false
        machines[i].open = definition.open or false
        machines[i].lift = 0
    end
    return machines
end

function Room.Machine(game, kind)
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.kind == kind then return machine end
    end
    return nil
end

function Room.FloorHeight(game, x)
    local pit = game.def.practicePit
    if not pit or x <= pit.x or x >= pit.x + pit.w then return 0 end
    local offset = x - pit.x
    if offset < pit.rampW then return -pit.depth * offset / pit.rampW end
    if offset > pit.w - pit.rampW then return -pit.depth * (pit.w - offset) / pit.rampW end
    return -pit.depth
end

function Room.Init(game)
    game.roomMachines = Room.CreateMachines(game.def.mechanisms)
    game.tutorial = { step = 1, moved = 0, jumped = false, switched = false,
        dropped = false, picked = false, skipped = false, dropOwner = 0 }
    for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
        cat.weight = 4 - i
        cat.jumpHeight = i == 2 and 2 or 1
        cat.jump = math.sqrt(2 * GRAVITY * cat.jumpHeight)
        cat.bodyH = i == 1 and 1 or 0.58
        cat.birthX, cat.birthY = cat.x, cat.y
        if i == 2 then cat.color = { 65, 68, 70, 255 } end
    end
    for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        ball.weight, ball.amount, ball.y = 3, 2, 0
    end
    game.autonomy = false
    print("[教学 1/6] " .. LESSONS[1])
    print("[第1关初始化] 三猫体重3/2/1，跳高1/2/1；整球3个，总毛线6；无损失区")
end

function Room.Size(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    local ball = game:CarriedBall(index)
    return CAT_W, cat.bodyH + (ball and ball.w * 0.85 or 0)
end

function Room.TutorialText(game)
    local lesson = game.tutorial
    if lesson.skipped or lesson.step > #LESSONS or game.won then return "" end
    return LESSONS[lesson.step]
end

function Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
    local lesson = game.tutorial
    if lesson.skipped then return end
    local farthest = 0
    for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do farthest = math.max(farthest, cat.x) end
    local button = Room.Machine(game, "button")
    local pit = game.def.practicePit
    -- 跳跃/选猫是提示而非强制关卡门槛。通过练习区可继续教学，
    -- 官方 D×10 序列无需额外跳跃；F 的气泡必须完成放+抱才会消失。
    while lesson.step <= #LESSONS do
        local complete = lesson.step == 1 and lesson.moved >= 0.6
            or lesson.step == 2 and (lesson.jumped or farthest >= pit.x - 1.5)
            or lesson.step == 3 and (lesson.switched or farthest >= pit.x)
            or lesson.step == 4 and lesson.picked
            or lesson.step == 5 and button.activated
            or lesson.step == 6 and game.won
        if not complete then break end
        lesson.step = lesson.step + 1
        print(string.format("[教学 %d/6] %s", math.min(6, lesson.step), LESSONS[lesson.step] or "全部完成"))
    end
end

function Room.SkipTutorial(game)
    if game.tutorial.skipped then return end
    game.tutorial.skipped = true
    game:PushUndo()
    print("[教学] 已跳过提示，关卡规则不变")
end

function Room.Select(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if not cat or cat.arrived or game.won or game.active == index then return end
    game.switches = game.switches + 1
    game.active = index
    game.jumpBuffer = 0
    game.tutorial.switched = true
    Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
    game:PushUndo()
    print("[选猫] " .. cat.name)
end

function Room.Jump(game)
    if game.won then return end
    game.jumpBuffer = 0.14
    game.started = true
end

function Room.Boxes(game)
    local boxes = {}
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.kind == "woodDoor" and not machine.open then
            boxes[#boxes + 1] = { x = machine.x, y = machine.y or 0, w = machine.w, h = machine.h }
        end
    end
    return boxes
end

local function ClampBall(game, x, ball, direction)
    local clamped = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - ball.w - 0.3, x))
    for _, box in ipairs(Room.Boxes(game)) do
        if clamped < box.x + box.w and clamped + ball.w > box.x then
            clamped = direction >= 0 and box.x - ball.w or box.x + box.w
        end
    end
    return clamped
end

function Room.GrabCandidate(game, index)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived or game.won then return nil end
    if cat.carry then return { mode = "drop", ball = game:CarriedBall(index).owner } end
    local cx = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
    local nearest, distance = nil, 0.85
    for i, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
        if not ball.carriedBy then
            local d = math.abs(ball.x + ball.w / 2 - cx)
            if d < distance and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.65 then
                nearest, distance = i, d
            end
        end
    end
    if not nearest then return nil end
    local ball = game.balls[nearest]
    local blocked = false
    for _, box in ipairs(Room.Boxes(game)) do
        if game:Overlaps(cat.x, cat.y, CAT_W, cat.bodyH + ball.w * 0.85, box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h) then
            blocked = true
        end
    end
    return { mode = "grab", ball = nearest, blocked = blocked }
end

function Room.ToggleCarry(game, index)
    local candidate = Room.GrabCandidate(game, index)
    if not candidate then return end
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if candidate.mode == "drop" then
        local ball = game:CarriedBall(index)
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy = false, nil
        ball.x = ClampBall(game, cat.facing > 0 and cat.x + CAT_W + 0.02 or cat.x - ball.w - 0.02, ball, cat.facing)
        ball.y, ball.vx = Room.FloorHeight(game, ball.x + ball.w / 2), 0
        game.tutorial.dropped, game.tutorial.dropOwner = true, ball.owner
        print("[放球] " .. cat.name .. " 放下整球；毛线总量 " .. game:YarnAmount())
    elseif not candidate.blocked then
        local ball = game.balls[candidate.ball]
        cat.carry, ball.carriedBy, ball.vx = true, index, 0
        if game.tutorial.dropped and game.tutorial.dropOwner == ball.owner then game.tutorial.picked = true end
        print("[抱球] " .. cat.name .. " 抱起线团；毛线总量 " .. game:YarnAmount())
    else
        print("[抱球] 木门附近头顶空间不足")
        return
    end
    Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
    game:PushUndo()
end

function Room.PressKey(game, key)
    if key == KEY_U then game:Undo()
    elseif key == KEY_R then game:Reset()
    elseif key == KEY_1 then game:Select(1)
    elseif key == KEY_2 then game:Select(2)
    elseif key == KEY_3 then game:Select(3)
    elseif key == KEY_TAB then game:Next()
    elseif key == KEY_F then game:ToggleCarry(game.active)
    elseif key == KEY_SPACE or key == KEY_UP or key == KEY_W then game:Jump()
    else return false end
    return true
end

function Room.TickCat(game, index, direction, dt)
    local cat = game.sheep[index]
    if cat.arrived then return end
    local oldX, oldY = cat.x, cat.y
    local wasGrounded = cat.grounded
    local x = math.max(0.3, math.min(game.def.roomWidth - CAT_W - 0.3, cat.x + direction * cat.speed * dt))
    local _, height = Room.Size(game, index)
    for _, box in ipairs(Room.Boxes(game)) do
        if game:Overlaps(x, cat.y, CAT_W, height, box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h) then
            if direction > 0 then x = box.x - CAT_W elseif direction < 0 then x = box.x + box.w end
        end
    end
    cat.x, cat.vx = x, direction * cat.speed
    if direction ~= 0 then
        cat.facing = direction
        cat.gait = cat.gait + dt * cat.speed * 4
        game.tutorial.moved = game.tutorial.moved + math.abs(x - oldX)
    end
    cat.coyote = wasGrounded and 0.1 or math.max(0, cat.coyote - dt)
    if index == game.active and game.jumpBuffer > 0 and cat.coyote > 0 then
        cat.vy = cat.jump
        cat.grounded, cat.support, cat.coyote = false, 0, 0
        game.jumpBuffer = 0
        game.tutorial.jumped = true
        game:AddEffect(cat.x + CAT_W / 2, cat.y, "dust")
        Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
        game:PushUndo()
        FX.Fire("jump")
        print(string.format("[跳跃] %s，设计峰高 %d 格", cat.name, cat.jumpHeight))
    end
    local floor = Room.FloorHeight(game, cat.x + CAT_W / 2)
    -- 贴地时跟随斜坡，起跳后则使用弹道；不把斜坡当墙或死亡坑。
    if cat.grounded and cat.support == -6 then
        cat.y, cat.vy = floor, 0
    else
        local nextY = cat.y + cat.vy * dt - GRAVITY * dt * dt / 2
        cat.vy = cat.vy - GRAVITY * dt
        cat.y, cat.grounded, cat.support = nextY, false, 0
        if cat.y <= floor and cat.vy <= 0 then
            cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = floor, 0, true, -6
        end
        -- 只有汤圆可以给队友当垫脚石，背高恰好 1 格。
        local orange = game.sheep[1]
        if index ~= 1 and not orange.arrived and cat.vy <= 0 then
            local back = orange.y + 1
            if oldY >= back - EPS and nextY <= back
                and cat.x + CAT_W > orange.x + 0.08 and cat.x < orange.x + CAT_W - 0.08 then
                cat.y, cat.vy, cat.grounded, cat.support = back, 0, true, 1
            end
        end
    end
    if cat.support == 1 and (cat.x + CAT_W <= game.sheep[1].x or cat.x >= game.sheep[1].x + CAT_W
        or game.sheep[1].arrived) then cat.grounded, cat.support = false, 0 end
    cat.dx, cat.dy = cat.x - oldX, cat.y - oldY
    cat.squash = math.max(0, cat.squash - dt * 3)
    if cat.grounded and not wasGrounded then cat.squash = 0.1 FX.Fire("land") end
    -- 脚边自由球可向前推，猫离开后球不会倒拖着跟随。
    if direction ~= 0 and cat.grounded then
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            local delta = ball.x + ball.w / 2 - (cat.x + CAT_W / 2)
            if not ball.carriedBy and direction * delta > 0 and math.abs(delta) < CAT_W / 2 + ball.w / 2
                and math.abs((ball.y or 0) - cat.y) < 0.3 then
                ball.x = ClampBall(game, direction > 0 and cat.x + CAT_W or cat.x - ball.w, ball, direction)
                ball.vx = 0
            end
        end
    end
end

function Room.ActivateButton(game, button)
    if button.activated then return false end
    button.activated = true
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.id == button.target then machine.open = true end
    end
    game.latched = true
    Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
    game:PushUndo()
    print("[按钮 " .. button.id .. "] 触发式：木门永久打开，按钮沉入地板")
    return true
end

function Room.TickMachines(game)
    for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
        if machine.kind == "button" and not machine.activated then
            for _, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                local cx = cat.x + CAT_W / 2
                if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded and math.abs(cat.y - (machine.y or 0)) < 0.08
                    and cx >= machine.x and cx <= machine.x + machine.w then
                    Room.ActivateButton(game, machine)
                    break
                end
            end
        elseif machine.kind == "nest" then
            for i, cat in ipairs(game.sheep) do
                if not cat.arrived and cat.grounded
                    and cat.x + CAT_W / 2 >= machine.x and cat.x + CAT_W / 2 <= machine.x + machine.w
                    and math.abs(cat.y - (machine.y or 0)) < 0.08 then
                    cat.arrived = true
                    cat.x = machine.x + 0.12 + (i - 1) * 1.0
                    cat.y, cat.vx, cat.vy = 0, 0, 0
                    game:AddEffect(cat.x + CAT_W / 2, 0.5, "home")
                    print("[进窝] " .. cat.name)
                    if game:ArrivedCount() == 3 then
                        game.won = true
                        print(string.format("[通关] 第1关，进窝3/3，毛线%d，%d星", game:YarnAmount(), game:Stars()))
                    elseif game.active == i then
                        game:Next()
                    end
                    Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
                    game:PushUndo()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Room.Update(game, dt, direction)
    local capped = math.min(dt, 0.08)
    game.clock = game.clock + capped
    if game.won then return end
    if direction ~= 0 then game.started = true end
    if game.started then game.elapsed = game.elapsed + capped end
    game.accumulator = game.accumulator + capped
    while game.accumulator >= STEP do
        game.accumulator = game.accumulator - STEP
        -- 开门/入窝是事件边界：一帧内的后续动作不能写到另一个猫身上。
        local active = game.active
        for i = 1, 3 do Room.TickCat(game, i, i == active and direction or 0, STEP) end
        game.jumpBuffer = math.max(0, game.jumpBuffer - STEP)
        for _, ball in ipairs(game.balls) do
            if ball.carriedBy then
                local cat = game.sheep[ball.carriedBy]
                ball.x, ball.y = cat.x + CAT_W / 2 - ball.w / 2, cat.y + cat.bodyH
            else
                ball.y = Room.FloorHeight(game, ball.x + ball.w / 2)
            end
        end
        Room.AdvanceTutorial(game)
        Room.TickMachines(game)
        for _, machine in ipairs(game.roomMachines) do
            if machine.kind == "woodDoor" then machine.lift = math.min(1, machine.lift + (machine.open and STEP * 3 or 0)) end
        end
        game.gateLift = Room.Machine(game, "woodDoor").lift
        game.undoTimer = game.undoTimer + STEP
        if game.undoTimer >= 1.2 then game.undoTimer = 0; game:PushUndo() end
        if game.won then break end
    end
    FX.StepEffects(game.effects, capped, "move")
end

function Room.PushUndo(game)
    local snap = { sheep = Copy(game.sheep), balls = Copy(game.balls), machines = Copy(game.roomMachines),
        tutorial = Copy(game.tutorial), active = game.active, elapsed = game.elapsed,
        won = game.won, started = game.started, latched = game.latched, switches = game.switches }
    local last = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    if last and last.active == snap.active and last.latched == snap.latched and last.won == snap.won
        and last.tutorial.step == snap.tutorial.step and last.tutorial.skipped == snap.tutorial.skipped
        and #last.balls == #snap.balls then
        local same = true
        for i = 1, #game.sheep do
            if math.abs(last.sheep[i].x - snap.sheep[i].x) > 0.02 or math.abs(last.sheep[i].y - snap.sheep[i].y) > 0.02
                or last.sheep[i].carry ~= snap.sheep[i].carry or last.sheep[i].arrived ~= snap.sheep[i].arrived then same = false end
        end
        for i = 1, #snap.balls do
            if last.balls[i].carriedBy ~= snap.balls[i].carriedBy or math.abs(last.balls[i].x - snap.balls[i].x) > 0.02
                or last.balls[i].kind ~= snap.balls[i].kind or last.balls[i].felt ~= snap.balls[i].felt then same = false end
        end
        if same then return end
    end
    game.undoStack[#game.undoStack + 1] = snap
    if #game.undoStack > 150 then table.remove(game.undoStack, 1) end
end

function Room.Undo(game)
    if #game.undoStack < 2 then return false end
    -- 尚未形成事件的尾部移动先记入时间轴，避免跳过最近的门/抱放事件。
    Room.PushUndo(game)
    table.remove(game.undoStack)
    local snap = game.undoStack[#game.undoStack]
    game.sheep, game.balls, game.roomMachines, game.tutorial = Copy(snap.sheep), Copy(snap.balls), Copy(snap.machines), Copy(snap.tutorial)
    game.active, game.elapsed, game.won, game.started = snap.active, snap.elapsed, snap.won, snap.started
    game.latched, game.switches = snap.latched, snap.switches
    game.jumpBuffer, game.accumulator, game.undoTimer = 0, 0, 0
    game.effects = {}
    game.gateLift = Room.Machine(game, "woodDoor").lift
    FX.Fire("undo")
    print("[回溯] 恢复上一个事件（包含选猫、教学、门、线团及进窝状态）")
    return true
end

return Room
YarnScissors:
-- 机关11：剪刀台。只做命中与形态转换；宿主关卡负责事件快照和球ID。
local Scissors = {}

function Scissors.New(x, width, height)
    return { kind = "scissors", number = 11, x = x, w = width or 1.4, h = height or 0.45 }
end

-- 碰撞区域（单位：格/米，Y向上）：
--       [猫中心必须在台面内部]
--       +------------------+ y = h
--       |    固定石台      | 宽w，高h；仅站稳的顶整球猫触发
-- ------+------------------+------ y = 0
--   半球1落左侧         半球2落右侧
-- 擦边/腾空不剪；空手、半球、毡球不剪；两个输出总毛线量等于输入。
function Scissors.Contains(machine, cat)
    local cx = cat.x + cat.w / 2
    return cat.grounded and not cat.arrived and cx > machine.x + 0.1 and cx < machine.x + machine.w - 0.1
        and math.abs(cat.y - machine.h) < 0.035 and math.abs(cat.vy) < 0.01
end

function Scissors.CanSplit(ball)
    return ball ~= nil and ball.kind == "full" and not ball.felt
end

function Scissors.Split(ball, machine)
    assert(Scissors.CanSplit(ball), "剪刀台只接受未毡化的整球")
    assert(ball.amount == 2, "整球毛线量必须为2")
    local width = 0.28
    local function Half(x)
        return {
            owner = ball.owner, kind = "half", felt = false, weight = 1, amount = 1,
            x = x, y = 0, w = width, h = width, vx = 0, vy = 0,
        }
    end
    return Half(machine.x - width - 0.25), Half(machine.x + machine.w + 0.25)
end

return Scissors
YarnSeesaw:
-- 可复用跷跷板：世界单位为米，左右板面各 2 格。
local Seesaw = {}
Seesaw.__index = Seesaw

function Seesaw.New(options)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Seesaw)
    self:Init(options or {})
    return self
end

function Seesaw:Init(options)
    self.pivotX = options.pivotX or 10
    self.pivotY = options.pivotY or 1.5
    self.halfLength = options.halfLength or 2
    self.threshold = options.threshold or 4
    self.rampX = options.rampX or 6
    self.maxAngle = math.asin(math.min(1, self.pivotY / self.halfLength))
    self.angle = 0
    self.target = 0
    self.leftWeight, self.rightWeight = 0, 0
    self.speed = options.speed or 1.6
end

-- 俯视投影 / 侧面碰撞示意（不是额外的机关）：
--        左 2 格           右 2 格
--    球/猫======\   ^   /======猫         高台 y=3
-- x=6 装载坡面   \ 支点 /                |  窝
-- 地面 y=0 -------\----/------------------|------
-- 检测：确实支撑在板上的猫、顶球、自由球 → 按总重倾斜并携带。
-- 边界：支点上的重量均分；空中经过不计重；离板即不再携带。
-- 低端不穿地，高端最大 y=3；装载坡面跟随低端，不存在碰撞缝隙。
function Seesaw:Point(distance)
    return self.pivotX + math.cos(self.angle) * distance,
        self.pivotY + math.sin(self.angle) * distance
end

function Seesaw:LocalAt(x)
    return (x - self.pivotX) / math.cos(self.angle)
end

function Seesaw:SurfaceAt(x)
    local distance = self:LocalAt(x)
    if distance < -self.halfLength - 0.0001 or distance > self.halfLength + 0.0001 then return nil end
    return self.pivotY + math.sin(self.angle) * distance
end

function Seesaw:RampAt(x)
    local leftX, leftY = self:Point(-self.halfLength)
    if x < self.rampX or x >= leftX then return nil end
    return leftY * (x - self.rampX) / (leftX - self.rampX)
end

function Seesaw:Weigh(entries)
    local left, right = 0, 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        if entry.support == "seesaw" then
            local distance = self:LocalAt(entry.x)
            if math.abs(distance) <= self.halfLength + 0.001 then
                if math.abs(distance) < 0.04 then
                    left, right = left + entry.weight / 2, right + entry.weight / 2
                elseif distance < 0 then left = left + entry.weight
                else right = right + entry.weight end
            end
        end
    end
    self.leftWeight, self.rightWeight = left, right
    local target = 0
    -- 本机关按左盘阈值优先，右端载猫(含顶球)不能额外取消左≥4的举升规则。
    if left >= self.threshold then target = self.maxAngle
    elseif right >= self.threshold then target = -self.maxAngle end
    local changed = target ~= self.target
    self.target = target
    return changed
end

function Seesaw:Update(dt)
    local oldAngle = self.angle
    local delta = self.target - self.angle
    local movement = math.min(math.abs(delta), self.speed * dt)
    self.angle = self.angle + (delta < 0 and -movement or movement)
    return oldAngle
end

function Seesaw:Snapshot()
    return { angle = self.angle, target = self.target,
        leftWeight = self.leftWeight, rightWeight = self.rightWeight }
end

function Seesaw:Restore(snapshot)
    self.angle, self.target = snapshot.angle, snapshot.target
    self.leftWeight, self.rightWeight = snapshot.leftWeight, snapshot.rightWeight
end

return Seesaw
